qa: Vragen van de leden Vos en Timmer (beiden PvdA) aan de minister van Economische Zaken over de compensatie van bedrijven die door kartels schade geleden hebben (ingezonden 27 april 2010).

MPs Vos and Timmer asked the Minister of Economic Affairs whether companies harmed by cartels should be compensated, whether a Dutch whistleblower reward scheme like a UK experiment would be introduced, and whether results of that experiment are known. The minister answered that liable parties should bear damages, pointed to the EU-level approach and the Dutch collective settlement act, said the UK scheme is discretionary and results are not published, and declined to introduce a whistleblower fund.
The OFT does not provide information on the results of this reward system, because recipients of rewards could be identified, endangering their safety and deterring potential informants.
Over de resultaten van dit beloningssysteem verstrekt de OFT geen informatie, omdat daardoor de ontvangers van beloningen achterhaald kunnen worden

Vragen van de leden Omtzigt, Ferrier (beiden CDA), Timmer en Kraneveldt-van der Veen (beiden PvdA) aan de ministers van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport en van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap over een cluster 3 school

MPs asked whether a school in Losser for children with an IQ of 35 or lower lacks structural care funding after the AWBZ package measures and why it has no education recognition from the municipality. The minister said the school needs municipal agreement, denied a confirmed funding gap, pointed to adjusted care classes and a EUR 10 million subsidy, and promised continued consultation with the health ministry.
It is not known whether there are no or fewer structural funds as a result of the AWBZ 2009 package measure for the care activities at the school.
Het is niet bekend of er geen of minder structurele middelen zijn als gevolg van de pakketmaatregel AWBZ 2009 voor de zorgactiviteiten op de school.

Vragen van de leden Timmer en Laaper (beiden PvdA) aan de ministers van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties en van Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid over de slechte bescherming van ambtenaren tegen agressie (ingezon

MPs Timmer and Laaper asked why many public-sector employers are unaware of or fail to comply with obligations to protect staff from aggression, and what the government will do. The ministers answer that the Veilige Publieke Taak programme, awareness campaigns and Labour Inspectorate inspections are being intensified, while acknowledging compliance remains insufficient.
Through the Veilige Publieke Taak programme of my Ministry I continue to pursue this important subject without reservation.
Door middel van het programma Veilige Publieke Taak van mijn Ministerie zet ik nog altijd onverkort in op dit belangrijke onderwerp.

Vragen van de leden Timmer en Spekman (beiden PvdA) aan de minister van Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid over de relatie tussen arbeidsomstandigheden en ziekte dan wel sterfte (ingezonden 3 mei 2010).

MPs Timmer and Spekman asked the Minister of Social Affairs about FNV figures showing over 3,000 work-related deaths a year, the weak coverage of sector OSH catalogues, under-registration by occupational physicians, and the low inspection frequency. The minister said the figures are not new and reflect past exposures, defended existing policy, and promised continued support for catalogues and registration efforts while rejecting statutory sanctions for lacking a catalogue.
I am of the opinion that the OSH policy is successful.
Ik ben van mening dat het arbobeleid succesvol is.

m: Gewijzigd amendement van het lid Duisenberg ter vervanging van nr. 9, waarmee mbo-opleidingen een groter deel van de associate degree-opleiding mogen verzorgen
Allows MBO institutions to deliver more than half of an associate degree programme in special cases, with ministerial approval on request from the higher education board.

At the request of the institution's board, the Minister may in special cases allow that less than half of such a programme, excluding the graduation phase and final examination, is delivered by the higher education institution.

Op verzoek van het instellingsbestuur kan Onze Minister in bijzondere gevallen toestaan dat minder dan de helft van een dergelijke opleiding, met uitzondering van de afstudeerfase en het afsluitend examen, door de instelling voor hoger onderwijs wordt verzorgd.
Amendement van het lid Duisenberg waarmee Mbo-opleidingen een groter deel van de associate degree-opleiding mogen verzorgen
Allows MBO institutions, in cooperation with a HBO institution, to deliver more of an associate degree programme while the minister still approves it.
If the Minister grants approval, he determines that the graduation phase and final examination are in any case provided by the higher education institution.

Indien Onze Minister goedkeuring als bedoeld in het eerst lid verleent, bepaalt hij daarbij dat in ieder geval de afstudeerfase en het afsluitend examen worden verzorgd door de instelling voor hoger onderwijs.

Nader gewijzigd amendement van het lid Duisenberg ter vervanging van nrs. 9 en 14 over het stellen van voorwaarden aan het toelatingsrecht

Amends the student admission rules so that non-qualification-obliged students lose the right to admission if they register late or skip mandatory intake activities, with institutions only permitted, not required, to refuse.
This amendment therefore provides that a non-qualification-obliged student may only invoke the right to admission if he or she registered on or before the statutory registration date.

Middels dit amendement wordt daarom geregeld dat niet-kwalificatieplichtige zich alleen kan beroepen op het toelatingsrecht, indien hij of zij zich heeft aangemeld voor of op de wettelijke aanmelddatum.

Motie van het lid Duisenberg c.s. over een academisch opleidingsniveau voor alle leraren in de bovenbouwklassen VWO
Asks the government to encourage academic-level teacher training for upper-secondary VWO teachers by 2020 as a starting point.
take academic training level for all teachers in these upper classes in 2020 as the starting point
het academisch opleidingsniveau voor alle leraren in deze bovenbouwklassen in 2020 als uitgangspunt te nemen
Amendement van het lid Van Meenen c.s. dat een herschikking van het extra vrijgekomen budget van 650 miljoen euro regelt
Amendment reallocating the extra 650 million euro education budget among primary, secondary, vocational, higher and university education.
This amendment arranges a reallocation of the extra freed-up budget of 650 million euros.
Dit amendement regelt een herschikking van het extra vrijgekomen budget van 650 miljoen euro.
Motie van het lid Rog c.s. over onderzoek naar lagere lasten van het accreditatiestelsel
Asks the government to study and pilot ways to substantially reduce administrative burdens of the education accreditation system and report to the House.
requests the government to investigate how the administrative burdens of the accreditation system can be substantially reduced
verzoekt de regering, te onderzoeken hoe de administratieve lasten van het accreditatiestelsel substantieel kunnen worden verlaagd
Motie van de leden Duisenberg en Mohandis over de rol van de opleidingscommissies in het verbeteren van de kwaliteit van het onderwijs
Asks the government, in consultation with the NVAO, to examine how programme committees can get a more explicit role in institutional and programme accreditation.
requests the government, in consultation with the NVAO, to examine how the programme committees can explicitly get a place
verzoekt de regering om, in overleg met de NVAO te bezien hoe de opleidingscommissies explicieter een plaats kunnen krijgen
Motie van het lid Duisenberg c.s. over de aanwijzingsbevoegdheid uit de brief Versterking Bestuurskracht Onderwijs
Asks the government to add the ministerial power of direction (aanwijzingsbevoegdheid) over higher education institutions to the quality assurance bill as soon as possible.
requests the government to incorporate the directive power from the letter Strengthening Education Governance into the bill as soon as possible
verzoekt de regering, de aanwijzingsbevoegdheid uit de brief Versterking Bestuurskracht Onderwijs zo spoedig mogelijk te verwerken in het wetsvoorstel
Gewijzigd amendement van het lid Duisenberg ter vervanging van nr. 41 over andere vormen van promotieonderwijs
Allows universities to offer PhD education, with the board setting rules for admission, organisation and assessment, and requires prior consent from the works council for those rules.
An institution may provide PhD education.
Amendement van het lid Duisenberg over andere vormen van promotieonderwijs
Adds a legal basis for institutions to offer doctoral education (promotieonderwijs), with board-set rules, admission conditions and fees for doctoral students.
This amendment provides that doctoral study programmes will be introduced in the Netherlands.
Dit amendement regelt dat er in Nederland promotiestudies komen.
Gewijzigd amendement van de leden Duisenberg en Mohandis ter vervanging van nr. 19 over het 60 ec per jaar in de verkorte HBO
Lets accelerated three-year HBO bachelor programmes for VWO students set 60 study credits per year instead of 80.
This amendment provides that the requirement of 80 study credits per year for three-year HBO programmes is changed to 60 study credits per year.
Dit amendement regelt dat de eis van 80 studiepunten per jaar voor 3 jarige HBO opleidingen wordt gewijzigd in 60 studiepunten per jaar.
Motie van het lid Duisenberg over de term "university of applied science"
Asks the government to promote and legally protect the term 'university of applied science' and consult with sector bodies.
requests the government to promote use of the term 'university of applied science' and protect that title in law
verzoekt de regering om, het gebruik van de term «university of applied science» te bevorderen en die titel in de wet te beschermen
Amendement van de leden Duisenberg en Mohandis over studievoorlichting
Amends the higher education law to extend mandatory study information with contact hours, study load, staff-student ratio, labour market prospects and follow-up master programmes.
the number of contact hours per programme
Amendement van de leden Duisenberg en Mohandis over het 60 ec per jaar in de verkorte HBO
Amendment changing the required study credits per year for three-year HBO bachelor programmes from 80 to 60, a higher education matter with no bearing on executive power.
in article 7.4, third paragraph, '80' is replaced by 60
wordt in artikel 7.4, derde lid, «80» vervangen door: 60
Amendement van de leden Duisenberg en Rog over hoger collegegeld voor honours tracks
Amends the higher education act so accreditation can cover a specific programme within a degree, allowing honours tracks to charge higher tuition.
The accreditation body may also grant the final judgment exclusively for a specific programme within a degree programme
Het accreditatieorgaan kan het eindoordeel, bedoeld in het eerste lid, onder c, ook verlenen uitsluitend ten aanzien van een bepaald programma binnen een opleiding
Amendement van het lid Duisenberg over andere vormen van promtieonderwijs
Allows universities to offer PhD education with rules set by the institutional board, subject to consent of the works council for admission and assessment rules.
Prior consent is also required for setting the admission conditions for PhD education
Voorafgaande instemming is tevens vereist voor het vaststellen van de voorwaarden voor toelating tot het promotieonderwijs
Motie van de leden Mohandis en Duisenberg over aanvullende (machts)middelen
Asks the government to pursue additional enforcement powers and legislation to recover student loans owed by people living abroad.
requests the government to work toward additional (enforcement) powers and legislation where needed
verzoekt de regering, in te zetten op het realiseren van aanvullende (machts)middelen en wet- en regelgeving
Motie van het lid Klaver c.s. over aanscherping van richtlijnen voor jaarrekeningen van onderwijsinstellingen
Asks the government to examine whether accounting guidelines for education institutions can be tightened so that no items are kept off the balance sheet.
to examine whether the guidelines for the annual accounts of education institutions can be tightened
te onderzoeken of de richtlijnen voor de jaarrekening van onderwijsinstellingen kunnen worden aangescherpt
Motie van het lid Duisenberg c.s. over het aflopen van het convenant Tweede Studies
Asks the minister to consult universities and universities of applied sciences to cushion the effects of the expiring 'Tweede Studies' covenant and inform the House.
requests the minister to consult with the VSNU and HBO-raad to absorb the consequences of the expiry of the Tweede Studies covenant
verzoekt de minister, in overleg te treden met de VSNU en de HBO-raad om de gevolgen van het aflopen van het convenant «Tweede Studies» op te vangen
qa: Antwoord op vragen van de leden Duisenberg en Van der Molen over het bericht 'Waarom moeten studenten betalen voor een bestuursjaar?'

MPs Duisenberg and Van der Molen asked the minister about reports that students serving as full-time student board members must still pay tuition despite not studying, and whether institutions should proactively grant the tuition exemption created by their amendment. The minister answered that the exemption is optional and left to institutional boards and works-council agreements, that the 87% figure refers to 53 of 61 full-time student board members, and that she will alert student organisations and sector associations and reports on the flexstuderen experiment.
The board makes arrangements with the works council on how the board grants are filled in.
Het bestuur maakt met de medezeggenschap afspraken over de invulling van de bestuursbeurzen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Duisenberg en Van der Molen inzake numeri fixi bij technische universiteiten

MPs Duisenberg and Van der Molen asked the minister about numerus fixus places at technical universities, the number of students turned away, and funding pressure on research. The minister answered that about 91 students could not enter their first-choice technical programme in 2016/17, that 2017/18 figures are not yet known, and that the investment fund proposal falls outside what a demissionary minister should take a position on.
Whether there will actually be a large over-enrolment in the eight TU programmes with a numerus fixus in academic year 2017–2018, I cannot say now.
Of er daadwerkelijk sprake zal zijn van een grote overinschrijving van de acht TU-opleidingen met een numerus fixus in collegejaar 2017–2018, kan ik nu niet zeggen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Duisenberg over het artikel ‘Wapens bij bestuurslid imamschool’

An MP asked the Education Minister about reports of fraud, weapons possession and people smuggling involving a board member of the Islamic University of Europe, and whether the Inspectorate and the minister can act, including on the institution's misleading use of the name 'university'. The minister condemned the conduct, said the Inspectorate's investigation is ongoing without a firm timeline, outlined intervention powers (warning, then withdrawal of degree-awarding authority), and committed to bringing the Name and Degree Protection Act into force by 1 June 2017 with fines as a sanction.
I will share the Inspectorate's conclusions with your House in due course.
Ik zal de conclusies van de inspectie te zijner tijd met uw Kamer delen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Duisenberg en Straus over het artikel ‘Schoolbestuur, waar is uw jaarrekening?’

MPs Duisenberg and Straus asked about a press report finding that many school boards do not publish their annual reports, despite agreements in the Good Governance Code, and what the government will do about it. The state secretary confirms the problem, says the government will amend sector laws and the reporting regulation to require publication if the agreements are not kept, and refers to the Inspectorate's forthcoming report.

Afterwards, further instructions on publishing the full annual report, consisting of the board report, the financial statements and other relevant documents, will be given in the Regulation on Education Annual Reporting.

Daarna worden in de Regeling Jaarverslaggeving Onderwijs nadere aanwijzingen omtrent de openbaarmaking van het gehele jaarverslag, bestaand uit zowel het bestuursverslag, de jaarrekening en overige relevante stukken gegeven.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jasper van Dijk en Duisenberg over het bericht dat bestuurders van de Universiteit Utrecht opnieuw royaal hebben gedeclareerd

MPs Van Dijk and Duisenberg asked the minister whether Utrecht University board members' lavish declarations (luxury hotels, business-class flights) after stricter rules were introduced are acceptable, and whether the accountant's reports were acted on. The minister replied that the inspectorate will investigate the accountant's flagged shortcomings and the declarations deviating from the regulation, will report by spring 2017, and that new uniform declaration rules apply from 2017.

The inspectorate will carry out further investigation into the shortcomings and will therefore examine the declarations and allowances to Utrecht University board members that deviate from the declaration regulation.

De inspectie zal nader onderzoek doen naar de tekortkomingen en zal dan ook de declaraties en vergoedingen aan bestuurders van de Universiteit Utrecht in ogenschouw nemen die afwijken van het declaratiereglement.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Boer, Duisenberg en Aukje de Vries over de uitgave van de Skûtsjekrant 2016

Three VVD MPs asked the minister whether the Binnenvaartbesluit and Binnenvaartregeling apply to historic sailing vessels, the bruine vloot and skûtsjes, what the effects are, whether there was consultation with the sector, and whether any fines have been issued. The minister answered that the rules have existed since 2009 with no known unclarity, that skûtsjes are exempted in key respects after sector consultation, that fines cannot be traced by vessel type, and that only the 31 December 2018 certificate obligation is new.
Fines issued in inland navigation since 2009 cannot be traced back to vessel type.
Boetes die in de binnenvaart sinds 2009 zijn afgegeven zijn niet naar type schip te herleiden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Lucas, Van Veen, Visser en Duisenberg over de financiering van kennisinstituut Wetsus na 2016

Four VVD MPs asked how the knowledge institute Wetsus, a public-private water technology research centre, would be financed after 2016 and whether it could be moved into NWO, KNAW or a TO2 status. The minister replied that funding continues through transition money, NWO calls, regional funds and private contributions, that structural funding falls outside IenM's remit, and that no move to NWO or KNAW is currently planned.
For the period from 2016 onward, the Wetsus funding is foreseen as follows.
Voor de periode vanaf 2016 is de Wetsus-financiering als volgt voorzien
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Duisenberg over het bericht dat opleidingen studenten verkeerd voorlichten over arbeidsmarktkansen

An MP asked the Minister of Education whether higher education institutions misinform students about labour market prospects, and whether they will fix the study guide, add an alumni monitor, improve study choice guidance, and consider an arbeidsmarktfixus. The minister acknowledged the error in the study guide, promised a corrected version and general update, agreed to explore alumni monitoring, and rejected an arbeidsmarktfixus for now while reviewing macro-efficiency policy.
I regret, like Studiekeuze123 and the VSNU, that this error was made.
Ik betreur, net als Studiekeuze123 en de VSNU, dat deze fout is gemaakt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Duisenberg en Rog over het artikel 'Groepsaansprakelijkheid bij onrechtmatige daad: Het blijft een bijzonder leerstuk'

MPs Duisenberg and Rog asked the Minister of Education, Culture and Science whether damages from the Maagdenhuis and Bungehuis occupations can be recovered from the occupiers, citing an insurance trade article. The Minister answered that recovery is impractical because perpetrators cannot be identified without investigating innocent students and staff, that the UvA and insurer concluded recovery is unlikely, and that the insurer paid out in full, so no concrete further action is planned.
I do not have this information. Nor is it for me to disclose confidential business information of the insurer.
Ik beschik niet over deze informatie. Het is ook niet aan mij om vertrouwelijke bedrijfsgegevens van de verzekeraar openbaar te maken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Anne Mulder en Duisenberg over de Wet werk en zekerheid

Two VVD MPs asked the Minister why the Wet werk en zekerheid prevents young researchers from carrying out their grant-funded research at their own university, and whether the law will be amended. The Minister attributes the problem to the growth of project funding, notes that the cao Universiteiten limits chained temporary contracts to four years, and says that UWV or mutual consent can end open-ended contracts when projects finish, so no amendment is planned and the issue will be raised with the VSNU.
We therefore see no reason to amend the Wwz, more specifically the so-called chain provision.
Wij zien dan ook geen aanleiding om de Wwz, meer in het bijzonder de zogenoemde ketenbepaling, aan te passen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Duisenberg en Mohandis over DaMu scholieren naar aanleiding van de uitzending "Alles voor je kind"

MPs Duisenberg and Mohandis asked the State Secretary about travel costs for DaMu dance and music pupils and whether existing schemes or funds could cover them. The State Secretary said no government scheme exists, estimated the cost of a student travel pass at about 600,000 euros, and announced from school year 2016/2017 an exceptional travel-cost contribution run by the Stichting DaMu.
After consultation with the Stichting DaMu, I have decided to provide, from school year 2016/2017 and in exceptional cases, a contribution towards travel costs for DaMu pupils.
Na overleg met de Stichting DaMu heb ik besloten om met ingang van schooljaar 2016/2017 in uitzonderlijke gevallen te voorzien in een tegemoetkoming van reiskosten voor DaMu-leerlingen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Duisenberg en Jasper van Dijk inzake het artikel Moslimrector opnieuw onder vuur, nu om haattweets

MPs Duisenberg and Van Dijk asked whether the Inspectorate will visit the Islamic University of Rotterdam again and whether the rector's renewed controversial tweets breach his agreements with the minister. The minister confirmed the Inspectorate visit, said the rector's statements breach the agreements and undermine trust, and announced a bill allowing recognition to be withdrawn for discriminatory statements by board members.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Duisenberg en Rog over de oproep om de slopers van het maagdenhuis aan te pakken

MPs Duisenberg and Rog asked the Minister of Education whether the damage from the Maagdenhuis occupation should be recovered from the vandals, including via group liability, and why the costs and deductible were handled as they were. The minister answered that the motion was considered executed, that group liability and tracing the perpetrators were judged unlikely to succeed and burdensome, and that she would not disclose the insurance contract details.
It is not for me to make confidential business information about the insurance agreement between the UvA and the insurer public.
Het is niet aan mij om vertrouwelijke bedrijfsgegevens over de tussen de UvA en de verzekeraar afgesloten verzekeringsovereenkomst openbaar te maken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Duisenberg over nieuwe uitspraken van de rector van de Islamitische Universiteit Rotterdam (IUR)

An MP asked the Minister of Education about repeated controversial statements by the rector of the Islamic University Rotterdam (IUR) and what the government would do if the governing board did not distance itself. The minister answers that the statements are unacceptable, that supervision by the inspectorate remains tightened, that the NVAO is assessing accreditation, and that she is preparing legislation to withdraw legal-person status where institutions fail to promote social responsibility.
I urgently asked the Supervisory Board and the foundation board to take measures.
Ik heb de Raad van Toezicht en het stichtingsbestuur dringend verzocht om maatregelen te nemen.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Potters en Duisenberg over de aanpak van radicalisering en de rol van het onderwijs, en de gezamenlijke verklaring van de EU-onderwijsministers in Parijs van 17 maart 2015

Two VVD MPs asked why radicalisation is framed within school social safety, why the minister signed the EU education ministers' Paris declaration without consulting parliament, and why the declaration omits explicit condemnation of radical ideology and EU democratic values, and who is responsible for follow-up. The minister answered that the approach is an integrated, sector-specific one, that parliament was informed in advance and a debate is offered, that the preamble stresses shared EU values, and that follow-up goes to the OJCS Council with subsidiarity as the guiding principle.
Your House was informed in advance of my intention to attend the conference in Paris to sign the declaration.
Uw Kamer is vooraf geïnformeerd over mijn voornemen om bij de conferentie in Parijs aanwezig te zijn om daar de verklaring te tekenen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Duisenberg inzake het bericht "The age of mooc: gratis online toponderwijs wordt door bedrijven én universiteiten ingekocht"

An MP asked the education minister about MOOCs being bought by universities and firms, and whether they could be integrated into the curriculum, recognised, and kept as a national ambition. The minister answered that institutions may integrate MOOCs as long as examination boards guarantee quality, that certificates are issued by institutions, and that she remains committed to open online higher education and a subsidy scheme.
I am willing to engage with the education sector if I receive signals of obstacles to integrating MOOCs and other forms of online education into the curriculum.
Ik ben bereid om het gesprek met het onderwijsveld aan te gaan, als ik signalen krijg van belemmeringen om mooc's en andere vormen van online onderwijs te integreren in het curriculum.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Duisenberg en Jadnanansing over de ‘Global Teacher Prize 2015’

MPs Duisenberg and Jadnanansing asked the state secretary about the 2015 Global Teacher Prize, the nomination of a Dutch history teacher, and whether online platforms could share the stories of the nominees. The secretary answered that the government supports the prize's aims, that learning from abroad matters, and that the ministry has started exploring online dissemination via its social media and a teachers' website.
We have started this exploration and it turns out that the Global Teacher Prize organisation is already very active on social media
Wij zijn deze verkenning gestart en het blijkt dat de organisatie van de Global Teacher Prize zelf al zeer actief is op social media
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Duisenberg en Azmani over het kort geding dat is aangespannen door twee vrouwen tegen de Islamitische Universiteit Rotterdam

MPs Duisenberg and Azmani asked about a summary-proceedings lawsuit by two women against the Islamic University of Rotterdam, the grounds for expelling students from non-funded programmes, and whether the institution's conduct should affect its accreditation. The minister answered that civil law governs non-funded institutions, that the court ordered the students reinstated, and that the Inspectorate and NVAO are conducting enhanced supervision and a visitation, with new legislation planned.
I have asked the Inspectorate to proceed with what in practice amounts to enhanced supervision.
Ik heb de Inspectie gevraagd om over te gaan tot wat in de praktijk neerkomt op verscherpt toezicht.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Duisenberg over het bericht “Bestuur Universiteit Utrecht declareert 24 mille aan onkosten”

An MP asked whether the Utrecht University board's EUR 24,000 in expense claims (dinners at starred restaurants, foreign trips) was justified and whether austerity should be anchored in the governance code. The minister answered that the sum covers three board members' claims over three years, that only seven meals cost EUR 470 in 2012 and none were at starred restaurants, that international trips serve strategic partnerships, and that existing expense rules and accountant checks are sufficient, so no further tightening is planned.
I see no reason to anchor the austerity any further.
Ik zie geen aanleiding om de versobering nog verder te verankeren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Straus en Duisenberg over Duits in de grensregio

MPs Straus and Duisenberg asked the education minister about shortages of German teachers, recruiting German teachers, and the role of German in border-region vocational education. The minister answered that shortages are a regional matter, that a German-teacher training programme and a small pilot already exist, and that she opposes replacing English with German in mbo, instead encouraging border institutions to use existing flexibility.
I have therefore, by letter, called on mbo institutions in the border regions to make greater use of the possibilities the mbo system offers them.
Ik heb daarom met een brief de mbo-instellingen in de grensregio's opgeroepen meer gebruik te maken van de mogelijkheden die het mbo-stelsel hen biedt.

Vragen van de leden Van Veen en Duisenberg (beiden VVD) aan de ministers van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport en van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap inzake het artikel «Vanaf 2014 loten voor hbo-studie Verpleegkunde aa

MPs Van Veen and Duisenberg asked why the Hanze University introduced a numerus fixus for nursing studies and whether nationwide internship places match future demand. The ministers answered that the number of places is an institutional decision, that shortages are primarily regional, that funding and regional programmes support placements, and that Europe plays no role.
A university of applied sciences may make such decisions itself and is responsible for its own choices.
Een hogeschool mag dit soort beslissingen zelf maken en is verantwoordelijk voor haar eigen keuzes.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Duisenberg over de kwaliteit van de Harvard Universiteit

An MP asked the education minister why DUO needs up to 8 to 12 weeks to assess Harvard's quality before granting student finance, arguing this is too slow for a student's deadline and that Harvard's excellence should make such a check quick. The minister answered that the maximum is 8 weeks plus 4 weeks at DUO, that actual processing averaged about 24 working days, that the assessment is complex and involves double testing, and that the procedure is adequate and gives students sufficient certainty.
In practice it has turned out that the investigation has also not taken more than a few days.
In de praktijk is gebleken dat het onderzoek ook niet meer dan enkele dagen in beslag heeft genomen.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Duisenberg en Straus over “Bumpy start for Pan European MOOCs”

MPs Duisenberg and Straus asked the education minister about reports of a bumpy start for the pan-European MOOC platform OpenupEd, and about US and Dutch online-learning participation figures. The minister answered that Dutch higher education has large opportunities in ICT-supported and open online learning, cited SURF, Wikiwijs and EU initiatives, and promised a policy letter in autumn 2013 on MOOCs and possible regulatory barriers.
I have promised your House to send a policy letter on this in the coming autumn.
Ik heb uw Kamer toegezegd hierover in het komend najaar een beleidsbrief te sturen.

m: Motie van het lid De Graaf over het instellen van een asielstop om Nederland te behoeden voor een etnisch-culturele en religieus-ideologische ramp
Motion asking the government to introduce an asylum stop.
requests the government to introduce an asylum stop
verzoekt de regering om een asielstop in te stellen
Motie van de leden De Graaf en Wilders over geen Marokkaans centrum in Nederland en duidelijk maken dat de gesloten deal er alsnog niet komt
Asks the government to tell Morocco that the proposed Moroccan centre in Amsterdam and the deal will not go ahead.
requests the government to make clear to the government of Morocco that the only Moroccan centre remains their own country and that the closed deal will not come after all
verzoekt de regering om aan de regering van Marokko duidelijk te maken dat het enige Marokkaanse centrum hun eigen land blijft en dat de gesloten deal er alsnog niet komt
Motie van het lid De Graaf over uitspreken dat het kabinet medeschuldig is aan de toename van antisemitisme, discriminatie en integratiegeweld
States that the cabinet is partly responsible for the rise in antisemitism, discrimination and integration violence because of migration.
declares that this cabinet is therefore partly responsible for the rise in antisemitism, discrimination and integration violence
spreekt uit dat dit kabinet daarmee medeschuldig is aan de toename van antisemitisme, discriminatie en integratiegeweld
Amendement van het lid De Graaf over middelen voor de Vereniging van Nederlandse Voedselbanken
Moves subsidy funds for 2023 from Vluchtelingenwerk Nederland under the integration article to the Vereniging van Nederlandse Voedselbanken.
the funds for the subsidy to Vluchtelingenwerk Nederland are reduced and transferred to the Vereniging van Nederlandse Voedselbanken
de middelen voor de subsidie aan Vluchtelingenwerk Nederland worden verlaagd en worden overgeheveld naar de Vereniging van Nederlandse Voedselbanken
Motie van het lid De Graaf over het in gang zetten van de verzelfstandiging van de landen van het Koninkrijk
Asks the government to treat decolonisation as complete and start a process of self-government for the Kingdom's constituent countries.
requests the government to regard the decolonisation process as completed
verzoekt de regering het proces van dekolonisatie als voltooid te beschouwen
Motie van de leden Léon de Jong en De Graaf over de grenzen sluiten voor alle asielzoekers en voor alle immigranten uit islamitische landen
Asks the government to close the Dutch borders to all asylum seekers and all immigrants from Islamic countries to protect the welfare state.
to close the Dutch borders to all asylum seekers and all immigrants from Islamic countries
de Nederlandse grenzen te sluiten voor alle asielzoekers en voor alle immigranten uit islamitische landen
Motie van de leden De Graaf en Wilders over het verzoek aan de onderhandelaars voor een nieuw kabinet om de-islamisering tot staand beleid te maken
Asks the coalition negotiators to make de-Islamisation official government policy and a central policy priority.
requests the negotiators ... to make de-Islamisation standing policy
verzoekt de onderhandelaars ... om de-islamisering tot staand beleid te maken
Motie van de leden Léon de Jong en De Graaf over pas sociale zekerheid voor immigranten na tien jaar in Nederland wonen en werken
Asks the government to ensure immigrants can claim Dutch social security only after ten years of living and working in the Netherlands without committing crimes.
requests the government to ensure that immigrants may only, after living and working in the Netherlands for ten years and committing no crimes, possibly claim Dutch social security

verzoekt de regering te bewerkstelligen dat immigranten pas nadat ze tien jaar in Nederland hebben gewoond en gewerkt en geen strafbare feiten hebben gepleegd, eventueel aanspraak kunnen doen op het ontvangen van Nederlandse sociale zekerheid
Motie van de leden Léon de Jong en De Graaf over de migratieachtergrond registreren van ontvangers van sociale zekerheid
Asks the government to register social security recipients by migration background, map separate rates and costs, and report yearly to the House with the Social Affairs budget.
to inform the House every year about this with the budget for Social Affairs and Employment
de Tweede Kamer daar ieder jaar bij de begroting Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid over te informeren
Motie van de leden Léon de Jong en De Graaf over alle uitkeringen aan statushouders intrekken en geen nieuwe verstrekken
Asks the government to withdraw all benefits from status holders and stop granting new ones.
requests the government to withdraw all benefits from status holders and grant no new benefits
verzoekt de regering alle uitkeringen van statushouders in te trekken en geen nieuwe uitkeringen meer te verstrekken
Motie van het lid De Graaf over een verbod op de azan
Asks the government to quickly consult municipalities so that the call to prayer from mosques is banned immediately.
requests the government to quickly consult with the municipalities where this occurs to arrange for it to be banned immediately
verzoekt de regering om snel met de gemeenten waar dit plaatsvindt, in overleg te gaan om te regelen dat dit direct wordt verboden
Motie van de leden De Graaf en Wilders over alle moskeeën sluiten
Asks the government to close all mosques and give the buildings another use.
requests the government to close all mosques and give the buildings in question another purpose
verzoekt de regering om alle moskeeën te sluiten en de betreffende gebouwen een andere bestemming te geven
Motie van het lid De Graaf over de finale afronding van het dekolonisatieproces
Asks the government to use talks with the other Kingdom countries to finalise decolonisation so they can leave the Kingdom within five years.
requests the government to use consultation with the other countries to quickly finalise the decolonisation process
verzoekt de regering het overleg met de andere landen te gebruiken om snel werk te maken van de finale afronding van het dekolonisatieproces
Motie van het lid De Graaf over erkennen dat de geweldloze jihad hetzelfde doel heeft als de gewelddadige

MPs Wilders and De Graaf asked whether State Secretary Van Huffelen misinformed the House about the duty of island governors (gezaghebbers) in the Caribbean Netherlands to vote in the executive board under the WolBES, and whether she would apologise to Bonaire's governor. The State Secretary replied that she had not misinformed the House, that the governor has a principled duty to vote only when a vote takes place, that consensus is normally sought, and that she sees no reason to apologise.
The House has not been misinformed by me.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Helder, Markuszower en de Graaf over het bericht ‘Hoofddoek boa moet kunnen’

MPs Helder, Markuszower and De Graaf asked whether Arnhem's decision to allow headscarves on municipal enforcement officers' (boa) uniforms conflicts with two adopted House motions, and what the minister will do about it. The minister said municipal councils may adopt their own motions, that a national guideline on boa uniform neutrality will be drafted in dialogue with the VNG and local government, and that the choice of instrument will be reported to the House in spring.

To this end, I will, in dialogue with the Association of Netherlands Municipalities (VNG) and local government, draft a guideline that secures the neutrality and nationwide uniformity and recognisability of the boa uniform.

Hiertoe zal ik, in dialoog met de Vereniging van Nederlandse Gemeenten (VNG) en het lokaal bestuur, een richtlijn opstellen waarin de neutraliteit en landelijke uniformiteit en herkenbaarheid van het boa-uniform worden geborgd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Markuszower en De Graaf over het bericht dat het CBS gaat stoppen met onderscheid maken tussen een ‘westerse’ en ‘niet-westerse’ achtergrond

PVV MPs asked the ministers whether abandoning the 'western' versus 'non-western' background classification by Statistics Netherlands (CBS) hides immigration problems, and urged the CBS to be called to order. The government replied that the CBS will keep recording origin and migration background, that the categories lost meaning, and that the minister will not interfere with the CBS's statistical categorisation because it is an independent administrative body.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Helder en De Graaf over het bericht ‘Klokkenluiders terrorismepolitie: er zijn “wandelende tijdbommen” die zomaar aanslag kunnen plegen’

PVV MPs Helder and De Graaf asked the Justice Minister about reports of mismanagement at the counterterrorism police unit CTER, including unsupervised radicalised returnees, understaffing and whistleblower complaints ignored by leadership. Minister Grapperhaus answered that the Inspectorate of Justice and Security has started an exploratory investigation, that no earlier signals had reached him, that CTER has 17 vacancies out of 128 fte, and that he will inform parliament once the Inspectorate concludes.
The Inspectorate operates independently. Therefore it is up to them to determine when the investigation is concluded.
De Inspectie opereert onafhankelijk. Daarom is het aan hen te bepalen wanneer het onderzoek is afgerond.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Helder en De Graaf over het bericht 'Falende screening: racende agent kon gewoon doorwerken’

PVV MPs Helder and De Graaf asked the Minister of Justice and Security how a police trainee whose relatives were reportedly in Syria, possibly involved in terrorism, could complete training, and what would be done about the resulting damage to trust. Minister Grapperhaus declined to discuss the case, explained the current screening instruments, said integrity remains a core value and that VIK reforms and the new screening law are underway.
I do not wish to go into concrete case details.
Ik wil niet ingaan op concrete casuïstiek.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Markuszower, De Graaf en Wilders over het bericht ‘Mohammed B. opnieuw door het lint in de gevangenis’

PVV MPs asked the Minister for Legal Protection about a 2019 prison incident in which two terrorism detainees damaged a gym, causing about 34,000 euro in damage, and why the news came out a year later, and whether terrorist detainees should be fully isolated, moved to the EBI, and deported. The minister said the incident was published in the October 2019 monthly incident overview, that one detainee was punished and reported while the other was punished without a report, and rejected full isolation and a higher security regime as unnecessary and contrary to human rights law, saying deportation of a non-resident is pursued via the return service with a long entry ban.
The newspaper report concerns an incident that took place on 20 September 2019.
Het krantenbericht gaat over een incident dat plaatsvond op 20 september 2019.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Wilders, Markuszower en De Graaf over het bericht 'Greenpeace gooit opnieuw keien op zeebodem: 'Levensgevaarlijke actie''

PVV MPs asked whether Greenpeace dumping boulders on the North Sea bed endangers fishers, whether this should be prosecuted as attempted murder or manslaughter, why the Dutch flag can be kept, and whether Greenpeace can be banned. The Minister replied that prosecution is for the Public Prosecution Service, which is examining the matter, that the flag cannot be withdrawn under Dutch law, and that only a court on Public Prosecution Service request can dissolve an organisation.
A judgement on the criminality of this conduct is for the Public Prosecution Service.
Een oordeel over de strafbaarheid van dit handelen is aan het Openbaar Ministerie.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Graaf en Wilders over het bericht 'gemeente Venlo zoekt naar andere locatie voor beachveld'

Two PVV MPs asked the Minister of Social Affairs about a Venlo municipality plan to relocate a beach volleyball pitch after objections from a nearby mosque, including questions framing Muslim demands as incompatible with Western culture and proposing that the mosque be moved abroad. The minister answered that the matter is local, rejected the framing of objections as 'gezever' and of Islam as making 'demands', and declined to intervene.
No, this concerns a local matter.
Nee, het betreft hier een lokale aangelegenheid.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Graaf en Wilders over het bericht ‘Hoe een Haagse moskee een verzamelplaats voor jihadisten werd,’

Two PVV MPs asked the Justice Minister why a The Hague mosque allegedly became a gathering place for jihadists, whether the municipality's radicalisation approach is evidence-based, and whether the mosque should be closed and administrative detention introduced. The minister defended the persoonsgerichte aanpak as evidence-supported, declined to name individuals, rejected closing the mosque and rejected administrative detention as incompatible with the rule of law.
I cannot go into individual cases.
Ik kan niet ingaan op individuele gevallen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Graaf en Wilders over het bericht ‘Vrijdaggebed van de krappe moskee naar een ruim bemeten voetbalveld’

Two PVV MPs asked whether Muslim public prayer gatherings should be banned during the coronavirus period, whether all municipalities should be told to stop them, and when all mosques will be closed. The Minister answered that freedom of religion, assembly and expression apply equally to all religious gatherings, that the government will not ban or close all mosques, and gave no commitment to action.
The same rules therefore apply to all types of religious gatherings in the Netherlands; no distinction is made based on religious belief.
Voor alle soorten religieuze samenkomsten gelden dan ook dezelfde regels in Nederland, er wordt geen onderscheid gemaakt naar religieuze overtuiging.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Graaf en Wilders over het bericht ‘IS op de weg terug’

Two MPs asked the Justice Minister about a press report that IS is making a comeback in Syria, Iraq and Europe, and what this means for threat levels and border policy. The minister answered that the jihadist threat to Europe has fallen since 2017 but remains significant, that closing borders to all Muslims or asylum seekers is not a realistic solution, and that counter-terrorism cooperation continues.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Graaf, Beertema en Wilders over het bericht ‘islamitische school hoort erbij’

PVV MPs asked whether an Islamic secondary school in Rotterdam should be denied funding, questioning the government's support for it and calling for all Islamic education to be abolished. The minister replied that the school's application met the statutory conditions under the WVO and that freedom of education is constitutionally protected, so neither revoking the permit nor abolishing Islamic education would be done.
The request from the Stichting voor Islamitisch Voortgezet Onderwijs Rotterdam (SIVOR) was assessed against the applicable laws and regulations.
Het verzoek van de Stichting voor Islamitisch Voortgezet Onderwijs Rotterdam (SIVOR) is getoetst aan vigerende wet- en regelgeving.

Two PVV MPs asked the government how two women who joined IS and their children reached the Dutch embassy in Ankara, and whether such returnees should be permanently barred from Dutch soil. Beyond that, we cannot go into individual cases.
Voor de rest kunnen wij hier niet op individuele gevallen ingaan.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Graaf en Wilders over het bericht ‘Blauwe moskee wil gebedsoproepen met luidsprekers versterken’

Two MPs from the PVV asked whether mosques should be closed given their alleged danger to democracy and minority rights, and what action the government would take against Friday prayer calls amplified by loudspeakers. The minister answered that founding mosques falls under religious, association and expression freedoms so closing all mosques is not an option, and that prayer calls are permitted under the Wet openbare manifestaties, with municipalities able to set rules on duration and volume.
To protect these important hard-won freedoms, the government will never resort to closing all mosques in the Netherlands.
Ter bescherming van deze belangrijke verworven vrijheden zal de overheid nooit overgaan tot het sluiten van alle moskeeën in Nederland.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Wilders en De Graaf over berichten ‘Invloed IS op Haags jeugdwerk’ en ‘De Marokkanen nemen in de buurthuis de boel over’

PVV MPs asked the ministers about reports of IS influence in Hague youth work and Moroccan takeover of a neighbourhood centre, and proposed measures including dismissals, closures, preventive detention, denaturalisation, mosque closures and ending diversity policy. The minister rejected the far-reaching proposals as disproportionate or contrary to the rule of law, while confirming a youth worker with radical views was dismissed and that deradicalisation funding continues.

Administrative detention, in the sense of a kind of preventive detention, is not one of the cases listed in Article 5 of the European Convention on Human Rights in which deprivation of liberty is possible.

Administratieve detentie, in de zin van een soort preventieve detentie, is niet één van de in artikel 5 van het Europees Verdrag voor de Rechten van de Mens (EVRM) genoemde gevallen waarin vrijheidsontneming mogelijk is.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid De Graaf over het bericht ‘All-points alert out for “most dangerous Portuguese terrorist of them all’

An MP asked whether the government would press Portugal to bar a Dutch-Portuguese dual national who joined ISIS from entering Portugal or Schengen, and whether her Dutch rights had been forfeited. The government declined to comment on individual cases, explained the conditions under which Dutch nationality can be revoked, and said it has no jurisdiction over other states' nationality decisions.
Furthermore, the cabinet does not comment on individual cases.
Verder gaat het kabinet niet in op individuele zaken.
Antwoord op vragen door de leden Van Aalst, De Graaf en Wilders over het bericht dat Arriva haar personeel afvalt als zij het boerkaverbod in de bus handhaven

PVV MPs asked whether the government would condemn Arriva for dismissing a bus driver who enforced the face-covering ban, and whether they would act against transport operators refusing to enforce it. The minister answered that both driver and police acted lawfully, that enforcement is a police and prosecutor task, that operators must only ask riders to remove face coverings, and that no operator currently refuses to comply, so no action is planned yet.
Contacts with public transport companies currently do not show that they refuse to comply with the law.
Uit de contacten met de openbaar vervoer bedrijven blijkt op dit moment niet dat zij de wet weigeren na te leven.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Graaf over het bericht ‘Smalle A7 bij Marum zorgt voor hachelijke situaties’

An MP asked the minister whether the narrowed A7 near Marum, with two-way traffic on one lane, is dangerous, how many accidents occurred, and whether the design followed Rijkswaterstaat guidelines. The minister answered that nine accidents occurred in the period, causation could not yet be established, the CROW guideline was followed, and the works finished on schedule at the end of August.
At this moment it cannot be established whether there is a link between the accidents and the works.
Op dit moment is niet vast te stellen of er een verband is tussen de ongevallen en de werkzaamheden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Graaf en Wilders over het bericht ‘U.S. State Department issues travel advisory for Netherlands due to terrorism concerns’

PVV MPs De Graaf and Wilders asked why the Dutch public is not informed about terrorism risks as the US State Department issued a travel advisory for the Netherlands, and whether the threat is increasing, and proposed closing borders and administrative detention. Minister Grapperhaus answered that the threat level remains level 4 of 5 (substantial), that the US advisory is unchanged rather than raised, and that the NCTV informs the public periodically.
The U.S. Department of State re-issued the travel advisory for American travellers to the Netherlands on 19 July 2019, without changes from the previous period.
De U.S. Department of State heeft het reisadvies voor Amerikaanse reizigers in Nederland op 19 juli 2019 opnieuw vastgesteld, zonder wijzigingen ten opzichte van de vorige periode.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Graaf en Wilders over het bericht 'Eritreeër verdacht van verkrachting in Oisterwijk: ‘Het is opgelost, we gaan trouwen’'

MPs De Graaf and Wilders asked the Justice and Security Minister about a news report on an Eritrean suspect in a rape case in Oisterwijk, including whether such cases are common and whether the suspect should be prosecuted and expelled. The Minister condemned sexual violence, noted police capacity, declined to comment on the ongoing case, said figures on comparable cases are not registered, and left prosecution decisions to the Public Prosecution Service.
It does not befit me as Minister to make statements about the case at this time.
Het past mij als Minister niet op dit moment uitspraken te doen over de betreffende zaak.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Graaf, Beertema en Wilders over het bericht dat er op een basisschool in Tilburg ramadanvoorlichting wordt gegeven aan kinderen door de GGD

Three PVV MPs asked the Minister of Social Affairs whether a Tilburg primary school's GGD-provided Ramadan information for children should be stopped, and about the societal costs of Ramadan and measures to keep Islam-related promotion out of health care, education and public media. The minister confirmed the facts, said schools may organise such activities under freedom of education and religion, referred the GGD question to the health minister, declined to quantify costs, and stated that Islam enjoys the same protections as other religions.
I see no reason to look into this.
Ik zie geen aanleiding om hiernaar te kijken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Markuszower, De Graaf en Wilders over het bericht ‘Onduidelijkheid over blokkeermoslims’

PVV MPs asked the Justice Minister why the Public Prosecution Service acted quickly against 'blokkeerfriezen' but not against 'blokkeermoslims' who disrupted a demonstration, and whether he would instruct prosecution and guarantee the right to demonstrate. The Minister said a criminal investigation is ongoing and declined to comment on the case, refused to instruct prosecutors in individual cases, and stated that mayors are responsible for maintaining public order under the Public Assembly Act.
There is an ongoing criminal investigation. While this investigation is ongoing, I cannot comment on this criminal case.
Er is sprake van een lopend strafrechtelijk onderzoek. Lopende dit onderzoek kan ik geen uitlatingen doen over deze strafzaak.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Graaf en Wilders over het bericht 'Betoging Pegida in Eindhoven opnieuw verboden'

Two PVV MPs asked why a Pegida demonstration in Eindhoven was banned again and whether all mayors would be reminded that Dutch law, not sharia, applies. The minister answered that protest management is a mayoral responsibility, that demonstrations may only be banned as a last resort and never because of their content, and that no letter to all mayors is planned.
Banning or ending a (peaceful) demonstration is a last resort and only applies when necessary to protect public health, traffic, or to prevent or combat public disorder.

Daarbij geldt dat het verbieden of beëindigen van een (vreedzame) demonstratie een uiterst middel is en uitsluitend aan de orde is als dat noodzakelijk is ter bescherming van de volksgezondheid, in het belang van het verkeer of ter bestrijding of voorkoming van wanordelijkheden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Graaf, Fritsma en Wilders over het bericht ‘Syriëstrijder opgepakt in Kapelle’

PVV MPs asked the Justice Minister about reports of a Syria fighter arrested in Kapelle, asking how many such persons entered the Netherlands, how screening failed, and whether they would stop admitting asylum seekers from Islamic countries and denaturalise terrorists. The minister declined to discuss the individual case, said screening and signal-reporting procedures exist, rejected closing borders as unrealistic, and noted nationality can only be revoked for convicted terrorists who hold another nationality.
I cannot go into the facts and circumstances of this individual case.
Op de feiten en omstandigheden in dit individuele geval kan ik niet ingaan.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Graaf, Markuszower en Wilders over het bericht 'Jihadboeken in bajesbieb/Haatlectuur op bestelling'

Three PVV MPs asked whether Islamic books inciting hatred and violence are available in prisons, how many Islamic chaplains and Muslim prisoners there are, and whether Islamic books should be banned and imams dismissed. The minister answered that detainees may read religious literature unless it threatens order or security, that the director may refuse books inciting discrimination or violence, that DJI employs 43 FTE Islamic chaplains without central registration of detainees' religion, and rejected banning books or dismissing imams.
Detainees are not centrally registered by religion or belief.
Gedetineerden worden niet centraal geregistreerd op religie of levensbeschouwing.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Graaf en Wilders over het bericht dat de politie in Limburg negen islamitische nachtmaaltijden organiseert

Two PVV MPs asked whether it is absurd that the Limburg police organise nine Islamic night meals and whether these should be cancelled in favour of fighting crime. Minister Grapperhaus answered that police units decide locally on community activities across many groups, that police should remain neutral and connected to all groups, and that he supports such activities as strengthening community ties and authority.
The way in which policy can best be given form locally and which activities accompany it, I leave to the police units themselves.
De wijze waarop het beleid lokaal het beste vorm gegeven kan worden en met welke activiteiten dat gepaard gaat, laat ik aan de politie-eenheden zelf.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Beertema, Wilders en De Graaf over het bericht 'Moslimdocenten wilden mij weg hebben'

MPs from the PVV asked whether a teacher's criticism of Islam, immigration and climate policy outside school is permitted, whether other teachers were pushed out for criticising Islam, and whether school managers should face consequences for how a teacher was treated by Muslim colleagues. The minister confirmed a teacher may voice criticism outside school, said no similar cases are known, and declined to judge the individual school situation, leaving it to school leadership.
It is not appropriate for me to pass judgment on that based on a newspaper article.
Het past mij niet om daarover op basis van een krantenartikel een oordeel te vellen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Graaf en Wilders over het bericht ‘Groen licht voor islamitisch meisjesinternaat in Blerick’

PVV MPs asked the Minister of Social Affairs whether a Blerick Islamic girls' boarding school should be closed and whether all Islamic boarding and weekend schools should be shut, given sharia-based teaching. The minister confirmed awareness of the report, rejected closure, and said supervision of youth boarding facilities lies with the municipality, whose mayor can close one only on a well-founded suspicion of an offence or serious threat to a minor's development.
After the youth residence opens, the institution falls under the supervision established by the Youth Residences Act.
Na opening van het jeugdverblijf valt de instelling onder het toezicht dat is gerealiseerd met de Wet op de jeugdverblijven.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Wilders en De Graaf over het bericht 'Onrust in Maastrichtse wijk om komst 'jihadbruid' Aïcha''

MPs De Graaf and Wilders asked the Justice Minister about reports of unrest in a Maastricht neighbourhood over the expected return of a woman who had travelled to IS territory, and whether she should be permanently barred, preventively detained and stripped of Dutch nationality. Minister Grapperhaus answered that Dutch nationals cannot be denied entry, returnees are questioned and may be prosecuted, a multidisciplinary case consultation is used, preventive detention without reasonable suspicion is not permissible, and nationality can be revoked only after a terrorism conviction or, for dual nationals, for joining a terrorist organisation.
As you know, I do not go into individual cases.
Zoals u weet ga ik niet in op individuele zaken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid De Graaf over uitspraken van de Raad van State inzake jihadisten

The MP asks whether the Dutch government is sure two jihadists identified in Raad van State rulings are not in the Netherlands, and whether it will ensure they never return and are imprisoned and deported if they do. The minister declines to comment on individual cases, says the State Secretary is examining the rulings' consequences for citizenship revocations, and describes the steps for returnees including arrest, prosecution and possible revocation of Dutch nationality.
The State Secretary is currently examining the Raad van State ruling to see what it means for these and other already taken decisions to revoke Dutch nationality.
Momenteel onderzoekt de Staatssecretaris de uitspraak van de Raad van State om te bezien wat dit betekent voor deze en andere reeds genomen besluiten tot intrekking Nederlanderschap
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Wilders, De Graaf en Beertema over het bericht 'Opnieuw geschiedvervalsing in Nederlands schoolboek'

PVV MPs asked why a VMBO textbook allegedly omits Jewish history of Jerusalem and the Middle East and wanted the government to ensure historically accurate teaching. The minister replied that the content of teaching materials is for schools to assess under freedom of education, pointing to school complaint and participation routes and criminal law limits.

As I and my predecessors have already indicated to your House in many earlier written questions on this subject, it is not for the cabinet to assess the content of teaching materials, but for schools.

Zoals ik en mijn voorgangers aan uw Kamer in vele eerdere schriftelijke vragen hierover ook al hebben aangegeven, is het niet aan het kabinet om de inhoud van leermiddelen te beoordelen, maar aan scholen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Graaf, Beertema en Wilders over het bericht 'Leerkracht geschorst na beledigen profeet'

PVV MPs asked the Education Minister whether a teacher's suspension after insulting the prophet shows that yielding to Islam is a pattern, whether intimidating pupils should have been punished instead, and whether the government will act to reinstate the teacher. The minister denied endorsing the premise, said school boards decide on suspensions within legal limits, and declined to intervene in the case.
In practice it is up to the board, school leader, teachers, parents and pupils to make arrangements with each other, within the limits of the law, about the school culture.
In de praktijk is het aan het bestuur, schoolleider, leraren, ouders en leerlingen om met elkaar en uiteraard binnen de grenzen van de wet afspraken te maken over de invulling van een schoolcultuur
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Graaf, Fritsma en Wilders over het bericht ‘Vrouwelijke IS’er wil naar Nederland’

PVV MPs asked the Justice Minister whether a female IS member wanting to return to the Netherlands could be permanently denied residence, citizenship and entry. The state secretary declined to comment on individual cases and only set out general naturalisation, residence and Schengen entry conditions, including refusal on public order or national security grounds.
As you know, I do not comment on individual cases.
Zoals u weet ga ik niet op individuele zaken in.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Graaf, Beertema en Wilders over het bericht «Turkije gaat weekendscholen financieren in Nederland»

MPs De Graaf, Beertema and Wilders asked whether the government would bar Turkish-funded weekend schools in the Netherlands, given concerns about foreign influence on children's education, and whether they should be banned. The minister answered that such informal schools fall outside education law, so the Inspectorate has no powers and they cannot be banned, while the government shares concerns about integration and anti-democratic teaching and has raised them with Turkey, which promised transparency and information sharing.
At present the cabinet does not have full insight into the nature and scale of informal education at, among others, weekend schools.
Op dit moment heeft het kabinet geen volledig zicht op de aard en omvang van het informeel onderwijs op onder andere weekendscholen
Antwoord op vragen van het lid De Graaf over het bericht ‘Rookgordijnen rond Bilal L.’

An MP from the PVV asked the Justice and Social Affairs ministers whether they would strip Bilal L. and Abderrazak A.O. of Dutch nationality and expel them, and whether they would clear the Stopera of Islamist criminal and jihad-facilitating elements. The Minister replied that nationality can be withdrawn only for terrorist convictions or threats to national security and not if the person would become stateless, and rejected the depicted picture, pointing to Amsterdam municipality's responsibility for the local jihadism approach.
I do not recognise the picture you have sketched. The municipality of Amsterdam is responsible for the Amsterdam local approach to jihadism and its implementation.
Ik herken me niet in het door u geschetste beeld. De gemeente Amsterdam is verantwoordelijk voor de Amsterdamse lokale aanpak jihadisme en de uitvoering daarvan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid De Graaf over het bericht ‘Examenlek nieuwkomers via besloten netwerken’

An MP from the PVV asked ministers whether participants in an alleged leak of exam questions via social media should be treated as criminals, deported, and whether asylum-route arrivals should be returned. The government answered that sharing recollections of exam questions is not criminal fraud, that deportation applies only under specific legal criteria after conviction, and that asylum status holders cannot generally be returned via safe countries.
Sharing information about the exam questions based on recollections does not qualify as fraud in the criminal sense.
Dit delen van informatie over de examenopgaven, gebaseerd op herinneringen, kwalificeert zich niet als fraude in de strafrechtelijke betekenis.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Markuszower en De Graaf over het bericht ‘Jihad-opruier Mounim A. komt vrij’

PVV MPs asked the Justice Minister whether he would act against judges who released a jihad-inciter and urged administrative detention of jihadists. The minister defended the independence of judges, refused to intervene in individual cases, and rejected administrative detention as unjustified, pointing to criminal-law and other measures instead.
Administrative detention, in the sense of preventive detention without a reasonable suspicion, is not a justified deprivation of liberty.
Administratieve detentie, in de zin van preventieve detentie zonder dat sprake is van een redelijke verdenking, is geen gerechtvaardigde vrijheidsontneming.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Wilders, Agema, De Graaf en Markuszower over de door een prediker gedane uitspraak in een online cursus van de As Soenah moskee te Den Haag, te weten: ‘Vrouwenbesnijdenis is niet verplicht

MPs Wilders, Agema, De Graaf and Markuszower asked about a preacher's statement that female genital cutting is recommended though not mandatory, and how many girls were cut, how many cases were prosecuted, and what subsidised organisations do. The minister answered that prevalence research is under way with results expected mid-2019, that cutting is prosecuted as assault, that cases are not registered separately, and that the government funds an integrated chain approach and will report on it in a progress letter.
It therefore cannot be retrieved from the registers how many court cases of genital mutilation there are.
Het is daarom niet uit de registers te halen om hoeveel rechtszaken van genitale verminking het gaat.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Graaf, Beertema en Wilders over het bericht “Syriërs sturen kinderen naar weekendscholen”

PVV MPs asked the government about Syrian weekend schools (informal Islamic/Koranic education), whether they should be closed and funded organisations dissolved, and whether all Syrian asylum seekers and status holders should be returned to Syria. The minister answered that this is informal education not covered by education law, that the government lacks structural oversight of it, and that closing it or returning refugees is rejected.
At present the cabinet has no structural insight into the nature and scale of education at, among others, weekend schools.
Op dit moment heeft het kabinet geen structureel zicht op de aard en omvang van het onderwijs op onder andere weekendscholen
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Graaf en Wilders over het bericht 'Gemeenten volgen 160 radicale moslims'

PVV MPs asked the Justice and Social Affairs ministers how the government handles hundreds of jihadists and thousands of sympathisers not under monitoring, why administrative detention is not introduced, how deradicalisation success is measured, how many are placed in work or schooling obligations, and expected costs. Minister Grapperhaus answered that local multidisciplinary case consultations and existing criminal and administrative tools suffice, that administrative detention without reasonable suspicion is not justified and will not be introduced, that deradicalisation programmes are evaluated but numbers are too small for conclusions, and that the local approach receives about EUR 6.5 million annually.
Case law and treaty obligations show that administrative detention, meaning preventive detention without reasonable suspicion, is not a justified deprivation of liberty.

Uit de rechtspraak en verdragsrechtelijke verplichtingen volgt dat administratieve detentie, in de zin van preventieve detentie zonder dat sprake is van een redelijke verdenking, geen gerechtvaardigde vrijheidsontneming is.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Roon en De Graaf over berechting Nederlandse terreurverdachten in Suriname

Two PVV MPs asked whether the government knows that two Surinamese-Dutch suspects are being prosecuted in Paramaribo for plotting a terror attack on the US ambassador, whether the Dutch embassy and police follow the trial and will report after each hearing, and whether Dutch roots of the plot are being investigated. The minister confirms awareness, says the embassy follows the case closely, notes one closed-door hearing, declines to send case reports to parliament, and declines to comment on an individual foreign case.
The Ministry of Foreign Affairs and the Ministry of Justice and Security cannot send your House reports on individual foreign court cases.
Het Ministerie van Buitenlandse Zaken en het Ministerie van Justitie en Veiligheid kunnen aan uw Kamer geen rapportages over individuele buitenlandse rechtszaken doen toekomen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Graaf en Wilders over het bericht ‘Salafisten op sleutelposities'

PVV MPs De Graaf and Wilders asked the Minister of Social Affairs about a press report on Salafists in key positions, including whether the government would investigate Rotterdam mayor Aboutaleb's role and contacts with Waqf, whether diversity policy is a route for Islamic influence, whether the Muslim Brotherhood would be investigated, and how to reverse 'islamisation'. The minister declined the investigations, saying the report relied on anonymous sources and Rotterdam's council denied the claims, and stated the government takes a neutral position on religion.
I note that the information provided in the reporting comes from anonymous sources and that there are no verifiable statements.
Ik constateer dat de verstrekte informatie in de berichtgeving afkomstig is van anonieme bronnen en dat er geen sprake is van toetsbare verklaringen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Markuszower en De Graaf over het bericht ‘Jihadist Maastricht verdacht van betrokkenheid bij ontvoering Zuid-Afrika’

MPs Markuszower and De Graaf asked the Justice Minister about reports that a convicted jihadist from Maastricht, under supervision with an ankle monitor, may have been linked to a kidnapping in South Africa, questioning the adequacy of the supervision and whether terrorists should be stripped of Dutch nationality. The minister said courts decide on sanctions and conditions, declined to comment on an individual case still before a judge, and explained the legal basis for nationality revocation and related measures.
Since this concerns an individual criminal case still before the judge, I cannot respond to this question.
Aangezien het hier gaat om een individuele strafzaak die nog onder de rechter is, kan ik niet op deze vraag ingaan.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Beertema, Wilders en De Graaf over het bericht dat de gemeente Utrecht voornemens is een vorderingsbesluit in te zetten om basisschool de Klimroos te verplichten klaslokalen beschikbaar te

Three PVV MPs asked the Education Minister whether he shares their view that an Islamic school threatens Dutch values and whether he will support a public primary school resisting Utrecht's plan to requisition classrooms for a new Islamic school. The minister rejected the premise, noted that schools commonly share buildings and that the municipality is responsible for housing, and said the municipality will keep talking with both school boards.
The municipality is responsible for housing schools.
De gemeente is verantwoordelijk voor de huisvesting van scholen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Graaf en Wilders over de bestuurlijke impasse op Bonaire

PVV MPs De Graaf and Wilders asked whether the administrative deadlock on Bonaire is too long, why trust in the island council and executive members is warranted, whether investment is wasted while duties are neglected, and whether the State Secretary will intervene temporarily under the Bonaire, Sint Eustatius and Saba Public Bodies Act. The State Secretary acknowledged the deadlock must be broken, pointed to agreed steps for a governing agreement soon after the summer, said the executive bears responsibility for good governance as a condition for further investment, and declined to intervene because existing structures do not prevent solutions.
Clear agreements have been made with the Executive Board on a governing agreement to be concluded, in which a large number of existing administrative knots will be untangled.
Met het Bestuurscollege zijn heldere afspraken gemaakt over een te sluiten bestuursakkoord waarin een groot aantal bestaande bestuurlijke knopen wordt ontward.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Graaf, Markuszower en Wilders over een verbod op Denk

MPs from the PVV asked whether the government would arrest and deport a Denk party staffer who said he was proud to be an IS supporter, and whether it would seek a ban on the Denk party. The Minister answered that IS-linked conduct is criminal and that dissolving a party is an exceptional measure requiring high legal standards, which is for the public prosecutor to decide, and that individual cases cannot be discussed.
It is for the public prosecutor to decide whether a request under article 2:20 of the Civil Code is opportune.
Het is aan het openbaar ministerie om te bepalen of een verzoek ex artikel 2:20 Burgerlijk Wetboek opportuun is.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid De Graaf over het bericht dat jihadist Victor Droste zich op Nederlandse bodem zou bevinden

An MP asked the Minister of Justice and Security whether jihadist Victor Droste had returned to the Netherlands after reports to that effect. The minister confirmed awareness of the report, declined to state Droste's whereabouts citing the ongoing criminal investigation, and explained that returnees are arrested on arrival and prosecuted.
The criminal investigation into the Dutch suspect Victor D. is still ongoing.
Het strafrechtelijk onderzoek naar de Nederlandse verdachte Victor D. loopt nog.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Graaf, Kops en Fritsma over het bericht “Miljardairsfamilie Van der Vorm koopt huizen voor Syriërs (en jij betaalt mee)”

PVV MPs asked why a Rotterdam housing initiative by the SNTR foundation reserves 200 homes for Syrian status holders, calling it discrimination against Dutch citizens, and whether such schemes should be stopped. The minister answered that the scheme responds to housing needs of status holders, that whether it constitutes discrimination is for a court to judge, and that no comparable initiatives are known; he rejected the call to restrict social housing to Dutch nationals.
Whether in this case there is also discrimination is not for the cabinet but for a judge to assess.
Of in het onderhavige geval ook sprake is van discriminatie is niet aan het kabinet, maar aan een rechter om te beoordelen.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Beertema, Wilders en De Graaf over het bericht dat een openbare school in Rijswijk de lesinhoud aanpast aan de ramadan en docenten vertellen welke islamitische gebeden verplicht zijn

Three PVV MPs asked whether the minister knows that a Rijswijk public school adjusts lessons to Ramadan and tells teachers which Islamic prayers are obligatory, how many schools do so, and whether the minister will act to keep Islamic influence out of public education. The minister confirmed knowledge of the report, said he does not know how many schools adjust programmes, and rejected intervention, stating that schools must meet attainment targets and may schedule parts of their programme themselves while taking pupil background into account.
Schools are obliged to provide education in line with the core objectives and the attainment targets.
Scholen zijn gehouden onderwijs te verzorgen in overeenstemming met de kerndoelen en de eindtermen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Beertema, Wilders en De Graaf over het bericht dat de burgemeester van Heerenveen heeft gepleit voor verplicht moskeebezoek voor scholieren

PVV MPs asked the education minister whether it is appropriate that the mayor of Heerenveen proposed compulsory mosque visits for pupils, whether schools may require them, and whether the minister would issue guidance or ask VNG to tell mayors to stay out of curriculum matters. The minister replied that excursions in the regular curriculum are in principle compulsory, parents may request exemption from the school board, schools have freedom of education, and no circular or VNG request is needed.
Question 3: Are you aware how many primary schools require pupils to attend a mosque visit? Answer 3: No.
Vraag 3 Is het u bekend hoeveel scholen binnen het primair onderwijs scholieren verplichten om aanwezig te zijn bij een bezoek aan een moskee? Antwoord 3 Nee.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Roon en De Graaf over een drugsbaron als consul op Aruba
