MPs De Roon and De Graaf (PVV) asked whether the Netherlands should accept a consul-general from Venezuela on Aruba with a questionable reputation, citing alleged drug links, and whether the appointment should be reversed. Minister Blok answered that no grounds such as a conviction currently bar the exequatur, that the person is not on the US SDN list, and that he sees no reason to reverse the decision.
I currently see no reason, with reference to the answers to questions 1 and 3, to reverse the decision.
Ik zie, met verwijzing naar de antwoorden op vraag 1 en 3, momenteel geen reden om het besluit terug te draaien.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Emiel van Dijk, De Graaf en Wilders over de uitnodiging voor een Defensie Iftar op donderdag 24 mei 2018

PVV MPs asked the Defence Minister whether he knew of a Defence Iftar invitation for 24 May 2018, and whether he agreed that Islam is a totalitarian ideology unfit for a secular armed forces and should not be facilitated. The state secretary confirmed the invitation, defended religious freedom and the integrated chaplaincy services, and said there is no room for extremist expressions in the armed forces.
Freedom of religion or belief is one of the classic fundamental rights that everyone in the Netherlands has, subject to everyone's responsibility under the law.
De vrijheid van godsdienst of levensovertuiging is één van de klassieke grondrechten die eenieder in Nederland heeft behoudens ieders verantwoordelijkheid voor de wet.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Graaf, Beertema en Wilders over het bericht ‘Gezellig. Cursussen koran voorlezen op de Vrije Universiteit gescheiden voor mannen en vrouwen’

PVV MPs asked whether it is unacceptable that Koran reading courses at the VU were segregated by sex and whether the government would pressure the university to stop such segregation. The minister replied that equality of men and women applies, that the VU's rules forbid segregation, that the student association moved the courses to an external location after the university intervened, and that he sees no reason for further talks with the VU.
As soon as the VU received signals about this, they entered into discussion with the student association and indicated that such segregation is not permitted at the VU.
Zodra de VU hier signalen over ontving, zijn ze in gesprek gegaan met de studentenvereniging en is aangegeven dat dergelijke segregatie op de VU niet is toegestaan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid De Graaf over de veroordeling van uitreiziger/jihadist Marouane Boulahyani

An MP asked the Minister whether he would revoke the citizenship of returned jihadist Marouane Boulahyani, bar his return, and place his network in administrative detention. The Minister said citizenship revocation under article 14(4) RWN is an option under active consideration but cannot be discussed publicly for this case, and rejected administrative detention as incompatible with the rule of law, pointing to criminal prosecution and the Tijdelijke wet bestuurlijke maatregelen terrorismebestrijding instead.
Whether the relevant provision of the RWN applies to the case of Marouane Boulahyani I cannot comment on in public.
Of de betreffende bepaling uit de RWN van toepassing is op de casus van Marouane Boulahyani daar kan ik in het openbaar geen uitspraken over doen.
Antwoord op vragen de leden De Graaf, Fritsma en De Jong over “Statushouder Werkloos”

MPs De Graaf, Fritsma and De Jong (PVV) asked the ministers whether refugees with status are poorly educated, whether economic migration has enriched the Netherlands, and whether residence permits of asylum seekers from safe countries should be revoked and an asylum stop introduced. The government answered that refugees are a diverse group, that it pursues activating policy and regional protection, that the IND judges protection needs, and that it will not introduce a full asylum stop in line with international treaties.
However, for status holders, as for Dutch people on social assistance, an activating policy applies that aims at rapid transition to work.
Voor statushouders geldt echter, net als voor Nederlanders in de bijstand, een activerend beleid dat gericht is op snelle uitstroom naar werk.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Graaf en Wilders over het bericht ‘Nederturken klaarstomen voor carrière’

PVV MPs asked the Minister of Social Affairs about reports on Turkish influence over Dutch Turks via Diyanet and the UETD, and whether mosques and Diyanet should be closed. The minister said Turkish authorities must not interfere in Dutch citizens' choices and would be called to account if needed, declined to investigate UETD now given no integration-based reason, and rejected closing mosques because of freedom of religion.
Closing mosques is therefore out of the question.
Van het sluiten van moskeeën kan dus geen sprake zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Helder, Wilders en De Graaf over het bericht 'Politie: wij hebben allochtonen nodig'

PVV MPs asked the Justice and Social Affairs ministers about a report that police need allochtonen, questioning positive discrimination, the overrepresentation of people with migration backgrounds in integrity violations, dual nationality, Islam, and prayer time for officers. Minister Grapperhaus answered that diversity is operationally necessary, selection standards are unchanged and integrity risks are addressed through measures, while rejecting the idea that dual nationality is undesirable and stating there is no policy on prayer during duty hours.
Above all, the selection criteria and quality of the police are not compromised.
Voorop staat dat aan de selectiecriteria en kwaliteit van de politie niet getornd wordt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Markuszower en De Graaf over het bericht 'Joods restaurant weer belaagd'

PVV MPs asked the Justice Minister whether the prosecutor would pursue an antisemitic motive for repeated vandalism of a Jewish restaurant in Amsterdam and whether the acting mayor should be replaced for failing to protect it. The minister said prosecution is for the OM to decide, that a discrimination aspect would be raised as an aggravating factor, and that local authorities determine protective measures, with the acting mayor already reporting measures to the council.
Where there is reason to do so, the local authority takes additional measures to protect the entrepreneur, employees and those present.
Indien daartoe aanleiding is treft het lokale gezag aanvullende maatregelen ter bescherming van de ondernemer, de werknemers en aanwezigen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Graaf, De Roon en Wilders over Diyanet

PVV MPs asked the government whether it would end its relationship with Diyanet Nederland (ISN/HDV) and close its mosques after Diyanet reportedly approved marriage and pregnancy of 9-year-old girls, and whether it would expel the Turkish ambassador or cut diplomatic ties. The minister answered that ISN is one of many dialogue partners with no formal cooperation, that Diyanet publicly condemned child marriage, that freedom of religion and association mean closing mosques is not possible, and that diplomatic relations are needed to discuss rule-of-law issues; no Turkish ambassador is currently accredited in the Netherlands.
There is no question of formal cooperation.
Er is geen sprake van formele samenwerking.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Graaf en Markuszower over de aankondiging van de extreem-linkse organisaties Anakbayan-Europe en Revolutionaire Eenheid, die de palestijnse veroordeelde terroriste/meervoudig moordenare

Two MPs asked the Justice Minister whether he knows that Rasmea Odeh, a convicted Palestinian figure, was invited to speak in Amsterdam by two far-left groups and was deported from the US for immigration fraud, and whether he will refuse her entry. The minister says he cannot verify the US deportation, does not discuss individual cases, and explains that entry can be refused via Schengen SIS alerts based on factual information such as AIVD or police reports.
However, the Netherlands does not routinely exchange information with third countries about such immigration law decisions.
Nederland wisselt echter niet standaard informatie uit met derde landen over dergelijke vreemdelingrechtelijke besluiten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid De Graaf over het aanstellen van dhr. M. Franco als regeringscommissaris op St. Eustatius

An MP asked the State Secretary why a Curaçao-born candidate was appointed government commissioner on St. Eustatius rather than a Dutch-based administrator, and whether a Dutch commissioner should be appointed. The State Secretary answered that the appointee holds Dutch nationality, that the functions were filled with people from both the Caribbean and European Netherlands, and that administrative experience was a key requirement.
Mr. Marcolino (Mike) Franco holds Dutch nationality and originates from Curaçao.
Dhr. Marcolino (Mike) Franco heeft de Nederlandse nationaliteit en is afkomstig uit Curaçao.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Graaf, Markuszower en Wilders over het bericht 'De beerput van Bilal L.'

PVV MPs asked whether the Amsterdam mayor could act outside council control on de-radicalisation, and whether a Rijksrecherche probe should examine the Amsterdam (de)radicalisation network around Bilal L. The minister answered that Amsterdam runs its own local jihadism policy, that the OM alone decides on such investigations and an existing criminal probe is ongoing, and that administrative detention is not justified.
During the investigation I will not comment on this case.
Gedurende het onderzoek doe ik geen uitspraak over deze zaak.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Jong, Fritsma, De Graaf, en Wildersover het bericht "Te weinig geld voor bijstandsuitkeringen vluchtelingen”.

PVV MPs asked whether municipalities' welfare shortfalls caused by migrant inflow should be addressed by ending benefits for status holders, requiring ten years' residence before benefit eligibility, and closing borders. The minister replied that benefits are a legal right for all residents below the minimum income, that the shortfall is partly offset by temporary Rijk advances, that existing language-related benefit reductions stay, and that no rule changes are planned.
I see no reason to change the rules in this regard.
Ik zie geen reden om de regels hieromtrent aan te passen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Graaf en Wilders over het bericht ‘Een nieuwe zeer grote moskee in Noord - en nauwelijks protest’

Two PVV MPs asked the ministers whether they would oppose the construction of a large mosque in Amsterdam-Noord and reduce the influence of Turkish President Erdogan, citing radicalisation concerns. The government answered that freedom of religion applies equally to all faiths, that foreign influence promoting anti-democratic behaviour will not be accepted, and that permitting the mosque is a matter for the local municipal government.
It is up to the local municipal government to grant permission for the construction.
Het is aan het lokale gemeentebestuur om toestemming voor de bouw te verlenen.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kops, Fritsma, De Graaf en Beertema over het bericht dat Nederlanders langer op de wachtlijst voor een sociale huurwoning moeten staan doordat statushouders en buitenlandse arbeidskrachten

PVV MPs asked whether Dutch social-rent applicants face longer waiting lists because statushouders, foreign workers and students get priority, and whether social housing should go only to Dutch nationals. The Minister said housing supply drives waiting times, that the automatic urgency status for statushouders was removed, that she has no data on how many social rentals statushouders occupy, and that allocation by nationality is ruled out under equal treatment.
I have no insight into how many social rental homes are currently occupied by statushouders.
Ik heb geen inzicht in hoeveel sociale huurwoningen momenteel worden bewoond door statushouders.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Graaf en Wilders over het bericht ‘Gebiedsverbod haatimam blijft’

PVV MPs De Graaf and Wilders asked whether an imam judged by a court to threaten national security, and holding dual nationality, should be stripped of Dutch nationality, expelled, or preventively detained. Minister Grapperhaus answered that dual-nationality revocation requires a criminal court ruling or the national-security ground in Article 14(4), which does not apply here, and that a person cannot be expelled while holding Dutch nationality and preventive detention without reasonable suspicion is not justified.
Furthermore, I note that in this case the criteria of Article 14(4) of the Kingdom Act on Netherlands Nationality are also not met
Ten overvloede vermeld ik dat in deze zaak ook niet wordt voldaan aan de criteria van artikel 14, vierde lid Rijkswet op het Nederlanderschap
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Graaf, Markuszower en Wilders over de antisemitische terreuractie tegen een Joods restaurant in Amsterdam

PVV MPs asked whether the suspect in the antisemitic attack on a Jewish restaurant in Amsterdam was known to the security services, whether he would be prosecuted for terrorism and deported, and whether administrative detention should be introduced. The Minister said he cannot comment on individual cases, that prosecution and sentencing are for the prosecutor and judge, and that administrative detention without reasonable suspicion is not a legitimate deprivation of liberty, pointing to existing tools.
It is for the public prosecution service to decide on prosecuting the suspect and to formulate a sentencing demand.
Het is aan het OM om te besluiten over de vervolging van de verdachte en daarbij een strafeis te formuleren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Markuszower, Fritsma, De Graaf en Wilders over het bericht ‘Brede onrust na aanval op joods restaurant’

MPs of the PVV asked the Minister of Justice and Security why the suspect in an attack on a Jewish restaurant, who threw a burning liquid, was prosecuted only for vandalism and theft rather than a terrorist offence, and whether he could be deported. The Minister replied that prosecution and sentencing are for the Public Prosecution Service and the courts, that he would not comment on the individual case, and noted the court had adjourned the case for further investigation.
As you know, it is for the Public Prosecution Service to decide on prosecuting the suspect and to formulate a sentencing demand.
Zoals bij u bekend is het aan het OM om te besluiten over de vervolging van de verdachte en daarbij een strafeis te formuleren.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Markuszower, De Graaf en Wilders over de berichtgeving inzake een Brabantse islamgeleerde die geen straf krijgt voor het verkrachten van zijn stiefkind vanwege dementie

MPs asked the Minister for Legal Protection how a 74-year-old suspect could be declared demented to avoid prosecution for raping his stepchild, and called for life imprisonment, denaturalisation and expulsion. The Minister declined to comment on the individual case, which is before the courts, and referred to a letter sent to parliament.
This concerns an individual case that is still before the courts.
Het gaat hier om een individuele zaak die nog onder de rechter is.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Graaf, Beertema, Wilders over het bericht 'Videos. Universitaire kindbruidjes over de zegeningen van islam'

PVV MPs asked the Education Minister whether a university Islam academy's programme undermines critical thinking, and whether Oman-funded chairs should be banned. The minister denied any duty to suppress critical thinking, said the academy responds to partner requests, and rejected a ban since Oman has no influence over the chair, which the university controls.
No. It is precisely a task of Dutch education to stimulate critical thinking.
Nee. Het is juist een taak van het Nederlands onderwijs kritisch vermogen te stimuleren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Graaf en Wilders over het bericht ‘Honderden IS-terroristen uit Raqqa ontsnapt onder geheime evacuatiedeal’

MPs De Graaf and Wilders asked the Justice Minister whether the government knew of a reported secret deal allowing hundreds of IS fighters to leave Raqqa, how many were freed and where they are, and how Nederland will prevent returnees from entering the country, including closing borders. Minister Grapperhaus answered that the cabinet was not informed in advance, that about 300 fighters left via tribal arrangements, that Dutch nationals cannot be barred from returning but are subject to criminal, intelligence and administrative measures including possible loss of citizenship, and that closing borders is not a realistic solution.
No, the cabinet was not aware of this agreement.
Nee, het kabinet was niet op de hoogte van deze afspraak.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Graaf en Markuszower over het bericht ‘Terrorist krijgt slechts 4 jaar cel opgelegd’

MPs De Graaf and Markuszower asked the Justice Minister whether a four-year prison sentence for a terrorist, reported in the press, is too lenient and whether the government will raise sentences and deport and denaturalise such offenders. Minister Grapperhaus answered that sentencing is for the independent judiciary and prosecutors, and that denaturalisation is possible case by case for dual nationals with a 20-year entry ban.
It is for the Public Prosecution Service to decide on prosecution and determine the sentencing demand.
Het is aan het Openbaar Ministerie om te besluiten over de vervolging en het bepalen van de strafeis.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kops, De Graaf en Agema over het bericht dat senioren in Apeldoorn overdonderd zijn door de komst van Turkse leeftijdsgenoten

MPs from the PVV asked ministers whether it is acceptable that a housing corporation in Apeldoorn plans to let vacated flats in a senior complex to Turkish elderly receiving home care, without consulting current residents, and asked for the plans to be stopped. The minister replied that corporations are free to set allocation policy within the Housing and Tenancy Acts, that the corporation appears to have followed the legal consultation procedure, and that residents can complain to the independent complaints committee or the courts, but that the minister has no role in individual allocation policy.
As far as I can tell, the housing corporation has acted within the framework of the law.
Voor zover ik kan nagaan heeft de woningcorporatie binnen de kaders van de wet gehandeld.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Graaf, van Dijck en Wilders over de berichten 'Stichtingen steunen terreur' en 'Drinkwater uitgedeeld in Syrië, maar waar dan'?

PVV MPs asked how many people have been convicted in the Netherlands since 2012 for financing Islamist terrorism, whether citizens convicted of such financing can have their Dutch nationality revoked and be deported, and whether bank and money-transfer reporting duties should be tightened. The government answered that no separate figures exist because terrorism financing is not split by ideology, that nationality revocation is possible case by case for dual nationals, and that the existing Wwft reporting system needs no stricter rules.
Figures on how many people in the Netherlands have been convicted for financing Islamist terrorism are therefore not known.
Cijfers over hoeveel mensen er in Nederland zijn veroordeeld voor het financieren van islamitisch terrorisme zijn daarom niet bekend.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Graaf en Wilders over het bericht 'Jankende jihadbruid hoort bij harde kern'

PVV MPs De Graaf and Wilders asked the Justice Minister about a news report on a jihadi bride and whether she should be barred from ever returning to the Netherlands. Minister Grapperhaus acknowledged that returnees from Syria and Iraq can pose a security risk but declined to comment on the individual case or on whether she should be refused re-entry.
I do not comment on individual cases.
Over individuele casussen doe ik geen uitspraak.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Graaf en Wilders over het artikel ‘Kind gestoken’

Two PVV MPs asked whether an imam convicted in England for child abuse and active at a Rotterdam mosque could be stripped of Dutch nationality, expelled and the mosque closed, and whether all mosques should be closed. The Minister declined to comment on the individual case, stated that Dutch nationality law provides no basis for revocation for common crimes and the European Nationality Convention prevents introducing one, said no data exist on convicted imams, and rejected closing all mosques on freedom of religion grounds.
I do not make statements about individual cases.
Ik doe geen uitspraken over individuele zaken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Graaf en Wilders over "de overname van de Haagse Thomaskerk door een moskee"

PVV MPs asked whether replacing the Thomaskerk in The Hague with a mosque undermines Judeo-Christian culture, whether the municipality should be told not to facilitate Islam, and whether borders should be closed. The minister rejected the cultural-replacement framing, cited freedom of religion, said municipal contacts with religious organisations fall under local autonomy, and declined to close borders.
Maintaining contacts with religious organisations falls under municipal autonomy.
Het onderhouden van contacten met religieuze organisaties behoort tot de gemeentelijke autonomie.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Graaf en Wilders over het bericht 'Nederland weer een stukje meer Turks: Enschede krijgt joekel van een azaantoetermoskee'

Two PVV MPs asked the government whether it shares their view that Islam should be reduced in the Netherlands and that Turkish state influence via Diyanet and a planned mosque in Enschede should be curbed. The minister answered that islamisation is not occurring, all religions are treated equally, the government will increase transparency of religious institutions, and permit decisions for the mosque are a municipal matter handled after objections were considered.
Granting permits and determining zoning plans is the responsibility of the relevant municipality and therefore a local matter.
Het verlenen van vergunningen, bepalen van de bestemmingsplannen etc. is de verantwoordelijkheid van de desbetreffende gemeente en dus een lokale aangelegenheid.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Wilders, Fritsma en De Graaf over de berichtgeving dat de Syrische terrorist Yahyah Farroukh onlangs in Nederland was

PVV MPs asked whether suspect Yahyah Farroukh visited family in the Netherlands, how he passed screening, and whether Syrian asylum permits should be revoked given Syria's supposed safety. The minister declined to comment on individual cases, stated the person is no longer a suspect, defended asylum protection for those the IND finds in need, and refused to revoke Syrian asylum permits.
I generally do not make statements about individual cases.
Over individuele zaken doe ik in de regel geen uitspraken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Graaf en Wilders over de berichten 'Gemeente blind' en 'Bilal L. bleek wolf in schaapskleren te zijn'

PVV MPs asked the Social Affairs and Justice ministers how a convicted terror suspect who recruited for jihad came to be hired as a deradicalisation youth worker by Amsterdam, whether the mayor knew, and whether comparable figures are employed and nationality can be revoked. The government answered that Amsterdam is autonomously responsible, the mayor knew of the hiring, Amsterdam will no longer hire people who went through radicalisation, and nationality revocation is only possible under narrow legal grounds which it does not discuss for individual cases.
Amsterdam municipality is responsible for the local approach to jihadism in Amsterdam and its implementation, and shapes this policy autonomously.
Gemeente Amsterdam is verantwoordelijk voor de Amsterdamse lokale aanpak jihadisme en de uitvoering daarvan en geeft autonoom vorm aan dit beleid.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Helder en De Graaf over het bericht 'Politiedienst slaat alarm: duizenden buitenlandse terreurtips genegeerd'

MPs Helder and De Graaf asked whether the police international legal assistance centre (LIRC) has thousands of backlogged terrorism-related requests and signals and whether this structural understaffing endangers security. The minister confirmed the backlog figures, said terrorism requests get top priority, and stated 32 vacancies have been filled with the remaining 8 expected by early 2018, with a letter to follow.
Requests related to terrorism receive the highest priority and are handled immediately.
Verzoeken in het kader van terrorisme krijgen de hoogste prioriteit en worden direct opgepakt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Wilders en De Graaf over de inzet van vrijwilligers bij de jaarwisseling in Den Haag

PVV MPs De Graaf and Wilders asked ministers whether the Hague mayor's use of volunteers for New Year's Eve, reportedly including salafist-linked actors, breaches public order, whether they will prevent a 'sharia police', and whether the mayor should be dismissed. The government answered that volunteers have no special powers and are supervised by police, and that judging the mayor's performance is a matter for the municipal council.
The judgement on the functioning of the mayor of The Hague is a matter for the municipal council.
Het oordeel over het functioneren van de burgemeester van Den Haag is aan de gemeenteraad.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Wilders, Fritsma en De Graaf over een in Brunssum opgepakte Syrische terreurverdachte met een verblijfsvergunning

PVV MPs asked how a Syrian asylum seeker with a residence permit, suspected of terrorism, passed screening, how many asylum seekers are suspected of terrorist links, why migration continues, whether such suspects will be deported, and when borders will close to Muslim-country nationals. The state secretary replied that the suspect was wrongly linked to terrorism, that authorities stay alert but cannot guarantee abuse is impossible, that deportation or residence/nationality measures are considered when a conviction or intelligence report exists, and rejected closing borders.
The Public Prosecution Service does not register by residence status.
Het OM registreert niet op verblijfstatus.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Graaf en Wilders over het bericht 'Haatsjeik toch actief in Den Haag'

PVV MPs asked the ministers of Social Affairs and of Justice whether a convicted Islamic preacher runs an illegal mosque in The Hague, and whether such individuals may act as preachers and should be shut down. The government answered that the leased premises may only be used for commercial activities, that the municipality has ordered the owner to stop the non-conforming use with legal follow-up threatened, and that the Justice minister imposed an area ban on the individual, while freedom of religion precludes 'deislamisation'.
The Hague municipality has meanwhile ordered the owner of the premises on Cilliersstraat to end the non-conforming use.
De gemeente Den Haag heeft de eigenaar van het pand aan de Cilliersstraat inmiddels gesommeerd het strijdige gebruik te beëindigen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Graaf, Beertema en Wilders over het bericht 'Islamschool paait jongere met gratis laptop of elektrische fiets'

PVV MPs asked whether Islamic schools should be banned, whether existing ones should be closed, and whether schools should be barred from visiting mosques, following a report on an Islamic school offering pupils gifts. The State Secretary answered that education is free under Article 23 of the Constitution, that schools must meet legal quality requirements including on citizenship and he will act where they do not, and that refused closures and mosque bans, leaving school visits to schools and parents.
Where schools do not comply with statutory quality requirements, including on citizenship, I will of course intervene for that reason.
Waar scholen zich niet houden aan wettelijke kwaliteitseisen, waaronder ten aanzien van burgerschap, treed ik om die reden uiteraard wel op.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Graaf, Beertema en Wilders over het bericht dat een nieuwe islamitische school in Amsterdam bekostigd moet worden door het Ministerie van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap

MPs De Graaf, Beertema and Wilders asked whether the Council of State's ruling obliging the Ministry to fund a new Islamic school in Amsterdam, despite concerns about IS sympathies, could be reconsidered and whether any Islamic education should be allowed. The Secretary of State answered that the ruling is respected and funding has started, that the Inspectorate will supervise the school and may enforce, and that a bill introducing a quality test for new schools is in preparation.
I have already prepared the bill Meer ruimte voor nieuwe scholen, which introduces a quality test for approval of a new publicly funded school.
Ik heb reeds het wetsvoorstel Meer ruimte voor nieuwe scholen in voorbereiding, waarmee ik een kwaliteitstoets introduceer voor de goedkeuring van een nieuwe bekostigde school.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Roon, De Graaf en Wilders over beschermde identiteit voor teruggekeerde Zweedse jihadisten

MPs De Roon, De Graaf and Wilders asked whether returning Swedish jihadists receive protected identities to aid reintegration, whether they could travel and settle in the EU and Netherlands, and whether Dutch services know of them. The ministers replied that the reports are incorrect, that Sweden only offers privacy-data protection for threatened citizens and not new identities, and that the other questions therefore do not apply.
No, this report is not correct.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Graaf en Wilders  over het bericht 'Engeland neemt paspoort van 150 Syriëgangers af: 'Britse nationaliteit is geen absoluut recht'

Two PVV MPs asked the Justice Minister about the UK stripping citizenship from around 150 Syria travellers, asking how many Dutch travellers remain abroad, how many hold dual nationality, and whether the Netherlands would do the same. The minister gave the numbers (about 190 still in the conflict zone), said dual-nationality data is not updated in the population register, and explained the Dutch legal grounds for revoking citizenship on national security grounds, noting each case needs an individual assessment and that no decisions under that power had yet been taken.
In general I cannot make statements about the number of travellers with a second nationality.
In zijn algemeenheid kan ik geen uitspraken doen over het aantal uitreizigers met een tweede nationaliteit.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Graaf en Wilders over het bericht ‘Radicaal vrijuit door slordigheid Justitie’

PVV MPs De Graaf and Wilders asked the Minister of Justice and Security why a radicalised individual was freed due to a procedural error, and whether preventive detention should be introduced. The minister rejected detention, pointed to the new Temporary Act on administrative counter-terrorism measures, and noted a court had found the measures lawful apart from an unclear map annex.
Furthermore, I will not go into (the measures surrounding) individual cases.
Verder ga ik niet in op (de maatregelen rondom) individuele gevallen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Popken en De Graaf over het bericht dat België radicalen op zee gaat opsporen

MPs Popken and De Graaf asked whether the Netherlands applies maritime border and port controls comparable to Belgium's new hunt for radicalised crew on suspicious ships, and whether Dutch controls should be stepped up. The ministers answered that Dutch sea and port controls are comparable, describing the roles of the Kustwacht, ILT, Douane and Marechaussee, and pointed to extra funding for the Marechaussee.
The organisation of sea and port control in the Netherlands and Belgium is comparable.
De inrichting van de controle van de zee en havens in Nederland en België is vergelijkbaar.
Antwoord op van de leden De Graaf, Beertema en Wilders over dagelijkse ramadanlezingen op de website van ‘Instituut Dar el Huda’

PVV MPs asked whether a Dutch public primary school hosting daily Ramadan lectures on a mosque institute's website is acceptable, whether similar cases exist, and whether harsh measures or closure of Islamic schools will be taken. The government replied that the lectures are a rental of a room in the evening by an outside foundation, not a school activity, that no violation of law exists so no measures are warranted, and that closing Islamic schools would violate constitutional freedoms of religion and education.
It is not recorded whether rooms in buildings housing a school are rented out and what these rooms are then used for.
Er wordt niet bijgehouden of ruimtes in gebouwen waar een school in is gevestigd worden verhuurd en waar deze ruimtes dan voor worden ingezet.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Helder en De Graaf over het bericht 'Amsterdamse politie wil hoofddoekje toestaan bij uniform'

MPs Helder and De Graaf asked whether the Amsterdam police was considering allowing headscarves as part of the uniform and how this fits with police neutrality rules and diversity policy. The minister said the police adheres to the lifestyle-neutrality code, that no concrete plan exists, that diversity policy does not override rules, and that he sees no reason to deviate from the code.
There was no concrete proposal or plan regarding this subject.
Er was geen concreet voorstel of plan met betrekking tot dit onderwerp.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Gerbrands, De Graaf en Wilders over speciale voorzieningen in ziekenhuizen tijdens de ramadan

Three PVV MPs asked the health minister whether it is the hospital's task to provide special Ramadan facilities, whether this raises patient risks, who pays, and whether it breaches the Hippocratic oath. The minister answered that the material is supportive, that patients and their care providers decide on managing diabetes during Ramadan, that costs are covered from DBC revenue, and that she sees no breach of the oath and will not intervene.
I see no breach arising of the Dutch physicians' oath, which is derived from the Hippocratic oath.
Ik zie geen inbreuk ontstaan op de (van de eed van Hippocrates afgeleide) Nederlandse artseneed.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Fritsma, De Graaf en Wilders over de berichtgeving dat er fouten zijn gemaakt bij de vrijstelling voor het inburgeringsvereiste

MPs Fritsma, De Graaf and Wilders asked why the IND failed to apply new rules, wrongly exempting thousands of migrants from the civic integration exam, and questioned the cost, grounds for not revoking permits, and the government's immigration policy. The State Secretary acknowledged the error, said the IND took corrective steps, defended that permits cannot be revoked for legal certainty reasons, and rejected the claim that the errors add burdens on public resources.
I regret that the IND did not test applications for a stronger residence right against the stricter civic integration requirements.
Ik betreur dat de IND bij verblijfsaanvragen om een sterker verblijfsrecht niet aan de verzwaarde inburgeringseisen heeft getoetst.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Graaf, De Roon en Wilders over het bericht 'Turkije haalt uit: Nederland is xenofoob en islamofoob'

Three PVV MPs asked the ministers whether the Turkish ambassador should be expelled after Turkey accused the Netherlands of xenophobia and Islamophobia, and whether Turkey's human rights record should be taken into account. The government answered that it seeks to de-escalate diplomatic tensions and does not consider sending the ambassador back desirable.
The Cabinet is aiming to de-escalate the diplomatic tensions between the two countries.
Het Kabinet zet in op de-escalatie van de diplomatieke spanningen tussen beide landen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Graaf en Wilders over het bericht: 'Stille tocht voor Israël in Rotterdam niet toegestaan'

MPs De Graaf and Wilders asked why a silent march supporting Israel in Rotterdam was not permitted while a conference they linked to Hamas was. The minister replied that freedom of assembly is constitutionally protected, a ban requires a concrete risk assessment, and the mayor of Rotterdam is responsible for public order, so he declined to intervene.
I do not intervene in the mayor's powers.
Ik treed niet in de bevoegdheid van de burgemeester.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Graaf, Beertema en Wilders over het bericht ‘Overheid moet oog hebben voor shariarecht’

PVV MPs asked whether the government should resist sharia influence, given a university chair studying good parts of sharia law, and asked who funds it. The minister answered that Dutch public order limits foreign law and that existing private international law rules are sufficient, without naming the chair's funder in detail.
The application of foreign law in the Netherlands and the recognition of legal facts or relationships established abroad always find their limit in Dutch public order.

De toepassing van buitenlands recht in Nederland en de erkenning van in het buitenland tot stand gekomen rechtsfeiten of rechtsverhoudingen vinden echter altijd hun grens in de Nederlandse openbare orde.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Graaf, Beertema en Wilders over het bericht ‘RK-scholen passen viering Pasen aan’

PVV MPs asked the state secretary whether Dutch Christian and Catholic schools that adjusted their Easter celebrations to accommodate Muslim pupils were betraying Judeo-Christian culture, how many schools and pupils were affected, and whether school boards and Muslim parents should be summoned or told to assimilate or leave. The state secretary rejected the premise, said the central government does not track school Easter practices or pupil transfers, declined to summon school boards, and said integration rather than assimilation is policy.
The central government does not keep track of whether schools celebrate Easter or how they do so.
De rijksoverheid houdt niet bij of scholen het paasfeest vieren en op welke wijze zij dit doen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Graaf, Markuszower en Wilders over misstanden in het Zuiderparkbad

MPs from the PVV asked the ministers about reported assaults, harassment and vandalism at the Zuiderparkbad in The Hague, including the ethnicity of perpetrators, whether they should be punished harshly, what has been done and whether national measures would be taken. The minister answered that the matter is a local responsibility, that the municipality has introduced security measures and a review is underway, and that prosecution is for the public prosecutor to decide.
Enforcing order and rules in swimming pools is a local matter.
De handhaving van de orde en regels in zwembaden is een lokale aangelegenheid.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Graaf, Wilders en Edgar Mulder over het artikel 'Gemeente 'viert' islamitische feestdagen'

Three PVV MPs asked whether the municipality of Almelo's promotion of Islamic holidays, through lighting a bridge, is objectionable and whether the minister would advise the mayor against it. The minister answered that Islam is a religion protected like others, that municipalities decide how to reflect pluralism within the law, and that the choice of lighting days is for Almelo to decide.
In this case it is therefore up to the municipality of Almelo to decide on which days the lighting on the bridge is switched on.
In dit geval is het daarom aan de gemeente Almelo om te bepalen op welke dagen de verlichting op de brug aangaat.
Antwoord op van de leden De Graaf en Wilders over het bericht "Turkse Nederlanders kiezen: ’evet’ of ’hayir'’', over het faciliteren van het Turkse referendum in Nederland

PVV MPs De Graaf and Wilders asked the government about reports that Turkish referendum polling stations were being facilitated in the Netherlands, covering postal voting, costs of traffic signage and police, AK-party representatives posing at a polling station, and whether the stations should be closed. Minister Asscher answered that postal voting is a choice for other states, that costs fall within regular Rijkswaterstaat and police work, that the government cannot confirm the posing claim, and that the polling stations would not be closed because they are permitted under the Vienna Conventions.
The Netherlands does not supervise the polling stations and therefore cannot confirm whether members of the AK Party posed at one of the polling stations.
Nederland houdt geen toezicht in de stemlocaties en kan dus niet bevestigen of er door leden van de AK-partij is geposeerd in een van de stemlocaties.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Graaf en Wilders over de Al Houda-moskee in Geleen

PVV MPs De Graaf and Wilders asked the Minister of Social Affairs whether the government is aware of reports of a Salafist takeover of the Al Houda mosque in Geleen and suspected support for armed jihad via the linked Babycare foundation, whether salafist takeovers threaten democracy, and whether the mosque and foundation will be closed and dissolved. The minister confirmed awareness, described a three-track approach of dialogue, confrontation and enforcement by prosecution and police, and stated that dissolution under Article 2:20 Civil Code is for the Public Prosecution Service to decide.
Under Article 2:20 of the Civil Code, the court may, at the request of the Public Prosecution Service, declare a legal person whose activities conflict with public order prohibited and dissolve it.

Op grond van artikel 2:20 Burgerlijk Wetboek kan de rechtbank op verzoek van het Openbaar Ministerie een rechtspersoon waarvan de werkzaamheid in strijd is met de openbare orde verboden verklaren en ontbinden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Graaf en Beertema over het bericht ‘Jihadonderzoeker UvA uitte zelf steun voor strijders van IS’

PVV MPs asked whether a report that a UvA jihad researcher expressed support for IS fighters is used in prosecutions of Syria travellers, and what will be done to stop alleged misuse of education, and whether returnees can be barred. The government said the prosecution has no knowledge of the report being used in court, that academic quality is for the academic community to judge, and that it will act only against clear discrimination or calls to armed jihad; on travellers it described existing prosecution, monitoring and new nationality-revocation powers.
It is for the academic community to assess and qualify the scholarly character of research.
Het is aan de academische gemeenschap om het wetenschappelijk karakter van onderzoek te beoordelen en te kwalificeren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Graaf, Helder en Wilders over het bericht 'Cel voor gijzelen importbruid'

PVV MPs asked whether a sharia court dissolved a marriage in the Netherlands and whether Dutch law can be supplemented by Islamic law, and whether such organisations should be dissolved. The minister replied that no parallel legal structure is possible, that no sharia courts are known to exist in the Netherlands, and that the Public Prosecution Service will consider a dissolution request under Article 2:20 Civil Code if warranted.
The Public Prosecution Service has indicated that, if there is cause, it will consider filing a request with the court.
Het Openbaar Ministerie heeft laten weten dat indien daartoe aanleiding bestaat, zij de mogelijkheid om bij de rechtbank een verzoek in te dienen zal overwegen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Graaf en Wilders over het artikel 'Link Eindhovense moskee met Al-Qaeda financiers'

Two PVV MPs asked the Minister of Social Affairs about a press report linking an Eindhoven mosque foundation (al-Waqf) to Al-Qaeda financiers, and whether it should be dismantled. The minister said no financial flows to the named ASM have been established, pointed to existing terrorism-financing tools and said dissolution under the Civil Code is for the Public Prosecution Service to decide.
It is for the Public Prosecution Service to determine whether that is the case here.
Het Openbaar Ministerie om te bepalen of daar in dit geval sprake van is.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Martin Bosma en De Graaf over het anti-Zwarte Pietenberaad

The MPs Bosma and De Graaf asked the Minister of Social Affairs about the round tables on Zwarte Piet, including attendees, how they were selected, how often they were held, and why participants were asked to sign a statement. The Minister answered that the round tables were convened by him, listed the participating organisations and dates, noted that the Chamber was informed in 2014, and said the statement was drafted at the initiative of participants.
The statement was drawn up at the initiative of the group of participants in the round table.
De verklaring is opgesteld op initiatief van de groep deelnemers aan de ronde tafel.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Graaf en Wilders over het artikel 'België zet haatprediker uit naar Nederland'

PVV MPs De Graaf and Wilders asked whether the government would bar, denaturalise or expel a Belgian-expelled Dutch imam who preaches hatred. Minister Asscher answered that Dutch citizens cannot be refused entry or expelled, that Dutch national security shows no current threat so far, and that the government will monitor him and act against incitement.
Dutch nationals cannot be refused access to the Netherlands. Nor can they be expelled.
Nederlanders kan de toegang tot Nederland niet worden geweigerd. Evenmin kunnen zij worden uitgezet.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Graaf en De Roon over het artikel "Qatar financiert omstreden Deense moskee via Den Haag"

PVV MPs De Graaf and De Roon asked whether the government knows of an NRC report that Qatar channels funding for a controversial Danish mosque via its Hague embassy, whether embassies should finance Islamic infrastructure, and whether other cases exist and the Qatari ambassador should be expelled. The minister answered that transparency rules on foreign religious funding are being drafted, that the embassy is also accredited to Denmark so the matter is bilateral, and referred to a separate letter.
The cabinet is therefore drawing up further rules on the transparency of financing flows.
Het kabinet stelt daarom nadere regels op over de transparantie van financieringsstromen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Graaf en Wilders over de berichten ‘Salafisten Rotterdam hebben omstreden geldschieter’ en ‘Hoe salafistengeld naar Nederland stroomt’

Two PVV MPs asked the Minister of Social Affairs about reports that Salafist groups in Rotterdam were funded by a controversial donor (Eid Charity) and asked whether the foundation should be kept out of the Netherlands or its property purchase reversed. The minister said the Rotterdam municipality is negotiating a sale of the building after the foundation pledged to stop its activities there, and that it is for the Public Prosecution Service to decide whether to request a court ban on the Al Nour foundation.

It is for the Public Prosecution Service to assess whether there are facts and circumstances that give cause to file a request for a civil-law prohibition or dissolution under art. 2:20 BW with the court.

Het is aan het Openbaar Ministerie om te beoordelen of er feiten en omstandigheden aanwezig zijn die aanleiding vormen om een verzoek tot civielrechtelijke verbodenverklaring of ontbinding ex art. 2:20 BW bij de rechtbank in te dienen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Martin Bosma en De Graaf  over de actieve bemoeienis van de minister van Sociale Zaken met Zwarte Piet

PVV MPs asked why the Minister of Social Affairs is involved in the Sinterklaas and Zwarte Piet debate, which other feasts he engages with, who attended his round table and why a declaration was requested. The minister answered that the government sees a role in facilitating respectful dialogue but rejects a state ban, and listed the round-table participants and said the declaration originated with the participants.
The cabinet is of the view that a state ban on Zwarte Piet is not the way out.
Het kabinet is van mening dat een verbod op Zwarte Piet van staatswege niet de uitweg is
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Graaf en Wilders over het bericht ‘Tsunami van jihadisten’

Two PVV MPs asked the Minister of Security and Justice about reports of a possible wave of ISIS fighters returning to Europe, asking whether the government is worried, how returnees will be handled, and whether borders should be closed to stop them. The minister answered that returnees are treated as a security risk and are interviewed, prosecuted where possible, and assessed in local case meetings, but that fully sealing the borders is neither practically nor legally possible, so intensified controls are used instead.
This question gives the impression that it would be practically or legally possible to hermetically seal the Dutch borders and thereby easily eliminate all risks to society.
Deze vraagstelling wekt de indruk dat het praktisch of juridisch mogelijk zou zijn de Nederlandse grenzen hermetisch af te sluiten en zo eenvoudig alle risico’s voor de samenleving weg te nemen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Klever en De Graaf over de komst van een Turks ziekenhuis in Amsterdam

PVV MPs Klever and De Graaf asked whether they object to a Turkish hospital opening in Amsterdam, whether Turkish influence should be resisted, and whether the Inspectorate will check the clinic, including on circumcision and medication. The minister replied that she has no objection while the clinic meets Dutch standards, that the IGZ and NZa supervise it, and that it will be inspected like other new entrants.
The IGZ treats and inspects the Stichting Acibadem International Medical Center as it inspects all new entrants to check whether they meet the standards applicable in the Netherlands.
De IGZ behandelt en inspecteert de Stichting Acibadem International Medical Center zoals zij alle nieuwe toetreders inspecteert of aan de in Nederland geldende normen wordt voldaan.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Wilders, Helder, Fritsma en De Graaf over de Marokkaanse straatterreur in Maassluis

PVV MPs asked the Minister of Justice and Security about street disturbances by Moroccan-origin youths in Maassluis, including arrests, the mayor's conduct, camera use, police response times and denaturalisation. The minister answered that local authorities chose an emergency order that restored order, eight complaints were filed, five suspects arrested under OM direction, and that camera deployment was routine, while declining to discuss the ongoing investigation and noting the 15-minute police response target.
While the investigation is ongoing, I, as usual, make no further statements about it.
Lopende het onderzoek doe ik, zoals gebruikelijk, hierover geen verdere mededelingen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid De Graaf over het bericht “Taaleis bijstand genegeerd”?

An MP from the PVV asked the State Secretary for Social Affairs about reports that welfare recipients with poor Dutch are not complying with the language requirement, asking how many are sanctioned and whether immigrants without Dutch should be denied benefits. The State Secretary answered that no national figures on sanctions are yet available (to be published for the 2020 evaluation), defended the language requirement as a tool for labour market participation, and said municipalities are responsible for enforcement, with the municipal council holding the supervisory role.
There are currently no national figures available on the number of people on welfare whose Dutch is insufficient.
Er zijn op dit moment geen landelijke cijfers beschikbaar over het aantal mensen in de bijstand dat het Nederlands onvoldoende beheerst.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Roon, De Graaf en Wilders over het organiseren van een lezing die wordt gegeven door een terroristenknuffelaar

PVV MPs asked the Foreign Minister why the ministry hosted a lecture by John Esposito, whom they called an apologist for Saudi Arabia and Islamist groups, and what it costs and who was invited. The minister answered that Esposito cancelled his trip for family reasons, described the event as part of broader counter-radicalisation outreach, and said costs fall on the hosting organisations while invitees were experts from inside and outside government.
Unfortunately, for family reasons he had to cancel his trip to Europe.
Helaas heeft hij wegens familieomstandigheden zijn reis naar Europa moeten afzeggen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Wilders, Fritsma en De Graaf over (Integratie) over de kosten van asiel en immigratie

MPs Wilders, Fritsma and De Graaf asked for year-by-year net costs of asylum and immigrant groups, and the costs of the 2014-2015 asylum cohort over 30 years including family migration. The State Secretary refused both, stating the government does not keep accounts of costs and benefits by group or origin and only evaluates policy, not citizens.
This cabinet also does not keep accounts of (groups of) citizens.
Ook dit kabinet houdt geen boekhouding van (groepen) burgers bij.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Martin Bosma en De Graaf over de weigerburgemeester van Weert

Two PVV MPs asked whether the Minister had requested a factual account from the Commissioner of the King on the 'refusal mayor' of Weert, when it would be ready, whether it would be shared with parliament, and whether maatregelen would be taken if the mayor broke the law. The Minister confirmed requesting the account, received it on 26 May, discussed it with the mayor on 2 June, sent parliament a letter with a factual overview on 16 June, and said no breach of law was found.
On 16 June 2016 I informed your House in writing, based on the Commissioner of the King's factual account and the conversation with the mayor, about the course of events in Weert.

Antwoord 3 en 4 Op 16 juni 2016 heb ik uw Kamer, op basis van het feitenrelaas van de commissaris van de Koning en het gesprek met de burgemeester, schriftelijk 1 geïnformeerd over de gang van zaken in Weert.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid De Graaf over het bericht ‘VVD: ‘Diefstal komt niet bij politie, dat lost het COA op’

MP De Graaf (PVV) asked the State Secretary whether a VVD MP's remarks that theft by asylum seekers is covered by the COA showed the need for further investigation, possibly by the Rijksrecherche. The State Secretary answered that compensating shopkeepers for asylum-seeker theft is not COA policy, that no such cases are known, that COA checked and found no concrete cases, and that no grounds for further investigation exist.
I therefore see no grounds for further investigation.
Ik zie dan ook geen aanknopingspunten voor verder onderzoek.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Agema en De Graaf over de brief van het Haagse college van B&W over de huisvesting van asielzoekers in een vleugel van verpleeghuis De Lozerhof

MPs Agema and De Graaf asked about housing asylum seekers in a wing of nursing home De Lozerhof, including expected work by residents, staffing impacts and who is responsible for care quality and safety. The Secretary of State said the arrangement is voluntary-work oriented with careful consultation, that the nursing home itself is responsible for care quality, and that the Inspectorate is following up on previously identified shortcomings.
Care institutions are themselves responsible for the quality and safety of the care provided and for the staff and volunteers in their institution.
Zorginstellingen zijn zelf verantwoordelijk voor de kwaliteit en veiligheid van de geleverde zorg en voor het personeel en vrijwilligers in hun instelling.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid De Graaf over het bericht dat het COA winkeliers compenseert voor door asielzoekers gestolen goederen

MP De Graaf asked the State Secretary whether reports that the COA compensates shopkeepers for goods stolen by asylum seekers are true, and how many shopkeepers and how much money were involved since early 2015. The State Secretary answered that the COA does not recognise this signal, would find it highly undesirable, and will actively check the origin of the rumour.
Inquiries with the COA show that it does not recognise this signal, and it would of course find it highly undesirable if this were the case.
Uit navraag bij het COA blijkt dat het zich niet in dit signaal herkent, en het uiteraard ook zeer onwenselijk zou vinden als hier sprake van zou zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid De Graaf over het bericht ‘COA geeft met opzet teveel uit’

An MP from the PVV asked the State Secretary for Security and Justice about reports that the COA deliberately overspent on costly contractors and event halls for asylum reception, and which contracts were signed since 2015. The State Secretary denied knowledge of a specific 20 million euro extra cost, pointed to COA's 2015 annual report irregularities, listed contract types and cost increases without listing individual contracts or values, and rejected closing the borders to all asylum seekers.
An additional cost of 20 million euros is not known to me.
Een extra kostenpost van 20 miljoen euro is mij niet bekend.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Graaf en Wilders over het artikel ‘Amsterdamse extremisten maken gebruik van El Tawheed moskee’

Two PVV MPs asked whether the El Tawheed mosque should be closed because a group that supports armed jihad uses it. The government declined to comment on the concrete case, said criminal investigation is possible if offences are indicated, and explained that courts can ban an organisation on Public Prosecution Service request and that closing a building for safety violations is a local authority matter.
In addition, a building as such can be closed if there is, among other things, non-compliance with fire and safety regulations.
Daarnaast kan een gebouw als zodanig gesloten worden indien er, onder andere, sprake is van niet-naleving van brand- en veiligheidsvoorschriften.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Graaf en Wilders over het bericht ‘Sjeikwatch: Osama-fan en 9/11-verheerlijker Anas Noorani Siddiqui in 020’

MPs De Graaf and Wilders asked why a preacher they called an incitement-to-violence figure was allowed into the Netherlands and whether he would be expelled. The ministers did not discuss the individual case, stated that visa-required and visa-free preachers spreading hatred or violence can be refused or confronted, and pointed to the three-track approach and a recent Eindhoven mosque ban as examples.
I do not make statements about individual cases.
Over individuele casuïstiek doe ik geen uitspraken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid De Graaf over het bericht ‘Gerard van Olphen nieuwe baas APG’

An MP asked whether the €566,000 salary of the new APG chief executive, the pension investor of ABP, is acceptable, whether any severance was agreed, and whether the minister will intervene to reverse the pay agreement. The Secretary of State said APG has reported a salary about 10% lower than its predecessor with no bonus, that she had earlier said a downward adjustment would be good, that she is unaware of any severance agreement, and that the government has no say over APG's pay and the director falls outside the pay-cap law.
At the same time, I am aware that the cabinet is not responsible for the level of remuneration of executives of market parties.
Tegelijkertijd ben ik mij er van bewust dat het kabinet niet gaat over de hoogte van de beloningen van bestuurders van marktpartijen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Graaf, Beertema en Wilders inzake het bericht 'Vrije dag Suikerfeest bespreekbaar voor Amsterdamse schoolbesturen'

PVV MPs asked whether Islamic celebrations such as Eid al-Fitr (Suikerfeest) should be excluded from Dutch schools and whether replacing Western holidays threatens national culture. The State Secretary answered that schools decide on celebrations themselves, that schools may use a four-day week up to seven times a year with parental consent, and rejected the assimilation framing and any intention to block Islamic events.
A school itself decides whether, and in which cases, celebrations or commemorations take place at school.
Een school bepaalt zelf of, en in welke gevallen, op school vieringen of herdenkingen plaatsvinden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Graaf en Wilders over de komst van een haat- en geweldprediker naar Utrecht

Two PVV MPs asked whether the government would bar Haitham al-Haddad, a British cleric they say preaches stoning and rejects the democratic legal order, from entering the Netherlands for an Utrecht conference. The minister confirmed awareness, said EU free-movement rules allow refusal only for a genuine, serious threat based on personal conduct, declined to comment on the individual case, and referred to strafrechtelijke handhaving and separate answers on intolerant behaviour.
I do not comment on individual cases.
Over individuele casuïstiek doe ik geen uitspraken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Graaf en Wilders over het bericht ‘Banden tussen moskee Utrecht en aan Al Qa’ida gelieerde instelling’

Two PVV MPs asked the Minister of Social Affairs about reported links between a Utrecht mosque (Al Fitrah) and an Al Qaida-linked institution, what concrete action had been taken, how many mosques are foreign-funded, and whether mosques and preachers linked to dubious foundations would be closed or expelled. The minister answered that the mayor agreed transparency and funding-openness commitments with Al Fitrah and an evaluation was agreed, declined to give an overview of foreign-funded mosques citing that intelligence services do not publicly disclose concrete cases, and explained the legal limits on closing buildings and expelling persons.
If persons or organisations pose a threat to national security because of their conduct, the AIVD investigates them.
Indien personen of organisaties vanwege hun gedragingen een bedreiging vormen van de nationale veiligheid, dan doet de AIVD daar onderzoek naar.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Graaf en Wilders over de aangekondigde islamitische conferentie in Eindhoven

Two PVV MPs asked the ministers whether a visa should be granted to a preacher who endorses suicide bombings and whether the Al Waqf/Al Fourqaan mosque in Eindhoven should be closed after inviting a violent preacher to a December 2015 conference. The minister replied that visas can be refused or revoked for threats to public order, that some visas were revoked, and that there is no basis under current law to dissolve or close the foundation.
I do not comment on individual cases.
Over individuele gevallen doe ik geen uitspraken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Graaf, Fritsma en Wilders over het bericht ‘Vluchtelingen ingezet voor nijpend personeelstekort’

PVV MPs asked why a project placing refugees in jobs against a staff shortage does not consider unemployed Dutch workers, whether it should be ended, and whether borders should be closed to asylum seekers. The minister replied that the shortages are sector-specific and long-standing, that refugees with residence permits bring useful skills, that the project fits government policy, and that asylum claims are assessed individually.
I do not intend to end this project, because it fits government policy of having refugees contribute to society.
Ik ben niet van plan dit project te laten beëindigen, want het past binnen het kabinetsbeleid om vluchtelingen een bijdrage te laten leveren aan de samenleving.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid De Graaf over het bericht Foto met mijn favoriete geleerde

An MP asks the Minister of Justice and Security about a senior prison-service manager's tweet praising an Islamic scholar linked to the Muslim Brotherhood, and whether he holds an incompatible position with an advisory body; the government says the secondary activities were approved and periodically reviewed, the individual was reminded of social media conduct, and it sees no need for a broad screening of all ministries. Answers refer to AIVD assessments and existing integrity mechanisms but commit to no new action.
No, I see no need for this.
Nee, hiertoe zie ik geen noodzaak.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Graaf, Agema en Wilders over het artikel 'Ouderen op zwart zaad'

PVV MPs asked the government to respond to an article on elderly people's poor finances, calling the situation a disgrace and accusing the government of undermining elderly care, the state pension and pensions. The minister replied that elderly purchasing power has declined due to pension fund problems and budget measures, that low incomes were protected, that long-term care was reformed, and that purchasing power will be reviewed annually with measures in the budget if needed.
Each year the integrated purchasing power picture, including that of the elderly, is weighed for the coming year and the cabinet takes measures where necessary, within the available budgetary room.
Jaarlijks wordt het integrale koopkrachtbeeld, waaronder die van ouderen, voor het komende jaar gewogen en treft het kabinet zo nodig, binnen de beschikbare budgettaire ruimte, maatregelen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Graaf en Wilders over het bericht ‘Oproep tot ‘jihadbendes’ in Europa

PVV MPs De Graaf and Wilders asked the ministers of Interior, Security and Justice, and Social Affairs about a report of calls for Muslim 'jihad gangs' in Europe, including calls to arm, attack police and recruit children, and whether the NCTV's dismissal of the material was adequate, and asked whether Islam is a problem requiring 'de-Islamisation'. The government answered that it takes jihadist violence seriously under its integrated action programme, that the NCTV rightly labelled the material jihadist propaganda with no reason to revise that view, and that Islam enjoys the same constitutional and human rights protection as other religions.
The cabinet takes the threat posed by violent jihadism extremely seriously.
Het kabinet neemt de dreiging die van het gewelddadig jihadisme uitgaat uiterst serieus.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bosma en De Graaf over hoe de KRO begrip wil creëren voor de islam

PVV MPs Bosma and De Graaf asked whether the public broadcaster KRO's programme 'Bekeerd', intended to create understanding for Islam, is a legitimate task for public broadcasting and whether the state broadcaster is being used to Islamize the Netherlands. The Secretary of State replied that the programme aims to give insight into the lives of young (converted) Muslims, fits the public broadcasters' mandate, and that under the Mediawet broadcasters themselves determine form and content, so it is not for the minister to judge.
It is therefore not for me to pass judgement on that.
Het is dus niet aan mij om daar een oordeel over te geven.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Graaf, Beertema en Wilders over het bericht “EU: Wij willen meer politieke islam in Europa”.

PVV MPs asked the government whether it agrees with EU foreign policy chief Mogherini's claim that Islam belongs in Europe, whether the EU endangers national identity, whether Netherlands should leave the EU, and whether she should be expelled to Saudi Arabia. The minister answered by citing EU treaty values and the Charter on religious freedom, rejected leaving the EU and rejected the expulsion request.
No. The cabinet considers continued membership of the European Union to be in the direct interest of Dutch citizens and businesses.
Nee. Het kabinet acht blijvend lidmaatschap van de Europese Unie in het directe belang van Nederlandse burgers en bedrijven.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Graaf, Beertema en Wilders over het bericht 'Arabisch op Blerickse scholen'

PVV MPs asked whether Arabic lessons in Dutch primary schools should be stopped, arguing the language is irrelevant and linked to radicalisation. The minister rejected these claims and stated that schools may offer Arabic as an extracurricular activity, while within school hours only English, German and French (plus Dutch and Frisian) are legally permitted.
Within school hours, primary schools are legally permitted to offer only English, German and French, alongside Dutch (and Frisian in Friesland).
Binnen de onderwijstijd is het in het basisonderwijs wettelijk alleen toegestaan de talen Engels, Duits en Frans aan te bieden, naast het Nederlands (en het Fries in Friesland).
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Roon en De Graaf over een in 2004 verhinderde aanslag

Two PVV MPs asked whether reports that the Netherlands escaped an attack in 2004 were correct, whether two men filming the Israeli embassy were prosecuted, their nationality, and whether they were handed to Israeli authorities. The Minister answered that the attack claim cannot be confirmed, that four men were arrested but prosecution for preparing an attack failed for lack of evidence, that two were convicted on lesser charges (one later acquitted on appeal), that one man of Saudi nationality was expelled, that the nationality of the others cannot be established, and that there was no reason to hand them over to Israel.
The criminal investigation did not, however, lead to prosecution for preparing an attack, because insufficient evidence was found for that.
Het strafrechtelijk onderzoek heeft evenwel niet geleid tot een vervolging ter zake van het voorbereiden van een aanslag, omdat daartoe onvoldoende bewijs werd gevonden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid De Graaf over het bericht 'Ex-bestuurder pensioenreus APG krijgt miljoen afkoopsom'

An MP asked the State Secretary about a reported ~1.1 million euro severance and continued-pay package for an ex-APG board member, and whether the rules on pension-sector pay were followed. The State Secretary confirmed the court-ordered payments, pointed to the Wet beloningsbeleid financiële ondernemingen as governing severance, and said it was for APG to decide on further steps.
It is up to APG to decide on any further steps.
Het is aan APG te beslissen over eventuele vervolgstappen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid De Graaf over het bericht ‘Excuses om weigeren vrouw met nikab in bus’

An MP asked whether a bus driver who refused a woman wearing a niqab was right, whether staff may refuse face-covering clothing before a ban exists, and whether the government will defend such staff. The government answered that a ban on face-covering clothing in education, care, government buildings and public transport is being prepared, that no legal ban exists yet, and that the driver breached company rules and the company apologised.
No, at this moment there is no legal ban on face-covering clothing, and under the carrier's company rules the niqab wearer should have been treated the same as all other passengers.

Nee, op dit moment is er geen wettelijk verbod op gezichtsbedekkende kleding en volgens de bedrijfsregels van de vervoerder had de niqaab draagster op dezelfde manier behandeld moeten worden als alle andere reizigers.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Agema en De Graaf over het reclamespotje van Stichting Moslimpleegkind

PVV MPs asked whether the government would stop a recruitment ad by Stichting Moslimpleegkind that implies white parents are poor foster carers and promotes Islam. The state secretary replied that foster placements are carefully screened and that the Jeugdwet requires considering a child's religious and cultural background, and that diversification campaigns exist, but declined to judge the interpretation of the ad and did not commit to stopping it.
Furthermore, it is not for me to judge the interpretation of a commercial by Stichting Moslimpleegkind.
Verder is het niet aan mij om een oordeel te hebben over de interpretatie van een reclamespotje van de Stichting Moslimpleegkind.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid De Graaf over het feit dat 64,2% van de in Nederland woonachtige Turken bij de laatste Turkse parlementsverkiezingen op de islamitische AK-partij van president en wannabe-sultan Erdogan hee

The PVV MP De Graaf asked whether it is known that 64.2% of Turkish voters in the Netherlands voted for Erdogan's AKP, and what this means for integration, citing Erdogan's statements on sharia, minarets and mosques under Diyanet supervision. Minister Asscher answered that the statements are no basis for judging integration, that voting freely is acceptable, that he will raise transparency and possible Turkish influence with Turkey and religious organisations, and that he will inform parliament.
Where there is group pressure in any way, I consider that undesirable and inappropriate.
Wanneer er sprake is van groepsdruk op welke manier dan ook, vind ik dat ongewenst en ongepast.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Graaf, Helder en Wilders over het bericht ‘Terreurverdachte gepakt in Limburg’

Three PVV MPs asked the ministers about reports of a terror suspect arrested in Limburg, whether terror suspects should be kept out of the Netherlands, whether this should be treated as a security warning, and whether the Netherlands should leave Schengen and reintroduce border controls. The government confirmed the arrest, said suspects can be arrested, prosecuted or extradited, noted the threat requires vigilance, and rejected leaving Schengen while defending its policy of preventing departures of foreign terrorist fighters.

The Cabinet is of the view that persons about whom there is a well-founded suspicion that they will travel to Syria and Iraq with the intention of joining a terrorist organisation must be prevented from departing.

Het Kabinet is van mening dat personen ten aanzien waarvan het gegronde vermoeden bestaat dat zij naar Syrië en Irak zullen uitreizen met de intentie om zich aan te sluiten bij een terroristische organisatie, het uitreizen moet worden verhinderd.
Antwoord op vragen van leden De Graaf en Wilders over het bericht ‘Omstreden haatsjeik donderdag naar Eindhoven’

Two PVV MPs asked whether a cleric calling for throat-cutting and skull-smashing should receive or keep a visa, and whether the Al Fourqaan mosque should be closed for hosting him. The government answered that Italy issued and then withdrew the visa so the speaker may not stay in the Netherlands, and that closing a building is only possible for building-safety violations, drug trade, or if the organisation's aims breach public order, while criminal incitement is prosecuted by the Public Prosecution Service.
This speaker therefore may not reside in the Netherlands.
Deze spreker mag dan ook niet in Nederland verblijven.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Graaf en Wilders over het bezoek van weer een haatsjeik, ditmaal aan een moskee in Helmond

MPs De Graaf and Wilders asked whether a preacher who allegedly called for violence against Jews, Christians and Shiites should be allowed to speak at a Helmond mosque and whether his visa and the mosque should be blocked. The government answered that free speech is limited when incitement to hatred or violence threatens public order, that visas are refused to preachers calling for hatred, and that after local consultation the mosque cancelled the invitation.
By refusing visas to preachers from visa-requiring countries who call for hatred and violence, the government seeks to temper polarisation and radicalisation.
Door middel van het weigeren van visa aan predikers uit visumplichtige landen, die oproepen tot haat en geweld, tracht de overheid polarisering en radicalisering te temperen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Graaf, Klever en Wilders over het bericht 'Medische raad bij ramadan'

Three PVV MPs asked whether patients who fast during Ramadan knowingly endanger their health and whether insurers should bear the extra advice and care costs of those who become medically unstable. Minister Schippers answered that the Health Insurance Act requires care decisions to rest on care-content criteria, that she does not intend to amend it, and that no registrations exist to determine the extra costs.
I am not aware of any records from which these extra costs could be derived without further ado.
Er zijn mij geen registraties bekend waar deze extra kosten zonder meer uit af te leiden zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Graaf en Wilders over het bericht ‘Utrecht vreest komst Belgische martelsjeik’

PVV MPs asked why a Belgian sheikh with alleged terrorist links and torture-related convictions was offered a visa for an Utrecht event, and whether the Al Fitrah foundation and its mosque should be dissolved or closed and a blacklist of hate preachers created. The government answered that the sheikh did not attend and held lawful residence in Belgium, that no visa was issued to him, that dissolution or closure is not warranted given free speech limits enforced through criminal law, and that no blacklist exists though an NCTV alert list and Schengen alerts are used.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Roon en De Graaf over de kille wijze waarop een Nederlandse Holocaust overlevende is gekort op haar AOW-uitkering

PVV MPs asked why a Dutch Holocaust survivor living in the West Bank had her AOW pension cut by about 35 percent, whether all residents of Israeli settlements in occupied territories face such cuts, how many are affected, and whether the government will act against it. The government regretted the handling, said the affected survivor's situation was corrected, and decided that current single AOW recipients in occupied territory keep their benefit while new single recipients from 2016 get the 50 percent married-couple norm; it declined to change the treaty or contact Israeli counterparts.
The cabinet regrets how matters unfolded; for the person concerned the situation has now been adjusted and she has been informed of this.
Het kabinet betreurt de gang van zaken Voor betrokkene is de situatie nu aangepast en zij is daarover geïnformeerd.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Helder en De Graaf over de uitspraak van een lid uit een coalitiefractie dat de korpschef van de Nationale Politie er goed aan doet sollicitanten te checken op PVV-achtige opvattingen

Two PVV MPs asked whether a coalition MP's remark that the police chief should screen job applicants for PVV-like views was acceptable and whether he would distance himself from it. The government answered that selecting applicants on political views is not permitted under the Constitution and the ECHR, that political affiliation plays no role in selection, and that it would not judge individual MPs' opinions.
Selecting applicants on political views is not permitted under Article 1 of the Constitution, Article 14 of the European Convention on Human Rights and other treaties.

Het selecteren van sollicitanten op politieke opvattingen is niet toegestaan op grond van artikel 1 van de Grondwet, artikel 14 van het Europees Verdrag voor de Rechten van de Mens en andere verdragen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Graaf en Wilders over het bericht ‘Gouds bestuur lost vrouwenkwestie op’

Two PVV MPs asked whether a planned wall separating women from view of Muslims in a Gouda redevelopment amounts to sharia-based apartheid, and whether the government will ban mosque construction and the planned Gouda mega-mosque. The minister answered that the wall is a site-entrance separation requested by a special school and a child day-care centre, and that the mosque has offered to reduce its size, with an independent facilitator starting a new consultation; he reiterated that Muslims may build mosques within zoning rules and the law.
The mosque board of the new mosque planned in Gouda recently (mid-March) offered to substantially reduce the size of the mosque.
