Het moskeebestuur van de nieuw te bouwen moskee in Gouda heeft recent (half maart) het aanbod gedaan om de moskee qua omvang substantieel te verkleinen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Roon en De Graaf over islamitische militairen die door loyaliteitsproblemen niet geschikt zijn voor de Nederlandse krijgsmacht

Two PVV MPs asked the Defence Minister about Islamic military personnel with alleged loyalty problems, questioning the choice of a commissioned study on religious chaplaincy, the number of Muslim soldiers and dual-nationality recruitment, and asking for ex-soldiers who joined jihadist groups and a recruitment campaign. The Minister rejected the premise that Muslim soldiers cannot be distinguished, stated that Defence does not register religious belief, cited a study finding about 1,600 soldiers with other non-Christian beliefs, refused to restrict dual nationals or launch the proposed campaign, and referred back to earlier answers on ex-soldiers.
Defence does not register the religious beliefs of its employees.
Defensie registreert de geloofsovertuiging van haar medewerkers niet.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Graaf, Fritsma en Wilders over het bericht ‘IS ziet immigrant als wapen’

PVV MPs asked whether reports that IS sees migrants as a weapon, and possible jihadist infiltration via the Libya-Italy route, mean a security emergency at the borders, and whether the government can guarantee no terrorists will arrive. The government answered that it is alert to signals of misuse of the refugee flow, describes existing reporting structures, awareness efforts and coordination bodies, but does not guarantee that no terrorists will arrive.
The Netherlands and the EU, including the implementing organisations, are alert to signals that ISIS or other jihadist organisations are misusing the refugee flow to reach the Netherlands or Europe.
Nederland en de EU, inclusief de uitvoeringsorganisaties, zijn alert op signalen van misbruik van de vluchtelingenstroom door ISIS of andere jihadistische organisaties naar Nederland of Europa.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Beertema, De Graaf en Wilders over het bericht 'Halaleten voor elke scholier'

PVV MPs asked the State Secretary for Education whether a Christian school imposing halal food on all pupils, including non-Muslims, on a school trip is unacceptable and whether the proposal will be withdrawn. The State Secretary answered that schools are free to make such choices within the law, parents can raise concerns with school leadership and through the works council, and the national government has no role in meal decisions.
Schools are free to make their own choices, within the limits of laws and regulations.
Scholen zijn vrij om, binnen de grenzen van de wet- en regelgeving, hun eigen keuzes te maken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Beertema en De Graaf over het bericht ‘Meer studenten voor omstreden Islamitische Universiteit

PVV MPs asked the Minister of Education about the Islamic University of Rotterdam: graduate numbers, student financing, foreign funding, and the rector's inflammatory statements about Turkish-Dutch EP candidates. The Minister said oversight was being tightened via the Inspectorate and NVAO, a bill on civic responsibility for unfunded institutions is planned, and the foreign-funding question is under a WODC study due in 2015.
My legal options to intervene are limited because it concerns unfunded institutions.
Mijn juridische mogelijkheden om in te grijpen zijn beperkt daar het gaat om een niet-bekostigde instellingen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Graaf en Wilders over het bericht ‘Religies in gesprek in Ridderzaal’

Two PVV MPs asked why Islamic representatives were invited to a government dialogue in the Ridderzaal, a symbol of freedom, given their view of Islam as a totalitarian ideology. The minister answered that Islam is a religion protected by freedom of religion, that the dialogue aimed to bridge differences in a pluralistic society, and that such conversations should continue.
Islam is a religion. Like other religions, this religion falls under freedom of religion and is subject to the same rules.
De Islam is een godsdienst. Deze godsdienst valt net als andere religies onder de vrijheid van godsdienst en is met dezelfde regels omgeven.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Graaf en Wilders over het bericht ‘Iedereen bij moskee wist van shariahuwelijken’

PVV MPs De Graaf and Wilders asked the Justice Minister about reports that a mosque community knew of sharia marriages, whether such marriages are tolerated, and whether imams performing them should be expelled or stripped of nationality. The minister said no national overview of sharia marriages exists, confirmed that religious marriages without a prior civil marriage are prohibited and punishable, and stated that stripping Dutch nationality for common crimes is not possible under current law or planned.
No national overview of this is available.
Hier is geen (landelijk) overzicht van beschikbaar.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Graaf en Wilders over het bericht “Jihadronselaar Bilal is nu jongerenwerker in Amsterdam”

Two PVV MPs asked the Minister of Social Affairs whether a convicted jihad recruiter now working as a youth worker in Amsterdam is truly deradicalised, whether he should be expelled, and whether his sister should be sent to ISIS. The minister said deradicalisation cannot be guaranteed, pointed to the Dutch citizenship-deprivation option and the integrated jihadism action programme, and refused to send the person or his sister away.
Deradicalisation, however, remains human work, so no one can give a guarantee about the degree of deradicalisation.
Deradicalisering blijft echter mensenwerk, waardoor niemand garantie kan geven over de mate van deradicalisering.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Graaf en Helder over het bericht ‘Man in Amsterdam opgepakt voor voorbereiden aanslag op agenten’

PVV MPs asked the Minister of Security and Justice about a reported arrest in Amsterdam for planning an attack on police officers, including why border controls were not reintroduced, how the suspect entered the Netherlands, whether borders should be closed to immigration from Islamic countries, and whether police should stop wearing uniforms in public. The Minister answered that border controls would be a last resort and not proportionate, declined to discuss individual cases, rejected closing borders, and said there are no concrete indications of an attack and no reason to deploy the military at stations.
No statements are made about individual cases.
Over individuele gevallen worden geen mededelingen gedaan.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Graaf en Wilders over het bericht ‘ISIS-vlag in beslag genomen’

Two PVV MPs asked the Minister of Security and Justice whether three men who waved an ISIS-type flag should be stripped of Dutch nationality and have their passports revoked. The minister replied that a prosecution decision is still pending after advice from the anti-discrimination expertise centre, so such measures are not yet on the table, and no further details can be given for reasons of investigation and prosecution.
Because of investigation and prosecution interests, no further information can be provided.
Vanwege belangen van opsporing en vervolging kunnen geen verdere mededelingen worden gedaan.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Graaf, Helder en Wilders over het bericht ‘Onderzoek naar jihadi-training in Ardennen’

Written questions from PVV MPs asked whether jihadi training facilities exist in or are used from the Netherlands, how many of the 41 passport-confiscated jihadists were trained in the EU, and whether jihadists can be denaturalised and expelled. The minister replied that no evidence of training camps in the Netherlands exists, that 48 passports are flagged, and that a bill to strip nationality from dual nationals convicted of terrorism is being prepared.
I have no indications that jihadist training camps are located in the Netherlands.
Ik heb geen aanwijzingen dat zich in Nederland jihadistische trainingskampen bevinden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Graaf, Fritsma en Wilders over het bericht ‘Of slapen er terroristen in Zwolle’

MPs De Graaf, Fritsma and Wilders asked the Minister of Security and Justice about reports of possible jihadist terrorists among asylum seekers, whether border closures and subsidy cuts were warranted. The minister answered that there are no concrete indications of planned abuse, that reintroducing internal border controls would be disproportionate, and that he will not close borders or cut subsidies, while pointing to a letter on measures and promising continued vigilance.
For operational reasons, I cannot make specific statements about any possible indications in this regard.
Vanwege operationele belangen kan ik geen specifieke mededelingen doen over eventuele aanwijzingen hieromtrent.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Graaf en Wilders over het bericht moslims delen flyers uit voor protest

Two MPs from the PVV asked the Minister of Security and Justice about a report that Muslims were handing out flyers for a protest, and whether the Hizb ut Tahrir caliphate aim undermines the democratic rule of law and whether members with Dutch passports should be denaturalised and expelled. The minister confirmed awareness, described HuT as an anti-democratic radical movement that does not call for violence but warrants vigilance, said measures follow only if criminal offences are committed, and rejected denaturalisation and expulsion as unnecessary.
If HuT were to commit criminal offences, measures would be taken.
Als de HuT zich schuldig zou (gaan) maken aan strafbare feiten dan worden er maatregelen genomen.
Antwoord op vragen de leden De Graaf, Helder en Wilders over het bericht ‘Superblunder: Franse jihadisten op vrije voeten'

PVV MPs asked the Minister of Security and Justice about reports that French jihadists were free in Turkey, whether Dutch-passport jihadists were held or extradited, whether they could be kept out, and whether border and passport controls should be tightened or borders closed. The minister said no Dutch-passport jihadists are currently known to be held in Turkey and none extradited, refused to end automated passport checks at Schiphol or to close borders, citing EU free movement and proportionality rules.
Such a decision is, as far as I am concerned, not on the agenda.
Een dergelijk besluit is wat mij betreft niet aan de orde.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Graus, De Graaf en Wilders over het Islamitisch Offerfeest op Werelddierendag

Three PVV MPs asked whether the Islamic Feast of Sacrifice falling on World Animal Day, and the ritual slaughter it involves, was acceptable and whether the practice should end. The minister answered that the government respects religious traditions within the rule of law, that unstunned ritual slaughter is governed by law and enforced by the NVWA, and that it sees no reason to end the practice.
The manner in which unstunned ritual slaughter may take place is laid down in Dutch laws and regulations.
De wijze waarop onbedwelmde rituele slacht mag plaatsvinden is vastgelegd in de Nederlandse wet- en regelgeving.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Graaf, De Roon en Wilders over de berichten ‘Werknemers pro forma tot de islam bekeerd’ en ‘werknemers bekeerd voor klus’

PVV MPs asked whether reports that Dutch workers were pro forma converted to Islam for a job in Saudi Arabia were known, and how their safety and the Saudi restrictions on non-Muslims were viewed. The minister confirmed awareness, said there were no indications the workers were at risk, declined to judge Saudi policy or the company director's stance, and said the matter would be raised in regular contacts.
The matter will be raised in the regular contacts between Saudi Arabia and the Netherlands.
De kwestie zal opgebracht worden in de reguliere contacten tussen Saoedi-Arabië en Nederland.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Graaf, Beertema en Madlener over het bericht 'Moldaviërs halen Roemenen in'

Three PVV MPs asked the ministers of Social Affairs, Foreign Affairs and Infrastructure about reports of Dutch transport firms 'flagging out', foreign drivers, lorry parking and the sale of passports and driving licences, and whether borders should be closed to Eastern European workers. The government answered that data on flagged-out firms and job losses is unavailable, that it cannot track non-EU nationality entitlements, that enforcement is being strengthened in cooperation with the ILT and Inspectie SZW, and that closing the labour market is not a realistic option.
It is not known how many Dutch lorry drivers have lost their jobs since the labour market was opened to Romanians, Bulgarians and Poles.
Het is niet bekend hoeveel Nederlandse vrachtwagenchauffeurs sinds de openstelling van de arbeidsmarkt voor Roemenen, Bulgaren en Polen hun baan hebben verloren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Beertema, De Graaf en Wilders over de vernieuwde islamitische gebedsruimte op de Vrije Universiteit

PVV MPs asked the Minister of Education whether the VU's reopened Islamic prayer room, which they said enables gender segregation and undermines integration, should be grounds for cutting its funding. The Minister replied that universities decide their own diversity policy, that the VU bars gender segregation, that other religions are also accommodated, and that she sees no reason to end funding.
No. Whether and how a university gives shape to its diversity policy is a matter for the university itself. The government has no role in this.
Neen. Of en hoe een universiteit invulling geeft aan haar diversiteitsbeleid is een zaak van de universiteit zelf. De overheid heeft hier geen rol in.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Graaf, Helder en Wilders over de berichten ‘Nederlandse Marokkanen nu ook in Marokko berecht’ en ‘Luxe auto’s en appartementen: daar gaat het geld naartoe’

PVV MPs asked about reports that Dutch-Moroccan dual nationals are detained and prosecuted in Morocco, how many dual nationals are detained and still receive benefits, and whether citizenship, assets, and benefits should be withdrawn or repatriation encouraged. The minister confirmed about 150 dual nationals detained in each country, explained benefit termination via data exchange, rejected the claim of hundreds involved in killings, noted existing asset-seizure and Moroccan benefit-check powers, and declined denaturalisation and benefit restrictions based on work history.
If a person is in detention and receives a benefit from the Dutch state, this benefit is terminated.
Indien een persoon in detentie verblijft en een uitkering van de Nederlandse staat ontvangt, wordt deze uitkering beëindigd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Graaf en Wilders over de berichten ‘Ouders top-25 geven niet thuis’ en ‘Aanpak top-24 zaak van lange adem’

Two PVV MPs asked whether the government will strip Moroccan criminals and their families of Dutch nationality and deport them, arguing that the soft approach to crime yields nothing and that parents should bear responsibility. The Minister rejects shifting responsibility to parents, explains that deprivation of nationality is only possible for state-undermining offences with sentences of 8+ years, and refuses to move neighbourhood officers to Morocco.
Revoking Dutch nationality and deportation following a conviction for ordinary offences is not possible.
De intrekking van de Nederlandse nationaliteit en uitzetting wegens een veroordeling voor commune misdrijven is niet mogelijk.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Graaf en Wilders over het bericht «Vrouw uit Nederland hielp al-Shabaab met geld»

PVV MPs De Graaf and Wilders asked about a report that a Dutch woman financed al-Shabaab, whether other cases of jihad fundraising in the Netherlands are known, and whether the government will investigate Islamic funding flows and detain, denaturalise and deport those financing jihad. The minister answered that suspicious transactions are passed to investigative services without disclosing details, that a WODC study on foreign funding of Islamic institutions is underway (Somalia not included), and that terrorism financing is punishable with prosecution decided case by case, while citizenship can be revoked after a final conviction and that possibility is being extended.
Since the reports concern personal or investigative data, I cannot say anything about the content of the reports.
Aangezien de meldingen persoonsgegevens dan wel opsporingsgegevens betreffen, kan ik over de inhoud van de meldingen geen mededelingen doen.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Graaf, Beertema en Wilders over het feit dat openbare school De Tweemaster in Duindorp (Scheveningen) leerlingen halalvoedsel heeft voorgeschoteld tijdens schoolkamp, zonder dat de oude

PVV MPs asked the ministers whether they knew that a Scheveningen public school served halal food on a school camp without informing parents, which other Hague schools did the same, who initiated it, and whether the mayor would be urged to combat such practices. The government confirmed awareness, said it does not centrally register camp meals and that the school is responsible, explained the camp site offered one halal-compliant evening meal for practical reasons, and declined to direct the mayor, referring questions to the school.
I am not aware which schools spent their school camp in Vledder.
Het is mij niet bekend welke scholen hun schoolkamp in Vledder hebben doorgebracht.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Graaf en Wilders over het bericht 'Haatimam in de ban'

PVV MPs De Graaf and Wilders asked the Minister of Social Affairs about a report on a hate-preaching imam, asking whether Islamic teaching should lead to closures and expulsions, whether Turkey's influence via imam appointments should be stopped, how mayors should respond, and whether migration and citizenship should be restricted. The minister answered that religion is not for the government to judge, that the state is neutral on imam appointments provided Dutch law is respected, that visas are refused to preachers calling for hate, that citizenship deprivation for terrorist offences is being expanded, and that the state acts where the rule of law is breached.
Where the limits of the rule of law are exceeded, the government acts, regardless of what inspired certain acts or statements.
Waar de grenzen van de rechtsstaat worden overschreden, treedt de overheid op, ongeacht waardoor bepaalde handelingen of uitspraken zijn geïnspireerd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Beertema, De Graaf en Bosma over alinea's uit het AIVD-rapport "Transformatie van het jihadisme in Nederland"

MPs asked whether the government knows of AIVD passages describing a salafist preacher and others passing intolerant and jihadist views to children, and whether the preacher will be detained, expelled and his institution closed. The minister declined to name the preacher or the institution citing operational secrecy, said administrative detention is not deemed necessary given existing criminal and administrative tools, and pointed to an integrated action programme and the Agenda Integratie.
I cannot make public statements about operational matters.
Ik kan in het openbaar geen mededelingen doen over operationele aangelegenheden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Beertema en De Graaf over het bericht dat op de Amsterdamse islamitische basisscholen El Amien I en II een angstcultuur heerst

PVV MPs asked whether a press report of a climate of fear, misused education funds and suspiciously high Cito scores at Amsterdam Islamic primary schools El Amien I and II justifies action, and whether the minister now has the powers to intervene such as closure. The minister answered that the inspectorate found improper spending that will be recovered, found no evidence of breaches of democratic values, that governance is inadequate so the board was ordered to improve, and that a follow-up inspection in Q4 2014 will determine whether to intervene further.
The inspectorate is preparing the recovery of unlawfully spent amounts and will continue to closely monitor the situation.
De inspectie bereidt de terugvordering van onrechtmatig bestede bedragen voor en blijft nauwlettend toezien op de situatie.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Madlener en De Graaf over het bericht dat een buschauffeur een persoon in een boerka heeft geweigerd

MPs Madlener and De Graaf asked the government about a report that a bus driver refused a woman wearing a burqa, and whether burqa bans should be pursued given security concerns. The State Secretary answered that the government considers face-covering clothing undesirable where communication is seriously hindered, that a legal ban in education, care, public transport and government buildings is being prepared, and that the driver's refusal was contrary to the carrier's rules, so apologies were offered.
According to the carrier's company rules, the burqa wearer should have been treated in the same way as all other passengers.
Volgens de bedrijfsregels van de vervoerder had de boerka-draagster op dezelfde manier behandeld moeten worden als alle andere reizigers.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Graaf en Wilders over de artikelen 'Nederlandse Joden huren bewaking in', 'Angst onder Rotterdamse joden na bedreiging op straat', 'Gesprek moet helpen' en 'Antisemitisme: 'Zo doen wij

MPs De Graaf and Wilders asked the government about press reports on Jewish security, antisemitism, a housing association's letters ordering removal of an Israeli flag, Muslim discrimination, and revoking Dutch nationality from jihadist travellers. The minister answered that the housing association regretted its letters and no action is planned, an antisemitism study is due in early 2015, and nationality can only be revoked after a terrorism conviction under limited conditions.
A study into possible breeding grounds and triggering factors for antisemitism ... will be delivered in early 2015.
Een onderzoek naar mogelijke voedingsbodems en triggerfactoren voor antisemitisme ... zal begin 2015 worden opgeleverd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Wilders, De Graaf en Helder over de anti-Israëldemonstratie

PVV MPs asked whether police failed to act against Nazi and terror symbols and a Hitler salute at a July 2014 anti-Israel demonstration in The Hague, and whether the mayor failed and suspects should be arrested, stripped of Dutch nationality and expelled. The minister refers to earlier answers, says criminal punishment is for the judge, and explains that Dutch nationality can only be revoked for terrorism convictions after 1 October 2010 and that residence can be ended only after a final conviction.
If someone has committed a criminal offence, it is for the judge to assess what punishment is appropriate, given the offence, the perpetrator(s) and the harm caused.
Indien iemand een strafbaar feit heeft begaan, is het aan de rechter om te beoordelen welke straf passend is, gelet op het delict, de persoon van de dader(s) en het aangedane leed.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Graaf, Helder en Wilders over de antisemitische demonstratie door moslims in Den Haag

Three PVV MPs asked why police and the mayor did not act against alleged criminal speech (calls to violence, a Hitler salute) at an anti-Israel demonstration in The Hague, and why a journalist was removed rather than her harassers arrested. The minister answered that two people were arrested and will be prosecuted, no Hitler salute was found, the mayor lacks legal power to ban a demonstration for its content, and the journalist's treatment aimed to prevent escalation.
The mayor also has no power to act against a demonstration solely to prevent or end criminal offences.
De burgemeester heeft ook geen bevoegdheid tegen een demonstratie op te treden enkel ter voorkoming of beëindiging van strafbare feiten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Graaf en Wilders over de voorgenomen nieuwbouw van de Tevhit-moskee in Venlo-Zuid

MPs De Graaf and Wilders asked whether the government knows of the planned new Tevhit mosque in Venlo, its links to the Turkish Diyanet foundation, its financing, and whether it will block construction. The government confirmed the plan, noted the mosque appears on the foundation's list of branches, said it does not interfere in financing of religious buildings absent suspicion of illegal acts, and pointed to freedom of religion under Article 6 of the Constitution while stating construction is allowed if Dutch law is respected.
The construction of new mosques or other places of worship is permitted in the Netherlands, on condition that Dutch rules and laws are not violated.
De bouw van nieuwe moskeeën of andere gebedshuizen is in Nederland toegestaan, op voorwaarde dat de Nederlandse regels en wetten niet worden overtreden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Helder en De Graaf over straatcoaches

The MPs asked whether street coaches, subsidised by municipalities, conceal crimes from police, whether police agreements with them obstruct information flow, and what the government will do given a Movisie study finding them ineffective. The minister said local authorities are responsible for such arrangements, that no national agreements exist, and that he will discuss the Movisie findings with the VNG and report to the House.
It is the responsibility of the local authority to make agreements on the deployment of street coaches and cooperation with the police.
Het is de verantwoordelijkheid van het lokaal bestuur om afspraken te maken over de inzet van straatcoaches en de samenwerking met de politie.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Graaf , Helder en Wilders over het bericht “Gevaarlijke jihadist vaak buiten beeld’

PVV MPs asked whether the government will reintroduce border controls, detain and expel returning jihadists and impose an immigration stop from Islamic countries after a report that foreign jihadists move freely in Europe unknown to the services. The Staatssecretaris answered that European intelligence cooperation is intensified, rejected the listed measures as incompatible with the constitution and treaties, and pointed to a national action programme on travel-data collection for later this autumn.
Concrete public statements cannot be made about the nature of cooperation between intelligence services.
Over de aard van de samenwerking tussen inlichtingendiensten, kunnen in het openbaar geen concrete mededelingen worden gedaan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid De Graaf over Marokkanen en uitkeringsfraude

An MP asks how many AIO recipients there are by country of birth, how often SVB checks foreign assets, in how many cases foreign authorities refuse cooperation, how verification of foreign data works, when sanctions are applied, and whether the approach is discriminatory. The State Secretary gives tables and counts of checks and hidden assets, states SVB relies on foreign institutions being reliable, describes penalties and suspension rules, and denies any discrimination.
The SVB has no indications that information is deliberately or knowingly provided incorrectly to the SVB.
De SVB beschikt niet over aanwijzingen dat opzettelijk of bewust niet juiste informatie wordt verstrekt aan de SVB.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Graaf, Beertema en Wilders over de berichten «Islamists infiltrating schools in Hamburg» en «Engelse scholen in greep van moslimradicalen»

PVV MPs asked the government whether Dutch schools face Islamist infiltration like reported cases in Hamburg and England, and whether Islamic schools should be closed. The government answered that the Inspectorate has found no signs of such infiltration, that radicalisation incidents are monitored through the biennial social safety monitor, and that closing Islamic schools is not warranted beyond the legal grounds of public order.
The inspectorate has not received any indications that Dutch education currently faces the Islamic infiltration you cite.
Vanuit de inspectie zijn geen aanwijzingen gekomen dat er in het Nederlandse onderwijs op dit moment sprake is van de door u aangehaalde islamitische infiltratie
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Graaf, Wilders en Helder over de ronselfilm ‘Fighting Journalists, Oh Oh Aleppo “De spookstad”

Three PVV MPs asked the Justice and Social Affairs ministers whether they knew of a jihadist recruitment film targeting Dutch youth, whether it aimed at recruiting for jihad, how they view the fact that the people involved are third-generation Dutch-born, and whether they would prosecute the makers and strip citizenship from dual nationals. The minister confirmed knowledge of the film, said it intends to radicalise and recruit youth, stated that recruitment for jihad is a crime with prosecution decided case by case by the Public Prosecution Service, and noted citizenship can be revoked after a final terrorism conviction where dual nationality exists.
Recruiting for jihad is a crime. The Public Prosecution Service decides case by case on possible prosecution.
Het ronselen voor de jihad is een misdrijf. Het openbaar ministerie beslist per geval over eventuele vervolging.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Graaf en Wilders over de berichten ‘Moskee moet plaats bieden aan duizenden’ en ‘Moslims onder druk om bijdrage moskee’

PVV MPs De Graaf and Wilders asked the Minister of Social Affairs about press reports on a Gouda mosque expansion, including alleged pressure on members to contribute 1,500 euro and past fundraising for Syria. The minister answered that mosque construction is a matter of religious freedom, that contributions must be voluntary and that pressure is rejected, while stating no evidence was found that funds went to jihad and that financing falls within Dutch law.
The board is entitled to ask mosque visitors for a financial contribution toward the construction of a new mosque.
Het bestuur is gerechtigd om de bezoekers van de moskee een financiële bijdrage te vragen ten behoeve van de bouw van een nieuwe moskee.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Graaf en Wilders over de stand van zaken in Irak en de opmars van ISIS

Two PVV MPs asked the ministers about returned Syria jihadists, recruiters, terror financing, mosque closures and denaturalisation/detention of returnees. The government answered that about thirty returnees are known, that operational details and locations are not disclosed, that prosecutors and services monitor them, and that mosque closure and nationality revocation are possible under specific legal conditions.
Operational matters and specific cases cannot be disclosed publicly.
Over operationele aangelegenheden en concrete gevallen kunnen in het openbaar geen mededelingen worden gedaan.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Graaf en Wilders over de uitzending van Nieuwsuur over de mislukking van het anti-radicaliseringsbeleid

Two PVV MPs asked the Minister of Social Affairs about a Nieuwsuur broadcast on the failure of anti-radicalisation policy, including its cost (around 30 million euros), how the money was spent, and whether Islam is the root cause. The minister confirmed the broadcast, gave a budget breakdown (14.46 million spent over 2007-2011, with 78 projects funded and oversight via subsidy conditions), and rejected the link between Islam and radicalisation.
Decentralisation grants were paid out via the municipal fund. There was consultation about this, but no formal review or control applies.
Via het gemeentefonds zijn de decentralisatie-uitkeringen uitgekeerd. Daarover is wel overleg geweest maar is een officiële toetsing/controle niet van toepassing.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Graaf en Wilders over het bericht ‘Hilversumse moskee tart herdenking’

Two PVV MPs asked whether the government shares their revulsion at a Hilversum mosque comparing the Holocaust to the Arab attempt to prevent Israel's creation, and whether the mosque should be closed and its land rezoned. The minister confirmed awareness and said closure or dissolution is only possible under narrow legal conditions (public order, fire/safety violations, drug trade) and that zoning is a municipal responsibility, none of which apply here.
The zoning of land is a municipal responsibility.
De bestemming van gronden is een gemeentelijke verantwoordelijkheid.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Graaf, Beertema en Wilders over het bericht ‘In Nederland studerende Saoediër opgepakt in Kenia’

PVV MPs asked why the Netherlands contributes to the education of students from Islamic countries such as Saudi Arabia, and whether such students should be barred or expelled after a Saudi student was arrested in Kenya. The minister answered that internationalisation policy does not distinguish by religion, declined to comment on the individual case, and refused to bar or expel students from Islamic countries.
I do not make statements about individual cases.
Ik doe geen mededelingen over individuele gevallen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Helder en De Graaf over bendeleden die naar Marokko zijn gevlucht

PVV MPs Helder and De Graaf asked whether gang members fled to Morocco to evade police, whether they are suspects, and why Morocco would refuse legal assistance requests. The minister answered that all suspects in the investigation have been arrested, no suspects are hiding in Morocco, no legal assistance requests were made, and the investigation is ongoing so no further statements can be made.
Because the criminal investigation is still ongoing, I cannot make any statements on this point.
Omdat het strafrechtelijk onderzoek nog loopt kan ik op dit punt geen mededelingen doen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Graaf, Helder en Wilders over het bericht ‘Buurtvader Gestel: “Ik ga derde overvaller Deurne niet aangeven”

PVV MPs asked why no action was taken against a neighbourhood father who said he would not name the third robber of a Deurne jeweller, and whether he should be arrested and whether Moroccans distrusting the Dutch should give up benefits and leave. The minister declined to comment on the ongoing investigation and rejected the claim of a failed integration and parallel society, and rejected the benefit-surrender idea by restating that everyone has equal rights and duties.
The investigation into the robbery in Deurne – and therefore also the investigation into all possible suspects – has not yet been concluded.
Het onderzoek naar de overval in Deurne – en daarmee ook het onderzoek naar alle mogelijke verdachten – is op dit moment nog niet afgerond.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Graaf en Wilders over het bericht ‘Vorig jaar twintig doden door eergerelateerd geweld’

PVV MPs asked the government about a report of twenty honour-related deaths in 2013, probing the role of Islam, shelter data, whether victims relocate for safety, and deportation or denaturalisation of perpetrators. The minister answered that the figures are being collected and the LEC EGG network continues, that culture rather than religion drives honour codes, that shelter nationality data is not kept, and that denaturalisation for common crimes is not permitted under the Dutch law and the European Nationality Convention.
Nationality and religious background are not recorded by the Federatie Opvang.
Nationaliteit en religieuze achtergrond worden niet bijgehouden door de Federatie Opvang.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid De Graaf over Marokkanen en uitkeringsfraude

MP De Graaf (PVV) asked whether the SVB's request for Moroccan identity numbers from benefit recipients is a sound fraud-detection tool, whether those refusing to cooperate should lose benefits, and what the government does to trace property abroad. Secretary Klijnsma answered that the number is needed only when investigation in Morocco is required, that non-cooperation can lead to benefit suspension decided case by case, and that cross-border asset checks run through existing SVB and UWV teams.
Because the SVB does not use the CIN number at this stage of its investigation, it does not need to be supplied now.
Omdat de SVB in dit stadium van haar onderzoek geen gebruik maakt van het CIN-nummer, hoeft dit nu niet te worden aangeleverd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid De Graaf over een website over duurzaam gedrag

An MP from the PVV asked the state secretary about the cost of the duurzaamdoen.nl sustainability website, which organisations were involved and funded, and why the government promotes sustainable behaviour, questioning the purpose and possible indoctrination. The secretary answered that the site cost 49,909.16 euro, that Milieu Centraal (two-thirds government-funded) is the main partner, and that the aim is to inform citizens as required by the Aarhus Convention, not to impose norms.
The cabinet wants to make use of the energy and ambitions that many parties and residents in our country have in the field of environment and sustainability.
Het kabinet wil gebruik maken van de energie en ambities die veel partijen en bewoners in ons land hebben op het gebied van milieu en duurzaamheid.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid De Graaf over Oost-Europese parkeertoestanden in Spijkenisse

An MP from the PVV asked the minister whether she knew of reports about Eastern European truck drivers causing disruption in Spijkenisse, whether such conduct belongs in the Netherlands, whether she would tackle it with the ILT and SZW inspectorates, and whether she would reprimand the municipality for weak enforcement. The minister confirmed awareness, said unwanted nuisance would be taken seriously, pointed to existing action plans and extra ILT capacity for cabotage enforcement, noted that the police handle enforcement here, and said the municipality bears responsibility for finding a solution with the police.
It is the responsibility of the municipality of Spijkenisse to look for a solution together with the police.
Het is de verantwoordelijkheid van de gemeente Spijkenisse om samen met de politie naar een oplossing te zoeken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid De Graaf over het rapport ‘Een Gevoelige Kwestie’

An MP from the PVV asked the state secretary about the report 'Een Gevoelige Kwestie', which challenges IPCC climate sensitivity estimates and the case for the Klimaatagenda, and asked whether the government would withdraw that agenda. The state secretary answered that the IPCC is sound, that independent evidence supports human-caused warming, that climate policy is needed even under low sensitivity, and declined to withdraw the Klimaatagenda.
No, I am not willing to withdraw the Climate Agenda.
Nee, ik ben niet bereid de Klimaatagenda terug te trekken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid De Graaf over het bericht dat vervoer van en naar stations een struikelblok is

An MP asked whether the government's innovation subsidy programme for transport to and from stations distorts the market and whether taxi companies and evaluations were properly examined. The state secretary rejected the distortion claim, said the subsidies are short-term and cannot be reclaimed for unsuccessful projects, and declined to make a specific evaluation method mandatory.
The aim of the subsidy programme was to stimulate innovation. Inherent in innovation is that some innovations succeed and others do not.
Het doel van het subsidieprogramma was stimuleren van innovaties. Inherent aan innovaties is dat sommige innovaties een succes worden en anderen niet.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid De Graaf over het bericht dat CO2-opslag in de Noordzee toch doorgaat

An MP asked the ministers whether the CO2 storage project under the North Sea would go ahead, what it costs taxpayers, why, and whether the risks to flora and fauna justify it. The government confirmed the subsidy of 150 million euros, argued CCS is unavoidable in the energy accord, rejected the environmental objections citing the environmental impact report, and said investors have not withdrawn.
The Netherlands granted a subsidy of 150 million euros to the ROAD project in 2010.
Nederland heeft in 2010 een subsidie van € 150 miljoen toegekend aan het ROAD-project.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Klever en De Graaf over het bericht dat de bouw van windmolens 6000 banen kost

PVV MPs Klever and De Graaf asked whether the reported loss of 6,000 jobs from offshore wind farms within the 12-mile zone is acceptable and whether those plans will be scrapped, and why regional effects are not studied. The minister answered that the figures come from a preliminary study measuring intended visits rather than actual effects, that the feasibility study is still in its final phase, and that regional effects are acknowledged and may be examined in a later phase.
It is therefore too early to conclude that placing wind turbines within the 12-mile zone would cost 6,000 jobs.
Het is daarom te vroeg om te concluderen dat plaatsing van windmolens binnen de 12-mijlszone 6.000 banen zou kosten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Graaf en Helder over de berichten “Rijbewijs gewoon te koop in Litouwen” en “Litauiske forekort kjopes for 80 Euro”

Two PVV MPs asked the transport minister whether Lithuanian driving licences bought for 80 euros should no longer be accepted in the Netherlands and whether Lithuanian vehicles should be barred from Dutch roads. The minister answered that no fraud has been established, that EU rules require mutual recognition of licences and free movement precludes banning Lithuanian vehicles, and that roadside checks continue.
This could be the case if fraud had been demonstrated. However, this is not the case.
Dit zou het geval kunnen zijn als fraude zou zijn aangetoond. Dit is echter niet het geval.

Vragen van de leden De Graaf, Wilders en Klever (allen PVV) aan de Ministers van Economische Zaken en van Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid over het bericht «accijnzen nekslag pomphouders» (ingezonden 7 januari 2014).

MPs De Graaf, Wilders and Klever asked whether a news report on excise increases hurting petrol station owners in border regions would prompt the government to cut excise duties to undercut neighbouring countries. The state secretary acknowledged the border-region impact, said a report would follow by mid-May 2014, and declined to commit to lowering excise duties yet, citing the need for more time to assess effects.
My predecessor promised to send a report to the House before the summer.
Mijn ambtsvoorganger heeft toegezegd voor de zomer een rapportage aan de Kamer te zullen zenden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Klaveren, Fritsma en De Graaf over Oost-Europese overlast op vakantieparken

Three PVV MPs asked the ministers about nuisance and overcrowding caused by Eastern European migrant workers housed on holiday parks, including whether a deterrence policy should replace the national housing declaration and whether work permits should be reintroduced. The government answered that municipalities enforce nuisance rules, that regional agreements have added 31,000 housing places, that free movement of workers cannot be reversed under the accession treaties, and that permanent occupation of recreational homes is a municipal matter.
Statistics Netherlands examined, in the municipalities of the 9 regions of the Flexwonen Arbeidsmigranten programme, how many migrant workers are housed in which municipality.
Het CBS heeft onderzocht in de gemeenten uit de 9 regio’s van het programma Flexwonen Arbeidsmigranten hoeveel arbeidsmigranten er in welke gemeente gehuisvest zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid De Graaf over de beantwoording van vragen over de berichten ‘Dode door brand in windmolen in Ooltgensplaat’ en ‘Tweede dode bij brand windmolen Ooltgensplaat’

An MP asked why fire-response plans specific to wind turbines are absent, how high brigades can reach, how quickly specialist rescue teams arrive, and how offshore turbines are regulated. The Minister answered that generic procedures apply, that municipal safety regions are responsible for instructions, and that offshore permits require certification and emergency plans reviewed by Rijkswaterstaat.
Drawing up instructions, deployment procedures and attack plans is a responsibility of the safety regions.
Het opstellen van instructies, inzetprocedures en aanvalsplannen is een verantwoordelijkheid van de veiligheidsregio’s.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Graaf, Madlener en Wilders over het bericht ‘Hundreds of thousands from outside EU could head for UK in passport loophole’

PVV MPs asked the Minister of Social Affairs about press reports that Bulgaria and Romania issue passports to non-EU nationals, enabling them to reach Northern Europe, and about expected Romanian and Bulgarian labour migration. The government replied that nationality law is a member-state competence, that it expects other states to act with due care, that predicting numbers is uncertain, and that the Netherlands has taken measures with municipalities to manage arrivals and tackle abuse.
Nationality legislation is not a competence of the European Union, and each member state therefore has its own legislation determining who is entitled to the nationality in question.
Nationaliteitswetgeving is geen bevoegdheid van de Europese Unie en iedere lidstaat heeft derhalve eigen wetgeving op basis waarvan vastgesteld wordt wie recht heeft op de betreffende nationaliteit.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Klever en De Graaf over het bericht dat het Rijk met verkeerde cijfers rekent en dat het bouwen van windmolens op zee veel duurder gaat uitpakken

PVV MPs Klever and De Graaf asked the Minister of Economic Affairs about reports that the government miscalculates offshore wind costs, including whether a 40% cost reduction derives from industry figures and whether tourism job losses were assessed. The minister said a feasibility study on wind within the 12-mile zone is nearing completion, that cost reduction depends on several factors, and that environmental impact assessments already cover tourism effects, so separate reporting is unnecessary.
I hope to be able to inform the House about the results in the first half of 2014.
Ik hoop de Kamer in de eerste helft van 2014 over de resultaten te kunnen informeren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Graaf en Klever over het bericht ‘Miljoenensubsidie voor taxi's die amper reden’

Two PVV MPs asked about press reports of a subsidy for taxi firm Prestige GreenCab that barely operated, asking how the former director behaved, how the money would be recovered, and what electric-driving subsidy projects exist with measurable targets. The minister answered that the project submitted incomplete financial proof, the subsidy was set at zero with a six-week objection period before recovery, and listed the subsidy programmes with their monitoring and disbursement rules.
On that basis, AgentschapNL decided on 16 December to set the subsidy for the project at zero.
Op grond daarvan heeft AgentschapNL op 16 december jl. besloten de subsidie van het project vast te stellen op «nihil».
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Graaf en Beertema over het bericht “Hulp mentor bij studiekeus allochtone jongere”

Two PVV MPs asked the ministers whether the Link2Work project for jongeren, which they described as aimed at allochtone youth, discriminates against autochthonous youth, and demanded an apology and its termination. Minister Asscher replied that Link2Work is open to all youth needing extra help in Amsterdam and Rotterdam, makes no distinction by ethnicity or origin, and that many participants are expected to have a migrant background due to the population of those cities.
No distinction is made on the basis of ethnicity or origin.
Er wordt geen onderscheid gemaakt naar etniciteit of afkomst.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Wilders en De Graaf over het bericht Oostblokker verdringt bouwvakker

PVV MPs Wilders and De Graaf asked whether the government will fully maintain work permits for Romanian and Bulgarian workers after 1 January 2014, given displacement fears in construction. The minister replied that transitional restrictions end on that date under the accession treaties, that displacement through bogus constructions will be tackled, and that bilateral agreements on enforcing Dutch working conditions were made.
From that date no measures are permitted that restrict the access of Bulgarian and Romanian workers to the labour market.
Per die datum zijn geen maatregelen meer toegestaan die de toegang van Bulgaarse en Roemeense werknemers tot de arbeidsmarkt beperken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Graaf en Beertema over het bericht ‘Jongeren vragen om meer klimaatonderwijs’

PVV MPs De Graaf and Beertema asked the State Secretary whether climate education promoted through youth representatives is appropriate, given the lack of proof of human influence and the parliamentary inquiry's call for schools to focus on core tasks. The State Secretary answered that the IPCC science is clear, climate education is already embedded in the curriculum, and schools decide how to organise it, without committing to any new action.
Subsequently, it is up to schools how they organise and shape education and which methods and teaching materials they wish to use.
Vervolgens is het aan scholen hoe zij het onderwijs inrichten en vormgeven en welke methoden en leermiddelen zij daarbij willen gebruiken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Klever en De Graaf over het bericht dat overheidssubsidie voor duurzame energie moet worden beperkt tot bedrijven die nieuwe productiemethodes introduceren

Two PVV MPs asked the Minister of Economic Affairs about reports that EU state aid rules would restrict renewable energy subsidies to innovation, what this means for the Dutch SDE+ scheme, and the innovation subsidy for the Noordoostpolder wind park. The minister replied that the Commission's guidance is not an instruction to limit subsidies to innovation, that SDE+ already uses competitive allocation, that wind parks can be innovative, and that the subsidy goes to the project initiators with budgets reserved until 2016.
As is customary after the publication of a Commission Communication, the cabinet will shortly send you a BNC fiche with a more extensive explanation of the Dutch position.
Zoals gebruikelijk na het verschijnen van een Mededeling van de Commissie zal het kabinet u binnenkort een BNC-fiche met daarin een meer uitgebreide toelichting op het Nederlandse standpunt sturen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid De Graaf over de berichten ‘Dode door brand in windmolen in Ooltgensplaat’ en ‘Tweede dode bij brand windmolen Ooltgensplaat’

An MP from the PVV asked whether the regional fire brigade was equipped to fight a turbine fire at height, how municipalities account for fire height when granting permits, and whether emergency plans exist for rescuing people from turbines. The government answered that the Rotterdam-Rijnmond fire service considers itself generally equipped, that an investigation is underway into the cause and firefighting options, that permits account for collapse and blade-failure risks, and that no turbine-specific emergency plans exist, relying instead on general working-at-height procedures and specialist rescue teams.
The Rotterdam-Rijnmond Safety Region is launching an investigation into the fire at the wind turbine in Ooltgensplaat.
De Veiligheidsregio Rotterdam-Rijnmond stelt een onderzoek in naar de brand van de windturbine in Ooltgensplaat.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Helder en De Graaf over trajectcontroles

Two MPs from the PVV asked the Justice and Infrastructure ministers about average-speed (trajectory) checks, including boete counts on the Utrecht-Amsterdam route, revenue, and accident effects on the A2. The minister answered that the 2012 comparison cannot be made reliably, reported roughly 43.6 million euro in sanctions from May to August 2013, said revenue goes to the state treasury, and deferred the accident question until 2014 data is available.
The requested comparison cannot be made properly.
De gevraagde vergelijking is niet goed te maken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Graus en De Graaf over het bericht ‘Afspraken over intercity snel maken’

MPs Graus and De Graaf asked the state secretary about delays in the Eindhoven–Heerlen–Aachen intercity link, the Heerlen mayor's concerns, steps taken, infrastructure agreements, and the link with rail decentralisation in Limburg. The state secretary said a decision is targeted for November 2013 pending the province's report, that the Euregiobahn service will continue in 2014–2015, and that decentralisation is not directly linked to the cross-border study.
Once those agreements have been made, I will inform the House of Representatives about them.
Zodra die afspraken zijn gemaakt, zal ik de Tweede Kamer daarover informeren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Graaf en Helder over het bericht ‘Polenprijsje voor niet handsfree bellen: 50 euro’

Two PVV MPs asked whether foreign truck drivers are favoured in traffic fines, citing a Polish driver fined 50 euros instead of 220 for phone use, and whether the government will stop this and re-sanction affected drivers. The minister answered that foreign drivers are not favoured, that the reduced amount was an exceptional prosecutorial decision given perishable cargo, that data on foreign fines is limited, and that a settled sanction cannot be increased.
Foreign drivers are not favoured when imposing traffic fines.
Buitenlandse chauffeurs worden niet bevoordeeld bij het opleggen van verkeersboetes.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Klever en De Graaf over het bericht “Ingreep in emissiehandel wekt woede van Tata Steel”

PVV MPs Klever and De Graaf asked the Minister of Economic Affairs why the Netherlands pushes to strengthen the EU ETS while compensating energy-intensive firms like Tata Steel, and whether the cross-sectoral correction factor fits the Steel Action Plan. The minister answered that the correction factor is mandated by the EU Directive and cannot be changed without revising it, and defended the ETS as the central instrument, with Dutch efforts focused on post-2020 safeguards for internationally competitive firms.
This intervention is however in line with the European emissions trading directive (ETS).
Deze ingreep is echter in lijn met de Europese richtlijn emissiehandel (ETS).
Antwoord op vragen van het lid De Graaf over de verhoging van de pakkans en boetes voor malafide vrachtwagenchauffeurs

MP De Graaf asked the minister about truck drivers fitting a second licence plate over the original, mainly Eastern European plates, and whether this circumvents cabotage rules, including penalties for Dutch firms employing such drivers and more inspection capacity. The minister said the inspectorate has not encountered this in practice, that such double plating violates traffic law and would be enforced under existing penalty policy with a company inspection if it were not an isolated incident, and that a study of cabotage enforcement is underway.
Should it turn out that manipulation by a company's drivers is not an isolated incident, a company inspection by the ILT will follow.
Mocht blijken dat manipulatie door chauffeurs van een bedrijf geen incident is, volgt een bedrijfsinspectie door de ILT.
Antwoord vragen van het lid De Graaf over het bericht ‘Nederland innoveert niet genoeg’

MP De Graaf (PVV) asked the minister whether the PBL merely compares countries and produces green propaganda, whether its statistics could be done by CBS, and whether the minister would close the PBL. The minister rejected all three, defending the PBL's strategic analysis role, its independent position and its positive international visitation review.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Madlener en De Graaf over het bericht ‘Weduwe buitenland houdt pensioen’

MPs Madlener and De Graaf asked whether the government will appeal a court ruling that the lowering of survivors' benefits for widows moving abroad under the country-of-residence principle is unlawful, and whether it will introduce repair legislation. The minister confirmed an appeal will be lodged, reaffirmed the policy with an estimated €8 million budget impact, and declined to propose repair legislation.
Yes, the Social Insurance Bank will appeal the ruling of the Amsterdam District Court of 22 August.
Ja, de Sociale Verzekeringsbank zal hoger beroep instellen tegen de uitspraak van de Rechtbank Amsterdam van 22 augustus jl.
Antwoord vragen van de leden De Graaf en Van Klaveren over het bericht ‘Asscher’s hypocriete waarschuwing tegen EU-arbeidsmigranten’

PVV MPs De Graaf and Van Klaveren asked the ministers of Social Affairs and Foreign Affairs about a news report on Asscher's warning regarding EU labour migrants, questioning Polish, Romanian and Bulgarian crime and welfare figures and calling for the closure of borders and reintroduction of work permits. Minister Asscher answered that the crime and welfare figures are relatively elevated but must be nuanced, announced a pilot on residence-rights and benefits and a governmental summit on EU labour migration, and stated the transitional restrictions cannot be extended after 1 January 2014.
Under the Accession Treaties, a Member State of the European Union may (under conditions) impose restrictions on the free movement of workers from new member states.
Op basis van de Toetredingsakkoorden kan een lidstaat van de Europese Unie (onder voorwaarden) beperkingen stellen aan het vrij verkeer van werknemers met nieuwe lidstaten.
Antwoord vragen van het lid De Graaf over het bericht ‘OV-chipkaart weer gekraakt’

An MP asked the state secretary about a report that the OV-chipkaart had been cracked again, the history of fraud and hacking incidents, privacy risks, and whether the system should be scrapped. The state secretary replied that the reported scenario is not currently possible, gave an overview of past incidents with limited damage, and rejected abandoning the system, citing rising user satisfaction.
No, I do not share this view. The OV-chipkaart is increasingly appreciated by travellers.
Nee, deze mening deel ik niet. De OV-chipkaart wordt in toenemende mate gewaardeerd door de reizigers.
Antwoord vragen Van Klaveren en De Graaf over het zwichten voor islamitisch antisemitisme

PVV MPs asked whether a memorial plaque for Jewish WWII victims was dropped after Muslim residents objected, and about combating Islamic antisemitism and a national study of it. The minister says the earlier Joods Lyceum memorial debate was not a concrete initiative and no objections were known, and points to existing research and a round table rather than a new national study.
I am prepared to commission specific follow-up research if the expected research results provide too little knowledge
Ik ben bereid om specifiek vervolgonderzoek te laten uitvoeren als de te verwachten onderzoeksresultaten te weinig kennis opleveren

Antwoord vragen van de leden De Graaf en Helder over het bericht dat toezichthouders van het Openbaar Vervoer in Amsterdam geen boete voor vernieling meer mogen geven van het Openbaar Ministerie wanneer er sprake is van

Two PVV MPs asked whether Amsterdam public transport inspectors may no longer issue fines for vandalism when OV gates are forced open, and whether the government would reverse this and widen inspectors' powers. The state secretary answered that Amsterdam's VOV inspectors, who are employed by the municipality, cannot issue zwartrijden fines under article 70 of the Wet personenvervoer, so an OM policy line and an adjustment of working methods are being pursued, while refusing to withdraw the OM policy or change the regulations.
To achieve a more uniform method of settlement, the OM recently issued a policy line on fare evasion and electronic access gates.
Om tot een meer eenduidige afdoeningswijze te komen heeft het OM onlangs een beleidslijn uitgevaardigd over zwartrijden en elektronische toegangspoortjes.
Antwoord vragen van de leden De Graaf en Helder over het bericht “Bonnenregen op A4 wekt ergernis”

MPs De Graaf and Helder asked why many speeding fines were issued on the A4 after average-speed (trajectory) checks started, and whether signage ambiguity should be fixed and fines dropped. The minister replied that the 100 km/h limit has long applied, signage was unchanged, warning signs and press releases preceded the checks, and that fines will not be dropped.
The maximum speed on the section of the A4 where the trajectory check is located has been 100 km/h for many years.
De maximumsnelheid op het gedeelte van de A4 waar de trajectcontrole staat, is al vele jaren 100 km/h.
Antwoord vragen De Roon en De Graaf over radarproblemen door windturbines

Two PVV MPs asked the Defence Minister whether wind turbines can disrupt military radar and create false alarms in the Netherlands, and whether Defence is informed or consulted about turbine plans. The minister confirmed turbines can disturb radar, described the Rarro 75 km radar disturbance zones and model-based testing with possible refusal or modification of projects, and reported nine false radar alarms since 2010 without fighter scrambles.
Around every military radar there is a so-called radar disturbance zone with a radius of 75 kilometres.
Rond elke militaire radar ligt een zogeheten radarverstoringsgebied met een straal van 75 kilometer.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid De Graaf over het bericht ‘Alleen provincie mag windmolenfilm zien’

An MP from the PVV asked whether the 3D wind farm visualisation film used by the Groningen provincial government should be public, and whether the minister would use her former influence to release it. The minister said the film is a preparatory tool for the environmental impact assessment of wind park N33, that she knows its content, and that public information evenings with the visualisations are planned for late April.
I do not consider that the provincial government is withholding crucial information, since the wind farm film is a 3D visualisation used in the preparatory phase of the EIA.

Ik ben niet van oordeel dat sprake is van het achterhouden van cruciale informatie door het provinciebestuur aangezien de windmolenfilm i.c. een 3D visualisatie is gebruikt in de voorbereidingsfase van het MER.
Antwoord vragen van het lid De Graaf inzake de berichten “Goedkope Filippijnen op truck” en “Filippijn rijdt voor € 650,-“.

An MP asked ministers about reports of cheap Filipino truck drivers undermining Dutch truckers, and whether the government would curb inflows of Eastern European and Filipino drivers. The minister answered that the case concerned a Latvian firm, that Dutch wage and labour rules apply to work for Dutch firms, and promised a letter on tackling sham constructions by 1 May.
The Minister of Social Affairs and Employment will inform the House by letter before 1 May about the approach to sham constructions.
De Minister van Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid zal uw Kamer voor 1 mei per brief informeren over de aanpak van schijnconstructies.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bosma en De Graaf over de bijdrage aan Culturele Hoofdstad 2018

Two PVV MPs asked whether a Dutch city becoming European Capital of Culture 2018 could count on a 20 million euro national contribution, whether no promises had been made to candidate cities, and whether the national government should distance itself from or withdraw the bid. The minister replied that no promises were made to the Eindhoven alderman, that the size of any national contribution was not yet known, that provinces and municipalities decide how to spend their funds, and that the Netherlands agreed to the EU title in 1999.
No commitments have been made to the Eindhoven alderman.
Er zijn geen toezeggingen aan de Eindhovense wethouder gedaan.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Graaf en Van Klaveren over het meenemen van geleidehonden in de taxi

Two PVV MPs asked the state secretary whether refusing blind passengers with guide dogs in taxis is unacceptable, whether the government will enforce this or legislate, and whether it will act despite religious objections to dogs. The state secretary called refusal unacceptable, said a national legal obligation is unnecessary, and said he will urge municipalities to use their power under the Taxi Act to bar such refusals.
However, I will explicitly point the municipalities to the possibility the Taxi Act offers to impose additional requirements on taxi transport.
Wel zal ik de gemeenten nadrukkelijk wijzen op de mogelijkheid die de Taxiwet biedt aanvullende eisen aan het taxivervoer te stellen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid De Graaf over het bericht dat rijexamens door de sneeuw zijn uitgesteld

An MP asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Environment about the roughly 1766 driving tests postponed by snow and whether candidates whose tests were scheduled before the new EU licence rules took effect on 19 January 2013 could still sit under the old regime. The minister said the old rules could no longer legally be applied after that date, that adapting the automated system would take months, and that the agency would examine free re-tests for affected motorcyclists.
It is legally not possible to continue conducting examinations and issuing driving licences under the old regime after 19 January 2013.
Het is juridisch niet mogelijk om na 19 januari 2013 door te gaan met het afnemen van examens en het afgeven van rijbewijzen onder de oude regeling.
Antwoord vragen De Graaf en Klever over het bericht ‘Subsidie voor erotische zitzak’

MPs De Graaf and Klever asked the minister of Economic Affairs about a news report on a subsidy for an erotic beanbag, its public benefit, whether such subsidies are pointless, and a full list of innovation subsidies since 2005. The minister answered that the WBSO is a generic tax scheme judged effective, that the government does not determine project goals, and that fiscal scheme projects cannot be listed due to tax secrecy, while stating it will keep generic innovation schemes.
This is a generic fiscal scheme aimed at encouraging companies in all sectors of the economy to innovate.
Dit is een generieke fiscale regeling die er op gericht is bedrijven in alle sectoren van de economie aan te zetten tot innovatie.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Bosma en De Graaf over gesubsidieerde grootverdieners in de toneelsector

PVV MPs asked the minister whether artistic leaders Ivo van Hove and Jan Versweyveld of Toneelgroep Amsterdam earn above the Balkenende norm and whether salaries will be capped and disclosed in subsidy conditions. The minister answered that neither exceeds the norm, so salaries are not published, and that existing WOPT/WNT rules apply without new subsidy conditions.
Since the salary does not exceed the norm, the salary is not made public.
Aangezien het salaris niet boven de norm uitkomt, wordt het salaris niet openbaar gemaakt.
Antwoord vragen van de leden De Graaf, Klever, Graus, Bosma en Van Vliet over het bericht “Topsalaris staatsbedrijven nog ruim boven Balkenendenorm”?

PVV MPs asked whether state-owned enterprise executive pay exceeding the Balkenende norm should be clawed back, and whether the Balkenende norm is high enough. The minister replied that state holdings fall outside the Balkenende pay-cap law because they are not publicly funded, but that the state's pay policy for these holdings is assessed against its own framework, which will be revised.
state holdings do not fall under the Public and Semi-Public Sector Senior Officials (Remuneration) Act, because they are not financed with public funds
staatsdeelnemingen vallen niet onder de Wet normering bezoldiging topfunctionarissen publieke en semipublieke sector, omdat zij niet met publieke middelen worden bekostigd
Antwoord vragen van het lid De Graaf over het bericht ‘Treinkaartjes naar België fors duurder' en over de hoge tarieven op de Hanzelijn

An MP asked about reported sharp fare increases on rail routes, including the Hanzelijn and Amsterdam–Brussels Fyra service. The state secretary said the Hanzelijn fares shown were wrong due to a routing error, that Fyra fares are set commercially by NS Hispeed and NMBS, and that the government will monitor market response.
As a result, the displayed fares are not correct.
Daardoor zijn de weergegeven tarieven niet juist.
Antwoord vragen van het lid De Graaf over het artikel “wie weet hoe hard je waar mag rijden”

An MP from the PVV asked the Minister of Infrastructure and the Environment whether speed-limit signs on Dutch motorways are incorrect or unclear and how fines based on wrong signage would be dealt with. The minister answered that about 100 locations were improved after an inspection, that controllers check signage before enforcement and report errors, and that people can object fines at the Public Prosecution Service.
Antwoord vragen van de leden De Graaf, Helder en Bontes over het artikel ‘Drugrunners vechten met NS-personeel’

MPs De Graaf, Helder and Bontes asked whether a permanent public transport ban, a permanent police post at Rotterdam CS, tasers for NS staff, and broader group liability should follow a violent attack on NS staff by drug runners. The minister answered that a travel and stay ban bill is being prepared, that the police post will return after renovation, that tasers have no legal basis for NS staff, and that existing criminal law suffices.
A bill amending the Passenger Transport Act 2000 to allow a stay ban at stations, for example, is currently being prepared.
Momenteel wordt gewerkt aan een voorstel tot wetswijziging van de Wet personenvervoer 2000 ten behoeve van een verblijfsverbod op bijvoorbeeld een station.
Antwoord vragen Fritsma en De Graaf over het bericht dat 60.000 euro aan subsidiegeld voor de Antilliaanse belangenvereniging MAAPP is “verdwenen”

Two PVV MPs asked the minister whether 60,000 euro of subsidy to the Antillean association MAAPP was lost to fraud, how ministry oversight failed, and whether the money and future subsidies are secured. The minister answered that the former chair withdrew funds unseen by the board, that the ministry will recover the undisbursed amount via a bailiff and the police are investigating, but that more oversight could not have prevented it and no new subsidies are planned.
The Ministry will recover the improperly spent funds from MAAPP.
Het Ministerie zal de niet juist bestede middelen terugvorderen bij MAAPP.

qa: Antwoord op vragen van het lid Arib over het tegenhouden van onafhankelijk onderzoek naar uithuisplaatsing kinderen toeslagenouders

An MP asked the Minister for Legal Protection why independent research into child removals of childcare-benefit parents was reportedly blocked, and whether the judiciary can investigate its own judges. The Minister replied that an Inspectorate investigation is underway, a research commission is being set up, and the judiciary has started its own reflection and file review with an external advisory committee, so no new study is needed.

At this moment I see no reason to initiate further research because the inspectorate investigation is already underway, the research commission is in preparation, and the judiciary has started a reflection process and will conduct file research into the out-of-home placements.

Op dit moment zie ik geen aanleiding om nog een onderzoek te initiëren omdat het inspectieonderzoek al loopt, de onderzoekscommissie in voorbereiding is en de rechtspraak een reflectietraject is gestart en dossieronderzoek naar de uithuisplaatsingen gaat doen
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Arib over het intimideren van kritische ambtenaren van BZK

An MP asked whether BZK staff critical of the Omgevingswet were pressured or intimidated, and whether officials feel free to dissent. The minister acknowledged signals of pressure on staff, said four people had come forward and a complaint is being examined, but denied knowing of such signals within BZK and could not rule out intimidation of dissenting officials.
In addition, in response to the signals received, the secretary-general is holding discussions within the organisation on conduct and the limits of integrity-compliant escalation behaviour.
Daarnaast voert de secretaris-generaal naar aanleiding van de ontvangen signalen binnen de organisatie het gesprek over omgangsvormen en de grenzen van integer escalatiegedrag.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Arib over grootschalige kabelinterceptie door AIVD/MIVD

An MP asked whether intelligence services could use cable interception to tap communications at neighbourhood or national level and whether this breached proportionality and the Wiv 2017 intent; the ministers answered that such regional or national bulk tapping is not technically possible or practised, that cable interception is always targeted via research assignments, and that additional safeguards and independent TIB review apply. The answers also point to a forthcoming temporary law and enhanced CTIVD oversight.
The AIVD and MIVD do not use research-assignment-based interception on the cable to tap neighbourhoods or regions in the Netherlands.
De AIVD en MIVD zetten onderzoeksopdrachtgerichte interceptie (hierna: OOG-interceptie) op de kabel niet in op het aftappen van wijken of regio's in Nederland.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Koekkoek, Sylvana Simons  en Arib over de uitkomsten van PwC-onderzoeken naar de Fraude Signalering Voorziening (FSV)

MPs Koekkoek, Simons and Arib asked the government about PwC findings on the Fraud Signalling Facility (FSV), including use of ethnicity-based risk profiles and whether this amounts to institutional racism. The State Secretary largely declined to characterise the practice as racism, stated that nationality will only be used in supervision with a clear legal basis, promised a compensation scheme and reforms, but deferred many substantive questions on racism and definitions.
I cannot make a general statement about that.
Ik kan daar geen algemene uitspraak over doen.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Koekkoek, Van der Lee  en Arib over de berichten dat de Belastingdienst discriminerende criteria in de fraudesignalering voorziening (FSV) verzweeg en dat de Belastingdienst op onrechtmati

Three MPs asked the State Secretary of Finance about reports that the Tax Authority concealed discriminatory criteria in the fraud signalling facility (FSV) and unlawfully blocked access to blacklists. The State Secretary confirmed the reports, admitted the ministry knew of the discriminatory handbook since 2020, acknowledged the FSV processing was unlawful and will pay the fines, and said that FSV access requests are being handled and letters sent, while formal refusals of some access requests remain subject to a balancing of interests.
Yes, the manner in which personal data was processed in FSV was unlawful.
Ja, de wijze van verwerking van persoonsgegevens in FSV was onrechtmatig.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Arib over de werking van de Wet normering topinkomens bij goededoelenorganisaties

An MP asked whether fundraising agencies working for charities should be subject to the same top-income cap as the Wet normering topinkomens (WNT) and whether the charity sector should be brought under it. The minister said the sector's own code already ties charity director pay to the WNT norm, that fundraising agencies are commercial firms outside its remit, and that the government does not intend to extend the WNT to the private charity sector.
The Minister of the Interior and Kingdom Relations does not intend to bring the entire private charity sector and all commercial organisations providing services to the charity sector under the WNT.

De Minister van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties is niet voornemens de gehele private goede doelensector en alle commerciële organisaties die diensten verrichten voor de goede doelen sector, onder de werking van de WNT te brengen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Arib over het naleven van de Wet openbaarheid van bestuur en rechterlijke uitspraken

An MP asked ministers why documents on Schiphol aviation safety were withheld despite a court ruling ordering their full disclosure under the Wob. The minister agreed that disclosure should be the norm, but withholds 17 of the 54 documents under the Rijkswet Ovv and EU Regulation 376/2014, and has referred the matter to the Council of State.
I cannot make the 17 documents public because I want to comply with the regulations that protect information from investigations into civil aviation incidents.
Ik kan de 17 documenten niet openbaar maken omdat ik de regelgeving wil naleven die ervoor zorgt dat informatie uit onderzoek naar voorvallen in de burgerluchtvaart wordt beschermd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Arib over het vernietigen van stukken die onderdeel zijn van een politiek debat en deel uitmaken van een Wob-procedure

An MP asked the Minister of the Interior whether destroying documents subject to a Wob request or political debate creates an impression of concealment, what rules apply, and whether the Woo will make such NTA reports public. The minister cited Council of State case law and Woo article 4.1a barring destruction after a request, declined to judge the Delft case, and explained the Woo active disclosure duties, noting they are not retroactive and are subject to exemptions.
An administrative body must therefore, after a request for information under the Wob has been submitted, preserve the documents to which that request relates.
Een bestuursorgaan dient dan ook na indiening van een verzoek om informatie op grond van de Wob de documenten waarop dat verzoek ziet, te bewaren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Arib over burgers die tegen de overheid moeten procederen

MP Arib asks whether citizens who miss short appeal deadlines against government decisions should be able to correct such errors, and whether the human touch should prevail in legal disputes with the state. The minister answers that a bill amending the General Administrative Law Act is in preparation, which will examine a 'civil loop' and more room for discretion on late objections, while stating that the existing administrative loop cannot cure time-limit breaches and that the government will consult on the bill in spring.
This question will be considered in the process of the bill in preparation amending the General Administrative Law Act following the childcare benefits affair.
Deze vraag wordt betrokken in het traject van het in voorbereiding zijnde wetsvoorstel tot aanpassing van de Awb naar aanleiding van de kinderopvangtoeslagaffaire.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Arib over het gebrek aan openheid bij de overheid

An MP asks the Minister of Interior whether government openness is adequate, especially on COVID-19 information, and whether the Wob is being stretched to block disclosure. The minister agrees openness is the starting point, attributes Wob delays to volume and complexity, and points to the Woo and planned measures to improve processing.
A transparent government must be the starting point, I agree with you on that.
Een transparante overheid moet het uitgangspunt zijn, dat ben ik met u eens.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kwint, Omtzigt, Azarkan, Inge van Dijk, Arib en Ceder over het bericht ‘Uithuisplaatsingen onder gedupeerden toeslagenaffaire’

MPs asked the government about reports that over 1,100 children of parents harmed by the childcare benefits scandal were placed out of home, requesting the grounds, the CBS data scope, plans to return children and a dedicated helpline. The minister answered that a causal link is hard to establish, that CBS data cover 2015–2020, that no central record of placement grounds exists, and that a plan for affected families will be sent to parliament as soon as possible.
