No, this specific information is not available. There is no central registration of the grounds on which an out-of-home placement is ordered.
Nee, deze specifieke informatie is niet beschikbaar. Er is geen centrale registratie van de gronden op basis waarvan een uithuisplaatsing wordt ingezet.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Arib en De Hoop over het functioneren van de voormalig minister en voormalig staatssecretaris van Infrastructuur en Waterstaat gedurende de periode dat zij wisten dat zij lobbyist zouden w

MPs Arib and De Hoop asked the Prime Minister whether former minister van Nieuwenhuizen and former state secretary van Veldhoven could access information relevant to their future lobby-type roles while they knew of them, and whether that was undesirable. The government answered that they may have had access to such information, that the lobby ban and confidentiality duty apply, that the timing of their contacts is not known to it, and that van Nieuwenhuizen's appointment was ultimately judged incompatible with office and she was dismissed.
In principle it is up to the officials concerned themselves to shape a follow-on position with integrity.
Het is in principe aan de betrokken bewindspersonen zelf om op een integere wijze vorm te geven aan een vervolgfunctie.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Arib en Kathmann over de hulp van ambtenaren bij een privékwestie van de staatssecretaris van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties

MPs Arib and Kathmann asked whether ministry officials helped State Secretary Knops with a private land purchase matter, and whether that is appropriate. The minister answers that the ministry checked the facts because integrity was at issue, found no improper conduct, and declines to publish the landsadvocaat's advice while stating the ministry bore no responsibility for the private lawsuit.
To be as transparent as possible, I have attached the email with which the landsadvocaat was asked for advice.
Om zoveel mogelijk transparant te zijn, heb ik de e-mail bijgevoegd waarmee de landsadvocaat om advies is gevraagd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Arib over nevenfuncties van de demissionair minister van Defensie

An MP asked whether demissionary Defence Minister Henk Kamp still held seats on the Dutch Caribbean financial supervisory colleges, whether this was compatible with the Rijkswet financieel toezicht, and whether a public register of ministers' side positions exists. The Prime Minister answered that Kamp had announced resignation from these positions before swearing-in and confirmed it in writing, that formal dismissal would follow by royal decree, that a successor was not yet known, and that no central public register of ministers' side positions exists, though side positions may be noted on official CVs.
The State Secretary for the Interior will inform you about the succession of Mr Kamp.
De Staatssecretaris van BZK zal u over de opvolging van de heer Kamp informeren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Hoop en Arib over het ontslag van de Minister en Staatssecretaris van Infrastructuur en Waterstaat, C. van Nieuwenhuizen-Wijbenga en S. van Veldhoven

Two PvdA MPs asked the Prime Minister why the two state secretaries of Infrastructure and Water Management resigned early to take new jobs, and about lobbying restrictions for former office-holders. The government answered that the resignations were personal career choices, that a two-year lobbying ban applies to former ministers at their old department unless the secretary-general grants an exception, and that the ban's scope for the cases at hand is for the secretary-general to assess.

This rule is therefore not intended to make taking up such a position impossible, but to prevent a former office-holder from using knowledge and position gained in the previous role for the interests of the new employer during a set period.

Deze regel beoogt dus niet het in dienst treden bij een dergelijke instelling onmogelijk te maken maar wel om gedurende een bepaalde periode te voorkomen dat een oud-bewindspersoon kennis en positie op grond van de vorige functie inzet voor de belangen van de nieuwe werkgever.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Arib over het bericht ‘Vrij spel voor kinderhandelaren’ inzake illegale adoptie uit Nepal

An MP asks the Justice Minister about reports of child trafficking and illegal adoption from Nepal after the 2015 earthquake, including whether Dutch couples may be involved and whether the Hague Adoption Convention is sufficient safeguard. The minister answers that the Netherlands has not adopted from Nepal since 2009, that illegal adoption by Dutch nationals cannot be excluded but would require emergency travel documents from the honorary consulate, and that Nepal has not yet acceded to the Hague Convention and has not implemented the recommended reforms.
The Netherlands has not adopted from Nepal since 2009.
Nederland adopteert sinds 2009 niet meer uit Nepal.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Arib en Servaes over het vervolgen van vrouwen voor vermeende abortus

MPs Arib and Servaes asked the Foreign Minister about the 30-year sentence of Teodora del Carmen Vasquez in El Salvador for alleged abortion and whether women prosecuted after miscarriages should be protected. The minister agreed that women have bodily autonomy and access to care, and said the Netherlands will raise the issue in El Salvador's next Universal Periodic Review and in bilateral contacts.
Are you willing to raise the case of Ms Del Carmen Vasquez in international forums and convey your concerns to the El Salvadoran government?
Bent u bereid de zaak van mevrouw Del Carmen Vasquez in internationaal verband aan te kaarten en uw zorgen hieromtrent over te brengen aan de El Salvadoraanse regering?
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Arib over adoptie van kinderen uit Bulgarije

An MP asked the Justice Minister about alleged misconduct in Bulgarian child adoptions to the Netherlands, the Hague Adoption Convention's trust principle, and whether an international supervisory authority is needed. The minister said all about 30 recent Bulgarian adoption files were reviewed with no reason to think children came in irregularly, that the trust principle and state responsibility for supervision remain adequate, and that no international authority is needed.
For that reason I have had all about 30 files of children adopted from Bulgaria over the past two years reviewed again.
Om die reden heb ik alle circa 30 dossiers van kinderen die de afgelopen twee jaar uit Bulgarije zijn geadopteerd nogmaals laten bekijken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Arib over het bericht “Levensbeëindiging pasgeborenen niet gemeld”

MP Arib asks the Minister of Health whether non-reporting of late termination and end-of-life decisions for newborns, as reported in the press, stems from doctors' lack of trust in the regulation, and what will be done to ensure proper reporting under the new rules. The Minister acknowledges the evaluation found the regulation unclear and says the amended regulation and a new committee will clarify criteria and roles, while maintaining that societal oversight is important.
Yes, I still believe that societal oversight is of great importance in the context of transparency and ensuring the carefulness of medical practice.
Ja, ik ben nog steeds van mening dat maatschappelijk toezicht van groot belang is in het kader van transparantie en het waarborgen van de zorgvuldigheid in het medisch handelen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Arib over het delen van informatie over erfelijke ziekten

An MP asked the health minister whether law and professional guidelines ensure that information about hereditary cancer, such as breast cancer, reaches relatives, and how clinics handle this. The minister answered that no general duty to inform relatives exists, that the professional guideline of the VKGN governs case-by-case balancing, and that clinics will be asked to consistently follow up with patients.
Under national or international law there is no duty to inform the patient's family members.
Er is naar nationaal of internationaal recht geen plicht tot het informeren van familieleden van de patiënt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Arib over de richtlijn voor reanimatie

MP Arib (PvdA) asked the health minister whether the resuscitation guideline rested on an outdated figure of 50% brain damage among resuscitated over-70s, whether this affected choices about resuscitation, and about a neutral Do-Not-Resuscitate pendant. The minister acknowledged the new AMC research, said the guideline will be reviewed with stakeholders, agreed vitality of older patients should be considered, and promised a report on the pendant in October.
I am therefore examining the possibilities for having a uniform, neutral (not linked to any particular foundation or association) NR pendant issued.
Ik onderzoek dan ook de mogelijkheden tot het laten uitgeven van een uniforme, neutrale (niet aan een bepaalde stichting of vereniging gelieerde) NR-penning.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Arib over het weigeren van single vrouwen die IVF-behandeling willen

An MP asked the health minister whether hospitals refusing IVF to single and lesbian women violates the protocol and equal-treatment law, and what she will do to ensure equal access. The minister agrees such blanket exclusion is wrong and contrary to the NVOG protocol and the AWGB, but says enforcement is for the professional body, the IGZ has received no complaints, and she sees no further role for herself.
I believe it is the role of the professional group to bring the protocol again to the attention of hospitals and practitioners.
Ik vind het de rol van de beroepsgroep om het protocol opnieuw onder de aandacht te brengen bij ziekenhuizen en beroepsbeoefenaren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Arib over de toename van euthanasie bij psychiatrisch patiënten via de levenseindekliniek

An MP asks the health minister about rising euthanasia among psychiatric and cancer patients via the Levenseindekliniek and about doctors refusing requests. The minister confirms the increase in cancer-patient referrals without knowing the cause, cites a 2012 ZonMw evaluation on refusals, notes ongoing trajectories, and promises the commission of wise men's report later in 2015.
I expect to receive the report later this year, and will send it to your House after its publication.
Het rapport verwacht ik later dit jaar te ontvangen, en zal ik na het verschijnen aan uw Kamer sturen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Arib over levensbeëindiging bij pasgeborenen

MP Arib (PvdA) asked the Health Minister about possible unlawful neonatal end-of-life decisions, the adequacy of public oversight given the weak trust in the central expert committee's review regulation, and the UN Children's Rights Committee's concerns. Minister Schippers answered that no such cases are known, that the current regulation lacks clarity and she will revise it, and that the UN committee did not request further information.

In the cabinet position on the evaluation of the Regulation I have therefore already announced that I will amend the Regulation in a way that does justice to the evaluation's findings and is workable for medical professionals.

In het kabinetsstandpunt op de evaluatie van de Regeling heb ik daarom al aangekondigd de Regeling te zullen aanpassen op een wijze die recht doet aan de bevindingen van de evaluatie en werkbaar is voor de medische professionals.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Arib en Mei Li Vos over het bericht dat zzp'ers bij donatie van een nier vaak in financiële problemen komen

MPs Arib and Mei Li Vos asked the Minister of Health about reports that self-employed donors of a kidney often face financial problems, and whether lost income is compensated, how often donors refrain from donating, and whether insurers and Kifid are involved. Minister Schippers acknowledged, based on an evaluation of the donation subsidy scheme, that self-employed donors without disability insurance face financial barriers, promised to study remedies and report this year, and stated Kifid has received no related complaints.
Now that the evaluation of the scheme has shown that there are indeed unnecessary financial barriers for self-employed people without disability insurance, I will take measures to change this.

Nu uit de evaluatie van de regeling is gebleken dat er voor zzp'ers zonder arbeidsongeschiktheidsverzekering weldegelijk onnodige financiële belemmeringen bestaan, zal ik maatregelen nemen om dit aan te passen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Arib over het bericht “Aantal donoren kan fors omhoog; organen wegschenken na euthanasie”

MP Arib asked the health minister about reports that organ donation after euthanasia could sharply increase donor numbers, and about how often it occurs and whether patients are informed. The minister answered that only 9 such procedures have occurred in the Netherlands (21 in Belgium), that the benefit for waiting lists is hard to predict, and that a guideline on the subject is expected after the summer.
As I previously promised, I will inform the House as soon as the guideline is ready.
Zoals ik eerder heb toegezegd, informeer ik de Kamer zodra de handreiking gereed is.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Arib over de effectiviteit van campagnes voor orgaandonatie

An MP asked the Minister of Health about the effectiveness and cost of organ donation campaigns since 2008, citing reports that about 20 million euros was spent without raising registrations. The Minister confirmed roughly 20 million euros was spent, said registrations and transplant numbers have risen, and promised a new communication strategy and a letter to parliament before summer.
As promised in the AO on organ donation of 12 March, I will, if possible, send a letter to the House of Representatives before the summer about the new strategy.
Zoals toegezegd in het AO orgaandonatie van 12 maart jongstleden zal ik zo mogelijk voor de zomer een brief naar de Tweede Kamer sturen over de nieuwe strategie.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Arib en Recourt over de roep om een aparte juridische status voor vermisten

MPs Arib and Recourt asked ministers whether a separate legal status for missing persons should be created, given practical and financial problems for relatives who cannot act on behalf of a missing family member. Minister Van der Steur answered that a separate official document would have the same legal effects as a declaration of presumed death and could cause confusion, preferring practical solutions such as protocols, case managers, a central register and existing guardianship arrangements.
I am of the opinion that introducing an official document confirming that someone is missing, alongside the existing declaration of presumed death, is not a good solution.

Ik ben echter van mening dat het invoeren van een officieel document, waarin bevestigd wordt dat iemand is vermist naast de bestaande verklaring van rechtsvermoeden van overlijden geen goede oplossing biedt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Arib over de zorgmodule Pro Life

MP Arib (PvdA) asked the Minister of Health whether the Pro Life health insurance module, which excludes abortion, euthanasia and sex-reassignment surgery, is compatible with insurers' duty of care, and what it covers and excludes. The Minister answered that the exception in article 11(5) of the Health Insurance Act allows such modules, that insurers must contract sufficient care but may consider Christian identity, that the exclusions are clearly published, and that she sees no reason for further measures.
In view of the above, I see no reason to take further measures on this.
Gezien het voorgaande zie ik geen aanleiding hierop nadere maatregelen te nemen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Arib over de abortuspil bij de huisarts

An MP asked the health minister about allowing GPs to perform medication abortion, citing Women on Waves' view that early pregnancy is not legally covered, and about access, counseling and registration. The minister said she disagrees that the situation causes unrest or that access is problematic, but is willing to consult stakeholders on whether GP treatment adds value, provided quality and safety are not compromised.
I would like to look at the added value of treatment by the GP.
Daarom wil ik graag kijken naar de meerwaarde van behandeling door de huisarts.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Arib over het bericht dat de Levenseindekliniek voor de vierde keer in een jaar is berispt

Arib asks the minister how the Levenseindekliniek can be repeatedly reprimanded, whether an independent study of the clinic is needed before the 2016 evaluation, and when a psychiatrist will sit on the regional review committees for complex euthanasia cases. The minister says four reprimands concern separate cases, that existing VUMC/AMC research and the 2016 evaluation suffice without a new study, and that two new physician members (a psychiatrist and an elderly-care specialist) are nominated for appointment.
On the four individual cases I will not comment, given the ongoing investigations by the Public Prosecution Service and the Health Care Inspectorate.
Op de vier individuele casus ga ik niet in lopende de onderzoeken van het Openbaar Ministerie en de Inspectie voor de Gezondheidszorg.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Arib over het betrekken van ouders bij beslissing levenseinde kind

An MP asked the Health Minister whether parents should be more involved in end-of-life decisions for seriously ill children, and about the status of the paediatricians' association's position on child euthanasia and a support point for such decisions. The minister agreed parents should be involved, pointed to existing professional norms and a forthcoming paediatric association position and study, and said a support point would be considered in that study.
I consider it of great importance that parents are involved in decisions surrounding the end of life of their child.
Ik vind het van groot belang dat ouders betrokken worden bij beslissingen rondom het levenseinde van hun kind.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Arib over willekeur bij toetsing euthanasie

An MP asked the Minister of Health about inconsistent SCEN-doctor assessments of euthanasia requests from patients without a short-term terminal illness, and whether stricter verification or revision of the KNMG guideline is needed. The Minister acknowledged the study, said complete uniformity is unrealistic given individual judgment, rejected limiting the SCEN doctor to verifying hopeless suffering, and committed to discussing whether the KNMG guideline still fits current practice.
I will discuss with the KNMG whether the guideline still sufficiently fits the current way the law is applied.
Ik zal met de KNMG in gesprek gaan of de richtlijn nog voldoende aansluit bij de huidige wijze waarop invulling wordt gegeven aan de wet.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Arib over het bericht “Het Radboud UMC weigert orgaandonatie na euthanasie”

MP Arib asked the Minister of Health whether Radboud UMC refused organ donation after euthanasia for lack of a treatment relationship, and whether the rules and hospital conduct were adequate. The minister answered that both procedures were handled carefully, that communication to the patient was unclear, that all parties had said no obstacles existed, and that existing law is sufficient while a practical guideline is welcomed.
I therefore consider this legislation sufficiently appropriate for the combination of organ donation after euthanasia, especially given the sequential nature of the procedures.
Ik acht deze wetgeving dan ook voldoende passend voor de combinatie van orgaandonatie na euthanasie, zeker gelet op de volgtijdelijkheid van de procedures.
Antwoord op vragen van het Arib over celkerntransplantatie, gericht op het voorkomen van de geboorte van een kind met een ernstige mitochondriale aandoening

An MP asked the Health Minister about mitochondrial donation (nuclear transfer) after UK news, asking how often it has led to pregnancies in the Netherlands, the status of Dutch research on clinical applicability, and how many families are affected. The minister answered that the technique is not performed in the Netherlands, that a feasibility study including international developments is nearly finished and will be sent to parliament, and gave prevalence estimates.
As soon as I have received the completed report, I will send it to your House.
Zodra ik het afgeronde rapport heb ontvangen, zal ik deze aan uw Kamer laten toekomen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Arib over de mogelijkheid van online sperma kopen in Denemarken

An MP asks the health minister whether buying donor sperm online from abroad, including Danish banks offering selection by eye colour, is lawful and how it squares with the child's right to know its origins and the donor's privacy under Article 8 ECHR. The minister answers that Dutch clinics must report donor data but parents who import donor sperma themselves are responsible for their own choices, and that the matter falls under the law of the country of origin.
If prospective parents order anonymous donor sperm via foreign websites or collect it abroad, this is their own responsibility.
Indien wensouders anoniem donorsperma bestellen via buitenlandse websites of dit donorsperma in het buitenland ophalen, is dit hun eigen verantwoordelijkheid.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Arib over het bericht dat de Levenseindekliniek weer op de vingers is getikt

An MP asks the Minister of Health whether she is concerned that the Levenseindekliniek was again found to have acted carelessly by the euthanasia review committee, its director's call for more lenient review, the need for research into its effect on demand and psychiatric expertise of review committees. The Minister declines to judge the case, which is with the IGZ and the Public Prosecution Service, declines an independent study pending the 2016 evaluation, and promises to involve a psychiatrist in complex psychiatric cases.
Both bodies have the task, within their own competence, to investigate the matter further and take a decision on that basis.
Beide instanties hebben binnen hun eigen bevoegdheid de taak om de zaak verder te onderzoeken en naar aanleiding daarvan een beslissing te nemen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Arib over patiënten die fors voor een donornier betalen

An MP asked the ministers whether paid illegal organ trade occurs in the Netherlands, how doctors should handle suspected commercial donors, how medical confidentiality relates to reporting suspicions, and whether a reporting point or donor premium exemption should be introduced. The minister answered that the Netherlands lacks clear evidence of such trade, that existing law and possible criminal reporting already suffice without new guidelines or a reporting point, and that financial incentives are ineffective and legally constrained.
I see no reason at this time to set up a reporting point for healthcare providers.
Ik zie geen aanleiding om op dit moment over te gaan tot het instellen van een meldpunt voor zorgverleners.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Arib over misstanden in het verleden bij spermabanken

An MP asks the health minister about past misconduct at the MC Bijdorp sperm clinic, including whether anonymous donor sperm was used after the 2004 law and how donor children can trace donors. The minister says the Health Inspectorate is investigating recent reports, earlier prosecutions were dropped, records have been moved for safekeeping, and she will consult the donor foundation on whether other clinics are involved.
While this investigation is ongoing, I cannot make any statements about this.
Lopende dit onderzoek kan ik hierover geen mededelingen doen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Arib en Van der Staaij over illegaal draagmoederschap

MPs Arib and Van der Staaij asked about illegal surrogacy, including enforcement by the prosecution service, whether the Raad voor de Kinderbescherming can track children born through surrogacy, a reporting structure, and screening of surrogates and intended parents. The government answered that it sees no reason to tighten enforcement, a reporting structure or screening now, deferring these questions to the Staatscommissie Herijking Ouderschap due mid-2016.
On this basis I see no reason to ask the Public Prosecution Service to tighten the current enforcement policy on surrogacy or to give it more priority with the police.

Ik zie op basis hiervan geen aanleiding het Openbaar Ministerie te verzoeken het huidige handhavingsbeleid ten aanzien van draagmoederschap aan te scherpen of het meer prioriteit te geven bij de politie.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Dik-Faber en Arib over één neutrale, landelijke niet-reanimeerpenning

MPs Dik-Faber and Arib asked whether a single neutral national do-not-resuscitate pendant should replace privately distributed ones, and whether registration and distribution should be arranged publicly. The minister supports a neutral, uniform pendant, will examine how VWS can facilitate one, and agrees to consult patient organisations on information.
I will explore the possibilities of issuing, or having issued, a uniform, neutral NR pendant not linked to any particular foundation or association.
Ik zal de mogelijkheden onderzoeken een uniforme, neutrale (niet aan een bepaalde stichting of vereniging gelieerde) NR-penning uit te (laten) geven.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Arib over wilsbekwaamheid bij zieke kinderen

An MP asked the Minister of Health about whether young children (under 12) can be considered capable of deciding on their own medical treatment and research participation, citing a study of decision-making competence. The Minister answered that the study does not justify general conclusions, that a fixed age limit of 12 should be kept for legal certainty, and that the government will send a proposal to align the research law's age threshold with the WGBO.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Arib over het bericht een dreigend tekort aan euthanasieartsen

The MP asks whether over 100 SCEN euthanasia physicians will lose registration under new BIG-register rules, whether regional SCEN groups will lose up to a third of their members, how this fits rising euthanasia requests, and whether knowledge and peer review will be lost. The minister confirms about 100 physicians may not re-register, states that 167 new SCEN physicians have started since 2012 with more in training, says total numbers are not falling and capacity is monitored, and sees no effect on practice.
There is no reason to assume that the inflow and outflow of SCEN physicians has consequences for the practice of euthanasia and assisted suicide.
Er is geen reden om aan te nemen dat de in- en uitstroom van SCEN-artsen gevolgen heeft voor de praktijk van euthanasie en hulp bij zelfdoding.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Arib over misstanden in het verleden bij spermabanken

An MP asked the Minister of Health about past irregularities at sperm banks, including incorrect donor information for children conceived before 2004 and the Fiom DNA database. The minister said she will consult Fiom and the IGZ, supports the Fiom database financially, but is not planning a government-run DNA database and says some pre-2004 donor records may no longer exist.
I will consult with Fiom about their findings.
Ik zal in overleg treden met Fiom over hun bevindingen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Arib over actieve levensbeëindiging bij kinderen tussen 1 en 12 jaar

An MP asked the health minister about calls within the Dutch paediatric association to allow active end-of-life decisions for children aged 1 to 12, the lack of registration of euthanasia requests, and low reporting to the Hubben committee for newborns. The minister answered that such acts are not currently permitted for this age group, that the newborn regulation will be clarified by spring 2015, and that the paediatric association will issue a position and commission an inventory study before any further action.
There is no central registration of euthanasia requests, whether from minors or adults.
Er is geen centrale registratie van euthanasieverzoeken, ongeacht of die afkomstig zijn van minderjarigen of meerderjarigen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Arib over de wijze waarop ziekenhuizen euthanasieverzoeken behandelen

An MP asked the Minister of Health how hospitals handle euthanasia requests, citing a report that Albert Schweitzer hospital received over 100 requests while carrying out only 15 euthanasias. The Minister answered that the ratio differs from national figures (with comparability uncertain), that doctors find it hard to judge true wishes to die, and that hospitals are free to organise euthanasia care as they see fit, with a dedicated consultant being one option.
Hospitals are free to shape their services in this area.
Ziekenhuizen zijn vrij om hun dienstverlening op dit gebied vorm te geven.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Arib over het tekort aan weefseldonoren

Labour MP Arib asks the Minister of Health about the 2013 decline in tissue, skin and cornea donors, its causes, and how to reverse it. Minister Schippers acknowledges the drop, says causes are hard to pinpoint, points to a donation-stimulation plan by the NTS with results promised by year-end, and notes stable transplant numbers.
I expect to be able to inform you of the results at the end of this year.
Ik verwacht dat ik u aan het einde van dit jaar kan informeren over de resultaten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Arib over een Europees burgerinitiatief tegen onderzoek met menselijke embryonale stamcellen

An MP asks the Health Minister about the European citizens' initiative 'One of Us' opposing research on human embryonic stem cells and whether Dutch rules on embryo research are dependent on EU funding and regulation. The minister defends the value of embryonic stem cell research, states Dutch law is carefully designed though partly shaped by EU directives, and says Dutch context should lead, with Dutch resistance to EU provisions with a medical-ethical character.
I endorse the principle that any adjustments to our legal arrangements should in principle be guided only by the Dutch context.
Ik onderschrijf het uitgangspunt dat voor eventuele aanpassingen van onze wettelijke regelingen en afspraken in principe alleen de Nederlandse context leidend zou moeten zijn.
Vragen van het lid Arib (PvdA) aan de Minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over het bericht dat sommige apothekers euthanasiemiddelen weigeren te verstrekken (ingezonden 17 april 2014).

An MP asked the health minister whether pharmacists may refuse to supply euthanasia drugs, on what grounds, and whether a referral duty or a role for pharmacists in the Euthanasia Act should be created. The minister answered that pharmacists may refuse, that referral notice is set in a joint guideline, and that no change to the Euthanasia Act is planned, while exchanges with the KNMP will continue.
In general there is no duty for pharmacists to supply.
Er bestaat ten algemene geen leveringsplicht voor apothekers.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Arib over het bericht ‘322 keer euthanasie via Levenseindekliniek’

PvdA MP Arib asked the health minister about reports of 322 euthanasia cases via the Levenseindekliniek, the role of GPs, consultation with the profession, and the clinic's care of psychiatric patients. Minister Schippers answered that the clinic meets a need for complex cases, referred to ongoing sector initiatives on end-of-life communication, and reported 12 euthanasia or assisted-suicide cases in psychiatric patients in 2013.
In two years, euthanasia and assisted suicide were granted 205 times, and 133 notifications have so far been assessed by the Regional Euthanasia Review Committees, all as careful.
In twee jaar tijd is 205 maal euthanasie en hulp bij zelfdoding verleend en er zijn tot nu toe 133 meldingen door de Regionale toetsingscommissies euthanasie beoordeeld, alle als zorgvuldig.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Arib over het stopzetten van de procedure naar het opsporen van doodsoorzaken van minderjarigen per 1 januari 2014

An MP asked the state secretary and health minister about ending the NODO procedure for investigating causes of death of minors from 1 January 2014, including parents' rights, the loss of knowledge infrastructure and whether the procedure was effective against child abuse. The government replied that legal duties for doctors and coroners remain unchanged, the sector will handle unexplained child deaths through joint working arrangements, and that talks with the field will start on 17 March with parliament to be informed of the outcome.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Arib over euthanasie bij mensen met een psychiatrische aandoening

An MP asked the Minister of Health about euthanasia for psychiatric patients, including the reported rise in cases and whether doctors consult multiple SCEN doctors and whether the review committees hear them all. The minister confirmed 42 notifications in 2013 versus 14 in 2012 and 13 in 2011, attributed the rise to growing doctor willingness and argued that consulting several SCEN doctors is permissible and rarely tracked, with the minister promising to ask the committees for their annual report sooner.
I will ask the Rte to send this annual report to me and the Minister of Security and Justice as soon as possible.
Ik zal de Rte verzoeken dit jaarverslag zo spoedig mogelijk aan mij en de Minister van Veiligheid en Justitie te doen toekomen.

Vragen van het lid Arib (PvdA) aan de Minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over het door ouders laten registreren van kinderen jonger dan 12 jaar voor orgaandonatie (ingezonden 19 november 2013).

An MP asks the health minister whether allowing parents to register children under 12 for organ donation would increase available organs, and about the legal basis for parental consent. The minister answers that it would likely not increase organs, that parents already decide after a child's death, and that she opposes registration by parents, instead promoting discussion and school education.
I am not in favour of parents being able to register their child under 12 in the donor register.
Ik ben er geen voorstander van dat ouders hun kind jonger dan 12 jaar kunnen registreren in het donorregister.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Arib over het bericht dat de verklaring euthanasie jaarlijks verlengd moet worden

An MP asked the Minister of Health whether the written euthanasia declaration should have a validity limit of two years and whether it should be discussed with doctors regularly, and asked about dementia cases in 2012. The minister rejected a fixed validity period, said the patient is primarily responsible for discussing the declaration with the doctor, and promised an update from a working group before the 19 December committee meeting.
However, I do not want to go so far as to formulate a period of validity at this moment.
Ik wil echter op dit moment niet zo ver gaan een geldigheidsduur te formuleren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Arib over het bericht dat artsenorganisatie KNMG wil dat huisartsen voortaan getoetst worden op regels inzake euthanasie

MP Arib asked the Minister of Health about the KNMG's proposal that GPs be tested on euthanasia rules and about the IGZ's handling of the Tuitjenhoorn case, the rise of palliative sedation and whether it masks euthanasia. The minister said GPs are assumed to have adequate knowledge, committed to an independent evaluation of the Tuitjenhoorn case, and gave statistics showing sedation rose 2005-2010 while noting professionalisation and training measures.
I have therefore decided to commission an independent evaluation of the conduct of all the instances involved in the Tuitjenhorn case.
Ik heb daarom besloten een onafhankelijke evaluatie te laten doen van het handelen van alle betrokken instanties in de zaak Tuitjenhorn.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Arib over het bericht dat de praktijk van draagmoederschap een ethische grens bereikt

An MP asked the State Secretary for Security and Justice and the Minister of Health about reports that surrogacy reaches an ethical limit, including a Dutch surrogate's birth to a child from anonymous Spanish donors and the Child Protection Board's decision to let the child go home with the intended parents. The government answered that Dutch law protects children's right to know their origins, that cross-border surrogacy is undesirable but not fully preventable, and that it will set up a State Commission on surrogacy and multi-parent families and follow Hague Conference work on an international instrument.
I intend to establish such a State Commission in the field of surrogacy and multi-parent families.
ben ik voornemens een dergelijke Staatscommissie in te stellen op het terrein van draagmoederschap en meeroudergezinnen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Arib en Voortman over het bericht dat zorgverzekeraars de Levenseindekliniek boycotten

MPs Arib and Voortman asked the health minister about reports that insurers are boycotting the Levenseindekliniek (end-of-life clinic) and whether patients are left dependent on donations. The minister answered that insurers have a duty of care but are free to choose contractors, that the CVZ has no specific opinion on the clinic, and that she will monitor developments without committing to new action.
It is up to the health insurer to decide with whom it wishes to contract for the provision of certain care.
Het is aan de zorgverzekeraar om te bepalen met wie deze een contract wil sluiten voor het leveren van bepaalde zorg.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Arib en Servaes over de arrestatie van journalist Ali Anouzla in Marokko

MPs Arib and Servaes asked the Foreign Minister about the arrest of journalist Ali Anouzla in Morocco for publishing a link to a terrorist group video, and whether this reflects wider press freedom problems and whether the Netherlands had raised it with Moroccan authorities. The minister answered that the case is a pending court matter, that the Netherlands monitors it and has discussed it with EU partners, and pointed to existing human rights and press freedom programmes with Morocco.
The Netherlands is following this case closely, but will not interfere in an ongoing court case.
Nederland volgt deze zaak nauwlettend, maar zal zich niet mengen in een lopende rechtszaak.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Arib en Wolbert over de ‘beste manier’ om genetische afwijkingen te achterhalen

Two PvdA MPs asked the health minister about the best way to detect genetic abnormalities, including whether the NIPT blood test should be introduced quickly and why Gezondheidsraad advice was delayed. The minister answered that NIPT is promising but must first be shown effective and safe under the Bevolkingsonderzoek law, that advice has been requested, and that a decision will follow promptly after the advice arrives.
Women go abroad on their own initiative to Belgium or Germany. Figures on this are not known to me.
Vrouwen gaan op eigen gelegenheid naar België of Duitsland. Cijfers hierover zijn mij niet bekend.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Arib en Wolbert over de beste manier om genetische afwijkingen te voorkomen

MPs Arib and Wolbert asked the health minister about the best way to detect genetic disorders, including whether Dutch hospitals send blood abroad for the non-invasive prenatal test (NIPT) and whether such testing should be allowed meanwhile. The minister said the precise role of hospitals is unknown, that she supports a swift but careful Health Council assessment, and that under the Dutch Population Screening Act testing abroad without a licence is not permitted.
The precise role of the Dutch hospitals is not known to me.
De precieze rol van de Nederlandse ziekenhuizen is mij niet bekend.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Arib over het bericht ‘Laat niet artsen maar rechters oordelen over euthanasieverklaring’

An MP asked the health minister about a proposal to have judges rather than doctors rule on the validity of advance euthanasia declarations for dementia patients, and asked about the number of such cases and a notary-certification proposal. The minister rejected judicial pre-review, said a declaration is already legally valid when dated and signed, opposed notarial certification, and declined to refer the proposal to the working group or consult the judiciary.
I consider it neither sensible nor desirable to involve judges in assessing the validity of the declaration of wishes.
Ik vind het zinvol noch wenselijk rechters te betrekken bij het beoordelen van de geldigheid van de wilsverklaring.

Antwoord vragen van het lid Arib over het bericht dat een Spaanse vruchtbaarheidskliniek Nederlandse paren met een kinderwens werft voor een vruchtbaarheidsbehandeling met anonieme eiceldonatie in Spanje

An MP asks the health minister about a Spanish fertility clinic that recruits Dutch couples for anonymous egg donation in Spain, including its Dutch information point, a genetic carrier test marketed at €400, sponsorship of patient group Freya, and whether Dutch rules are circumvented. The minister answers that the Dutch information point is lawful, that Dutch gynaecologists' cooperation is disapproved, that anonymous donation is not permitted in the Netherlands, that EU-level action is not appropriate, and that she will inform parliament on oversight of health information.
Fertility treatments with anonymous egg donors are not permitted in the Netherlands.
Vruchtbaarheidsbehandelingen met anonieme eiceldonoren zijn in Nederland niet toegelaten.

Vragen van het lid Arib(PvdA) aan de staatssecretaris van Veiligheid en Justitie en de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over het vaak niet melden van de dood van een minderjarige (ingezonden 6 maart 2013).

An MP asks the State Secretary of Security and Justice and the Minister of Health about the low rate of reporting of deaths of minors to municipal coroners, the new NODO procedure, and whether obduction without suspicion of abuse complies with Article 8 ECHR. The government answers that reporting is improving, attributes low 2010 rates to physician unfamiliarity, states that case numbers are about fifty per year, and justifies compulsory obduction as proportionate.
In consultation with professional associations and the Association of Dutch Municipalities (VNG), awareness of the reporting obligation will be increased.
In overleg met beroepsverenigingen en de Vereniging van Nederlandse Gemeenten (VNG) zal de bekendheid van de meldplicht worden vergroot.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Arib over de zelfmoord van een Russische vreemdeling in het uitzetcentrum in Rotterdam

An MP asks the State Secretary for Security and Justice about the suicide of a Russian asylum seeker in the Rotterdam detention centre, whether he was wrongly detained, his psychiatric condition, and the reasons for rejection. The State Secretary confirms shock, has asked the Inspectorate for Security and Justice to investigate, explains detention rules, and declines to discuss the individual asylum account or to say whether the rejection is linked to the suicide.
Following this event, I have asked the Inspectorate for Security and Justice (IVenJ) to start an investigation.
Naar aanleiding van deze gebeurtenis heb ik de Inspectie Veiligheid en Justitie (IVenJ) gevraagd een onderzoek te starten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Ojik en Arib over de voorgenomen uitzetting van een Oeigoerse asielzoeker naar China

MPs Van Ojik and Arib asked whether a planned deportation of a Uyghur asylum seeker to China, halted by the Council of State, would be cancelled, whether his risks were re-examined, and whether Dutch policy on deporting Uyghurs to China would be reviewed in light of NGO warnings. The State Secretary declined to discuss the individual case for privacy reasons, said the country report on China is under review and that the government will inform parliament shortly.
Given the privacy interest of the foreign national concerned and the fact that his case is before the court, I will not go further into this individual case.
Met het oog op het belang van de privacy van de betrokken vreemdeling en gezien het feit dat zijn zaak onder de rechter is, ga ik niet verder in op deze individuele zaak.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Arib over de moeilijkheden voor een in Nederland geboren kind dat afkomstig is uit Kosovo om een verblijfsvergunning te krijgen wegens het ontbreken van een paspoort

MP Arib asked the state secretary why a Dutch-born child of Kosovar parents must meet the passport requirement for a residence permit, and whether this is unreasonable when no Kosovar passport can be obtained locally. The state secretary answered that the passport requirement applies, exemption is only granted when the foreign authorities cannot issue a passport, and the child can register at the Kosovar embassy in The Hague and apply for a passport in Brussels, so no return trip is needed.
It is not possible to apply for a passport for a child born in the Netherlands at the Embassy of Kosovo in The Hague.
Het is niet mogelijk om voor een in Nederland geboren kind een paspoort aan te vragen bij de ambassade van Kosovo in Den Haag.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Arib over de oproep van Vluchtelingenwerk Nederland om te stoppen met de grensdetentie van vluchtelingen

An MP from the PvdA asked the State Secretary for Security and Justice about Vluchtelingenwerk's call to end border detention of asylum seekers arriving by air, including numbers detained, detention durations, minors, and whether alternatives exist. The State Secretary defended border detention as required by the Schengen Borders Code, reported 620 detained asylum seekers and 50 in the closed extended procedure in 2012, and said he would report on alternatives before the summer recess.
I expect to be able to inform your House about this before the summer recess.
Ik verwacht uw Kamer hierover voor het zomerreces te kunnen berichten.
Antwoord vragen lid Arib over het verhuizen van asielkinderen.

An MP from the Labour Party asked the State Secretary for Security and Justice about a report on asylum children being relocated repeatedly between reception locations, and whether this should be reduced. The State Secretary replied that moves are largely on the family's own request or necessary parts of the procedure, that the COA tries to minimise and schedule them during school holidays, and that small-scale commercial family housing is not preferred, while noting moves can burden children.
I do not share the conclusion that the number of relocations is exorbitantly high.
De conclusie dat het aantal verhuizingen exorbitant hoog is, deel ik niet.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Arib over de ervaringen met Nader Onderzoek DoodsOorzaak minderjarigen (NODO-procedure)

An MP asked about the NODO procedure for unexplained deaths of minors, prompted by a case involving a severely disabled child, including whether obduction is needed when a medical file exists, procedure duration, the two NODO centres, and training of forensic doctors. The government answered that the procedure is standard for unexplained deaths, explained its steps and criteria, noted a startup evaluation until October 2013, and stated the procedure is neutral and non-judicial, while declining to discuss the individual case.
In answering these and the following questions I cannot go into the individual case.
Bij de beantwoording van deze en volgende vragen kan ik niet ingaan op de casuïstiek

Antwoord vragen van het lid Arib over de gevolgen van de oorlog in Syrië voor de mogelijkheden van Nederlandse statushouders om te naturaliseren en voor de gezinsleden van vluchtelingen om naar Nederland na te reizen

An MP asked about the consequences of the Syrian war for Syrian status holders' naturalisation eligibility and for family reunification, including document requirements and processing times. The state secretary answered that most naturalisation requirements still apply, that document evidence of hardship is assessed case by case, and that family reunification processing averages 22 weeks with no commitment to fast-track or early entry.
This information is not available. The IND does not record this data.
Deze informatie is niet beschikbaar. De IND legt deze gegevens niet vast.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Arib over oppakken van vreemdelingen op basis van huidkleur

MP Arib asked the state secretary of Security and Justice about police stopping foreigners based on skin colour, the legal consequences of Council of State rulings, cooperation between Connexxion and the aliens police, and the abandonment of a vulnerable woman after detention. The state secretary referred to earlier answers on questions 1-4, said no formal cooperation existed with Connexxion, and described detention-release procedures and the 2012 change allowing medical staff to be present in the evening, without addressing the individual case due to privacy.
Due to privacy, I cannot go into this individual case, which took place in 2011.
In verband met de privacy kan ik niet ingaan op dit individuele geval, dat speelde in 2011.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Arib over de barrières bij de gezinshereniging van vluchtelingen

An MP asked the state secretary of Security and Justice about the Defence for Children and Vluchtelingenwerk report on barriers to family reunification for refugees, and about high refusal rates. The state secretary defends the procedure as careful and anti-fraud, rejects the report's characterisation, says he will respond more fully in spring 2013, and states that refusals do not necessarily indicate fraud.
A refusal does not by definition mean that there is fraud.
Een afwijzing betekent niet per definitie dat er sprake is van fraude.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Arib over het bericht dat de Haarlemse vreemdelingenpolitie een Ghanese tuinman, enkel op grond van zijn huidskleur, heeft opgepakt

MP Arib asked whether the Haarlem aliens police detained a Ghanaian gardener solely on the basis of his skin colour, and whether guidelines should change. The state secretary replied that the newspaper report is incorrect, that the official record and court ruling show no ethnic basis for the check, that skin colour alone cannot establish a reasonable suspicion, and that he sees no reason to amend the guidelines.
Skin colour alone does not give rise to a reasonable suspicion of unlawful residence measured by objective standards.
Huidskleur alleen levert geen naar objectieve maatstaven gemeten redelijk vermoeden van illegaal verblijf op.
Antwoord vragen Arib over de slechte situatie voor asielzoekers in Griekenland

An MP from the PvdA asks the state secretary of Security and Justice about the poor conditions for asylum seekers in Greece, including the reported detention and street-exposure of unaccompanied minors, and whether Dublin transfers to Greece can resume. The state secretary says he is concerned, awaits Greece's official response, notes Greece's revised action plan due in January 2013, and says Netherlands will press for EU support but gives no firm timeline for resuming Dublin returns.
I only want to go into the substance of the report after this reaction.
Ik wil inhoudelijk pas ingaan op het rapport na deze reactie.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Arib over de veroordeling van een van pedoseksueel misdrijf verdachte Nederlander in Cambodja

An MP asked the Justice Minister about the Cambodian conviction of a Dutch national for child sexual abuse, whether Cambodia was informed about a possible mutual legal assistance request, and why a travel ban for convicted paedophiles has not yet been legislated. The minister answered that Cambodia was informed but has not filed a request, that Dutch officers can act abroad only with local consent, and that a travel-ban bill is expected in the first half of 2013.
I therefore tackle child sex tourism to reduce the risk that children abroad fall victim to sexual abuse by Dutch nationals.
Ik pak kindersekstoerisme dan ook aan om het risico dat kinderen in het buitenland slachtoffer worden van seksueel misbruik door Nederlanders te verkleinen.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Arib over de moord op een door Nederland afgewezen Servische asielzoeker na terugkeer in het land van herkomst

An MP asks the state secretary of Security and Justice about the murder in Serbia of a Serbian asylum seeker rejected by the Netherlands, including whether his asylum refusal was justified and whether an independent investigation will be held. The state secretary answers that the IND decision was reviewed by the courts and confirmed, that further investigation would not bear on the decision's care, that the time lapse makes any causal link speculative, and that he will consider additional procedural safeguards for coordination with witness-protection programmes.

I am willing to include additional procedural safeguards in the asylum procedure for contact between government bodies responsible for the asylum procedure and witness protection programmes at international tribunals.

Ik ben bereid om voor contact tussen overheidsinstanties verantwoordelijk voor de asielprocedure en beschermingsprogramma's voor getuigen bij internationale tribunalen, aanvullende procedurele waarborgen op te nemen bij de asielprocedure.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Arib over tientallen vrouwen die zijn opgelicht en verkeerde borstimplantaten kregen

An MP asked the health minister whether surgeons secretly used cheaper, controversial PIP breast implants instead of the promised premium brands, and what the inspectorate and professional body had received and would do. The minister said the cases are primarily civil-law matters for courts and the disciplinary judge, noted three inspectorate reports, and announced a central implant register while declining to order a broader inspection.
I am of the view that the situation described, given its nature, falls within the civil-law domain.
Ik ben van mening dat de beschreven situatie gelet op zijn aard in het civielrechtelijke domein thuishoort.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Arib over het bericht dat er in Amsterdam tenminste 200 vrouwen “gekooid” leven

An MP asked the ministers whether a report that at least 200 women in Amsterdam are kept confined by their families is accurate, what the government is doing about it, whether such confinement is criminal, and whether national data exists. The government answered that it shares the goal of women's participation and points to existing programmes and the Wet inburgering, that forced confinement can constitute deprivation of liberty under the Criminal Code, and that no national figures exist, with a research study promised for the first half of 2013.
There is no national data on the number of women who are forced to stay indoors and may not have contact with others.
Er zijn geen landelijke gegevens over het aantal vrouwen dat gedwongen wordt binnenshuis te blijven en geen contact met anderen mag hebben.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Arib over Kamervragen over een leeftijdsgrens voor esthetische ingrepen

An MP asked the health minister about an age limit for cosmetic surgery on minors, citing a clinic director's remarks and the professional guidelines of plastic surgeons. The minister said the guidelines bar cosmetic procedures under 18 except in exceptional cases, that the IGZ can intervene if guidelines are not followed, and that she is examining the beauty sector and will consider an age limit, though she gave no firm commitment to legislate.
The answer to both questions is not known to me.
Het antwoord op beide vragen is mij niet bekend.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Arib over een tekort aan opvang voor slachtoffers van mensenhandel

An MP asked the Justice minister about a shortage of shelter for victims of human trafficking and domestic violence, and whether responsibility lies with the national government or municipalities. The minister replied that there is currently no shortage of beds for trafficking victims after capacity was raised from 50 to 70, that funding responsibility is clarified through existing arrangements, and that a separate recovery claim against perpetrators is unnecessary.
At present 70 shelter places are sufficient to accommodate the victims in the reflection period.
Op dit moment zijn 70 opvangplaatsen voldoende om de slachtoffers in de bedenktijd op te vangen.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Arib over de gedwongen uithuwelijking van een Nederlands meisje in Somalië

An MP asked ministers whether they were aware of the case of a Dutch girl forced into marriage in Somalia and abandoned there, how the embassy handled her case, and whether a Forced Marriage Unit like the British one should be set up in the Netherlands. The government answered that embassy assistance is limited by foreign legal systems, declined to discuss the individual case for privacy reasons, and said an analysis of options, including the British model, will be sent to parliament in spring 2013.
In view of the protection of the privacy and safety of S., we cannot go into the individual case.
In verband met de bescherming van de privacy en veiligheid van S. kunnen wij niet ingaan op de individuele zaak.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Arib over de suggestie dat borstkanker is te voorkomen door osteopathie

MP Arib asks the minister whether the claim by the Robuste clinic that good blood supply to breasts reduces breast cancer risk, and the associated website information, are acceptable and whether they can be banned. The minister says no scientific evidence supports the claim, that such misleading claims are unacceptable, and that the Consumer Protection Act already prohibits misleading claims that a product can cure diseases, enforced by the Consumentenautoriteit.
I do not find it acceptable if this suggestion were to be created.
Ik vind het niet acceptabel als deze suggestie zou worden gewekt.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Arib over het korten op de subsidie voor Fiom, de landelijke hulpverleningsorganisatie op het gebied van zwangerschap, kinderwens, afstamming en adoptie

An MP asked the health minister why the state subsidy to Fiom, a national counselling organisation on pregnancy, fertility and adoption, is being cut, and whether its expertise is lost and costs rise as a result. The minister answered that the structural subsidy is cut to 2 million euro with a transition subsidy for 2013-2014, that regular care and local services can provide similar help, and that the government no longer deems it appropriate to fund this specific work.
Furthermore, the number of unwanted pregnancies is fairly stable, as is the number of adoptions.
Verder is het aantal ongewenste zwangerschappen redelijk stabiel, net als het aantal adopties.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Arib over preconceptiezorg

An MP asks the health minister whether preconception care and genetic risk information should be expanded, including a programmatic approach, a preconception consult for all prospective parents, and wider perinatal audit coverage. The minister answers that existing information materials and targeted risk-group efforts suffice for now, that audits already include congenital anomalies, and that a preconception consult will await ZonMw research results.
I indeed am of the view that existing preconception care currently suffices.
Ik ben inderdaad van mening dat de bestaande preconceptiezorg vooralsnog voldoet.

Antwoord vragen van het lid Arib over het bericht dat slachtoffers van seksueel misbruik, die als kind onder verantwoordelijkheid van de overheid in tehuizen of pleeggezinnen zijn geplaatst tussen wal en schip dreigen te

MP Arib asks whether a broad reporting point for victims of sexual abuse in state-responsible youth care will be operational by 8 October 2012, when the Samson commission reports, and how victims who have not yet come forward can still report. The state secretary answers that a national telephone line via Slachtofferhulp Nederland will open on 1 October 2012, linked to existing reporting points, and that she will not anticipate the Samson report's findings.
A reporting point for all victims of sexual abuse will be realised from 1 October 2012 via a national telephone number at Slachtofferhulp Nederland.
Een meldpunt voor alle slachtoffers van seksueel misbruik zal vanaf 1 oktober 2012 gerealiseerd zijn via een landelijk telefoonnummer bij Slachtofferhulp Nederland.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Arib over het bericht “over de campagne tegen huwelijksdwang”

An MP asked ministers whether the state adequately protects women facing forced marriage, marital captivity and abandonment, including criminal law, consular aid, registration, and whether a UK-style Forced Marriage Unit should be set up. The government answered that existing criminal provisions, civil-court routes, Steunpunt Huiselijk Geweld and embassy help suffice for now, that data registration will be assessed in 2013, and that an analysis including a possible unit will be sent to parliament in spring 2013.
To offer more effective help in cases of abandonment and forced marriage, the cabinet is currently making an analysis of the problem and of possible solutions.
Om slagvaardiger hulp te bieden bij gevallen van achterlating en huwelijksdwang maakt het kabinet op dit moment een analyse van de problematiek en welke oplossingen mogelijk zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Arib over het weigeren van medewerking van Nederland aan de veroordeling van een van pedoseksueel misdrijf verdachte Nederlander in Cambodja

An MP asked the Justice Minister why the Netherlands had not cooperated with Cambodian proceedings against a Dutch national suspected of child sexual offences, and whether he could be prosecuted in the Netherlands. The minister said contacts with Cambodian authorities had taken place via the Dutch police attaché, that information would not be disclosed, and that a Dutch prosecution was legally possible but its opportunity could not yet be judged.
This concerns a case that is currently before the court in Cambodia.
Het betreft hier een zaak die op het moment in Cambodja onder de rechter is.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Arib over eigen bijdrage voor bevallen in het ziekenhuis of geboortecentrum

An MP asks the health minister about the copayment for hospital or birth-centre deliveries without medical indication, whether it drives epidural choices or home births, and whether financial factors should influence birth location. The minister says the NZa advised studying differentiated copayments, leaves follow-up to a successor given her caretaker status, cites epidural rate data, and states no research shows financial motives.
Given my caretaker status, I will leave the follow-up of this advice to my successor.
Gezien mijn demissionaire status zal ik de opvolging van dit advies aan mijn opvolger overlaten.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Arib over het niet reageren op het gillen van een meisje dat werd uitgehuwelijkt

An MP asked the Minister of Security and Justice why police did not intervene when a girl screaming against a forced marriage was seen, and whether police should be trained on forced marriage. The minister rejected the characterization of inaction, listing search actions, phone contact with the adult woman who declined to file a complaint, and existing expert involvement, and saw no added value in separate training.
Inquiries with the force show that after a report of a possible abduction came in, the police immediately took various actions.
Navraag bij het korps leert dat na binnenkomst van een melding van een mogelijke ontvoering de politie direct diverse acties heeft ondernomen
Antwoord vragen van het lid Arib over toezicht op de veroordeelde pedoseksueel

An MP asks the state secretary about a convicted sex offender who reportedly found housing without reclassering involvement, and whether mayors are always informed about released sex offenders. The state secretary denies the housing report, notes the court ruling on reclassering information-sharing, and says the BIJ information project is ongoing with an evaluation due end 2012, while rejecting the need for new legislation.
I therefore see no need to make changes to laws and regulations in addition to what I have already done.
Ik zie dan ook geen noodzaak om aanvullend op hetgeen ik reeds heb gedaan wijzigingen in wet- en regelgeving door te voeren.
Antwoord vragen Arib en Timmermans over Tweede Kamervragen over Jordaanse wetgeving die toestaat dat een verkrachter met zijn slachtoffer mag trouwen

MPs Arib and Timmermans asked the Foreign Minister whether the government would press Jordan, given international rules, to reform Article 308 of its penal code, which lets rapists escape prosecution by marrying their victims. The minister acknowledged rights concerns, said international pressure is important, and said the issue will be raised in bilateral consultations and in EU forums.
I will raise this issue within the EU; the Human Rights Subcommittee under the EU Association Agreement with Jordan and the relevant EU Council working groups offer opportunities to do so.

Ik zal deze problematiek in EU verband aan de orde stellen; het Subcomité Mensenrechten in het kader van het EU Associatieakkoord met Jordanië en de relevante EU-raadswerkgroepen bieden daartoe mogelijkheden.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Arib over verloskundige zorg in Meppel en omstreken

An MP asks the health minister about the Meppel maternity care dispute, including a hospital board member's public statement that closing acute obstetrics was unavoidable while talks were ongoing, and whether the decision was effectively already taken. The minister says the board will weigh the Blijham report, expects the outline of regional maternity care by 1 November 2012, and describes the College Perinatale Zorg as having a facilitating role.
The board states that it will take the final report of Mr Blijham into account in its upcoming decision-making.
Het bestuur geeft aan het eindrapport van de heer Blijham mee te wegen in hun komende besluitvorming.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Arib over regionale verschillen in moedersterfte in Nederland

An MP asked the health minister about regional differences in maternal mortality in the Netherlands, including higher rates in Zeeland and Rotterdam and among non-Western women and older mothers, and whether targeted measures and a plan of action would be provided. The minister answered that the variation partly reflects known health inequalities, pointed to the Stuurgroep advice and the Healthy Pregnancy 4 All programme, and referred back to the earlier answers for the remaining questions.
For the answer to questions 5 through 9, see my answer to questions 3 and 4.
Voor het antwoord op vraag 5 tot en met 9 zie mijn antwoord op de vragen 3 en 4.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Arib over het bericht over zelfdoding onder Hindostaanse meisjes

MP Arib asks the health and education ministers about reports of high suicide among Hindustani girls, whether prior answers on attention to the issue hold up, whether schools and professionals are equipped, and whether recent national figures exist. Minister Schippers answers that suicide prevention has received more investment, that schools will be pointed to available information via the VO-raad without a mandatory approach, and that no recent national figures on migrant young women are available, while promising a forthcoming clinical guideline.
No recent national figures are available on the number of suicide attempts among certain groups of migrant young women.
Er zijn geen recente landelijke cijfers beschikbaar van het aantal suïcidepogingen onder bepaalde groepen migranten jonge vrouwen.
Antwoord vragen Arib over het risico dat er binnen vrijwillersorganisaties en sportclubs ontucht met kinderen kan worden gepleegd

An MP asked the state secretary of Security and Justice how volunteer organisations and sports clubs can prevent people who previously committed child sexual abuse from working with children again, and whether a mandatory certificate of conduct (VOG) should be required. The state secretary answered that such abuse is unacceptable, pointed to a disciplinary college and reference list being set up and linked to sports registries by 2014, and said there is no legal basis to make the VOG mandatory, since responsibility primarily lies with the clubs.
If not, why not? Answer 5: For the situation described in the article, the sports club can ask the prospective volunteer to submit a VOG.
Zo nee, waarom niet? Antwoord 5 Voor de geschetste situatie in het artikel geldt dat de sportclub de beoogde vrijwilliger kan vragen een VOG te overleggen.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Arib over de vergoeding van In Vitro Fertilisatie (IVF)

MP Arib asks the health minister about proposals to restrict IVF reimbursement to women under 41, the cost savings from more efficient drug prescribing, and whether IVF should be stopped or limited. The minister replies that alternative measures including a 43-year age limit were developed and advised on by the CVZ, that three IVF treatments remain reimbursed, and that she has not decided to stop reimbursement.
I have not decided to stop the reimbursement of IVF.
Ik heb niet besloten tot het stopzetten van de vergoeding van IVF.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Arib over het bericht dat kinderen elkaar misbruiken in Almelose jeugdinstelling

MP Arib asked the ministers whether sexual abuse between minors persists at the Almelo youth institution Commujon, whether sanctions for not reporting abuse are adequate, whether a reporting duty should cover adult and peer abuse, and how many criminal complaints youth institutions have filed. Minister Schippers answered that no recent signals exist, that the institution was placed under intensified supervision in 2010 and lifted in 2011, that she opposes a broader reporting duty in favour of a reporting code, and that complaints are not centrally registered.
I do not have the figures on the number of criminal complaints filed by youth care institutions.
Ik beschik niet over de cijfers van het aantal aangiftes gedaan door jeugdzorginstellingen.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Arib over het bericht dat de babysterfte in de Bijlmer de hoogste is van Nederland

An MP asked the health minister whether avoidable infant mortality in the Bijlmer (Amsterdam Zuidoost) is caused by substandard hospital care, and what measures will reduce it. The minister answered that the causes lie mainly in social and medical risk factors, that no signals of lower care quality were received, and pointed to existing programmes (Healthy Pregnancy 4 All with 14 municipalities, the College Perinatale Zorg) with results only available around 2014.
The IGZ has received no signals indicating that, on top of this, the quality of care in Amsterdam hospitals is lower than elsewhere in the country.
De IGZ heeft geen signalen ontvangen waaruit blijkt dat daarbovenop de kwaliteit van de zorgverlening in de Amsterdamse ziekenhuizen minder zou zijn dan elders in het land.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Arib over cosmetische chirurgie als genitale verminking

An MP asked the health minister whether cosmetic genital procedures such as G-spot enlargement amount to deception and mutilation, whether only qualified doctors should perform them, whether private clinics keep adequate records, and whether a minimum age should apply. The minister said the procedures are experimental and not yet assessable, that IGZ oversees quality and information, that no new rules are in preparation beyond a European standard in development, that clinics do report to IGZ, and that she will investigate an age limit for cosmetic surgery and report back.
I have launched an investigation into the possibility of setting an age limit for plastic surgery.
Daartoe heb ik een onderzoek ingesteld naar de mogelijkheid om een leeftijdsgrens in te stellen voor plastische chirurgie.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Arib en Timmermans over een 14-jarig Marokkaans meisje dat gedwongen werd haar verkrachter te trouwen

MPs Arib and Timmermans asked the Dutch government whether it would press Morocco, bilaterally and within the EU, to reform article 475 of its penal code after a 14-year-old girl was forced to marry her rapist, and what concrete steps it would take. The minister answered that the issue is raised through the UN Universal Periodic Review and the EU-Morocco neighbourhood dialogue, that a bilateral working group is not the right forum, and that Morocco's national debate on the article has not yet started.
That is why I have had this case raised in Morocco's review under the UN Human Rights Council's Universal Periodic Review.
Daarom heb ik deze zaak aan de orde laten stellen in het landen-examen van Marokko in het kader van de Universal Periodic Review van de VN-Mensenrechtenraad.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Arib over illegale besnijdenissen in Engeland

An MP asked the ministers of Health and Justice about reports of illegal female genital cutting in England, whether Dutch at-risk families send girls abroad, and whether a Europe-wide study and joint approach are planned. The state secretary answered that the reports could not be confirmed, cited ongoing European and Dutch prevalence studies, reported that no one has yet been convicted in the Netherlands, and committed to a European strategy on violence against women that will address this practice.
Yes. The European Commission intends to develop a European strategy on violence against women.
Ja. De Europese commissie is voornemens te komen tot een Europese strategie over geweld tegen vrouwen.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Arib over vermijdbare sterfte in de zorg en het Kinderformularium

An MP asked the health minister whether the Children's Formulary would be discontinued on 1 July 2012 for lack of funding, how often it is used, how much it needs, and whether the minister would help keep it alive. The minister said the ministry was only a start-up funder, offered temporary bridge funding until March 2013 while the parties agree a long-term solution, and rejected structural state funding.
I am willing to fund the NKFK during the bridging period needed for the parties to reach agreement among themselves
Ik ben bereid tot een financiering van het NKFK gedurende de overbruggingstijd die nodig is om de partijen met elkaar tot overeenstemming te laten komen
Antwoord vragen van het lid Arib over mishandeling van zwangere vrouwen

An MP asked the Justice Minister whether the assault on a pregnant woman that led to her unborn child's death warrants stronger sentencing, and whether Article 82 convictions for such cases are recorded. The minister answered that the forensic investigation is ongoing with no date for results, that no separate statistics exist on Article 82 convictions, and that existing maximum penalties and sentencing discretion already allow the pregnancy to be taken into account.
The investigation in this case is still ongoing.
Het onderzoek in deze zaak loopt nog.
Antwoord vragen Arib over schizofrenie bij Marokkaanse jongeren en het taboe dat daarop rust

An MP asked the health minister about the higher rate of schizophrenia among Moroccan-Dutch young men and the stigma and low help-seeking around it. The minister acknowledged the vulnerability, cited stigma and lack of knowledge as barriers, and said the Health Council's advice on migrant youth mental health is pending, with a government response to follow.
A cabinet response will follow on this advice.
Op dit advies zal een kabinetsreactie komen.
Antwoord vragen Arib over de zorg voor kwetsbare vrouwen met psychosociale en psychiatrische problematiek, rond zwangerschap en geboorte

An MP asked the health minister about the effects of the GGZ own-contribution (eigen bijdrage) on vulnerable pregnant women with psychosocial and psychiatric problems, and about why no exemption was created for them. The minister said the effects are still being monitored, acknowledged the risks of care avoidance, but declined a targeted exemption and instead lowered the general contribution to 200 euro with some exceptions.
I am willing to further explore the possibilities for alternative measures for 2013 within the development of the broader policy agenda.
130 ) ook aangegeven dat ik bereid ben om in het kader van de ontwikkeling van de brede beleidsagenda de mogelijkheden voor alternatieve maatregelen voor 2013 verder te onderzoeken.
Antwoord vragen Marcouch en Arib over politieprioriteiten in Twente

MPs Marcouch and Arib asked the Minister of Security and Justice about local police priorities in Twente, after reports that local CDA and VVD prefer animal police to address sex crimes and that a motion urged broader use of animal cops. The state secretary answered that local input on police priorities is welcome under existing and proposed law, that animal police work within the general police task with regular powers, and that both animal welfare and child pornography are national priorities.
I welcome that municipalities are thinking about how to fill in police priorities.
Ik juich het toe dat in de gemeenten wordt nagedacht over de invulling van politieprioriteiten.
Antwoord vragen Arib en Timmermans over de zelfmoord van het 16-jarige Marokkaanse meisje Amina Filali

MPs Arib and Timmermans asked the ministers of Justice and Security and Foreign Affairs about the suicide of a 16-year-old Moroccan girl forced into marriage with her rapist under Article 475 of Morocco's penal code, and whether the Netherlands would press Morocco on it. The minister of Foreign Affairs acknowledged the article's effect on women's rights, said the Moroccan government will address the issue itself and that EU human rights dialogue will cover progress, and declined to commit to a working-group meeting.
Because the Moroccan government has indicated it will address this issue itself, it is now mainly up to the Moroccan government and society to study the legal context and revise the legislation.

Omdat de Marokkaanse regering heeft aangegeven deze kwestie zelf te zullen aanpakken, is het nu vooral aan de Marokkaanse regering en de Marokkaanse samenleving om de juridische context te bestuderen en de wetgeving te herzien.
Antwoord vragen Arib over illegale prostitutie in massagesalons

An MP asked the Minister of Security and Justice about illegal prostitution in massage parlours, including whether it spreads beyond Amsterdam and whether such businesses should be subject to the Bibob integrity-screening regime. The minister confirmed signals in other cities, announced a research study on trafficking in the Chinese beauty sector, and pointed to the pending prostitution regulation bill that would require licensing of all sex businesses, with Bibob screening available in licence applications.
This study is expected to be completed around the summer.
Dit onderzoek zal naar verwachting rond de zomer zijn afgerond.

Vragen van het lid Arib (PvdA) aan de ministers van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport en van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties en de staatssecretaris van Veiligheid en Justitie over het niet melden van een niet-n

An MP asked ministers why the Public Prosecution Service believes doctors wrongly sign natural-death certificates and why reporting of non-natural deaths is low, and whether the NODO procedure for child deaths will be introduced.
