The government answered that the prosecution service relies on a Nivel/EMGO estimate of about 1,960 avoidable care-related deaths yearly against only 96 reports, plans a knowledge campaign before approaching institutions, and promises a letter on the NODO procedure's status.
To establish whether a wrongly issued natural-death certificate has occurred, the prosecution service depends on other parties.
Om vast te stellen of sprake is geweest van een ten onrechte afgegeven verklaring van natuurlijk overlijden is het OM afhankelijk van andere partijen.
Antwoord vragen Samsom en Arib over de besmetting van een ex-AMV-er met hepatitis B, direct na verblijf in het detentiecentrum in Rotterdam

MPs Samsom and Arib asked whether a former unaccompanied minor, released from the Rotterdam immigration detention centre and later found infected with acute hepatitis B, had reported symptoms, how the GGD handled the case, and what measures would prevent sick migrants being released onto the street. The minister declined to answer medical questions, said the State Secretary had asked for an investigation by the IGZ into the care given and precautionary measures, reported the GGD's contact tracing found no link to the centre so far, and said medical intake and aftercare standards apply and a residence offer was made under RANOV.
I cannot answer questions that fall within the medical duty of confidentiality.
Op vragen die vallen binnen de medische geheimhoudingsplicht kan ik niet ingaan.
Antwoord vragen Samsom en Arib over de besmetting van een ex- AMV-er met hepatitis B, direct na verblijf in het detentiecentrum in Rotterdam

Two MPs asked ministers about a seriously ill Chinese asylum seeker released from immigration detention in Rotterdam with hepatitis B, including alleged neglect, destroyed samples, and a wrongly denied general pardon since 2007. The minister answered that the internal investigation is pending, the IGZ may investigate further, no other infections were found, and the individual's own conduct and unclear identity contributed to the delayed permit, with any compensation left open.
If, after the internal investigation is completed, questions remain unanswered in the inspectorate's view, the IGZ itself, as an independent party, will carry out further investigation.
Wanneer – na afronding van het interne onderzoek – er naar oordeel van de inspectie vragen onbeantwoord blijven, dan zal de IGZ zelf, als onafhankelijke partij, nader onderzoek verrichten.

Antwoord vragen Arib en Groot over het bericht dat de fiscus belasting heft over smartengeld van slachtoffers uit de Tweede Wereldoorlog en mogelijk ook over vergoedingen voor slachtoffers van seksueel misbruik binnen de

MPs Arib and Groot asked whether tax is levied on compensation paid to Second World War victims and to victims of abuse in the Catholic Church, and how such payments affect benefit entitlements. The government answered that periodic Artikel 2 Fonds payments are taxable income, that lump-sum church compensation is not income for tax purposes but counts as assets, and that municipalities decide on benefit means-testing, with a planned exemption under review.
I have decided together with the relevant fellow ministers to take measures so that the one-off payments from the Roman Catholic Church at issue are included in this regulation.

Ik heb met de betrokken collega-bewindslieden besloten om maatregelen te treffen waardoor de hier aan de orde zijnde eenmalige uitkeringen van de Rooms-Katholieke Kerk in deze regeling worden opgenomen.
Antwoord vragen Arib over slachtoffers van seksueel misbruik

Labour MP Arib asks the Justice Minister whether the OM's renaming of 'slachtoffer' to 'aangever' in the sexual abuse prosecution guideline signals distrust of victims, and about false-report figures and victim experience. The minister replies that the term aims at objectivity without distrust of victims, that victims' rights remain, that false-report estimates are limited, and that a victim monitor is underway but the guideline wording will not change.
The use of the more neutral term 'aangever' has nothing to do with distrust of victims, but aims to do more justice to the pursuit of objectivity in the truth-finding process in sexual offence cases.

Het gebruik van de neutralere term «aangever» heeft met wantrouwen jegens de slachtoffers niets te maken, maar beoogt meer recht te doen aan het streven naar objectiviteit in het proces van waarheidsvinding bij zedenzaken.
Antwoord vragen Arib over de aanpak van kindermisbruik en kinderporno via anonieme internetnetwerken

An MP asked the Minister of Security and Justice how police and prosecutors tackle child abuse material distributed over anonymous networks such as Tor, and why they seemed slow to act. The minister answered that the scale cannot be measured, that some websites were taken offline in summer 2011 under judicial authorisation, and that capacity and expertise are being expanded.
Given the anonymity mentioned above, and because not all communication over anonymous networks is structurally monitored, no statements can be made about the number of (Dutch) users.

Gezien de hiervoor genoemde anonimiteit, en omdat niet alle communicatie die via anonieme internetnetwerken wordt gevoerd structureel wordt gemonitord, zijn geen uitspraken te doen over het aantal (Nederlandse) gebruikers
Antwoord vragen Arib over het bericht ‘zorgen over seksueel misbruik in orthodox-protestantse kring’

An MP asked the Minister of Security and Justice about reports of concern over child sexual abuse in orthodox Protestant communities, including whether helpers receive signals and whether research is planned. The minister said Movisie's exploratory study found some helpers received such signals but did not investigate them, that the OM would act on any complaint filed, and pointed to a planned multidisciplinary study on abuse in dependency relationships.
Antwoord vragen Timmermans, Arib en Marcouch over ongeregeldheden in Noord-Marokko

Three PvdA MPs asked the foreign minister about arrests of demonstrators in northern Morocco, including a Dutch-Moroccan man detained for photographing a demonstration, and about Morocco's democratic and human rights reforms. The minister said protesters were detained, that the government should allow peaceful demonstrations, that the man is now free but still faces trial, and that further steps depend on the court outcome.
It is important that the new government shows it takes the modernisation process seriously and allows peaceful demonstrations.
Het is belangrijk dat de nieuwe regering aantoont het moderniseringsproces serieus te nemen en vreedzame demonstraties toestaat.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Arib over een mogelijk verband tussen de sterftepiek in het katholieke jongensinternaat huize St. Joseph in Heel en castraties aldaar

An MP asked the Justice Minister whether the criminal investigation into the high death toll at St. Joseph's boys' home in Heel covers possible castrations and related offences. The minister answered that the OM investigation was limited to the 1952-1954 peak, found no indication of castrations, and will decide on extending the inquiry only after the final report.
The Public Prosecution Service limited its investigation to the peak of deaths in 1952-1954 at Huize St. Joseph in Heel.
Het Openbaar Ministerie heeft het onderzoek gericht op en beperkt tot de piek van sterfgevallen in de jaren 1952–1954 in Huize St. Joseph te Heel.

MPs from six parties asked the health minister about breast implants (PIP), the ASIA syndrome, the AZM autoimmune centre closure, registration, quality standards and liability. The minister said evidence linking implants to autoimmune disease is limited, referred to the pending NIV/NVPC study, and said clinics and insurers will cover aftercare while IGZ monitors, with other matters deferred to a separate letter.
Aftercare is the responsibility of the clinics and hospitals where these prostheses were implanted.
De nazorg is de verantwoordelijkheid van de klinieken en ziekenhuizen, waar deze protheses zijn ingebracht.
Antwoord vragen Arib over het bericht dat slachtoffers van seksueel misbruik binnen katholieke instellingen veel langer moeten wachten op een schadevergoeding dan voorzien

An MP asked the Justice minister about reports that victims of sexual abuse in Catholic institutions face longer waits for compensation than promised, and about the state's oversight and prosecution role in past abuse. The minister said the delay is regretted but reflects careful assessment, that no general conclusion on state oversight can be drawn from the Deetman findings, and that no evidence shows justice authorities knowingly ignored abuse.
I cannot, on the basis of the delay in handling the first compensation requests, give a judgement on the follow-up the Roman Catholic Church gives to the Deetman Commission's recommendations.

Ik kan niet op basis van de vertraging in de afhandeling van de eerste compensatieverzoeken een oordeel geven over de opvolging die de Rooms-Katholieke Kerk geeft aan de aanbevelingen van de Commissie Deetman.
Antwoord vragen Arib over het gebrek aan toezicht op escortbedrijven

MP Arib asks the Minister of Security and Justice about the lack of oversight of escort agencies, including unlicensed firms, advertising, trafficking risks and enforcement capacity. The minister answers that the pending prostitution regulation law will require licences, a national register of refusals and withdrawals, and advertising limits, and that trafficking remains a priority with no exact count of specialised officers.
The national register also includes refusals and withdrawals of municipal licences, including for escort agencies.
In het landelijk register zijn tevens weigeringen en intrekkingen van gemeentelijke vergunningen van onder meer escortbedrijven opgenomen.
Antwoord vragen Arib over gezondheidsproblemen van illegale vrouwen

An MP from the Labour party asked the health minister how to respond to a dissertation showing that undocumented women have serious unmet health needs, including sexual violence, gynaecological problems and limited access to care. The minister replied that Dutch law already provides access to medically necessary care for undocumented people, that GGDs and existing schemes are adequate, and that no special screening, new pilot or targeted approach is needed.
I am of the opinion that the Netherlands complies with these obligations.
Ik ben van mening dat Nederland voldoet aan deze verplichtingen.
Antwoord vragen Arib over het ontduiken van de afspraken in het Convenant Overgewicht

An MP asks the health minister whether Haribo's sponsorship of a children's TV show and a school promotion breach the Convenant Overgewicht advertising rules, and whether sanctions should apply. The minister replies that the convenant has lapsed, the relevant advertising rules are self-regulatory and not breached, and sanctions are not appropriate under the convenant's structure.
The Convenant Overgewicht is no longer current; it was terminated at the end of 2009.
Het Convenant Overgewicht is niet meer actueel; eind 2009 is dit beëindigd.
Antwoord vragen Bouwmeester en Arib over de lobby van de sigarettenindustrie

MPs Bouwmeester and Arib asked the health minister about reported tobacco industry lobbying, WHO guideline compliance, contacts with the industry, and whether smoking is addictive and the industry's economic role matters to policy. The minister said Dutch practice follows the FCTC 5.3 guideline with transparency, referred to earlier overviews of contacts, said there was no prior contact with the industry on recent measures, and stated tobacco policy is not affected by the industry's economic contribution.
The requested overview of contacts between my ministry and the tobacco industry was previously provided in parliamentary questions of 1 December 2011 and 31 January 2012.
Het gevraagde overzicht van contacten tussen mijn ministerie en de tabaksindustrie heb ik eerder verstrekt in Kamervragen van 1 december 2011 en 31 januari 2012.
Antwoord vragen Arib over concentratie van verloskundige zorg

An MP asks the minister about the planned concentration of acute obstetric care from Meppel to Zwolle, the required ambulance adjustments, the role of the College Perinatale Zorg, and national overviews. The minister answers that the hospital decision is not yet final pending accessibility guarantees, lists ongoing consultations and inventories, and promises further reports before the parliamentary debate.
I cannot currently give you an overview of the initiatives to concentrate obstetric care in the Netherlands.
Ik kan u op dit moment geen overzicht geven van de initiatieven tot concentratie van verloskundige zorg in Nederland.
Vragen van het lid Arib (PvdA) aan de ministers van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport en van Veiligheid en Justitie over levensgevaarlijke therapieën voor huilbaby's (ingezonden 20 december 2011).

An MP asks the health and justice ministers about therapists treating crying babies with dangerous manipulations, including whether regulated practitioners must disclose non-regular treatments, how many complaints the inspectorate received, and whether government should ensure parents make informed choices. The minister answers that practitioners must inform patients and distinguish regular from alternative treatments, that the inspectorate received one 2008 report and will be asked to investigate, and that parents' informed choice and their own responsibility are primary, while declining several questions as outside policy responsibility.
I will ask the IGZ to investigate these practices.
Ik zal de IGZ vragen naar deze praktijken onderzoek te doen.
Antwoord vragen Arib over de remmende werking van preventie op de stijging van de zorgkosten en het terughoudende beleid inzake overgewicht

An MP asks the health minister about a study claiming prevention could cut health cost growth and about the government's restrained obesity policy, and asks for a fuller response before a debate. The minister answers that the cost-saving estimates rest on unlikely assumptions, that prevention is not expected to cut costs much, that policy is integrated across ministries, and commits to sending a written reaction before the debate.

Vragen van het lid Arib (PvdA) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over de wijze waarop Nederland zich aan internationale afspraken houdt inzake preventie (ingezonden 20 december 2011).

An MP asks the health minister whether the Netherlands honours its international commitments on chronic disease prevention, including the UN political declaration, the WHO's tobacco stance and the FCTC, and how it will fund prevention. The minister replies that the Netherlands largely follows WHO recommendations, that national policy freedom is retained, and that prevention spending is increased although its cost effects should not be overstated.
Since this cabinet took office, no meeting has yet taken place at ministerial level with the tobacco industry.
Sinds het aantreden van dit kabinet heeft op ministerieel niveau nog geen gesprek met de tabaksindustrie plaatsgevonden.

An MP asks the health minister whether the inspectorate now advises removing PIP breast implants even without a detected rupture, and why the joint IGZ/NVPC advice was tightened, how many women have come forward, and how other countries reimburse explantation and replacement. The minister confirms the joint advice, explains the change as driven by reported symptoms and avoiding constant monitoring, and says the number of women seeking checks is unknown because there is no central registration.
How many women have so far reported is not known. There is no central registration in which institutions keep track of this.
Hoeveel vrouwen zich tot dusver hebben gemeld is niet bekend. Er is geen centrale registratie waarin de instellingen dit bijhouden.
Vragen van het lid Arib (PvdA) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over het bericht dat 30 000 Franse vrouwen van siliconen in borsten afmoeten (ingezonden 23 december 2011).

An MP asked the health minister about reports that 30,000 French women must have PIP silicone breast implants removed, and about Dutch exposure, complaint registration, recall reach, reimbursement and the approval role of regulators. The minister answered that the number of Dutch recipients is unknown, that no cancer cases have been reported to the inspectorate, that recall reach is incomplete due to bankruptcies, and that removal is reimbursed only in limited cases, with the notified body TÜV Rheinland responsible for approval.
There is no central registration in which the institutions keep track of this. Institutions are also not obliged to do so.
Er is geen centrale registratie waarin de instellingen dit bijhouden. Instellingen zijn hiertoe ook niet verplicht.

Vragen van het lid Arib (PvdA) aan de minister van Veiligheid en Justitie over vervolging van de rooms-katholieke kerk vanwege seksueel misbruik en eventuele personele consequenties daarvan (ingezonden 23 december 2011).

An MP asked the Justice Minister whether the Church or its members could be prosecuted for sexual abuse, whether the Deetman commission's files could yield prosecutions, and whether stricter measures such as certificates of conduct or disqualification from office should apply to clergy. The minister answered that the OM can prosecute legal persons but sees no basis to do so for the Church, that the Deetman material offers no further leads, and that certificates of conduct for clergy and new policy on disqualification are left to the churches and existing OM guidelines.
The Public Prosecution Service sees no reason to investigate ex officio which criminal measures could be taken against the Roman Catholic Church as a legal person.
Het Openbaar Ministerie ziet geen aanleiding om ambtshalve te onderzoeken welke strafrechtelijke maatregelen kunnen worden genomen tegen de rooms-katholieke kerk als rechtspersoon.

Vragen van het lid Arib (PvdA) aan de minister van Veiligheid en Justitie en de staatssecretaris van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over de uitzending van Zembla waaruit blijkt dat jeugdzorginstellingen klachten van s

MP Arib asked the Minister of Security and Justice and the State Secretary of Health about a Zembla broadcast alleging that youth care institutions ignored sexual abuse complaints, including whether central coordination is lacking and why children were placed with foster parents later convicted of abuse. The State Secretary answered that the government is working with the sector on agreements such as limiting private providers to subcontracting arrangements, that individual cases are not assessed, and gave figures on reports to the Inspectorate for Youth Care.
I do not assess individual cases.
Ik treed niet in de beoordeling van individuele zaken.

Vragen van het lid Arib (PvdA) aan de ministers van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport en van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap over het bezuinigingsplan van de GGD Midden Nederland en het staken van seksuele voorlichting

An MP asks the health and education ministers about GGD Midden Nederland's plan to cut sexual health education in 500 schools, STI partner tracing and TB/infectious disease control, and whether reduced services will raise STI rates and weaken girls' resilience. Minister Schippers answers that the GGD has withdrawn the cuts, that municipalities must carry out their statutory tasks with IGZ overseeing care quality, and that the government relies on personal responsibility while maintaining prevention policy and monitoring.
For me, it is paramount that municipalities and GGDs carry out all statutory tasks adequately and at a sufficient level.
Voor mij staat voorop dat gemeenten en GGD-en alle wettelijke taken adequaat en op voldoende niveau uitvoeren.

Vragen van het lid Arib (PvdA) aan de ministers van Buitenlandse Zaken en van Veiligheid en Justitie over ondertekening door Nederland van het Verdrag van de Raad van Europa over preventie en bestrijding van geweld tegen

An MP asked the ministers of Foreign Affairs and Justice why the Netherlands had not yet signed the Council of Europe convention on violence against women and domestic violence, and whether it should do so promptly. The government supports the convention in general terms, says it will begin preparing signature and ratification in early 2012, and aims to sign before summer 2012.
Early in 2012 the Netherlands will begin preparing for the signature and ratification of the convention.
Aanvang 2012 zal Nederland een begin maken met de voorbereiding voor de ondertekening en ratificatie van het verdrag.

Vragen van het lid Arib (PvdA) aan de minister en de staatssecretaris van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over zelfmoorden onder Hindoestaanse, Turkse en Marokkaanse meisjes (ingezonden 21 november 2011).

An MP asks the health minister about suicide among Hindustani, Turkish and Moroccan girls and whether mental health services are accessible to them. The minister cites regional Rotterdam and The Hague data showing elevated attempted suicide among Turkish and Hindustani girls, says no national figures exist, and rejects the claim that mental health care is inaccessible to these groups, relying on a 2011 dissertation.
I see no added value in having further research carried out into the exact size of these groups.
Ik zie geen toegevoegde waarde om verder onderzoek te laten verrichten naar de exacte omvang van deze groepen.
Vragen van het lid Arib (PvdA) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over de door het RIVM aangespannen bodemprocedure tegen de huisarts H. Van der L. (ingezonden 1 december 2011).

An MP asks the minister about RIVM's civil lawsuit against a GP who publicly criticised the flu vaccination programme, the costs and proportionality of that lawsuit, alleged conflicts of interest of Prof. Coutinho, and the status of a transparency register for pharma ties. The minister defends the lawsuit as proportionate given the GP's public authority, denies Coutinho's involvement in vaccine-maker-funded projects, and promises the register by Q1 2013 with details to follow by summer 2012.
Mr Van der L. holds a social position that gives his statements such authority in public opinion that a legal procedure to obtain a ruling is, in my view, proportionate to that.

De heer Van der L. vervult een maatschappelijke positie die maakt dat aan zijn uitspraken een zodanig gezag in de publieke opinie wordt toegekend, dat een procedure ten behoeve van een uitspraak voor recht daarmee naar mijn mening in verhouding staat.

Vragen van het lid Arib (PvdA) aan de ministers van Veiligheid en Justitie en van Buitenlandse Zaken over de mogelijke uitnodiging van een omstreden Imam door de As-Soenah moskee (ingezonden 6 december 2011).

An MP asks ministers whether the government will refuse a visa to a controversial imam invited by a Den Haag mosque, whose views on marrying nine-year-old girls are condemned. The minister condemns the views as incompatible with international child-protection treaties, says he will consult the mayor of Den Haag, and says a visa decision will be based on the facts at the time, with refusal possible if warranted.
Are you willing to consult the mayor of The Hague about the role and position of this mosque and to inform the House about it? Yes.
Vraag 5 Bent u bereid in overleg te treden met de burgemeester van Den Haag over de rol en positie van deze moskee en de Kamer hierover te informeren?

Vragen van het lid Arib (PvdA) aan de staatssecretarissen van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport en van Veiligheid en Justitie over een dominee die kindermishandeling vergoelijkt (ingezonden 15 november 2011).

MP Arib asked the state secretaries whether a Katwijk pastor's newsletter, which said children may be physically punished, amounts to inciting child abuse and whether it is criminal. The government replied that it condemns any violence against children, that the Public Prosecution Service judged the statements a non-criminal exhortation to read a book, and that the pastor distanced himself from any call to corporal punishment.
The Public Prosecution Service examined the statements and regards them mainly as a non-criminal exhortation to the members of his congregation to read a book the pastor finds worthwhile.

Het Openbaar Ministerie heeft de uitingen van betrokkene bekeken en ziet deze vooral als een – niet strafbare – aansporing aan de leden van zijn gemeente om een boek te lezen dat betrokkene lezenswaardig vindt.
Vragen van het lid Arib (PvdA) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over de onoorbare praktijken van de IVF-kliniek Geertgen (ingezonden 22 november 2011).

An MP asks the health minister about allegations of improper practices at IVF clinic Geertgen, including anonymous donation and whether the Inspectorate can act. The minister replies that the clinic appears to comply with donor-data rules, the Inspectorate has no signs of misconduct, the clinic's permit application was refused and is under appeal in court, and the minister will consider whether the 'fair reciprocity' donor system fits Dutch law but sees no reason for measures now.
However, there is currently an appeal case because I rejected the licence application of the Geertgen clinic.
Wel is het zo dat er op het moment een beroepszaak loopt, omdat ik de vergunningaanvraag van de Geertgen-kliniek heb afgewezen.

Vragen van de leden Arib en Bouwmeester (beiden PvdA) aan de minister van Veiligheid en Justitie over het bericht dat een veroordeelde pedofiel niet onder toezicht van de reclassering zou staan (ingezonden 2 september 20

Two PvdA MPs asked the Minister of Security and Justice whether the probation service can no longer supervise a convicted paedophile, as reported in the press, and why this would be the case. The answers were given in a letter of 29 November 2011 to Parliament (Kamerstuk 29 270, nr. 62), which the item refers to without reproducing its content.
These questions have been answered in the letter of 29 November 2011 (Parliamentary paper 29 270, no. 62).
Deze vragen zijn beantwoord bij brief van 29 november 2011 (Kamerstuk 29 270, nr. 62 ).
Vragen van het lid Arib (PvdA) aan de minister van Veiligheid en Justitie over de pedoseksueel Sytze van der V. (ingezonden 5 oktober 2011).

An MP asked the Minister of Security and Justice whether a convicted paedophile, Sytze van der V., was being supervised by probation services, whether the reclassering had tried to house him in Eindhoven, and whether the municipality was informed of his possible return. The answer was given by the state secretary by letter of 29 November 2011, which the item references as answering questions 1 to 5.
These questions were answered in a letter of 29 November 2011 (Parliamentary paper 29 270, no. 62).
Deze vragen zijn beantwoord bij brief van 29 november 2011 (Kamerstuk 29 270, nr. 62 ).
Vragen van het lid Arib (PvdA) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over het nut van de griepprik (ingezonden 25 oktober 2011).

An MP asked the health minister whether doubts about the usefulness of the flu vaccine, the evidence base, the expert and industry ties, costs, and the need for new research are justified. The minister defended the Health Council's advice to keep offering flu vaccination to risk groups, citing RCT evidence for some groups and referring to the Council's briefing for the rest, and declined to commission new research.
The declarations of interest of experts involved in flu vaccination are public.
De belangenverklaringen van betrokken deskundigen bij de griepvaccinatie zijn openbaar.

Vragen van het lid Arib (PvdA) aan de minister van Veiligheid en Justitie over het verbieden van een rechtspersoon die zich bezighoudt met pedoseksualiteit en waarvan een bestuurder schuldig is aan kinderporno (ingezonde

An MP asked the Minister of Security and Justice whether statements by a board member of the Stichting Martijn, a pedophilia-advocacy organisation, and a board member's conviction for child pornography could justify prosecution or a ban. The minister answered that such general statements are not punishable under criminal law, that the organisation is continuously monitored by the Public Prosecution Service, and that prosecution will follow if the limits of the law are crossed.
The Public Prosecution Service continues to monitor the association closely.
Het Openbaar Ministerie blijft de vereniging onverminderd nauwlettend in de gaten houden.
Vragen van het lid Arib (PvdA) aan de staatssecretaris van Veiligheid en Justitie over commercieel draagmoederschap in Nederland (ingezonden 12 oktober 2011).

An MP asked the state secretary of Security and Justice about commercial surrogacy in the Netherlands, including the outcome of an expert meeting, legal ambiguity on parentage, the distinction between altruistic and commercial surrogacy, data collection and enforcement. The state secretary answered that the questions are substantive, that he is consulting with two other ministers, and promised a letter to parliament before the Christmas recess.
On the subject of (commercial) surrogacy I am in consultation with the Minister of Health, Welfare and Sport and the Minister of Foreign Affairs.
Over het onderwerp (commer cieel) draagmoederschap ben ik in overleg met de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport en de minister van Buitenlandse Zaken.
Vragen van het lid Arib (PvdA) aan de minister van Veiligheid en Justitie over de aanpak van mensenhandel (ingezonden 4 oktober 2011).

MP Arib asks the Minister of Security and Justice about reports that a Utrecht public health service passed 30 suspected human trafficking cases among prostitutes to police and prosecutors, what was done with them, and whether this shows trafficking remains widespread. The Minister replies that police handled the 18 reports received by its information desk, declines operational details for investigative reasons, says trafficking is a known priority with existing measures, and explains that signalling in other municipalities is done through local cooperation without national registration.
Because of the investigative interest, I cannot go into further detail on which of the 18 reports police and/or the Public Prosecution Service have acted upon or will act upon.
Vanwege het opsporingsbelang kan ik niet verder in detail treden over de vraag in welke van de 18 meldingen actie is of zal worden ondernomen door politie en/of het Openbaar Ministerie.
Vragen van het lid Arib (PvdA) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over bloeddonatie door homoseksuelen (ingezonden 9 september 2011).

An MP asks the health minister about the UK's move to allow gay men to donate blood and whether the Dutch exclusion policy should change. The minister answers that Sanquin will study whether the UK arguments apply in the Netherlands, that safety of recipients is the key concern, and that the policy will be reviewed after that research and the forthcoming Council of Europe resolution.
I have asked Sanquin to conduct research on this and to report on it as soon as possible.
Ik heb Sanquin gevraagd daarnaar onderzoek te doen en zo spoedig mogelijk daarover te rapporteren.

Vragen van de leden Timmermans en Arib (beiden PvdA) aan de minister van Buitenlandse Zaken over een hof in Saudi-Arabië dat een vrouw veroordeeld heeft tot tien zweepslagen omdat ze achter het stuur zat van een auto (in

Two PvdA MPs asked the foreign minister about a Saudi court sentencing a woman to ten lashes for driving, and whether the Netherlands would condemn it in the EU and back the Women2Drive campaign. The minister noted the king pardoned her, said the government raises women's rights bilaterally and in the EU, knows of no similar cases, welcomes the planned women's voting rights, and supports Women2Drive and an EU human rights strategy for Saudi Arabia.
The Dutch government raises it bilaterally and in EU-level talks with the Saudi authorities.
De Nederlandse regering stelt het aan de orde bilateraal en bij gesprekken in EU-verband met de Saudische autoriteiten

Vragen van het lid Arib (PvdA) aan de minister van Veiligheid en Justitie over het onderzoek naar een hoger aantal sterfgevallen in katholieke instellingen voor verstandelijk gehandicapte kinderen (ingezonden 8 september

An MP asks the Minister of Security and Justice about a reported higher number of deaths among children in a Catholic institution (Sint Joseph in Heel), including whether the prosecution or judiciary knew of suspicious deaths earlier and whether that could impair an independent investigation. The minister says a police investigation is ongoing with a public tip line, that others have come forward, that establishing who knew earlier is a study goal, and that it is very unlikely investigators are compromised.
Given the passage of time, I consider it very unlikely that those currently involved in the investigation are in any way hindered in their independence.
Ik acht het – gelet op het tijdsverloop – zeer onwaarschijnlijk dat degenen die thans bij het onderzoek betrokken zijn op enigerlei wijze belemmerd zijn in hun onafhankelijkheid.
Vragen van het lid Arib (PvdA) aan de minister van Veiligheid en Justitie over het bericht dat Nederland mensenhandel in stand houdt (ingezonden 3 oktober 2011).

An MP asks the Minister of Security and Justice whether the Netherlands sustains human trafficking, whether sentences are too low, whether trafficked victims are reported, and what is done to confiscate traffickers' profits and prevent cases like Saban B. The minister rejects the claim, cites international praise and recent increases in maximum sentences, disputes the 40% early-release figure with NRM data, and describes profit confiscation efforts and past measures.
Regarding the sentences for human trafficking, I note that the statutory maximum penalties have been increased in the recent past.
Met betrekking tot de straffen voor mensenhandel merk ik op dat de wettelijk strafmaxima in het recente verleden zijn verhoogd
Vragen van het lid Arib (PvdA) aan de ministers van Veiligheid en Justitie en van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over geld voor misbruik slachtoffers kerk (ingezonden 5 juli 2011).

An MP asked ministers whether state-placed child abuse victims deserve compensation like the Catholic Church's scheme, and whether an independent compensation commission should be set up. The state secretary declined to commit, deferring to the Samson commission's final report due in 2012, while noting the existing Schadefonds Geweldsmisdrijven support and referral to victim aid.
I can only assess the question of financial compensation for victims of sexual abuse once I have all the information needed and sufficient insight into all relevant facts.
Het vraagstuk van financiële compensatie voor slachtoffers van seksueel misbruik kan ik pas beoordelen als ik over alle hiervoor benodigde informatie beschik

Vragen van de leden Dijsselbloem en Arib (beiden PvdA) aan de staatssecretaris van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over de opvang van een pleegkind met een islamitische achtergrond in een christelijk pleeggezin (ingezo

Two Labour MPs asked the state secretary about a Muslim foster child placed in a Christian foster family and whether Bureau Jeugdzorg Limburg failed to act on the baptism. The state secretary said individual cases are not assessed by the ministry, restated the legal duty to respect religious background, and described existing safeguards and recruitment efforts.
I do not assess individual cases.
Ik treed niet in de beoordeling van individuele zaken.
Vragen van de leden Çelik en Arib (beiden PvdA) aan de minister van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap over verbeterde aandacht voor kinderrechten via het onderwijs (ingezonden 1 september 2011).

Two PvdA MPs asked the education minister how children's knowledge of their rights could be improved through schooling, citing EU and NGO reports. The minister answered that schools already address human and children's rights under citizenship requirements, that the inspectorate supervises this, and that further improvement is not excluded, with a Onderwijsraad advisory request pending.
I do not rule out that it could still be better.
Ik sluit niet uit dat het nog beter kan.

Vragen van het lid Arib (PvdA) aan de ministers van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport en van Veiligheid en Justitie over onvoldoende aandacht voor seksuele diversiteit in de aanpak van eergerelateerd geweld (ingezonden 7

An MP asks ministers whether attention to sexual diversity in combating honour-related violence is insufficient, whether it is needed to organise shelter for LGBT victims structurally, and whether an expected rise in violence when youths come out will be addressed. The state secretary acknowledges the issue, says sexual diversity is part of the priority on violence in dependency relationships, refers shelter to existing pilots and promises to raise the topic with the big cities and shelter federation, while deferring structural shelter design to a pending reaction to a commission advisory report.
I will soon meet with the four largest cities and then I will bring this theme further to attention.
Ik spreek binnenkort de vier grote steden en dan zal ik dit thema extra onder de aandacht brengen.
Vragen van het lid Arib (PvdA) aan de minister van Veiligheid en Justitie over het bericht dat een pedoseksueel als vrijwilliger heeft gewerkt op een kinderkamp (ingezonden 14 september 2011).

MP Arib asks the Minister of Security and Justice why a convicted child sex offender could work as a volunteer at a children's camp just after facing trial, and whether a legal requirement for volunteers to present a certificate of conduct (VOG) should be introduced. The state secretary says the organisation never requested a VOG, which would have been refused, rejects a statutory VOG obligation as shifting responsibility to government, and promises a disciplinary college and reference list for the volunteer sector.
I find it absolutely undesirable that convicted paedophiles work with children in a situation of dependence.
Ik vind het absoluut onwenselijk dat veroordeelde pedoseksuelen met kinderen in een afhankelijkheidssituatie werken.
Vragen van het lid Arib (PvdA) aan de minister van Veiligheid en Justitie over het opleggen van preventieve huisverboden aan plegers van huiselijk geweld (ingezonden 29 augustus 2011).

MP Arib asks the Minister of Security and Justice whether he agrees that mayors should impose preventive domestic-violence home bans earlier, and how this squares with earlier answers that such bans are already possible. The minister agrees the ban should be used more preventively, points to the meldcode and a letter to municipalities, and says the tension with the statute will be assessed in the 2014 effect evaluation.
I share the view that the home ban should be imposed earlier and more preventively where possible.
Ik deel de mening dat het huisverbod waar mogelijk eerder, preventiever ingezet moet worden.

Vragen van de leden Timmermans en Arib (beiden PvdA) aan de minister van Buitenlandse Zaken over de arrestatie van een vrouw in Saoedi-Arabië omdat zij achter het stuur van een auto zat (ingezonden 26 mei 2011).

Two MPs asked the Foreign Minister whether he would condemn the arrest in Saudi Arabia of a woman filmed driving, and push for EU action demanding her release. The minister confirmed the arrest, condemned it as an example of structural discrimination against women, said she was released on 30 May, and stated the issue is raised bilaterally and in EU talks with Saudi authorities.
It is a specific matter of concern that is also raised, both bilaterally and in EU talks with the Saudi authorities.
Het is een specifiek onderwerp van zorg dat ook aan de orde wordt gesteld, zowel bilateraal als bij gesprekken in EU-verband met de Saudische autoriteiten.

Vragen van de leden Arib en Timmermans (beiden PvdA) aan de ministers van Veiligheid en Justitie en van Buitenlandse Zaken over het bericht dat het reisverbod voor Filippijnse au pairs wordt omzeild (ingezonden 18 juli 2

Two PvdA MPs asked whether the Netherlands is circumventing the Philippine travel ban on au pairs, letting agencies bring them in and so enabling exploitation, and whether the government would change the law. The minister answered that Dutch admission policy ignores foreign exit bans, that the IND screens and sanctions agencies and refers abuse to police and the Labour Inspectorate, that a WODC study has been commissioned, and that no legal change is planned.
I do not have this data.
Over deze gegevens beschik ik niet.
Vragen van het lid Arib (PvdA) aan de minister van Veiligheid en Justitie over het hoge aantal vrijspraken in zaken tegen (vermeende) loverboys (ingezonden 10 augustus 2011).

MP Arib asks the Minister of Security and Justice about the high acquittal rate in loverboy (pimping of minors through a false relationship) cases, the complexity of article 273f Sr, flawed indictments, and how judges weigh victims' consent. The Minister acknowledges the higher acquittal rate, says the article is complex but sound, points to specialist prosecutors and judicial concentration, declines to judge individual rulings, and commits to no concrete new action.
It is not for me to judge how judges assess individual cases and the decisions they take.
Mij past geen oordeel over de wijze waarop rechters individuele zaken beoordelen en de beslissingen die daarin worden genomen.

Vragen van de leden Arib en Timmermans (beiden PvdA) aan de ministers van Veiligheid en Justitie en van Buitenlandse Zaken over het bericht dat een Nederlandse vrouw onder onmenselijke gevangenisomstandigheden in detenti

MPs Arib and Timmermans asked the ministers of Foreign Affairs and Security and Justice about reports of a seriously ill Dutch woman held in harsh conditions in a Moroccan prison, and whether the Netherlands was doing enough to have her transferred to serve her sentence at home under the prisoner transfer treaty. The minister answered that the embassy visits and advises detainees, that medical care is provided, that Nederland will request transfer if Morocco does not, and that 59 Dutch nationals were detained in Morocco.
As soon as a WOTS request on behalf of the person concerned is received in the Netherlands by the Ministry of Security and Justice, it will be handled with goodwill.
Zodra een WOTS-verzoek ten bate van betrokkene in Nederland door het ministerie van Veiligheid en Justitie wordt ontvangen, zal dit met welwillendheid in behandeling worden genomen.
Vragen van het lid Arib (PvdA) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over de hoge perinatale sterfte in Den Haag (ingezonden 5 juli 2011).

MP Arib asks the health minister about high perinatal mortality among Creole women and in deprived Hague neighbourhoods, and why a two-year pilot is needed before targeted policy. Minister Schippers responds that a 62-municipality analysis produced twelve pilot sites run by ErasmusMC, that she rejects ethnicity-specific measures, and that early midwife visits are the mother's own responsibility.
I find it a worrying fact that infant mortality is so high especially among the lower educated.
Ik vind het een verontrustend gegeven dat de babysterfte vooral bij laagopgeleiden zo hoog is.

Vragen van het lid Arib (PvdA) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over het onderzoek van de IGZ naar de verloskundige zorg tijdens avond-nacht en weekenduren (ingezonden 21 juli 2011).

An MP asks the minister about the IGZ inspectorate's investigation into obstetric care during evenings, nights and weekends, including whether the report will be sent to parliament and whether an overview of complaints on obstetric care can be provided. The minister says the report is finished and will be sent to parliament in mid-September 2011, but a full overview of complaints cannot be provided due to privacy and because the registration system serves inspection purposes, offering aggregated findings instead.
Sending the Chamber an overview of all reports the IGZ has received about obstetric care is not possible.
Het aan de Kamer zenden van een overzicht van alle meldingen die de IGZ heeft ontvangen over verloskundige zorg is niet mogelijk.

Vragen van de leden Dijsselbloem en Arib (beiden PvdA) aan de staatssecretarissen van Veiligheid en Justitie en van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over een Groningse incestpleger (ingezonden 27 juni 2011).

Two MPs from the PvdA asked the state secretaries of Security and Justice and of Health about how a convicted incest offender in Groningen was granted sole parental authority over his children, and whether child-protection checks and post-release supervision should change. The minister answered that sole authority was granted after a court procedure where the mother did not appear and the father withheld his prior convictions, that the Raad voor de Kinderbescherming does not automatically advise in such cases, and that a policy framework for checking criminal histories is being developed, with supervision by reclassering described as adequate.
I am examining how this can be put into practice in the Council's implementation and how much longer than the 24th year of life the child file must be kept.
Ik onderzoek wordt op welke wijze dat in de uitvoeringspraktijk van de Raad zijn beslag kan krijgen en hoeveel langer dan tot het 24 e levensjaar jaar het kinddossier moet worden bewaard.
Vragen van het lid Arib (PvdA) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over een resistente bacterie in het Maasstad Ziekenhuis (ingezonden 6 juni 2011).

An MP asks the health minister about a resistant Klebsiella pneumoniae outbreak at Maasstad Hospital, including patient numbers, timing of reporting to the GGD, earlier ESBL outbreaks, and public risk. The minister answers that the outbreak is a local matter, RIVM findings are expected in September, the Inspectorate has placed the hospital under intensified supervision, and the public faces little risk.
As soon as I have this information, I will send it to the House.
Zodra ik hierover beschik zal ik deze naar de Kamer zenden.

Vragen van de leden Arib (PvdA), Gesthuizen (SP) en Dibi (GroenLinks) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport en de staatssecretaris van Veiligheid en Justitie over nazorg van misbruik in de Rooms-katholiek

MPs Arib, Gesthuizen and Dibi asked the health and justice ministers whether aftercare for victims of sexual abuse in the Catholic Church is sufficient and whether the state should support victim gatherings and urgently provide aftercare before the Samson and Deetman inquiries report. The minister answered that existing arrangements with Slachtofferhulp Nederland and regular mental health care are adequate, that no extra measures are needed now, and that the state has no role in organising victim meetings.
I therefore see no reason at this moment to provide extra assistance and prefer to first await the results of the ongoing investigations.
Ik zie daarom op dit moment geen aanleiding om in extra hulpverlening te voorzien en geef er de voorkeur aan nu eerst de resultaten van de lopende onderzoeken af te wachten.
Vragen van de leden Timmermans en Arib (beiden PvdA) aan de minister van Buitenlandse Zaken over toenemend geweld bij demonstraties in Marokko (ingezonden 7 juni 2011).

Two PvdA MPs asked the Foreign Minister whether the government is aware of escalating violence against 20 February Movement protesters in Morocco, including a death after police action, and whether it will press Morocco and the EU on the right to peaceful protest and on dialogue. The minister acknowledged the reports and a death under investigation by Moroccan authorities, said there is no evidence the movement has turned to violence, stated the EU and diplomats have already raised concerns and will do so again if needed, and noted Morocco's constitutional referendum and expected early elections as the primary route forward.
Should the situation give cause for this again, I will express my serious concern to the Moroccan authorities, directly and via the EU.
Mocht de situatie hiertoe wederom aanleiding geven, dan zal ik bij de Marokkaanse autoriteiten mijn ernstige zorg hierover uitspreken, rechtstreeks en via de EU.
Vragen van het lid Arib (PvdA) aan de minister van Veiligheid en Justitie over het bericht dat slechts de helft van de slachtoffers van mensenhandel aangifte doet (ingezonden 17 juni 2011).

An MP asked the Minister of Security and Justice about reports that only half of human trafficking victims file a complaint, asking about causes, sector and gender differences, protection measures, and shelter for male victims. The minister cited CoMensha figures of about 51-53% filing, said the causes are fear or ties to the perpetrator and hopelessness, saw no need for further research, and said shelter for men is being addressed through pilots and a forthcoming structural decision.
I currently see no reason for further investigation.
Ik zie thans geen reden voor nader onderzoek.
Vragen van het lid Arib (PvdA) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over de invloed van leefstijlinterventies op het terugdringen van babysterfte (ingezonden 16 juni 2011).

An MP asked the health minister about high referral rates of Antillean women to gynaecologists, low awareness of pregnancy risks and folic acid, and the slow rollout of the Rotterdam perinatal mortality plan. The minister answered that awareness work is being pursued through pilots, research and the College Perinatale Zorg, without a national folic acid campaign.
I indeed consider the Perinatal Mortality Action Plan (Ready for a Child) a good example of a solid approach to reducing infant mortality.
Ik vind het Aanvalsplan Perinatale Sterfte ( Klaar voor een Kind ) inderdaad een goed voorbeeld van een gedegen aanpak om de babysterfte terug te dringen.
Vragen van het lid Arib (PvdA) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over het bericht dat tolken bij artsenbezoek niet meer worden vergoed (ingezonden 7 juni 2011).

MP Arib asked the health minister whether scrapping reimbursement for interpreters in healthcare would create barriers for non-Dutch speakers, conflict with patient information and consent rights under the WGBO, and violate field norms. The minister replied that patients are responsible for arranging interpreters, that access to care is not impeded, that the measure does not affect self-determination, and that patients may use an interpreter from their own network or hire a professional at their own cost.
This measure has no consequences for the right of self-determination.
Deze maatregel heeft geen gevolgen voor het zelfbeschikkingsrecht.
Vragen van de leden Omtzigt (CDA), Ten Broeke (VVD) en Arib (PvdA) aan de minister van Buitenlandse Zaken over gevangenschap van de broer van een Armeense oppositiepolitica (ingezonden 19 mei 2011).

Three MPs asked the foreign minister whether the detention of Tigran Postanjyan, brother of an Armenian opposition MP, was meant to pressure his sister, and about his cell conditions and the 2008 violence investigation. The minister answered that he was released on 3 June 2011 under an amnesty, that the government denied any political link (citing alleged corruption), and that the Dutch ambassador monitored the case via contacts and the OSCE.

The Armenian government denied any link between Mr Postanjyan's arrest and his sister's political activities; according to the Armenian government it concerned a criminal investigation into alleged corruption.

De Armeense regering ontkende enig verband tussen de arrestatie van de heer Postanjyan en de politieke activiteiten van zijn zuster; volgens de Armeense regering betrof het een strafrechtelijk onderzoek vanwege vermeende corruptie.

Vragen van de leden Arib en Dikkers (beiden PvdA) aan de ministers van Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid en van Veiligheid en Justitie over het bericht dat wie eerlijk is over hiv een baan kan vergeten (ingezonden 30 mei

MPs Arib and Dikkers asked ministers about reports that job applicants who disclose HIV may be rejected, and about employer attitudes, legal protection, and planned measures. The state secretary acknowledged persistent prejudice, noted the legal ban on HIV-based discrimination and existing complaint routes, and promised to consult social partners and anti-discrimination bureaus and to respond to ILO recommendation 200.
I am examining whether it is possible, within existing frameworks, to give more attention to discrimination on the grounds of HIV.
Ik bezie of het mogelijk is om binnen bestaande kaders meer aandacht te geven aan discriminatie op grond van hiv.
Vragen van het lid Arib (PvdA) aan de minister van Veiligheid en Justitie over het bericht dat Amsterdam meer middelen wil voor de aanpak van mensenhandel (ingezonden 26 mei 2011).

MP Arib asked the Minister of Security and Justice whether Amsterdam's call for more resources against human trafficking is accepted, whether forced prostitution is verifiable, and what tools exist against successors of traffickers. The minister said capacity will be dedicated and the number of criminal networks tackled doubled, that a licence-refusal rule and Woningwet change address successors, and that municipalities need more instruments, but gave no figures on the forced-prostitution share.
Various studies have been carried out over the years into physical or mental coercion of prostitutes.
Er zijn in de loop der jaren verscheidene onderzoeken gedaan naar fysieke of geestelijke dwang bij prostituees.
Vragen van de leden Arib en Kuiken (beiden PvdA) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over toegenomen gebitsverwaarlozing onder peuters en kleuters (ingezonden 23 mei 2011).

MPs Arib and Kuiken asked the health minister about rising tooth decay among toddlers and young children, including reports of 700 children in the Utrecht region under anaesthesia for dental treatment, and whether cuts by municipal health services contributed. The minister called it a worrying trend, stressed parents' primary responsibility, pointed to existing coverage, new dental guidelines and prevention codes, said no waiting-list figures are held, saw no evidence that GGD cuts played a role, and promised further inventories and first results of a study.
I do not have such figures.
Ik beschik niet over dergelijke cijfers.

Vragen van de leden Arib en Spekman (beiden PvdA) aan de ministers van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport en voor Immigratie en Asiel over psychische problemen onder asielzoekers en de vergoeding van antidepressiva (ingez

MPs Arib and Spekman asked the health and immigration ministers about mental health problems among asylum seekers, their care costs, suicide cases, and the 2011 change to antidepressant reimbursement. Minister Leers answered that prevalence is high in past studies, care costs about 18 million euros a year, suicides are registered, and reimbursement criteria were aligned with medical guidelines, while declining to join a proposed working group.
Research into the extent of mental health problems among asylum seekers compared with other groups has not recently been carried out.
Onderzoek naar de mate van psychische problemen bij asielzoekers in vergelijking met andere groepen is recentelijk niet uitgevoerd.

Vragen van het lid Arib (PvdA) aan de staatssecretaris van Economische Zaken, Landbouw en Innovatie en de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over de toenemende besmetting van voedsel met ESBL en het gevaar da

An MP asks the state secretary and health minister why antibiotic use in intensive livestock farming has not been curbed more forcefully despite repeated warnings, and what guarantees exist that reduction targets, veterinarian prescribing and sales separation, and registration will be achieved. The government says it trusts the sectors to meet the 2013 50% reduction target, will take far-reaching measures including decoupling vets' prescribing and sales if targets are missed, and that registration is the responsibility of the sectors overseen by an independent body.

If it turns out that the sectors and the veterinary profession do not adhere to the agreed reduction targets, I will take far-reaching measures, including decoupling the veterinarian and pharmacist functions.

Als blijkt dat de sectoren en de beroepsgroep van dierenartsen zich niet aan de afgesproken reductie-doelstellingen houden, dan zal ik vergaande maatregelen nemen, waaronder het ontkoppelen van de dierenarts- en apothekerfunctie.
Vragen van het lid Arib (PvdA) aan de minister van Veiligheid en Justitie over een mobiel alarmsysteem voor slachtoffers van huiselijk geweld (ingezonden 3 mei 2011).

An MP asks the Minister of Security and Justice about delays before victims of domestic violence and stalking are connected to the AWARE mobile GPS alarm system, and whether waiting times of up to a month are acceptable. The minister says waits are usually one to a few days depending on region, that longer waits are exceptional, and promises to ask the VNG to share good practice and to raise the issue at administrative consultation.
I will ask the chair of the VNG to identify good examples for this transitional period and the emergency procedure already in use by municipalities, and to make them available to its members.

Ik zal de voorzitter van de VNG vragen om goede voorbeelden voor deze overgangsperiode en de spoedprocedure die reeds in gebruik zijn bij gemeenten, te identificeren en beschikbaar te stellen aan haar leden.
Vragen van het lid Arib (PvdA) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over de hogere babysterfte in drie Amsterdamse stadsdelen (ingezonden 10 mei 2011).

MP Arib asked the health minister about higher infant mortality in three Amsterdam districts despite low rates elsewhere in the city, and which risk factors apply and whether targeted local policy is planned. The minister acknowledged the findings, said the risk factors are already covered by existing national policy, and announced a two-year local pilot in six municipalities financed by the ministry.
I agree that infant mortality must also be tackled at local level, with a specific approach per district or municipality.
Ik ben het ermee eens dat babysterfte ook op lokaal niveau moet worden aangepakt, met een specifieke aanpak per stadsdeel of gemeente.
Vragen van het lid Arib (PvdA) aan de minister van Veiligheid en Justitie over het preventief opleggen van huisverboden (ingezonden 13 april 2011).

An MP asked the Minister of Security and Justice whether preventive home bans (imposed before any report of domestic violence) are effective, whether their legal basis is sound, and whether more awareness is needed. The minister answered that the Temporary Domestic Ban Act already allows preventive bans, that the 2010 evaluation found 86% of bans coincided with criminal proceedings, and that remaining questions will be answered in a later written consultation report.
Your remaining questions form part of the written consultation report that the standing committee for Security and Justice submitted to me for answering on 28 March.
Uw overige vragen maken onderdeel uit van het Verslag Schriftelijk Overleg dat de vaste commissie voor Veiligheid en Justitie op 28 maart jl. aan mij ter beantwoording heeft voorgelegd.

Vragen van de leden Arib en Van Dekken (beiden PvdA) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport en de staatssecretaris van Economische Zaken, Landbouw en Innovatie over illegale handel in antibiotica (ingezond

MPs Arib and Van Dekken asked the ministers about illegal trade in antibiotics, its health consequences, the scale of the trade, and why Denmark's separation of prescribing and sales is not adopted. The state secretary answered that risks exist, that the nVWA will intensify inspections, that sector reduction agreements are in place with a threat of decoupling if not met, and listed prior advisory reports.
The scale of the illegal trade in unregistered veterinary medicines is not known.
De omvang van de illegale handel in niet-geregistreerde diergeneesmiddelen is niet bekend.

Vragen van het lid Arib (PvdA) aan de minister van Veiligheid en Justitie over het verbieden van een rechtspersoon die zich bezighoudt met pedoseksualiteit en waarvan een bestuurder schuldig is aan kinderporno (ingezonde

An MP asks the Minister of Security and Justice whether the association Martijn, linked to paedophile advocacy, could be banned after a board member was convicted of child pornography, and how criminal conduct of a board member can be attributed to the association. The minister answers that a legal person can be dissolved by a court under Article 2:20 BW if its activities contravene public order, that a board member's conviction can be relevant if it connects to the association, and explains the Supreme Court criteria for attributing offences to legal persons.
A legal person whose activities or purpose conflict with public order can, on application by the public prosecution service, be declared prohibited and dissolved by the court.
Een rechtspersoon waarvan de werkzaamheid of het doel in strijd is met de openbare orde kan op vordering van het openbaar ministerie door de rechter verboden worden verklaard en worden ontbonden.
Vragen van het lid Arib (PvdA) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over het verband tussen narcolepsie en vaccinatie tegen Mexicaanse griep (ingezonden 21 februari 2011).

An MP asks the health minister about reports linking the Pandemrix pandemic flu vaccine to narcolepsy in children, the role of the adjuvant, the advisory choice and Professor Osterhaus's involvement, and calls for independent inquiry and disclosure of industry ties. The minister acknowledges a possible link in the 4-19 age group abroad, says no Dutch signal has been seen, points to the Gezondheidsraad advice and ongoing EMA/CBG monitoring, and promises a regulation on physician-industry transparency.
I will send the Tweede Kamer the regulation as soon as I have it.
Ik zal de Tweede Kamer de regeling toesturen zodra ik daarover beschik.
Vragen van de leden Arib en Çelik (beiden PvdA) aan de ministers van Veiligheid en Justitie en van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap over seks met de leraar (ingezonden 18 maart 2011).

MPs Arib and Çelik asked the ministers of Justice and of Education about a Brandpunt survey showing sexual relations between teachers and pupils at nearly half of secondary schools, and whether such cases are more common than earlier research showed. The minister answered that the Inspectorate figures and the survey are not comparable, that action must always be taken on suspicion of such relations, and that schools and teachers will be reminded of the statutory reporting duty.
I therefore consider it important that schools and teachers are aware of the statutory reporting duty.
Ik vind het daarom van belang dat scholen en docenten zich bewust zijn van de wettelijke meldplicht.

Vragen van het lid Arib (PvdA) aan de ministers van Veiligheid en Justitie en van Buitenlandse Zaken over een misbruikschandaal dat Nederland in de doofpot zou hebben gestopt (ingezonden 22 april 2011).

An MP asks the Justice and Foreign Affairs ministers whether a senior Dutch diplomat in Jakarta who allegedly sexually abused male Indonesian guards was shielded from prosecution, and whether Dutch law should cover such conduct abroad. The minister answers that the diplomat was dismissed and reported, but the Public Prosecution Service dropped the case because the acts were not all punishable in Indonesia and no formal authority relationship existed; he sees no reason to change the law.
To be able to prosecute in the Netherlands, the facts must be punishable both in Indonesia and in the Netherlands.
Om tot vervolging in Nederland te kunnen overgaan is vereist dat de feiten zowel in Indonesië als in Nederland strafbaar zijn.
Vragen van het lid Arib (PvdA) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over het bericht «Schaf verbod op betalen eicel af» (ingezonden 24 maart 2011).

Arib (PvdA) asked the health minister whether the ban on paying for egg donation should be lifted, given rising fertility treatment abroad and the shortage of eggs in the Netherlands. Minister Schippers opposed paying donors, citing the Council of Europe convention, said reimbursement of costs is allowed, rejected a UK-style independent authority in favour of the Health Council, and said she had no tools to stop women receiving insurance reimbursement for treatment abroad.
I am of the view that the Netherlands should not establish an independent body analogous to the British Human Fertility and Embryology Authority (HFEA).
Ik ben van mening dat er in Nederland niet een onafhankelijke instantie analoog aan de Britse Human Fertility and Embryology Authority (HFEA) moet komen.
Vragen van het lid Arib (PvdA) aan de minister van Veiligheid en Justitie over het in bescherming nemen van een veroordeelde pedofiele priester (ingezonden 11 februari 2011).

An MP asked the Minister of Security and Justice whether Cardinal Simonis protected a convicted paedophile priest, whether prosecution followed, whether church sanctions and the Deetman/Samson inquiries were adequate, and whether certificates of conduct or professional bans should be required. The minister confirmed awareness, said the two complaints were dismissed (one for lack of evidence, one time-barred), said the state cannot be held responsible for church employment matters and that no legal obligation is warranted for now, and declined to comment on the cardinal's statements.
It is not my responsibility to pass judgement on facts and measures in employment situations outside those falling under my direct responsibility as public employer.

Het behoort niet tot mijn verantwoordelijkheid om een oordeel te vellen over feiten en maatregelen in arbeidssituaties buiten die welke onder mijn directe verantwoordelijkheid als overheidswerkgever vallen.
Vragen van het lid Arib (PvdA) aan de minister van Veiligheid en Justitie over extra rechercheurs voor de opsporing van kinderporno (ingezonden 23 februari 2011)

An MP asks the Minister of Security and Justice about reports that child pornography investigations are overwhelming police and whether more specialised detectives are needed, and how this compares with animal-cop capacity. The minister answers that specialised detective capacity is fully used, a national approach with a capacity estimate is being drafted, and that police priorities cover both child pornography and animal abuse.
The police and the Public Prosecution Service are therefore currently drafting a proposal for a national approach to child pornography.
De politie en het OM zijn daarom momenteel een voorstel aan het uitwerken voor een nationale aanpak van kinderpornografie

Vragen van het lid Arib (PvdA) aan de ministers van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport en van Veiligheid en Justitie over het bericht dat de hulpverlening aan pedofielen tekortschiet (ingezonden 25 januari 2011).

An MP asks the health and justice ministers whether preventive treatment for non-offending paedophiles is seriously failing, and what will be done to improve access. The minister says expertise exists in forensic care, that the taboo makes voluntary uptake hard, and promises to stimulate early help via a campaign modelled on Stop it now! and to convene the field.
That means I will ask field parties, for example, to translate the English campaign Stop it now! into Dutch.
Dat betekent dat ik veldpartijen ga vragen om bijvoorbeeld de Engelse campagne Stop it now! naar Nederland te vertalen.

Vragen van het lid Arib (PvdA) aan de ministers van Veiligheid en Justitie en van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties over het mogelijk maken van internationale kinderontvoering door bijschrijving van een kind in e

An MP asks whether a Dutch multilingual birth extract can be obtained without the other parent's consent, allowing a foreign father to register a child in his passport and risking international child abduction. The state secretary confirms that Algerian law allows this without the mother's consent, that Algeria's rules are for Algeria to decide, and refuses to require both parents' consent for the extract, citing the Vienna convention.

No. The current Dutch arrangement for issuing a multilingual birth register extract follows from the Vienna Convention on the issue of multilingual extracts from civil status records, to which the Netherlands is a party.
Nee. De huidige in Nederland geldende regeling van de verstrekking van een meertalig uittreksel uit het geboorteregister vloeit voort uit de Overeenkomst van Wenen

Vragen van het lid Arib (PvdA) aan de ministers van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport, Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties en de staatssecretaris van Veiligheid en Justitie over het niet goed uitvoeren van onderzoe

An MP asks several ministers why the NODO procedure for investigating sudden unexplained deaths of minors is not yet in force and whether this leaves children's deaths unexamined. The government replies that the procedure is not yet mandatory, that since 2010 doctors must consult the municipal coroner, and that alternatives such as rapid-response teams are being studied to reach a decision soon.
The Public Prosecution Service has no figures on the number of investigations ordered by the public prosecutor
Het Openbaar Ministerie heeft geen cijfers over het aantal onderzoeken dat door de officier van justitie wordt gelast
Vragen van het lid Arib (PvdA) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over zoutbeperking in voedsel om grote gezondheidswinst te boeken (ingezonden 3 februari 2011).

An MP asks the health minister about the large health gains from salt reduction in food, questioning the figures cited, why the government does not pursue a salt policy, and whether pansalt should be introduced as in Finland. The minister says the figures are misquoted, that industry salt reduction efforts are ongoing, and that she has no plans to introduce pansalt or commission research on it.
No, I do not have that intention. How producers and suppliers such as hospitality and catering reduce the salt content of their products I leave to them.
Nee, dat voornemen heb ik niet. Hoe producenten en aanbieders zoals horeca en catering het zoutgehalte in hun producten reduceren, laat ik aan hen zelf over.
Vragen van het lid Arib (PvdA) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over incest binnen migrantengemeenschappen (ingezonden 14 december 2010).

MP Arib asks the minister whether incest in migrant communities is a taboo, whether help for victims is adequate, whether a new study like Draijer's is needed, and related questions. The state secretary replies that she knows the issue, points to existing help options, a partnership on sexual violence and planned action on abuse of dependency relations, but declines to commission a new prevalence study.
No. That sexual violence is a considerable and very serious problem is known to me.
Nee. Dat seksueel geweld een aanzienlijk en zeer ernstig probleem is, is mij bekend.
Vragen van het lid Arib (PvdA) aan de minister van Veiligheid en Justitie over mishandeling van zwangere vrouwen (ingezonden 30 december 2010).

An MP asks the Justice Minister about violence against pregnant women, citing Belgian research on partner violence, whether the government knows its prevalence, whether professionals can recognise it, how many offenders are prosecuted, and whether criminal law can be tougher. The minister says the prevalence is 3-8% per international studies, no dedicated study is needed now, a mandatory reporting code for care providers is planned, pregnancy is not registered in police data, and existing sentencing rules already allow account to be taken of the victim being pregnant.
Moreover, registration would be difficult to carry out, since it is not always known – by the police and/or the woman herself – whether the victim is pregnant.
Registratie zou bovendien moeilijk uitvoerbaar zijn, aangezien niet altijd bekend is – bij de politie en/of de vrouw zelf – of het slachtoffer zwanger is.
Vragen van het lid Arib (PvdA) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over babysterfte en de afstand tot een ziekenhuis (ingezonden 27 januari 2011).

An MP asked the health minister about a study linking travel times over 20 minutes to higher neonatal mortality, the Stuurgroep recommendations, concentration of obstetric care, and the College Perinatale Zorg. The minister acknowledged a possible link, said timely referral can mitigate risk, outlined planned hospital action plans and IGZ oversight, and described the College's start-up.
The IGZ will send a letter to hospitals after 1 April 2011 on what it expects of them and how it will test and enforce.
De IGZ gaat na 1 april 2011 een brief aan de ziekenhuizen sturen over wat zij van de ziekenhuizen verwachten en hoe zij gaan toetsen en handhaven.

Vragen van de leden Arib en Klijnsma (beiden PvdA) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over het bericht over euthanasie bij baby's die niet gemeld wordt (ingezonden 7 februari 2011).

MPs Arib and Klijnsma ask the health minister whether euthanasia of babies is under-reported because doctors disagree on unbearable and hopeless suffering, and how many cases are reported, and whether a uniform guideline or palliative sedation priority is needed. The minister answers that the reporting commission cites several causes for under-reporting, that doctors must decide individually, and that the medical profession itself should build consensus and lead on guidelines.
Ultimately it remains up to the individual doctor to assess, within his professional framework, the unbearableness and hopelessness of a newborn's suffering.
Uiteindelijk blijft het aan de individuele arts om met zijn professionele beoordelingskader de ondraaglijkheid enuitzichtloosheid van het lijden van een pasgeborene te beoordelen.
Vragen van het lid Arib (PvdA) aan de minister van Veiligheid en Justitie over misbruik van minderjarige jongens in de prostitutie (ingezonden 8 december 2010).

An MP asks the Minister of Security and Justice why questions on abuse of underage boys in prostitution from September 2009 went unanswered for over a year, and whether authorities recognise the signs, the scale is known, and action is taken. The state secretary says the questions are now answered, that scale data are unavailable, that a registration system is being developed, and that customers can be prosecuted, while acknowledging no specific approach exists yet.
To gain more insight into the scale of youth prostitution, I have also made room in my budget for 2011 for developing a registration system.
Om meer zicht te krijgen op de omvang van jeugdprostitutie heb ik ook voor 2011 ruimte op mijn begroting gemaakt voor de ontwikkeling van een registratiesysteem.

Vragen van het lid Arib (PvdA) aan de staatssecretaris van Veiligheid en Justitie over een uitspraak van de Afdeling bestuursrechtspraak van de Raad van State betreffende adoptie (ingezonden 18 november 2010).

MP Arib asks the state secretary about a Council of State ruling on an adoption case and the Wolfsen amendment allowing exceptions to the age limit for prospective adoptive parents. The secretary declines to discuss the individual case, explains the general procedure and the role of advisory bodies, and says the amendment's 'special circumstances' are not further defined.
These questions concern an individual case on which the court has already ruled.
Deze vragen betreffen een individuele zaak waarover door de rechter al een uitspraak is gedaan.
Vragen van het lid Arib (PvdA) aan de minister van Veiligheid en Justitie over het verbieden van de vereniging Martijn (ingezonden 22 december 2010).

MP Arib asked the Justice Minister about the status of criminal complaints against the pedophile association Martijn, whether it could be banned under civil law, and related questions on forum liability and possible prosecution. The minister replied that the Public Prosecution Service is conducting an internal inventory of legal options (not a criminal investigation), that no grounds for civil dissolution exist yet, and that he sees no reason to use his instruction power for now.

At this moment the Public Prosecution Service (OM) is carrying out an inventory in which all information about (members of) the association Martijn, the investigative possibilities and the legal possibilities for prosecuting the association, its board members or the forum administrator is being examined.

Op dit moment wordt door het Openbaar Ministerie (OM) een inventarisatie uitgevoerd waarbij alle informatie over (leden van) de vereniging Martijn, de opsporingsmogelijkheden en de juridische mogelijkheden van vervolging van de vereniging, zijn bestuursleden of de beheerder van het forum worden bekeken.
Vragen van het lid Arib (PvdA) aan de minister van Veiligheid en Justitie over de aanpak van huiselijk geweld (ingezonden 12 november 2010).

An MP asks the minister about a domestic violence awareness campaign that showed cosmetics for concealing bruises, its effect on helpline use, its cost, the 0900 helpline's cost and limited hours, a reported UN rebuke, the registration of domestic violence deaths, and the timing of a mandatory reporting code bill. The government defends the campaign's shock approach, reports helpline call figures and campaign budgets, promises to investigate 24-hour and free access for the helpline, and says it will send a letter on the reporting code.
The state secretary for VWS will, together with the SHG branches, examine how 24-hour availability in the Netherlands can best be organised for the SHGs.
De staatssecretaris van VWS zal samen met de branches van de SHG's onderzoeken op welke wijze een 24-uursbereikbaarheid in Nederland voor de SHG's het beste kan worden ingericht.
Vragen van het lid Arib (PvdA) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport en de minister van Veiligheid en Justitie over eergerelateerd geweld (ingezonden 17 november 2010).

MP Arib asks the health and justice ministers about protecting victims of honour-related violence, the frequent flight of victims while perpetrators go free, unmet shelter needs, professional competence, case numbers, the Zahir and EVA pilots, and their structural funding. The government answers that victims' protection is the priority, points to prosecution guidelines and a national method, promises a letter on professionals' role, says case numbers cannot be estimated well, reports pilot capacity was expanded, and defers the structural funding question to the De Jong committee's advice.
The study has now been completed. The evaluation and the cabinet's position on the De Jong committee's report will be sent to the House as soon as possible.
Het onderzoek is inmiddels afgerond. De evaluatie en het kabinetsstandpunt op het rapport van de commissie De Jong worden zo spoedig mogelijk naar de Kamer gezonden.
Vragen van het lid Arib (PvdA) aan de minister van Veiligheid en Justitie over achterlating in Pakistan (ingezonden 28 oktober 2010).
