The minister acknowledged the concern, said preventive measures and a reduction of poultry density are being pursued, described the gassing procedure and CO2 supply logistics, and stated that the public health risks are monitored through established surveillance structures.
In doing so we focus, among other things, on accelerating the vaccination process and further strengthening biosecurity with a mandatory biosecurity plan for all poultry farms.
Daarbij zetten wij onder andere in op versnelling van het vaccinatietraject en verdere versterking van de bioveiligheid met een verplicht bioveiligheidsplan voor alle pluimveebedrijven.

Antwoord op vragen van lid Vestering over het handjeklap dat zou hebben plaatsgevonden tussen het ministerie van Infrastructuur en Waterstaat en de fabrikant van een emissiearme stalvloer, om de stalvloer als schoner te

MP Vestering (PvdD) asked the state secretary whether the ministry improperly favoured the manufacturer of the Eco-vloer low-emission stable floor, lowering its emission factor under pressure, and whether ministries shared information on it. The government denies any deal, admits the correction factor was omitted in 2019 and intends to raise the emission factor back to 7 kg, while declining to see the handling as improper.
I intend to adjust the emission factor.
Ik ben voornemens de emissiefactor aan te passen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Vestering over 645.000 geiten in de Nederlandse geitenhouderij

MP Vestering (PvdD) asked the minister about welfare conditions for about 645,000 goats in Dutch farms, including confinement, the culling of kid goats, and whether the minister would weigh animal interests in decisions. Minister Adema answered that animals have intrinsic value under the Wet dieren, described existing rules and NVWA supervision, announced a study on goat housing and kid-rearing obligations from 2023, and committed to weigh animal interests in future decisions.
Yes, under the Wet dieren the government must explicitly weigh the interest of the animal when setting rules and taking decisions based on those rules

Ja, op grond van de Wet dieren dient de overheid bij het stellen van regels bij of krachtens de wet en bij het nemen van op die regels gebaseerde besluiten het belang van het dier expliciet mee te wegen
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Vestering over de toekomst van de eendenhouderij in Nederland

An MP from the Party for the Animals asks the agriculture minister about avian flu outbreaks in duck farming, the welfare and slaughter of ducks, public health risks, and the allocation of nitrogen space to duck farming. The minister acknowledges the outbreaks, says a flu intensification plan is being prepared, and states that slaughter methods are governed by EU rules and that nitrogen space is not reserved for duck farming.
That is why I am working on an intensification plan for avian flu, as also discussed with you during the debate on 13 October.
Daarom werk ik aan een intensiveringsplan voor vogelgriep, zoals ook met u besproken tijdens het debat op 13 oktober jl.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Vestering over hoe we een wereld van verschil kunnen maken voor de ruim 520 miljoen kippen die jaarlijks worden geslacht in de pluimvee-industrie

An MP asked the Minister of Agriculture, Nature and Food Quality how to improve conditions for the over 520 million chickens slaughtered yearly in the Dutch poultry industry, citing cage housing, animal deaths and bird flu culling. The minister acknowledged animal welfare concerns, committed to ending cage housing through EU revision of welfare rules, and pledged to weigh animals' interests in future decisions, without announcing new domestic binding measures.
I think an end must come to that.
Ik vind dat daar een einde aan moet komen.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Vestering over hoe we een wereld van verschil kunnen maken voor de 2,6 miljoen konijnen die jaarlijks worden gefokt, gebruikt en gedood in de Nederlandse konijnenhouderij

An MP asked the Minister of Agriculture, Nature and Food Quality about welfare problems for the roughly 2.6 million rabbits bred and slaughtered yearly in the Dutch rabbit sector, including high mortality, ammonia air, solitary housing of breeding does, and cage conditions. The minister answered that animals have intrinsic value under the Animal Welfare Act, pointed to inspection, a public-private study on young rabbit mortality, a sector plan to move breeding does to group or combi housing by 2030, and EU welfare regulation reform, and committed to weigh animal interests in future decisions.
I believe animals are more than an object or property; they are living beings with their own value, separate from the use value humans assign to them.
Ik vind dat dieren meer zijn dan een object of eigendom, het zijn levende wezens met een eigen waarde, los van de (gebruiks)waarde die de mens er aan toekent.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Vestering over hoe we een wereld van verschil kunnen maken voor de 17,2 miljoen varkens die jaarlijks worden geslacht in de varkenshouderij

An MP from the Party for the Animals asked the Minister of Agriculture, Nature and Food Quality about welfare conditions for pigs in Dutch farming, including tail docking, housing, air quality, daylight and behavioural needs, and what she would do as minister responsible for animal welfare. The minister answered that animals have intrinsic value under the Animal Welfare Act, pointed to existing rules, NVWA enforcement, a review of EU welfare rules, and that she would weigh animal interests in her decisions.

Yes, under the Animal Welfare Act the government must explicitly weigh the interest of the animal when setting rules under that act and when taking decisions based on those rules, without prejudice to other justified interests.

Ja, op grond van de Wet dieren dient de overheid bij het stellen van regels bij of krachtens die wet en bij het nemen van op die regels gebaseerde besluiten het belang van het dier expliciet mee te wegen, onverminderd andere gerechtvaardigde belangen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Vestering over hoe we een wereld van verschil kunnen maken voor de 848.000 schapen in de Nederlandse schapenhouderij

An MP asks the Minister of Agriculture, Nature and Food Quality about the welfare of the roughly 848,000 sheep in Dutch sheep farming, including slaughter of lambs, live exports, heat stress, hormonal breeding and grazing-based schemes. The minister answers that animals may legally be kept for production, outlines existing enforcement by the NVWA, and pledges action on EU animal welfare rules and a sector-wide dierwaardige veehouderij approach.
Last year the Netherlands, together with the so-called Vught group of countries, drew up a position paper as input for the revision of the EU animal welfare regulation.
Nederland heeft vorig jaar samen met de zogenaamde Vughtgroeplanden een position paper opgesteld, als input voor het traject van de herziening van de EU dierenwelzijnsregelgeving.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Vestering over hoe we een wereld van verschil kunnen maken voor de ruim twee miljoen koeien, stieren en kalfjes die jaarlijks worden geslacht in de veehouderij

An MP asked the Minister of Agriculture how the government will improve the welfare of millions of cattle and calves slaughtered yearly in Dutch livestock farming, citing lameness, udder infections, respiratory disease and social behaviour. The minister answered that animals have intrinsic value under the Wet dieren, pointed to sector initiatives, monitoring, pilots and EU welfare revision, and committed to weighing animal interests in future decisions.

Yes, under the Wet dieren the government must explicitly weigh the interest of the animal when setting rules under that law and when taking decisions based on those rules, without prejudice to other justified interests.

Ja, op grond van de Wet dieren dient de overheid bij het stellen van regels bij of krachtens die wet en bij het nemen van op die regels gebaseerde besluiten het belang van het dier expliciet mee te wegen, onverminderd andere gerechtvaardigde belangen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Vestering over de inbeslagname van een varken in de achtertuin van een woonhuis omwille van dierenwelzijn

MP Vestering asks the minister whether the seizure of a pig kept in a small backyard shed reflects poor welfare standards, and why pigs in commercial farming have far lower housing requirements than companion pigs. The minister defends the separate regulatory frameworks, says the LID's assessment is its own call, declines to discuss the ongoing case, and pledges to push for stricter EU welfare standards and a convenant with the sector.
This concerns an ongoing case. No statements can be made about ongoing cases in the interest of the legal proceedings.
Het betreft hier een lopende zaak. Over lopende zaken kunnen geen uitspraken worden gedaan in het kader van het procesbelang.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Vestering over stalbranden

An MP asked the Minister of Agriculture about a barn fire in Assen that killed 28,500 hens, the fire-prevention measures in place, the compartmentalisation of the barn, and progress on fire-safety regulation following the Safety Board report. The minister answered that existing Building Decree rules apply, that the two barns formed one fire compartment, that the fire-safety regulation is still being drafted with a parliamentary submission expected in Q2 2023, and that the Animal Act amendment is not yet signed.
I intend to put the draft general administrative order into procedure at the end of this year.
Ik ben voornemens om de ontwerp algemene maatregel van bestuur eind dit jaar in procedure te brengen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Akerboom en Vestering over het levensbelang van de natuur voor mens, dier en het oplossen van de klimaat- en biodiversiteitscrises

Two Party for the Animals MPs asked the nature minister about the link between biodiversity loss and the climate crisis, Dutch ecological footprint, North Sea role, and the 150,000 hectare nature expansion figure. The minister acknowledged the seriousness of the issues, pointed to existing and forthcoming policy (NBSAP, NPLG, Noordzeeakkoord, food strategy) and gave general commitments without new binding measures.
The cabinet is working on this through, among other things, a substantial reduction of greenhouse gases, accelerating the circular economy and the transition to a nature-inclusive society.
Het kabinet zet daar op in middels onder meer een forse reductie van broeikasgassen, het versnellen van de circulaire economie en de transitie naar een natuurinclusieve samenleving.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Vestering over de ongekende droogte en de rol van de landbouw

An MP asks the minister about irreversible drought damage to nature, water allocation priorities, irrigation bans, groundwater abstraction by farms, and fire risk in dune areas. The minister answers that the water allocation order is applied by water boards and provinces, that regional bans are a decentralised decision, and that groundwater measures are being prepared in regional programmes due in 2023.
Provinces can, through a provincial regulation, establish a priority order for groundwater (article 2.9 Water Act). No province has done so yet.
De provincies kunnen, via een provinciale verordening, een verdringingsreeks voor grondwater instellen (artikel 2.9 Waterwet). Dit heeft nog geen enkele provincie gedaan.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Vestering en Van Esch over de vondst van plastic in veevoer, melk en vlees

MPs Vestering and Van Esch asked the ministers about microplastics found in feed, milk, meat and blood, the health risks, the 0.15% action limit for packaging residues in feed, and enforcement. The minister answered that health risks are not expected but cannot be fully excluded, that research funding is provided, and that the Dutch policy already complies with EU rules.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Vestering en Wassenberg over het wederom sluiten van een gedeelte van het Kroondomein ’t Loo

MPs Vestering and Wassenberg asked why the Kroondomein 't Loo is closed for over three months when the King reportedly hunts only a few hours, and whether the closure and subsidy conform to parliamentary motions and the subsidy conditions. The minister answers that closure is a management choice of the Kroondrager under the constitution, that the subsidy was lawfully granted, and gives detailed subsidy and budget figures while declining to substantively address the hunting claim or the motion.
The cabinet has indicated that for this reason it cannot carry out the motion of member Arissen.
Het kabinet heeft aangegeven om die reden de motie van het lid Arissen niet te kunnen uitvoeren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Vestering over de procedurele verlenging van de werkzame stof glyfosaat

An MP from the Party for the Animals asks whether the Netherlands will vote for a one-year procedural extension of glyphosate's approval before safety assessments are complete, and questions cancer, neurological, water and bee risks, Monsanto lobbying and the precautionary principle. The Minister confirms the Dutch vote, says the extension is needed because the reassessment is delayed by public consultation responses, rejects economic considerations, and answers most questions by citing ongoing EU reassessment and EFSA/ECHA findings, while promising to raise a bee study with EFSA.

I attach importance to all scientific insights, including those reaching a different conclusion, being taken into account, because this makes the weighing of whether to renew approval better possible.

Ik hecht eraan dat alle wetenschappelijke inzichten, ook die tot een andere conclusie komen, worden betrokken, omdat dit de afweging voor het al dan niet hernieuwen van de goedkeuring beter mogelijk maakt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Wassenberg en Vestering over een sneltest voor het detecteren van vogelgriep onder in het wild levende dieren

MPs Wassenberg and Vestering asked whether rapid human flu and COVID tests could detect avian influenza in wild animals, how reliable they are, whether a pilot should be funded, and whether such tests have societal value. The minister answered that these tests are not validated for animals and may give false results, that PCR remains the proper test, and that WBVR will assess available rapid tests, while seeing only limited added value.
The Ministry of Agriculture, Nature and Food Quality has asked Wageningen Bioveterinary Research, the national reference laboratory for avian influenza, to map which rapid tests are on the market.

Het Ministerie van Landbouw, Natuur en Voedselkwaliteit (LNV) heeft Wageningen Bioveterinary Research (WBVR), het nationaal referentielaboratorium voor vogelgriep, gevraagd om in kaart te brengen welke sneltesten er op de markt zijn
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Vestering over de maximale temperatuur bij diertransporten

An MP asked the Minister of Agriculture about maximum temperatures for animal transports after heat stress cases in summer 2022, and referred to EFSA advice setting upper temperature limits per species. The minister answered that EU rules currently lack such limits, that the NVWA is evaluating summer inspections, and that the government is considering a national policy rule based on the EFSA findings, to be communicated to parliament.
That is why I am currently examining the possibilities of applying the EFSA findings in a policy rule, similar to how I drew up the Policy rule for animal transport at high temperatures in 2020.

Daarom bezie ik momenteel de mogelijkheden om de EFSA-uitkomsten toe te passen in een beleidsregel, vergelijkbaar met hoe ik in 2020 de Beleidsregel voor diertransport bij hoge temperaturen heb opgesteld.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Vestering en Van Esch over eendenslachterij Tomassen Duck-To, die al zes jaar miljoenen dieren per jaar slacht zonder geldige vergunning en zonder dat hiertegen wordt opgetreden

MPs Vestering and van Esch ask why the Tomassen Duck-To duck slaughterhouse in Ermelo has operated for six years allegedly without a valid permit and without enforcement, and why three environmental services have not acted. The state secretary answers that Gelderland granted a permit in May 2022, that the municipality and environmental services are enforcing (including a Raad van State ruling on a penalty), and that the Van Aartsen recommendations on VTH enforcement are being implemented via the IBP VTH, though he rejects national supervision of environmental services.
I believe the VTH system must be strengthened as soon as possible.
Ik vind dat het VTH-stelsel zo spoedig mogelijk moet worden versterkt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Raan, Vestering en Teunissen over investeringen in de intensieve veehouderij door ABP

MPs from the Party for the Animals asked the ministers whether ABP's investments in intensive livestock farming conflict with animal welfare, climate and Paris goals, and what the government can do to steer the pension fund. The government replied that the ABP board is independently responsible for investment policy, that the government has no formal control over it, and pointed to existing voluntary IMVB and climate commitments with review later.
The cabinet, as one of the sector employers involved with ABP, has no formal means to steer the implementation of the pension scheme.
Het kabinet heeft, als één van de sectorwerkgevers betrokken bij het ABP, geen formele mogelijkheden ter sturing op de uitvoering van de pensioenregeling.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Raan, Van Esch en Vestering over de mogelijke bouw van huizen ten kosten van waardevolle natuur op Bonaire

MPs from the Party for the Animals asked whether housing construction on Plantage Bolivia on Bonaire, a valuable nature area, can be prevented and how the zoning plan and intent agreement are handled. The minister answered that the island authority is responsible for the zoning plan, that the current zoning protects the area, and that the national government will review any draft plan and can issue a reactive direction if needed.
Once the (draft) plan has been released, it will be assessed by the national government and a response will be given.
Nadat het (voor)ontwerp is vrijgegeven, zal dit door het Rijk worden beoordeeld en zal daarop worden gereageerd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Vestering over het nieuws dat 700 varkens zijn omgekomen nadat een Nederlandse vrachtwagen met 900 varkens is gekanteld op een Duitse snelweg

An MP asked the minister about a Dutch truck carrying 900 piglets that overturned on a German motorway, killing about 700, and about the legality and welfare of such loads in extreme heat. The minister said the transport complied with EU rules, that NVWA supervised loading, and committed to pushing for stricter EU transport rules with other member states, with a Commission proposal expected next year.
Currently this transport complied with the applicable laws and regulations, and the NVWA supervised it prior to departure.
Momenteel geldt dat dit transport voldeed aan de geldende wet- en regelgeving, daar heeft de NVWA voorafgaand aan het vertrek toezicht op gehouden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Vestering over de toename van de export van varkens over lange afstanden en de dreiging van Afrikaanse varkenspest

An MP from the Party for the Animals asks the Minister of Agriculture about the sharp rise in long-distance exports of piglets and fattening pigs to Spain, Italy, Poland and Slovenia, and the risk of African swine fever. The Minister describes the transport conditions, attributes the increase to temporary slaughter capacity problems, and says that stopping such transports requires an EU-wide amendment of the transport regulation rather than unilateral Dutch action.
The Dutch government cannot unilaterally take measures to stop this.
De Nederlandse overheid kan niet eenzijdig maatregelen treffen om dit te stoppen.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Vestering over ‘bronnen waaruit blijkt dat mogelijk ook in Nederland bloed wordt afgenomen van drachtige paarden voor de productie van Pregnant mare serum gonadotrophin (PMSG)’

An MP asked the Minister of Agriculture whether blood is taken from pregnant mares in the Netherlands for PMSG production, after Polish and Romanian authorities named the Netherlands as a supplier, and whether an investigation would follow. The minister answered that no mares are kept for PMSG in the Netherlands, the cited Dutch production site has been out of use since 2015, the NVWA has no signals of illegal practices, no investigation is planned absent signals, and the EU is being pressed to tighten animal welfare rules.
However, should signals come in, I will immediately have an investigation carried out.
Wanneer er echter wel signalen binnenkomen, zal ik daartoe onmiddellijk een onderzoek in laten stellen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Vestering over een hitteplan voor dieren

An MP from the Party for the Animals asked the Minister of Agriculture, Nature and Food Quality what she would do to protect livestock from extreme heat, including transport limits, stocking density, outdoor shelter and waiting times at slaughterhouses. The minister answered that existing rules and NVWA enforcement already apply, that a generic 30-degree transport limit and a 15-minute slaughterhouse waiting limit are not legally feasible yet, and that she will await EFSA advice and facilitate talks with municipalities on shelter.
I will await this advice before making any adjustments to the policy rule.
Ik wacht dit advies af alvorens ik eventuele aanpassingen doorvoer in de beleidsregel.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Vestering en Van Esch over oeverbeschoeiing die behandeld is met een kankerverwekkende stof

MPs Vestering and Van Esch asked about roughly 245 km of riverbank piling in the Noordoostpolder treated with carcinogenic creosote, exceedances of fluoranthene norms, and whether such piling should be banned or replaced by 2027. The minister answered that the fluoranthene norm must be met by 2033, that creosote piling is largely replaced and no structural exceedances are known, and that alternatives are in use, while the water board has not yet decided on replacement.
The water board has not yet taken a decision on this.
Het waterschap heeft hierover nog geen besluit genomen.
Antwoord op vragen van leden Van Esch en Vestering over de recreatieve plannen bij het Henschotermeer

MPs Van Esch and Vestering asked whether a YMCA complex relocating to the Henschotermeer area, within the Natuurnetwerk Nederland, conflicts with nature protection rules, including land use, species protection and a planned climbing forest. The minister confirmed the relocation is in process via a zoning plan revision, said compensation and ecological assessments are still being worked out, and that the municipality and province will assess the plan.
It is known that YMCA is developing plans to relocate to a site near the Henschotermeer. The zoning plan must however be amended for this.
Het is bekend dat YMCA plannen ontwikkelt om te verhuizen naar een locatie nabij het Henschotermeer. Daarvoor moet wel het bestemmingsplan worden aangepast.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Vestering over een veel kleinere zwijnenpopulatie als gevolg van voedselschaarste

An MP asked whether wild boar numbers on the Veluwe have fallen sharply due to food scarcity and whether the minister would impose a national hunting ban during the birthing season, alongside questions on wolf predation and planned culls. The minister answered that boar reproduction naturally follows food supply, that wildlife management has been decentralised to the provinces, and that the minister will not intervene in provincial decisions, referring to provincial bodies for culling figures.
Under the Nature Conservation Act, wildlife management, including management of wild boar, has been decentralised to the provinces.
In de Wet natuurbescherming is het faunabeheer en zo ook het beheer van wilde zwijnen gedecentraliseerd naar de provincies.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Vestering over het toezicht tijdens het Offerfeest

An MP asked the minister whether the government would call for vigilance against illegal unstunned animal slaughter during the Eid al-Adha festival, and about the inspection capacity and staffing for supervision at slaughterhouses. The minister confirmed the NVWA's call, supported reporting illegal slaughter, and gave detailed figures on inspectors and staff deployed across 43 slaughterhouses and the mobile teams.
Because the NVWA does not publicly disclose by name the slaughterhouses that slaughter for the Eid al-Adha festival, the requested figures were not specified further.
Omdat de NVWA de slachthuizen die ten behoeve van het Offerfeest slachten niet met naam naar buiten brengt, zijn de gevraagde cijfers niet nader gespecificeerd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Vestering over de uitblijvende maatregelen om dieren te beschermen tegen stalbranden

An MP from the Party for the Animals asks the minister why measures to protect animals from barn fires have stalled after several fires killed large numbers of animals, and whether a cap on animals per fire compartment and compartmentalisation of technical rooms will be pursued. The minister responds that a fire-compartment cap is to be worked out with other considerations, that compartmentalisation is under study by WUR with a possible shift to tailored measures, and that new rules on compartmentalisation, inspections and electrical checks are being prepared.
I do not believe that with the announced measures the barn fire dossier would be back at square one.
Ik ben niet van mening dat met de aangekondigde maatregelen het stalbrandendossier terug bij af zou zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Vestering over het massaal vergassen van kippen, eenden en kalkoenen vanwege uitbraken van het vogelgriepvirus

An MP from the Party for the Animals asks the Minister of Agriculture about mass gassing of poultry during avian flu outbreaks, including welfare, supervision, compensation and whether gassing should be a last resort. The Minister defends CO2 gassing as the best available method, describes NVWA and welfare commission oversight, gives cost and compensation figures, and says a vaccination pilot and biosecurity are being pursued.
The Animal Diseases Welfare Committee oversees the entire process and can intervene and advise on-site where there is reason to do so.
De Welzijnscommissie Dierziekten ziet toe op het hele proces en kan ter plekke interveniëren en adviseren als daar aanleiding voor is.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Esch en Vestering over de ‘ongekende droogte’

MPs Van Esch and Vestering asked the government about the 2022 drought, groundwater abstraction, illegal wells, enforcement, the water tax and compensation claims. The minister answered most questions substantively, pointing to existing measures, a ongoing review of the water tax, and declining to judge a pending collective claim.
I therefore refrain from giving a judgment on that.
Ik onthoud mij daarom van een oordeel daarover.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Vestering over het afschieten van grote grazers in de Oostvaardersplassen

An MP asks the minister about the culling of large grazers in the Oostvaardersplassen, including whether hunting was disproportionate, whether veterinary reports can be shared, and whether the 2016 covenant with Flevoland should be evaluated. The minister answers that Staatsbosbeheer and the province are responsible, cites cull figures and inspection by the Omgevingsdienst, and declines to reopen the covenant or halt culling.
The outcomes of these inspections are not available at the Ministry of Agriculture, Nature and Food Quality.
Uitkomsten hiervan zijn niet beschikbaar bij het ministerie van Landbouw, Natuur en Voedselkwaliteit.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Vestering over het doden van zwanen op lugubere wijze

An MP asked the Minister for Nature and Nitrogen about reports of swans being killed in a gruesome manner and whether such killings and nest-raiding have increased, and what is being done and evaluated to prevent it. The minister said no animal abuse was found (the swans flew into power lines), that the ministry has no data on rising reports, that police and provinces enforce the rules, and that the policy has not been evaluated.
The Ministry of Agriculture, Nature and Food Quality (LNV) does not have this data.
Het Ministerie van Landbouw, Natuur en Voedselkwaliteit (LNV) beschikt niet over deze gegevens.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Vestering over het nieuwe onderzoek naar gezondheidsrisico’s van landbouwgif

An MP asks the Minister of Agriculture about a new study on health risks of pesticides for farmers and residents, including RIVM findings on respiratory disease, Parkinson's, eye irritation, leukaemia, pesticide residues in homes and urine, and the Health Council's advice on the precautionary principle and stricter approval. The minister confirms the coalition agreement commits to health research, says the RIVM advice is delayed so the research agenda will follow after the summer recess, and says a pesticide phase-out target will be pursued but full phase-out is not foreseen.
This advice has unfortunately been delayed, so I will send this agenda to your House after the summer recess.
Dit advies is helaas vertraagd, waardoor ik uw Kamer deze agenda na het zomerreces zal doen toekomen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Wassenberg en Vestering over het delen van rapporten over de staat van de haas en het konijn met jagers en provincies voordat ze met de Kamer zijn gedeeld

MPs Wassenberg and Vestering asked why the minister shared reports on hare and rabbit conservation status with the hunters' association and provinces before informing parliament, and whether this gave the KNJV an unfair advantage. The minister said the reports were shared in confidence to assess consequences of closing hunting, defended the reports' rigor, confirmed a planned provisional closure of hare hunting in three provinces and rabbit hunting everywhere, and rejected any preferential treatment of the KNJV.
I shared the reports in confidence with the provinces and the Hunters' Association in order to get a clear picture of the consequences of a decision on hunting.
Ik heb de rapporten in vertrouwen gedeeld met de provincies en de Jagersvereniging om een goed beeld te krijgen van de consequenties van een besluit over de jacht.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Wassenberg over de betrokkenheid van de jagersvereniging bij hervorming van de telprotocollen

MPs Vestering and Wassenberg asked the minister about involving hunters in revising game-count protocols, doubts about Sovon/WUR data, and why hunting of hare, rabbit, duck, pheasant and wood pigeon is only partly closed. The minister defended the Sovon/WEnR protocols, said the Waardenburg analysis was not the reason for protocol changes, and announced temporary hunting closures for some species and provinces while stating a broader closure was not warranted.
I consider the motion fulfilled by the letter mentioned above.
Ik beschouw de motie als afgedaan met bovengenoemde brief.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Wassenberg en Vestering over het nieuws dat kalverhouders in de afgelopen maanden veel meer kalfjes hebben geïmporteerd uit Ierland

Two MPs asked the Minister of Agriculture whether the sharp rise in Irish calf imports, involving long transports of very young animals, was acceptable and what steps were being taken. The minister said the transports are concerning, the sector has targets to reduce long transports, and the minister supports a ban on long-distance transport of unweaned calves in the EU transport regulation review while awaiting an EFSA opinion.
My position for the upcoming revision of the European transport regulation is a ban on long-distance transport of unweaned animals, such as young calves but also goat and sheep lambs.

Mijn inzet voor de aanstaande herziening van de Europese transportverordening is een verbod op langeafstandtransporten van ongespeende dieren, zoals jonge kalveren maar ook geiten- en schapenlammeren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Vestering over de toename van landbouwgifcocktails op voedsel en op insecten, waaronder bijen

An MP from the Party for the Animals asked the Minister of Agriculture, Nature and Food Quality about rising pesticide residue cocktails on Dutch food and insects, including bees. The minister disputed the PAN-Nederland findings as based on an unrepresentative sample, stated that cumulative exposure poses no health risk for now, and said a safety factor for pesticide approval is being pursued at EU level without committing to a national maximum on the number of residues.
I cannot confirm that. The NVWA supervises the maximum permitted residue levels (MRLs) on food; the average number of pesticide residues is not part of that.
Dat kan ik niet bevestigen. De NVWA houdt toezicht op de maximaal toegestane residuen (MRL's) op voedsel, het gemiddeld aantal residuen van bestrijdingsmiddelen is daar geen onderdeel van.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Esch en Vestering over de bescherming van het koraal tegen de zandstorting van het Chogogo Dive and Beach Resort op Bonaire

MPs Van Esch and Vestering asked ministers about a sand dumping project by Chogogo resort on Bonaire that allegedly lacked a permit and damaged coral, including a verbal tolerance decision and an unpaid penalty. The government answered that a natural permit was belatedly granted in January 2022 with conditions, that the island authority is responsible for enforcement and collecting the penalty, and that enforcement programmes will be strengthened, though impacts on coral are still unknown.
The public body is responsible for this.
Het openbaar lichaam is hiervoor verantwoordelijk.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Vestering over de registratie van geitenlammetjes

The MP Vestering asked whether the seven-day registration duty for goat kids since 1 November 2020 is enforced and asked for mortality and inspection figures. The Minister confirms the duty, explains that late registrations are flagged but not verifiable for accuracy, reports 319 holdings with late registrations, and promises to answer the mortality questions in April 2022.
Based on the notification of a birth in the I&R system, it is not possible to check the accuracy of the stated birth date.
Op basis van de melding van een geboorte in het I&R-systeem is geen controle mogelijk op de juistheid van de opgegeven geboortedatum.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Esch en Vestering over de verwachte groei van de geitenhouderij in Noord-Brabant

Two MPs from the Party for the Animals asked the minister about expected growth of goat farming in North Brabant, its links to lung infections in nearby residents, and whether national measures are needed. The minister replied that the moratorium blocks new stables and expansions, that the cause of the health risk is still under study, and that provinces hold the power to impose goat stops while the government supports them.
The authority for this lies with the provinces.
De bevoegdheid hiervoor ligt bij de provincies.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Vestering en Wassenberg over het rapport van de Algemene Rekenkamer: ‘waar is de grutto?’

Two MPs from the Party for the Animals asked the minister whether the Court of Audit's finding that meadow bird policy failed, with grutto numbers still declining, justifies that conclusion, and how ANLb subsidies will be kept effective. The minister acknowledged the report, rejected the 'failed policy' conclusion while accepting that results have not yet reversed the decline, and pointed to monitoring and a 2023 ecological evaluation without committing to new structural changes.
I do not share this conclusion.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Vestering en Van Esch over duisternis en stilte

MPs Vestering and Van Esch asked the government about protecting darkness and quiet (light and noise pollution), the number and loss of quiet areas, and hunting in them. The Minister answered that darkness and quiet are recognised as important, that protection relies on existing law and provincial competence, that about 14,000 hectares of land quiet area were lost net, and that no new national rules are planned.
The cabinet is currently not intending to draw up new, additional rules on this, partly because of its caretaker status.
Het kabinet is op dit moment, mede vanwege zijn demissionaire status, niet voornemens hierover nieuwe, aanvullende regels op te stellen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Vestering over de uitbreiding van zeker 360 veehouderijen te midden van de natuurcrisis

An MP asks the minister whether at least 360 livestock farms have been allowed to expand since the 2019 PAS ruling via internal netting despite nature crisis, and whether unreliable technical measures and the 678 million euro reserve make this policy effective. The minister answers that no overview exists of farms actually expanded, that the effectiveness of low-emission stables is under study with results expected in 2022, and that the structural approach and any further policy choices are for the next cabinet.
There is no overview, either with me or with the provinces, of the number of businesses that have actually expanded.
Er is geen overzicht, bij mij en bij provincies, over het aantal bedrijven dat daadwerkelijk is uitgebreid.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Vestering over het plaatsen van honingbijkasten in de nabijheid van natuurgebieden

An MP from the Animal Party asked the minister whether beekeeping near nature areas and Natura 2000 sites, which may compete with wild pollinators, requires policy, permits, passing assessments, buffer zones or a registry. The minister acknowledged competition risks but declined new national policy for now, citing regional responsibility, lack of registration data, and planned research and a registry from 2023.
I am willing to enter into discussion with land-managing organisations and beekeepers' associations on this matter
Ik ben wel bereid om hierover het gesprek aan te gaan met terreinbeherende organisaties en bijenhoudersverenigingen
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Vestering over de sterfte en slacht van geitenlammetjes binnen een week na hun geboorte

An MP asks the Minister of Agriculture about the reported slaughter of goat kids under one week old, the reliability of the I&R registration system, and whether the government will act on a parliamentary motion for a plan against kid mortality. The minister says the data cannot establish the scale or fraud with certainty, points to shared responsibility of slaughterhouses and goat keepers, and promises monitoring and an analysis of 2021 mortality figures by April 2022.
It is not known how many kids in the period mentioned in question 1 were transported for destruction.
Het is niet bekend hoeveel bokjes in de periode zoals genoemd in vraag 1 voor destructie zijn afgevoerd.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Vestering over de vernieuwde toelating van het hormoonverstorende landbouwgif cypermethrin die wordt besproken tijdens de vergadering van het SCoPAFF van 21 en 22 oktober

An MP from the Party for the Animals asks the Minister of Agriculture, Nature and Food Quality why cypermethrin, a pesticide alleged to be hormone-disrupting, is being re-approved, citing independent studies and the stricter 2018 criteria. The Minister answers that current evidence shows no hormone-disrupting properties, that the producer must supply missing data within two years, and that the Ctgb and the Dutch delegation will not change their position.
The publications of Singh et al. (2020) and Wang et al. (2021) will be brought to the attention of the rapporteur Member State Belgium.
De publicaties van Singh et al. (2020) en Wang et al. (2021) zullen onder de aandacht worden gebracht van de rapporterende lidstaat België
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Raan en Vestering over interne analyses en afwegingen aangaande de gaswinning Ternaard en de aanleg van een elektrische stroomkabel onder de Wadden

MPs Van Raan and Vestering asked about internal legal assessments, public consultation, and the Ternaard gas extraction and Wadden cable routing. The minister answered that the internal legal review underlying the draft decisions was shared, that the Landsadvocaat was not consulted beforehand to avoid exposing litigation strategy, and that the cable landing decision is being pursued jointly with other projects.

The government, like any other litigating party, must be able to speak freely with the lawyer representing it in (future) court proceedings, without the risk that advice given in that context becomes public.

De overheid moet, net als elke andere procespartij, vrijelijk kunnen spreken met de advocaat die haar vertegenwoordigt in (toekomstige) rechterlijke procedures, zonder het risico dat adviezen die in dat verband worden gegeven openbaar worden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Vestering en Teunissen over de productie en export van zeer schadelijke landbouwgiffen die in Nederland verboden zijn

MPs Vestering and Teunissen asked whether pesticides banned in the EU but exported from the Netherlands, and residues of them on imported food, should be stopped and whether MRLs should be set at zero. The minister reported about 16,000 tonnes of chemicals exported outside the EU in 2018 and noted that other countries set their own rules, that the Commission plans green diplomacy and to reconsider import tolerances, and that MRLs cannot automatically be set to the detection limit.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Wassenberg en Vestering over de jachtakte van prinses Amalia voor het beheer van het Kroondomein

Two Party for the Animals MPs asked the Minister of Agriculture, Nature and Food Quality whether Princess Amalia obtained a hunting certificate, whether an exception to the minimum age was made, and whether this relates to management of the Crown Estate and a subsidy request. The minister answered that she obtained a hunting diploma (not a hunting licence), that no exception was made, and that there is no link between the diploma, the subsidy request and management of the Crown Estate.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Vestering over het gedogen van ernstig dierenleed door botbreuken, bloedingen en ontwrichtingen bij tientallen miljoenen kuikens per jaar

An MP asked the Minister of Agriculture, Nature and Food Quality why the NVWA stopped enforcing against catching chickens by the legs despite a court ruling and EU transport rules, and about the resulting injuries to tens of millions of chickens. The minister replied that the NVWA is pausing further inspections on catching method pending EFSA advice, that the court ruling was followed, that the method is not animal-friendly, and that enforcement against injuries continues through post-slaughter inspections and dialogue with the sector.
The NVWA's management independently decides on inspections and enforcement.
De IG NVWA neemt eigenstandig besluiten over de inspecties en handhaving.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Vestering over de voordelen en de stimulering van voedselbossen

An MP asks the minister of Agriculture, Nature and Food Quality about the environmental benefits of food forests, their eligibility for CAP subsidies, the Green Deal's outcomes and national ambitions for food forests. The minister answers that food forests can be supported via the GLB basic premium, the eco-scheme and investment subsidies are still being explored, and the Green Deal evaluation and a national network are underway.
I am further exploring how the transition to agroforestry can be facilitated, for example through support for establishment within the NSP.
Ik verken bovendien verder hoe de omschakeling naar agroforestry gefaciliteerd kan worden, bijvoorbeeld via een ondersteuning voor aanleg binnen het NSP.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Vestering over ‘het te laat delen van de SCoPAFF-agenda, waardoor de Kamer dit niet tijdig kan bespreken’

An MP asked why the minister sent her position on the SCoPAFF pesticide votes of 21-22 October 2021 only on the evening of 15 October, after the agenda had been public since 6 October, leaving parliament no time to debate it. The minister answered that the position is sent when the Ctgb advice and interdepartmental coordination are complete, that this was not possible earlier before the autumn recess, and that she will inform parliament before each meeting and aim to do so as early as possible.
I aim to inform your House as transparently and as timely as possible about the SCoPAFF agenda.
1 Antwoord 1 Ik streef ernaar om uw Kamer zo transparant en tijdig mogelijk te informeren over de SCoPAFF agenda.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Vestering over de stapeling van pesticiden tot gifcocktails in ons milieu

An MP asks the Minister of Agriculture about the synergistic toxicity of pesticide mixtures on bees, the stacking of active substances, water contamination and whether bans or quantitative reduction targets will be pursued. The Minister answers that the Ctgb is reviewing the study, that stacking restrictions were introduced for four substances, and that the government will pursue EU-level safety factors and monitoring while promising to report on follow-up.
The Ctgb has submitted the scientific article to the European working group developing the new bee guidance.
Het Ctgb heeft het wetenschappelijke artikel ingebracht in de Europese werkgroep die het nieuwe bijenrichtsnoer ontwikkelt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Vestering over de het nagenoeg gelijkblijvende gebruik van landbouwgif, ondanks beloftes voor een drastische afname

The MP Vestering asks the Minister of Agriculture, Nature and Food Quality why pesticide sales in the Netherlands fell only 1% in 2019 and why the government has not set quantitative targets despite promising a drastic reduction. The minister responds that the Netherlands is not directly comparable to the EU figures, that the trend is downward over 2011-2019, and that quantitative sub-targets are not yet set but will be monitored, with first monitoring results expected in autumn 2022.
Statistics Netherlands conducts a survey every four years to map pesticide use in the agricultural sector. The most recent data are from 2016.
Het CBS voert elke vier jaar een enquête uit om het gebruik van gewasbeschermingsmiddelen in de agrarische sector in beeld te brengen. De meest recente gegevens zijn van het jaar 2016
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Vestering over het misdrijf in Stroe waarbij een beschermde wolf is doodgeschoten

An MP from the Party for the Animals asked the Minister of Agriculture, Nature and Food Quality about the shooting of a protected wolf near Stroe, the ammunition used, the criminal investigation, the penalty gap with Belgium, a reward for the perpetrators, and measures against illegal killing of wolves. The minister answered that the investigation is ongoing and cannot be discussed in detail, pointed to existing penalties and Benelux cooperation, said no reward has yet been considered, and committed to better public information, but declined to add new legislation on firearms.
The type of ammunition and the conclusions drawn from it form part of the ongoing criminal investigation.
Het type munitie en de daaraan verbonden conclusies vormen onderdeel van het lopende strafrechtelijk onderzoek.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Vestering over het afschot van wilde zwijnen

An MP asked the Minister of Agriculture, Nature and Food Quality about record wild boar culls on the Veluwe, including the lack of a national overview of cull figures, permits and population counts, and the government's oversight role. The minister replied that provinces are responsible for hunting oversight and population data, that the government's role is limited to system responsibility and frameworks, and that the matters are for provincial decision-making, though she committed to answering each question.
Oversight of cull figures is a decentralised responsibility of the provinces.
Toezicht op afschotcijfers is een gedecentraliseerde verantwoordelijkheid van provincies.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Esch en Vestering over de vondst van zeehonden met hoogpathogene vogelgriep in Duitsland

MPs Van Esch and Vestering asked the ministers about avian flu (H5N8) found in seals in Germany, its spread to wild animals, monitoring, and protocols for dead wild birds. The minister answered all 14 questions, mostly on substance, noting monitoring and protocols are being developed while rejecting a hunting ban and some measures.
We do not share that view. We do not pursue a policy to combat the disease in wild birds.
Die mening delen wij niet. Wij voeren geen beleid om de ziekte bij wilde vogels te bestrijden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Vestering over het vrijgeven van de juridische analyse van de natuurvergunning voor de gaswinning onder de Waddenzee

An MP asked the Minister whether the Wadden Sea gas extraction permit application by NAM could be refused under existing nature protection law, whether the legal analysis would be released before the objection deadline, and whether the rules should be revised if the permit must be granted. The Minister declined to pre-judge the final decision, pointed to the draft decision and public documents, and said the current law strongly protects Natura 2000 areas.
I will take this objection together with the other submitted objections into account when preparing the final decision on the application for a Wnb permit.
Ik zal deze zienswijze tezamen met de andere ingediende zienswijzen betrekken bij de voorbereiding van het finale besluit op de aanvraag om een Wnb-vergunning
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Vestering over het meerekenen van intensieve landbouwgronden als Natura 2000-gebieden terwijl Nederland bijna wereldkampioen biodiversiteitsverlies is

An MP from the Party for the Animals asks the Minister of Agriculture, Nature and Food Quality why intensively farmed land counts as Natura 2000 protected nature amid high biodiversity loss, and whether goose culling and pesticide use in these areas are consistent with conservation goals. The minister acknowledges the biodiversity problem, reports the area of farmland within Natura 2000 sites, says agricultural use is needed for certain protected species, defers on the pesticide court ruling pending the province's response, and declines to reclassify such land as unrealised nature ambition.
No, these arable fields and grasslands are designated because they have a function within the Natura 2000 area, for example as foraging area.
Nee, deze akkers en weilanden zijn aangewezen omdat ze een functie hebben binnen het Natura 2000-gebied, bijvoorbeeld als foerageergebied.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Esch en Vestering over het vasthouden van water in natuurgebieden om overstromingen te helpen voorkomen

MPs Vestering and Van Esch asked about retaining water in nature areas to help prevent floods, including the role of agriculture, river space, and responsibilities across government tiers. Minister Schouten answered substantively, describing existing policy, river-widening measures and groundwater frameworks, and committing to further letters on climate adaptation for nature later this autumn.
Action lines on climate adaptation for nature will be communicated to you later this autumn.
Actielijnen klimaatadaptatie natuur u later dit najaar wordt geïnformeerd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Vestering over de resten van landbouwgif in ons voedsel

An MP asked the Minister of Agriculture about pesticide residues found in food by EenVandaag, including whether there should be cumulative limits and stricter MRLs given supermarket standards. The minister answered that residues within legal MRLs pose no concern, that cumulative effects are being studied by RIVM and EFSA, and that the EU is considering a safety factor, but declined to lower MRLs structurally.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Vestering over het dodelijke landbouwgif Roundup

An MP from the Party for the Animals asked the minister about glyphosate-based Roundup herbicide, including reports it kills bumblebees, the role of co-formulants, France's withdrawal of 36 products, and Luxembourg's ban. The minister answered that the Ctgb judges the Roundup products safe for bees under use instructions, that co-formulant testing is done at national level, and that Dutch authorities cannot adopt Luxembourg's ban without scientific justification.
The Ctgb expects that the formulation studies with honeybees are representative of bumblebees with respect to the observed effects attributed to formulation adjuvants.
Het Ctgb verwacht dat de formuleringsstudies met honingbijen representatief zijn voor hommels ten aanzien van de geobserveerde effecten die aan formuleringshulpstoffen worden toegeschreven.
Antwoord op vragen van lid Vestering over hittestress bij dieren

MP Vestering asks the minister about heat stress in farm animals, including the failure of voluntary transport and sector protocols, lack of legal rules, slaughterhouse waiting times and mortality reporting. The minister says a plan of action on heat stress is being prepared, motions on 30-degree transport limits and a 15-minute waiting cap are being worked out, and no legal basis yet exists to structurally cut slaughter speed.
I am therefore having research done into how slaughter speed affects risk factors for animal welfare and food safety control and the ability to maintain effective supervision.
Ik laat dan ook onderzoeken hoe de invloed van slachtsnelheid op risicofactoren voor dierenwelzijn en controle op voedselveiligheid en het goed kunnen houden van toezicht, is.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Vestering over de uitblijvende maatregelen tegen stalbranden

An MP asked the agriculture minister why concrete measures against barn fires have not yet followed the Safety Board's March 2021 report, and whether the minister can use the MP's amendment to protect animals. The minister confirmed the MP's reading of the amendment and referred to a separate letter of 8 October on the announced measures rather than setting them out in the answer.
I refer you for the announced measures to the letter to the House 'Aanpak van stalbranden' of 8 October.
Ik verwijs u voor de aangekondigde maatregelen naar de Kamerbrief «Aanpak van stalbranden» van 8 oktober jl.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Vestering over ‘het leed van geitenbokjes en de duizenden geitenlammetjes die illegaal binnen een week naar het slachthuis zijn afgevoerd’

An MP from the Party for the Animals asks the Minister of Agriculture about reports that thousands of very young goat kids were slaughtered or transported illegally within a week of birth, and about registration gaps and mortality. The Minister disputes that the figures prove illegal transport, explains the rules and registration changes, says NVWA oversees compliance, and declines to commit to a new plan but promises a later update.
From 2016 to July 2021, 23 transports of goat kids were inspected. No violations were found during these inspections regarding fitness for transport and the I&R obligation.
Vanaf 2016 tot juli 2021 zijn 23 transporten met geitenlammeren gecontroleerd. Bij deze controles zijn geen overtredingen vastgesteld met betrekking tot de geschiktheid voor vervoer en de I&R-plicht.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid lid Vestering over het bericht 'Gegoochel met stikstof waardoor de natuur achteruitboert’

An MP asks the Minister of Agriculture, Nature and Food Quality whether innovative stable techniques cut nitrogen less than promised, whether low-emission floors pose explosion risks, whether intra-sector offsetting avoids new permits, and how subsidies, PAS-melder legalisation and latent permit space will avoid nature deterioration. The Minister largely acknowledges weaker real-world performance of some techniques, cites ongoing research and existing measures, rejects some claims, and defends the legalisation of PAS-melders and the new Wsn as adequate safeguards.
The Aarhus Convention and Article 6(3) of the Habitats Directive require public participation regarding permits for plans and projects that require an appropriate assessment.

Het Verdrag van Aarhus en artikel 6, lid 3, van de Habitatrichtlijn verplichten tot inspraak ten aanzien van toestemming voor plannen en projecten waarvoor een passende beoordeling moet worden verricht
Antwoord op de vragen van de leden Vestering en Wassenberg over het illegaal vangen van zwanen

Two MPs from the Party for the Animals asked the ministers of Agriculture and Justice about illegal capture of swans, including how many cases occur, how the ban on swan drives is enforced, and the number of reports received. The minister answered that the ministry lacks the data, that provinces and police are responsible for enforcement, and that reports to the NVWA and police are listed, while admitting a late reply on earlier questions.
The Ministry of Agriculture, Nature and Food Quality (LNV) does not have this data.
Het Ministerie van Landbouw, Natuur en Voedselkwaliteit (LNV) beschikt niet over deze gegevens.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Vestering en Van Raan over de dood van een lammergier na botsing met een Nederlandse windmolen

MPs Vestering and Van Raan asked ministers about the death of a lammergier after a collision with a Dutch wind turbine, detection systems, protected-area permits, cumulative effects and subsidies for biodiversity. The ministers answered largely in general terms, saying permits are the responsibility of provinces, that a black-blade pilot is under way, and that a cumulative study and subsidy review are being considered.
Provinces are the competent authority for granting exemptions or waivers for species and permits for Natura 2000.
Provincies zijn bevoegd gezag voor het verlenen van ontheffingen of vrijstellingen voor soorten en vergunningen voor Natura 2000.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Vestering en Wassenberg over stropers

Two PvdD MPs asked the ministers of Agriculture, Nature and Food Quality and of Justice and Security about a poaching network in Limburg, including the methods used, the seizures, detection rates and reports, and the number of animals killed. The minister condemned the practices but declined to share operational details, gave aggregated report and case figures, said animal totals cannot be reliably counted, and did not commit to a new national study.
I cannot share further information with your House, as I cannot go into individual cases or investigative information.
Meer informatie kan ik niet met uw Kamer delen aangezien ik niet in kan gaan op individuele gevallen of opsporingsinformatie.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Wassenberg en Vestering over het bericht 'Tweede Duitse coach weggestuurd uit Tokio na mishandeling paard'

Two MPs from the Party for the Animals asked the ministers whether a German coach's mistreatment of a horse at the Tokyo Olympics constitutes animal abuse, and about whipping, bit use, horse trade fraud, subsidies and a national horse welfare decree. The minister condemned the conduct, said whip use as punishment is not customary and that enforcement follows existing frameworks, but declined a dedicated horse welfare law and deferred answers on several points.
I am of the view that deploying specific, additional legislation on horse welfare does not contribute to better welfare for horses or to accelerating the process.
Ik ben van mening dat het inzetten van specifieke, aanvullende wetgeving voor paardenwelzijn niet bijdraagt aan beter welzijn voor paarden of versnelling van het proces.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Vestering en Teunissen over turf-vrije potgrond

MPs Vestering and Teunissen asked the government about peat extraction for potting soil, its CO2 and biodiversity impacts, import volumes, and bans in other countries. Minister Schouten answered that peat extraction harms peatlands, that RPP certification aims for 100% certified peat by 2025, that England alone plans a sales ban, and that the minister will work toward fully peat-free potting soil for private consumers and study phase-out in the professional sector, reporting before the budget debate.
Yes, I have been called upon by your House through a motion to work toward fully peat-free potting soil for private consumers
Ja, ik ben door uw Kamer per motie opgeroepen toe te werken naar volledig turfvrije potgrond voor particulieren
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Vestering over de aanleg van een wolvenhek in Friesland

An MP from the Party for the Animals asked the minister whether a wolf-proof fence in Friesland, covering the province's border, is compatible with the Habitats Directive, nature networks and the Nature Conservation Act, and whether it should be stopped. The minister answered that only a test fence on one farm exists, no permit or assessment was submitted or carried out, the fence would conflict with nature connectivity, and farmers are responsible for protecting livestock, while not committing to any new action.
No exemption or permit application has been submitted by the initiators to the province of Fryslân.
Er is geen ontheffings- of vergunningsaanvraag door de initiatiefnemers ingediend bij de provincie Fryslân.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Vestering over wilde zwijnen

MP Vestering (PvdD) asks the minister about wild boar culling on the Veluwe, including animal intrinsic value, population counts versus permits, and whether the nulstandsbeleid should be lifted. The minister repeatedly states that faunabeheer is decentralised to the provinces, that the ministry lacks the requested data, and that the data on counts and permits is publicly available.
It is not for me to intervene in the considerations and decisions the province makes in this regard.
Het is niet aan mij om te treden in de afwegingen en besluiten die de provincie hierbij neemt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Vestering over Nederland dat relatief meer bomen kapt dan Brazilië

MP Vestering (PvdD) asked the minister whether Dutch forest felling is relatively greater than Brazil's, whether 3,400 ha of compensation forest is truly 'extra', whether the replanting exemption for Natura 2000 felling should be removed, and how compensation, biodiversity and CO2 accounting are handled. Minister Schouten answered substantively on most points, committing to evaluate the forest chapter of the Wet natuurbescherming and to compensate past felling retroactively, while declining to say how much out-of-network felling was offset inside the Natuurnetwerk and stating the questions could not be answered within the deadline due to summer recess.
I intend to evaluate the chapter 'houtopstanden' in the Nature Conservation Act.
Ik ben voornemens het hoofdstuk «houtopstanden» in de Wet natuurbescherming te evalueren.

Antwoord op op vragen van het lid Vestering over de uitspraak van de rechtbank Noord-Nederland dat voor het gebruik van landbouwgif, ontwatering en beregening rond Natura 2000-gebieden een natuurvergunning nodig is

MP Vestering asked the minister whether a court ruling requires farms using pesticides, drainage or irrigation near Natura 2000 areas to obtain nature permits, and asked about enforcement and health risks. The minister answered that she awaits the province's appeal before interpreting the ruling, pointed to the Habitats Directive permit rule for significant effects, and referred to pesticide reduction programmes and a planned pilot on toxicity pressure.
It is appropriate for me to await the continuation of this concrete legal proceeding before I can arrive at an interpretation of this matter.
Het past mij om het vervolg van deze concrete rechtsgang af te wachten, voordat ik tot een interpretatie van deze kwestie kan komen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Vestering over de afschuwelijke onverdoofde slacht van tienduizenden dieren tijdens het Offerfeest en het toezicht hierop

An MP asked the Minister of Agriculture, Nature and Food Quality about illegal unstunned slaughter of animals during the Feast of Sacrifice (Offerfeest), including enforcement measures, past cases, NVWA inspection capacity and the number of slaughterhouses involved. The minister answered that mobile NVWA teams monitor for illegal slaughter, described past prosecutions and penalties, stated that inspection capacity is deployed on a risk basis, and gave the 2021 inspector numbers and slaughterhouse participation.
Because the NVWA does not publicly name the slaughterhouses that slaughter for the Feast of Sacrifice, the requested figures have not been specified further.
Omdat de NVWA de slachthuizen die ten behoeve van het Offerfeest slachten niet met naam naar buiten brengt, zijn de gevraagde cijfers niet nader gespecificeerd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Vestering over het met spoed opvangen van schapen die zijn aangetroffen bij illegale slachtplaats tijdens het Offerfeest

An MP from the Partij voor de Dieren asked the Minister of Agriculture about the NVWA's discovery of illegal unstunned slaughter of sheep at a Gelderland farm during the Feast of Sacrifice, and why 18 remaining sheep were not seized and moved to a shelter. The Minister answered that the animals were healthy, identified and registered, so there was no legal basis for seizure, that proceedings were drawn up against the farm owner and the buyer, and that the owner decides whether the animals are slaughtered.
There is no legal basis to seize these animals.
Er is geen wettelijke grond om deze dieren in beslag te nemen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Raan en Vestering over de aanleg van een elektriciteitskabel door een kwetsbaar stuk van het Werelderfgoed Waddenzee

MPs Van Raan and Vestering (PvdD) asked the government about routing an offshore electricity cable through the vulnerable Wadden Sea World Heritage area, including Schiermonnikoog, and why the Eemshaven West route was chosen over Eemshaven East. The State Secretary answered that no route decision is final, that a second-phase environmental assessment and further studies will be completed before any irreversible steps, and that the government considers the wider energy transition and future connections in its choice.
In the meantime, I am not taking any irreversible steps.
In de tussentijd neem ik geen onomkeerbare stappen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Raan en Vestering over mogelijke overheidssteun voor Formule 1 races

Two PvdD MPs asked whether the government would rule out financial support for the Dutch Grand Prix at Zandvoort, citing earlier promises, the organiser's request for compensation, and fly-past plans. The state secretary answered that the organiser does not qualify for the event guarantee scheme, that no state financial support was given, and that the fly-past was cancelled.
However, the DGP does not meet the requirements of the event guarantee scheme, because the event was not prohibited by the central government.
De DGP voldoet echter niet aan de eisen van de garantieregeling evenementen, omdat het evenement niet door de rijksoverheid is verboden.
Antwoord op op vragen van het lid Vestering over het betrekken van ook dieren in de nood- en evacuatieplannen voor de overstroomde gebieden in Limburg

An MP from the Party for the Animals asked the Minister of Agriculture, Nature and Food Quality how animals are included in emergency and evacuation plans for flooded areas of Limburg, what measures were taken to evacuate farm and wild animals, and where they were moved. The Minister answered that the Landelijk Crisisplan and a 2014 evacuation guideline assign animal keepers primary responsibility with government facilitation, outlined RVO and sector-organisation support and relaxed registration obligations, and described evacuation locations and rest measures for wild animals.
I am looking together with RVO and NVWA at how this will be implemented.
Ik kijk met RVO en NVWA samen naar de invulling hiervan.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Raan en Vestering over het lage btw-tarief op sierteeltproducten

MPs Van Raan and Vestering asked the government about the reduced 9% VAT rate on ornamental horticulture products, questioning its original justifications, its environmental impact, reliance on migrant labour, and whether it should continue. Minister Schouten answered that the reduced rate remains justified for affordability and sector support, that the sector's pesticide use per hectare has declined, and that a broad evaluation of the reduced rate will take place in 2022.
A broad evaluation of the reduced VAT rate, including ornamental horticulture, will take place in 2022.
Er zal in 2022 een brede evaluatie van het lage btw-tarief, inclusief sierteelt, plaatsvinden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Vestering en Teunissen over laagvliegende vliegtuigen die vogels verstoren tijdens het broedseizoen

MPs Vestering and Teunissen asked whether low-flying military transport aircraft disturb breeding birds and whether this complies with nature protection law, and why military exercises cannot be moved abroad during COVID measures. The State Secretary answers that a 2018 preliminary assessment found military flights above 3,000 ft not disturbing, that low-level flights are conditional on avoiding important breeding areas, and that permit applications for some areas are in preparation, while refusing to halt exercises during the breeding season.
For temporary restricted areas that are regularly used for an exercise, a permit application is being prepared.
Voor tijdelijke gebieden met beperkingen die met regelmaat in gebruik zijn voor een oefening is een vergunningaanvraag in voorbereiding.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Vestering over de meest giftige pesticiden die nog op de Europese markt zijn toegelaten

An MP asked the Minister of Agriculture about pesticides on the EU substitution list that are persistent, bioaccumulative or highly toxic, the use of comparative assessments, and whether the Ctgb considers non-chemical alternatives, including the case of difenoconazole. The Minister answered that 98 substances are currently on the list (26 no longer approved), that 33 comparative assessments have been started with 8 completed without withdrawing any product, that the Ctgb does not disclose ongoing applications, and that the Toekomstvisie gewasbescherming 2030 aims to reduce pesticide use, with a pending EU proposal to simplify comparative assessment.
The Ctgb does not provide information on ongoing applications, because this concerns commercially confidential information.
Het Ctgb verstrekt geen informatie over lopende aanvragen, omdat dit bedrijfsvertrouwelijke informatie betreft.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Vestering over jachtactiviteiten in gebieden waar wolven zijn gevestigd

An MP from the Party for the Animals asks the Minister of Agriculture, Nature and Food Quality whether boar hunting and population management in wolf habitat (Veluwe) comply with EU Habitats Directive protection duties, including disturbance of breeding wolves and damage to wolf dens. The Minister answers that hunting and population management are permitted under approved management plans, that experts see no negative effect on wolves, and that the province is the competent authority for permits and enforcement.
It is then up to the competent authority to enforce and supervise compliance with the conditions attached to the exemption granted under the Nature Conservation Act.

Het is vervolgens aan het bevoegd gezag om te handhaven en toe te zien op de naleving van de voorschriften die aan de ontheffing die op grond van de Wet natuurbescherming wordt verleend zijn verbonden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Vestering over het verhoogde risico op Parkinson door het levenslange gebruik van melkproducten

An MP asked the minister whether lifelong dairy consumption raises Parkinson's risk, whether pesticide residues in feed could explain it, and whether MRLs, neurotoxicity testing and feed standards are adequate. The minister answered that the studies show an association rather than causation, that feed is covered by safety rules and pesticide approval assesses consumer exposure including neurotoxicity, and that the government has asked EFSA and RIVM to screen and improve testing, but did not commit to new MRLs for feed.
Earlier this year I asked the RIVM to carry out an exploration of options to improve the risk assessment for approving active substances in plant protection products with regard to neurotoxicity.

Ik heb begin dit jaar het RIVM gevraagd een verkenning uit te voeren naar de mogelijkheden om de risicobeoordeling bij de goedkeuring van werkzame stoffen in gewasbeschermingsmiddelen te verbeteren met betrekking tot neurotoxiciteit.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Vestering over het verdwijnen van een boom met een kolonie zeldzame vliegende herten op Kroondomein Het Loo

An MP asked the minister about the felling of an oak on Kroondomein Het Loo that hosted a colony of stag beetles, and whether protections were breached and the King should be held to account. The minister answered that the tree was dead, that RVO found no shortcomings, that no permit was needed, and that no compensation or action against the King was required, while noting planned improvements to written management records.
No errors came to light during the inspection.
Bij de inspectie zijn geen fouten aan het licht gekomen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Vestering over 575.000 kippen die in 2020 dood aan kwamen bij het slachthuis

Party MP Vestering asks the Minister of Agriculture, Nature and Food Quality about the roughly 575,000 chickens that arrived dead at slaughterhouses in 2020, including the causes, the absence of an EU norm, and the NVWA's 1% intervention threshold and enforcement record. Minister Schouten answers that DOA figures are falling, that causes are hard to establish and not registered, that the NVWA actively addresses catching injuries and imposed 11 fines and 6 warnings in 2016–2020, and that the threshold has no legal or scientific basis.
In practice it is difficult to establish unambiguously what causes the increased DOA percentage, and who can be held responsible for it.
Het is in de praktijk lastig eenduidig vast te stellen wat de oorzaak van het verhoogde DOA-percentage is, en wie hiervoor verantwoordelijk gesteld kan worden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Wassenberg en Vestering over het 'per ongeluk' kappen van een beschermd bos en het kappen van bomen in het broedseizoen

MPs Wassenberg and Vestering asked the minister about the accidental felling of a protected forest and tree-cutting during the breeding season, including killed squirrels, a badger disturbance permit, and the lack of central oversight of municipal and provincial tree-felling. The minister acknowledged the Nature Conservation Act was breached, referred enforcement to the RUD Utrecht, said central regulation is not the answer but will explore changes with provinces and VNG, and committed to raising the issues with an expert group.
The investigation by the RUD is still ongoing, so the province cannot comment on it in advance of that investigation.
Het onderzoek bij de RUD is nog lopende, waardoor de provincie vooruitlopend op dit onderzoek hier niet op in kan gaan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Vestering over de noodzaak van een drastische vermindering van de stikstofuitstoot en de verwachting dat natuurherstelmaatregelen averechts werken

Parliamentarian Vestering (PvdD) asked the Minister of Agriculture, Nature and Food Quality why nitrogen emissions must fall drastically and whether nature restoration measures may be counterproductive, citing ecologists' warnings and accumulated nitrogen under the PAS. Minister Schouten answered that she sees no sufficient basis yet to tighten the nitrogen targets, that the PAS-related accumulation cannot be quantified because the effects of source measures were never systematically monitored, and that restoration measures are approved and assessed for effectiveness and no funds are reserved for harmful activities.
At the same time, there is currently insufficient basis to say with certainty already that the generic objectives included in the Wsn are insufficient.
Tegelijkertijd is er op dit moment onvoldoende basis om nu al met zekerheid te kunnen zeggen dat de in de Wsn opgenomen generieke doelstellingen onvoldoende zijn
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Vestering over het gedoogbeleid van de NVWA bij wetsovertredingen

MP Vestering (PvdD) asked the Minister of Agriculture about the NVWA tolerating use of the unauthorised tomato virus agent V10 by growers from 2006 to 2020 without enforcement, and whether this shows the NVWA is overburdened and should move to the Ministry of VWS. The Minister answered that she was not aware of the tolerance, will commission an external expert to investigate how it happened, and explained the history of exemptions and authorisation of V10 while defending the NVWA's independence.
I will ask an external expert to answer the questions of how this could have happened and what we can learn from it.
Ik zal een externe deskundige vragen antwoord te geven op de vragen hoe dit heeft kunnen gebeuren en wat we hiervan kunnen leren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Vestering over de schijnoplossing van mestfabrieken voor het mestprobleem

An MP asks the Minister of Agriculture whether manure processing plants are a stopgap for the manure surplus that lets livestock numbers stay unchanged, and whether they are needed at scale under the planned manure policy. The Minister answers that processing adds value to manure, that about 15 percent of phosphate production exceeds domestic capacity and is exported, that the policy contours are still being elaborated, and that a concrete reduction of animal numbers is not committed to.
Processing manure means bringing phosphate outside Dutch agriculture.
Het verwerken van mest, betekent het buiten de Nederlandse landbouw brengen van fosfaat.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Vestering over het onrechtmatig doden van konikpaarden en heckrunderen in de Oostvaardersplassen

An MP asked the minister whether the province of Flevoland unlawfully killed konik horses and Heck cattle in the Oostvaardersplassen, and whether oversight of provincial permits was adequate. The minister replied that the animals are not legally protected species so no permit was needed, that a handhavingsverzoek revealed only a missing authorisation for silenced rifles, and that this was regularised by an opdracht to Staatsbosbeheer, while the Rijk does not systematically check provincial decisions.
The national government does not have the role of systematically checking individual provincial decisions.
Het Rijk heeft niet de rol stelselmatig individuele provinciale besluiten te controleren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Vestering over de 200.000 dieren die vast zaten aan boord van transportschepen door de blokkade van het Suezkanaal

An MP asked the Minister of Agriculture, Nature and Food Quality about roughly 200,000 animals stranded on livestock ships blocked in the Suez Canal, including feed, welfare, veterinary care and reporting of sea transport deaths. The minister answered that only partial information on Romanian and Spanish ships is available, that the Netherlands has no direct role since these shipments did not leave from the Netherlands, and that she advocates an EU-wide ban on long-distance live animal transport to non-EU countries and better reporting.
