No information is shared with a shipping country, such as the Netherlands, when it is found that there is too little feed on board.
Er wordt geen informatie gedeeld met een verzendend land, zoals Nederland, als geconstateerd wordt dat er te weinig voer aan boord is.

m: Motie van de leden  Wolbert en Joldersma over cliënten met een complexe of specifieke begeleidingsbehoefte
Asks the government to promote that VNG model regulation require external expertise for clients with complex care needs.
requests the government to promote that the VNG model regulation include that external expertise is deployed for clients with complex or specific support needs
verzoekt de regering, te bevorderen dat in de modelverordening van de VNG wordt opgenomen dat voor cliënten met een complexe of specifieke begeleidingsbehoefte externe expertise wordt ingezet
Motie van de leden Joldersma en Dille over actief monitoren van de uitgaven van gemeenten
Asks the government to take realised data into account in the municipal budget distribution model and to monitor spending actively.
de uitgaven van gegevens actief worden gemonitord
Motie van het lid Dille c.s. over verstandelijk/meervoudig beperkte kinderen
Motion asking the government to give extra attention to the transition bureau regarding children with intellectual disabilities who need care under different regimes.
requests the government to have the transition bureau pay extra attention to this target group
verzoekt de regering, om het transitiebureau extra aandacht te laten besteden aan deze doelgroep
Motie-Joldersma/Bouwmeester over regelgeving voor gedwongen opname, verlof en doelgroepen voor long care
Motion asks the government to further elaborate regulations on compulsory admission, leave and target groups for long-care forensic measures.
requests the government to further elaborate in regulations compulsory admission, leave and target groups for long care
verzoekt de regering in de regelgeving gedwongen opname, verlof in en doelgroepen voor long care nader uit te werken

Amendement van het lid Joldersma c.s. over de bevoegdheid van de burgemeester om de verkoop van alcoholische drank door een niet-vergunningplichtige detailhandel te verbieden bij overtreding van het l
Removes the requirement that the mayor's power to ban alcohol sales applies only after three violations within twelve months, widening mayoral discretion and allowing general rules by decree.
the words 'three times within a period of 12 months' are deleted
vervalt «in een periode van 12 maanden driemaal»

Amendement van het lid Joldersma c.s. ter vervanging van nr. 23 over de bevoegdheid van de burgemeester om de verkoop van alcoholische drank door een niet-vergunningplichtige detailhandel te verbieden

Replaces the bill's fixed trigger for the mayor's power to bar alcohol sales from a supermarket after age violations with a broader power and allows general administrative rules to set how it is applied.
The mayor may deny the natural or legal person operating a business who has violated article 20(1) the authority to sell low-alcohol drinks from the location.

De burgemeester kan de natuurlijke persoon of de rechtspersoon die een bedrijf exploiteert als bedoeld in artikel 18, tweede lid, of artikel 19, tweede lid, onder a, en die artikel 20, eerste lid, heeft overtreden, de bevoegdheid ontzeggen zwak-alcoholhoudende drank te verkopen
Amendement van de leden Joldersma en Voordewind over het sluiten van drankketen
Allows municipalities by ordinance to set rules on drinking-booth establishments that serve alcohol without a licence to regular visitors.
By municipal ordinance, rules can be set on closing drinking booths.
Bij gemeentelijke verordening kunnen regels worden gesteld over het sluiten van drankketen.
Motie Heerts c.s. over arbeid en onderwijs in detentie
Asks the government to inform the Chamber how education and work in detention can be introduced on a cost-covering basis and what role employers could play.
requests the government to inform the Chamber on how sufficient education and work in detention (cost-covering) can be introduced
verzoekt de regering de Kamer te informeren op welke manier er voldoende onderwijs en arbeid in detentie (kostendekkend) kunnen worden ingevoerd
Motie Jodersma en Teeven over het weren van drugs in penitentiaire inrichtingen
Asks the government to extend the strict drug-exclusion approach to forensic psychiatric centres and youth institutions and to restore drug-free wards for addicted detainees.
requests the government to extend the proposed uniform stricter approach to drugs in penitentiary institutions
verzoekt de regering: – de voorgestelde eenduidige, strengere aanpak van drugs in penitentiaire inrichtingen uit te breiden
Amendement van het lid Joldersma c.s. om de taakstelling voor Slachtofferhulp voor het jaar 2009 ongedaan te maken
Amendment reverses the 2009 budget cut (taakstelling) for Slachtofferhulp Nederland, the victim support organisation, and asks to end the cut in multi-year projections.
This amendment aims to reverse the budget cut for Slachtofferhulp for the year 2009.
Dit amendement wil de taakstelling voor Slachtofferhulp voor het jaar 2009 ongedaan maken.
qa: Antwoord vragen van de leden Joldersma en Çörüz over minderjarigen die zich na alcoholgebruik schuldig maken aan misdrijven en (uitgaans)geweld

Two MPs from the CDA asked the ministers of Health and of Justice about under-16s committing offences and violence after drinking, including how incidents are recorded, whether police should register alcohol use, whether public drunkenness by minors should be punished more harshly, and how higher sentence demands for alcohol-related offences are implemented. Minister Opstelten answered that police registration of alcohol use is being prepared with a bill on testing powers, that public drunkenness by youths is mostly fined already and an objective promille norm is undesirable, and that prosecutors will seek higher sentences once the testing powers take effect.
Before this registration process can be implemented, the police must be given the power to use substance tests.
Alvorens dit registratietraject te implementeren dient de politie de bevoegdheid te krijgen om middelentesten in te zetten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Çörüz en Joldersma over het bericht ‘Verkopers schoonmaakmiddel verdienen fors aan partydrug GHB’

MPs Çörüz and Joldersma (CDA) asked ministers about reports that GBL sellers profit from GHB, including hospital admissions, Netherlands as distribution country, RIVM/CAM purity findings, licensing, denaturation and the FIOD reporting point. Minister Schippers answered that GHB is being moved to list I, GBL purity bans are not desired, prevention will be analysed, and the FIOD reporting point is adequately publicised.
Very soon GHB will be moved from list II to list I of the Opium Act.
Zeer binnenkort zal GHB van lijst II naar lijst I van de Opiumwet worden verplaatst.

Antwoord vragen van de leden Bruins Slot en Joldersma over het bericht dat hulpverleners in de psychiatrie regelmatig slachtoffer worden van geweld veroorzaakt door een patiënt, en daarvan vaak geen aangifte doen of meld

MPs Bruins Slot and Joldersma (CDA) asked the health minister about reports that psychiatric staff are often assaulted by patients and rarely report it to police, and about how to improve reporting, prosecution follow-up, and support. Minister Schippers answered that violence against care workers is unacceptable, pointed to the Actieplan Veilig werken in de zorg, to planned measures including time-outs and new patient-oriented coercion laws, and to annual training support for 100 institutions.
Whatever the background, aggression and violence against care workers is unacceptable.
Wat de achtergrond ook is, agressie en geweld tegen zorgverleners is onacceptabel.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Biskop en Joldersma over een tekort aan stageplekken in het mbo

MPs Biskop and Joldersma asked the ministers about a reported shortage of internship places in vocational education (mbo), particularly in care and welfare, and how the government would stimulate more places. The minister answered that enrolment and placements have risen, cited the Stagefonds funding, and said existing instruments are considered sufficient, without committing to new measures.
At present, according to SBB, the existing instruments of the knowledge centres are sufficient to keep the national supply of internship places and apprenticeships at the desired level.
Op dit moment volstaat volgens de SBB het bestaande instrumentarium van de kenniscentra om het landelijke aanbod van stageplaatsen en leerbanen op peil te houden.
Antwoord vragen Joldersma over het bericht waarin wordt aangegeven dat toevoegingen aan tabak nog altijd geheim zijn

An MP asked the health minister why tobacco ingredient data supplied by industry has not yet been published and when a consumer-friendly publication can be expected. The minister replied that publication is planned in two phases, with the second phase (industry-supplied ingredient data) being prepared with RIVM and expected this year, while citing the need for context and protection of trade secrets.
Because the second phase also involves protecting trade secrets and competitive relations, publication of this information must take place carefully.
Omdat bij de tweede fase ook de bescherming van bedrijfsgeheimen en onderlinge concurrentieverhoudingen een rol spelen, dient openbaarmaking van deze informatie op zorgvuldige wijze plaats te vinden.
Vragen van het lid Joldersma (CDA) aan de minister van Justitie over het uitdelen van gratis joints (ingezonden 21 april 2010).

MP Joldersma (CDA) asked the Justice Minister whether giving free joints to coffeeshop regulars to encourage voting is inappropriate and whether it breaches the AHOJG criteria, and whether coffeeshops can be closed for it. The minister called the practice undesirable, said announcing it breaches the advertising ban and that Maastricht has issued a warning, with an enforcement order for repeat offences.
This warning has since been issued on behalf of the mayor of Maastricht. For further violations, action will be taken by imposing an order subject to a penalty.
Deze waarschuwing is inmiddels namens de burgermeester van Maastricht gegeven. Bij volgende overtredingen zal worden opgetreden door het opleggen van een last onder dwangsom.
Vragen van het lid Joldersma (CDA) aan de minister van Justitie over het bericht dat een ontsnapte tbs’er zijn spaargeld terug eist (ingezonden 18 mei 2010).

Joldersma (CDA) asked the Justice Minister about reports that an escaped tbs-detainee was claiming his savings, and why escape during leave is not a criminal offence and whether the savings could be withheld. The minister answered that leave is essential to rehabilitation, that unauthorised absence already carries consequences, and that the clinic head decides on returning property, while automatic forfeiture of savings is undesirable.
Making unauthorised absence from leave a criminal offence would mean the tbs treatment must be interrupted for the criminal procedure that follows.
Het strafbaar stellen van een onttrekking aan verlof heeft tot gevolg dat de tbs-behandeling ten behoeve van de strafrechtelijke procedure die daarop volgt, moet worden onderbroken.
Vragen van het lid Joldersma (CDA) aan de minister van Justitie over een tbs’er die tijdens verlof een vrouw neerstak. (ingezonden 22 april 2010)

An MP asked the Justice Minister about a tbs patient on humanitarian leave from a Zeeland longstay clinic who stabbed a woman, and whether leave in general should be reconsidered. The minister confirmed the facts, explained the humanitarian purpose of longstay leave reviewed by the Avt, reported that 49 leave permits were suspended pending investigation, and agreed to consult local mayors on restoring calm.
Of the 124 longstay patients of the clinic concerned, the locations in Vught and Zeeland, 49 hold a leave permit.
Van de 124 longstay-patiënten van de betreffende kliniek, de locaties in Vught en in Zeeland beschikken er 49 over een verlofmachtiging.
Vragen van het lid Joldersma (CDA) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over langdurig verblijf van psychiatrische patiënten in de isoleercel (ingezonden 20 april 2010).

An MP asks the health minister about long-term isolation of psychiatric patients, the status of research into reducing seclusion, medical care guarantees for involuntarily admitted patients, strengthening family roles, and suicide prevention with the guideline on assisted suicide requests. The minister says a study by IVA is underway with results expected in June 2010, cites Wet bopz treatment-plan rules, describes planned family advocate reforms in the WvGGZ bill, and refers to professional responsibility and the euthanasia review committee.
The results of this study are expected in early June 2010. The House of Representatives will then be informed of the study results as soon as possible.
De resultaten van dit onderzoek worden begin juni 2010 verwacht. Vervolgens wordt de Tweede Kamer zo spoedig mogelijk geïnformeerd over de resultaten van het onderzoek.

m: Motie van het lid Crijns over fusies van jeugdzorginstellingen alleen laten plaatsvinden na goedkeuring van de NZa
Asks the government to explore making youth care institution mergers subject to prior approval by the NZa based on a youth-care concentration test.
requests the government to explore whether mergers of youth care institutions can only take place after approval by the Netherlands Healthcare Authority
verzoekt de regering te verkennen of fusies van jeugdzorginstellingen alleen kunnen plaatsvinden na goedkeuring van de Nederlandse Zorgautoriteit
Motie van het lid Crijns c.s. over elke twee jaar een rapport opstellen over de verplichte regionale samenwerking
Asks the government to report to the House every two years on how the mandatory regional cooperation in youth care is working.
requests the government to prepare a report every two years after entry into force on the functioning of the mandatory regional cooperation, and to inform the House about it
verzoekt de regering om elke twee jaar na inwerkingtreding een rapport op te stellen over de werking van de verplichte regionale samenwerking, en de Kamer hierover te informeren
Motie van het lid Crijns c.s. over maximaal inzetten op de bestrijding van illegale handel in tabaksproducten
Asks the government to do its utmost to fight illegal trade in tobacco products and to inform the Chamber periodically on progress.
requests the government to do its utmost to combat illegal trade in tobacco products and to periodically inform the Chamber on progress
verzoekt de regering zich maximaal in te zetten om de illegale handel in tabaksproducten te bestrijden, en de Kamer periodiek te informeren over de voortgang
Gewijzigd amendement van het lid Crijns  ter vervanging van nr. 10 over NZT voor oraal gebruik niet verbieden maar gelijkstellen met andere NZT
Removes the ban on oral nicotine pouches without tobacco and instead treats them like related products with sales, advertising and age limits.
Amendement van het lid Crijns over NZT voor oraal gebruik niet verbieden maar gelijkstellen met andere NZT
Amendment removing the ban on oral nicotine products without tobacco and treating them like other nicotine products with sales, advertising and age rules.
With this amendment the submitter aims to lift the ban on oral nicotine products
De indiener beoogt met dit amendement het verbod op NZT voor oraal gebruik op te heffen
Motie van het lid Crijns over stoomsteentjes met en zonder nicotine onder het rookverbod laten vallen
Asks the government to bring steam stones with and without nicotine under the smoking ban.
requests the government to arrange that steam stones, both with and without nicotine, fall under the smoking ban
verzoekt de regering te regelen dat stoomsteentjes, zowel met als zonder nicotine, onder het rookverbod gaan vallen
Motie van het lid Agema c.s. over voorkomen dat de zorg implodeert door een topprioriteit te maken van de vermindering van de regeltijd
Asks the government to make reducing administrative burden in care, through digitalisation, automation and scrapping rules, an absolute top priority.
requests the government to make digitalising, automating and abolishing administrative time through screening national rules an absolute top priority
verzoekt de regering van het digitaliseren, automatiseren en afschaffen (doorlichten wet- en regelgeving vanuit het Rijk) van regeltijd een absolute topprioriteit te maken
qa: Antwoord op vragen van het lid Crijns over het bericht 'Inspectie grijpt in bij instelling pleegmeisje Vlaardingen: ’Risico’s voor veiligheid meer pleegkinderen Enver’'

An MP asked the State Secretary about Inspectorate findings that foster care provider Enver has safety shortcomings (screening, matching, dossier documentation), whether placing children in incompletely screened foster homes violates the Youth Act, how the problems stayed hidden, what immediate measures apply and whether consequences follow if Enver fails the deadline. The State Secretary answered that the IGJ found protocols not sufficiently applied, that the Youth Act permits placement before screening is complete under conditions, that a thematic inspection of all foster care providers is planned for autumn 2025, that Enver must comply by end January 2026 under intensified supervision, and that the IGJ may take administrative measures if needed.
Enver must implement the necessary improvements by the end of January 2026 at the latest.
Enver moet uiterlijk eind januari 2026 de noodzakelijke verbeteringen doorvoeren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Smitskam en Crijns over het bericht ‘Malafide jeugdzorgmedewerkers ronselen jongeren voor criminaliteit: ’Ik heb zelfs een huis opgeblazen''

PVV MPs asked the state secretaries about reports that fraudulent youth care workers recruit young people for crime, asking about oversight, a независимый investigation, victim numbers and reforms. The government acknowledged the seriousness, pointed to planned measures such as a vergewisplicht in the Jeugdwet and a Zorgfraudebrief, but declined a new independent investigation and said it does not register how many children were affected.
Given the measures the parties are taking, I currently see no reason for additional investigation.
Gezien bovenstaande maatregelen die partijen nemen, zie ik op dit moment geen aanleiding voor aanvullend onderzoek.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Crijns over het bericht 'Karremans wil harder optreden tegen ongezond eten'

PVV MP Crijns asked the state secretary for Health about the reported plan to act harder against unhealthy food, questioning whether the Nationaal Preventieakkoord has delivered measurable health gains, whether the approach restricts consumer choice and burdens poorer families, and whether the money would be better spent on lowering VAT on groceries. The state secretary replied that the RIVM modelling shows the agreement reduces smoking, overweight and problem drinking though targets will be missed by 2040, and defended legal measures on child-targeted marketing and supermarket shelf agreements, while rejecting a VAT cut.
That is why I am also working on a coherent prevention approach, the first outlines of which I presented to your House on 8 April.
Daarom werk ik ook aan een samenhangende preventieaanpak waarvan ik uw Kamer 8 april jl. de eerste contouren heb laten zien.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Crijns over de misstanden bij een Limburgse jeugdzorginstelling

An MP (PVV) asked the State Secretary for Health about reported abuses at a Limburg youth care institution, including drug use, coercion, violence, understaffing and the role of the inspectorate IGJ. The State Secretary declined to answer several questions citing ongoing investigations, said the youth was not placed there due to closure of closed youth care, and described past IGJ inspections and a new risk-based inspection.
The IGJ cannot, however, make any statements about this case at this time.
De IGJ kan echter nu geen mededelingen doen over deze casus.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Crijns over het bericht dat de Mutsaersstichting genderzorg beperkt tot Limburg

An MP asked the State Secretary for Health about the Mutsaersstichting limiting gender care to Limburg, and whether this reflects ideological priorities and whether gender care should yield to other youth care. The State Secretary answered that the decision is part of the foundation's continuity plan, that youth outside the region are referred elsewhere, and that the government is working on youth care availability and a transgender care platform while holding that all children with acute needs should receive timely care.
The decision the Mutsaersstichting took is part of its continuity plan.
Het besluit dat de Mutsaersstichting heeft genomen is onderdeel van haar continuïteitsplan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Crijns over het bericht dat een huisarts machteloos staat om hulp te krijgen voor hulpbehoevende jongere

An MP asked the state secretary for health about a GP's report that she could not get help for a vulnerable young patient, and about long youth care waiting lists. The state secretary acknowledged the problems, pointed to the Hervormingsagenda Jeugd, the Integraal Zorgakkoord, a planned youth care bill and regional expert teams, but gave no concrete remedy for this case.
Young people in the most vulnerable situations, who really need help and support, must be able to rely on timely available and appropriate (specialist) youth care.
Jeugdigen in de meest kwetsbare situaties, die hulp- en ondersteuning echt nodig hebben, moeten kunnen rekenen op tijdig beschikbare en passende (specialistische) jeugdhulp.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Crijns over het bericht ‘Nutri-score dreigt fiasco te worden: producenten stappen af van ’onbegrijpelijk’ voedselstoplicht’

An MP from the PVV asked the State Secretary for Health whether the Nutri-Score front-of-pack label is misleading, what it costs, and why cheese scores worse than some biscuits. The State Secretary defended Nutri-Score as a shopping aid within product categories, cited consumer research and a Health Council evaluation, reported a 1.2 million euro campaign, and argued that cheese generally scores D while most biscuits score E.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Crijns over het bericht 'Gevaarlijke Ozempic-handel vraagt om aanpak én preventie'

An MP asks why prescription-only medicines like Ozempic are sold online without a prescription, whether the online trade should be curbed, and whether the IGJ acts forcefully enough with sufficient resources. The minister says illegal online sales are unacceptable, the IGJ works with partners to remove websites and sanctions them, but does not commit to new resources or specific new measures.
The illegal online supply of (illegal) medicines, on the other hand, I find very undesirable.
Het illegale online aanbod van (illegale) geneesmiddelen daarentegen vind ik zeer ongewenst.
Antwoord op vragen van lid Crijns over het bericht 'Gesloten jeugdhulp in Fryslân komt terug: vijf opvangplekken in Drachten'

An MP asked the State Secretary about the reopening of closed youth care in Drachten, Friesland, after past abuses at Woodbrookers, and how abuses would be prevented and why the policy of zero closed placements by 2030 is being bent. The State Secretary answered that a contract for ten closed places was agreed for lack of alternatives, that the Inspectorate will carry out an entry check after six months, and that the goal of zero closed placements by 2030 remains.
The IGJ will carry out an entry check at the new location in Drachten after six months.
De IGJ voert na zes maanden een entreetoets uit op de nieuwe locatie in Drachten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Crijns over het bericht 'Aanbieders jeugdzorg komen niet of nauwelijks meer rond'

An MP asked the state secretary about reports that youth care providers are barely breaking even, their causes, measures to prevent bankruptcies, plans to tackle waiting times and staff shortages, and the rollout of the Hervormingsagenda. The state secretary attributes financial pressure to rising personnel and energy costs and points to the Jeugdautoriteit analysis, a continuity subsidy, and a bill on youth care availability, while noting that tariffs and provider management also play a role.
I cannot currently explain the average profit figure of 0.1% in the youth care sector cited by A-Insights based on the data available to me, and will look into it further.

Ik kan het door A-Insights genoemde percentage van 0,1% gemiddelde winst in de jeugdzorgsector op dit moment niet verklaren op grond van de bij mij aanwezige gegevens en laat hier nog nader naar kijken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Crijns over het bericht 'Instanties waren jaren op de hoogte van misstanden op zorgboerderij Wekerom'

An MP from the PVV asked the State Secretary for Health, Welfare and Sport how authorities could have ignored reports of abuse and exploitation of children at a care farm in Wekerom, including the role of the Leger des Heils as guardian, and what would be done to strengthen supervision of youth care. The State Secretary answered that the Inspectorate (IGJ) is assessing nine signals, that individual cases cannot be discussed for privacy reasons, that an independent investigation is not needed for now, and that the Nederlandse Zorgautoriteit will gain supervisory tasks under a pending bill.
I cannot make statements about individual cases.
Ik kan geen uitspraken doen over individuele casussen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Crijns over het bericht 'Zwaargewond pleegmeisje (10) vertelde op school dat ze werd mishandeld, toch moest ze terug naar huis'

The MP Crijns asks how local authorities, foster care organisations, the school, Veilig Thuis and the police could ignore repeated abuse warnings about a 10-year-old foster child, and what will be done to prevent recurrence and inform biological parents. The State Secretary answers that joint inspectorate research is underway, which must be awaited before conclusions, while pointing to the meldcode, complaint routes for parents, and existing child-listening initiatives.
This investigation is being carried out jointly by the Health and Youth Care Inspectorate (IGJ) and the Inspectorate of Justice and Security (IJV), with involvement of the Inspectorate of Education.
Dit onderzoek gebeurt in gezamenlijkheid door de Inspectie Gezondheidszorg en Jeugd (IGJ) en Inspectie Justitie en Veiligheid (IJV) met betrokkenheid van de Inspectie van het Onderwijs.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Crijns over het bericht 'Vapes van Nederlandse kinderen in lab onderzocht: bomvol gif, lood en te veel nicotine'

An MP from the PVV asked the State Secretary for Health about lab findings that illegal vapes used by Dutch children contain toxins, lead and excess nicotine, and asked what the NVWA is doing against their sale on social media. The State Secretary confirmed enforcement at importers, distributors, shops and online platforms (3.6 million vapes withdrawn, over 1,000 posts removed) and pointed to youth prevention campaigns.
Since January the NVWA has had over 1,000 advertisements and posts offering vapes removed from social media and platforms.
De NVWA heeft sinds januari ruim 1.000 advertenties en posts waarin vapes worden aangeboden van social media en platformen laten verwijderen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Hoeff en Crijns over het bericht 'Zorgen bij kinderombudsman: Steeds meer kinderen gaan niet naar school'

MPs Van der Hoeff and Crijns asked the minister about a report that more children are staying out of school and the implications for the child ombudsman's concerns, including links to youth care waiting lists and the closure of secure youth care. The minister acknowledges the problem, cites causes such as waiting lists, teacher shortages and Long COVID, and lists measures like digital schooling and a truancy bill, without confirming a link to secure youth care closures.
Together with schools, collaborative partnerships, municipalities and care organisations, we are working to ensure that no child stays at home unnecessarily any longer.
Samen met scholen, samenwerkingsverbanden en gemeenten en zorgorganisaties zetten we ons in om ervoor te zorgen dat geen kind meer onnodig thuiszit.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Crijns en Maeijer over het bericht dat 400.000 kinderen nooit buitenspelen

PVV MPs asked the state secretary about a report that 400,000 children never play outside and whether safe play spaces and social safety are declining. The state secretary acknowledged the problem as complex, said data on play spaces is incomplete, and promised a study and further consultation with Jantje Beton, but committed to no binding measures.
The lack of (complete) data overviews makes it difficult to properly investigate, evaluate or monitor policy on and the availability of sports and play spaces in Dutch municipalities.
Het gebrek aan (volledige) data-overzichten maakt het lastig om het beleid over en de beschikbaarheid van sport- en speelplekken in Nederlandse gemeenten goed te onderzoeken, evalueren of monitoren.
Antwoord op vragen van de Kamerleden Vondeling en Crijns over het bericht dat uithuisplaatsingen van kinderen stilzwijgend worden verlengd

MPs Vondeling and Crijns asked whether child out-of-home placements and supervision orders are extended without a court hearing via the 'meldbrief' procedure, and whether this is extra-legal. The minister acknowledged roughly 4,000 yearly extensions decided without a hearing (under 30%), said the meldbrief procedure is problematic, and promised the LOVF is seeking an alternative, while maintaining the judge decides whether to hold a hearing.
The National Consultation on Family and Youth Law has indicated, in consultation with my ministry, that it gives high priority to finding an alternative to the current meldbrief procedure.

Het Landelijk Overleg Vakinhoud Familie- en jeugdrecht (LOVF) heeft in overleg met mijn ministerie aangegeven hoge prioriteit te geven aan het zoeken naar een alternatief voor de huidige procedure met de meldbrief.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Crijns over het bericht dat eén op de vijf jongeren slachtoffer is van huiselijk geweld, geen toename door Corona

An MP from the PVV asked the State Secretary for Health, Welfare and Sport about reports that one in five young people has been a victim of domestic violence, the long waiting times at Veilig Thuis, and how many perpetrators are removed from the home. The State Secretary answered with prevalence figures, a list of prevention initiatives (meldcode, campaigns, guidelines, integrated approach), regional figures on temporary home bans, and an explanation of the causes of Veilig Thuis waiting times.
Statistics Netherlands (CBS) publishes half-yearly figures on the approach to domestic violence and child abuse, including the number of temporary home bans requested and imposed.

Het Centraal Bureau voor de Statistiek (CBS) publiceert halfjaarlijks cijfers over de aanpak van huiselijk geweld en kindermishandeling, waaronder het aantal aangevraagde en opgelegde tijdelijke huisverboden.

m: Motie van het lid Synhaeve over in gesprek gaan met onder andere het Nederlands Jeugdinstituut om de effectiviteit van methodes voor mentale weerbaarheid van jongeren te laten vaststellen

Asks government to consult the Nederlands Jeugdinstituut and other knowledge organisations on the effectiveness of mental resilience methods for youth and inform schools, including on methods proven not to work.
requests the government to enter into discussion with the Nederlands Jeugdinstituut and other relevant knowledge organisations
verzoekt de regering in gesprek te gaan met het Nederlands Jeugdinstituut en andere relevante kennisorganisaties
Motie van het lid Synhaeve over kleinschalige intensieve jeugdzorg op landelijk niveau inkopen
Asks the government to purchase small-scale intensive youth care nationally so that supply covers the whole country with strict quality procurement.
to purchase small-scale intensive youth care at national level
kleinschalige intensieve jeugdzorg op landelijk niveau in te kopen
Motie van het lid Synhaeve over onderzoeken of er draagvlak is voor een pilot voor rechtepadpleegzorg
Asks the government to investigate whether there is support for a pilot of foster care for young offenders, with support for foster parents.
requests the government to investigate whether there is support for setting up a pilot of rechtepadpleegzorg
verzoekt de regering te onderzoeken of er draagvlak is om een pilot op te zetten van rechtepadpleegzorg
Motie van de leden Dobbe en Synhaeve over samen met jeugdhulpmedewerkers, jeugdhulpaanbieders en gemeenten uniforme toetsingskaders voor jeugdhulpaanbieders opstellen
Asks the cabinet to draw up uniform assessment frameworks for youth care providers together with providers, staff and municipalities to reduce administrative burden and inconsistent oversight.
requests the cabinet to draw up, together with youth care staff, providers and municipalities, uniform assessment frameworks for youth care providers
verzoekt het kabinet om samen met jeugdhulpmedewerkers, jeugdhulpaanbieders en gemeenten uniforme toetsingskaders voor jeugdhulpaanbieders op te stellen
Motie van het lid Synhaeve over een plan voor het inzetten van positieve ervaringen met het Mockingbirdmodel voor meer pleegouders
Motion asks the government to present a plan, before the next legislative consultation, on using Mockingbird model experiences to recruit more foster parents.
requests the government, based on these pilots, to come up with a plan before the next legislative consultation
verzoekt de regering op basis van deze pilots voor het volgende wetgevingsoverleg met een plan te komen
Motie van het lid Van den Hil c.s. over het verbeteren van de bekendheid en de samenhang van bestaande verlof- en ondersteuningsregelingen
Asks the minister to improve awareness and coordination of existing leave and support schemes for informal carers.

requests the Minister, together with the Minister of Social Affairs and Employment, employers, employees and municipalities, to improve the awareness and coherence of existing leave and support schemes.

verzoekt de Minister om samen met de Minister van Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid, werkgevers, werknemers en gemeenten de bekendheid en samenhang van bestaande verlof- en ondersteuningsregelingen te verbeteren
Motie van het lid Synhaeve c.s. over medische zorg zonder veiligheidsrisico's voor slachtoffers van huiselijk geweld en jonge vrouwen die geheim geplaatst zijn
Asks the government to ensure medical care without security risks for domestic violence victims and women placed in secret, and to inform the Chamber before summer.
requests the government to ensure these people can receive medical care without security risks and to inform the Chamber before the summer
verzoekt de regering te bewerkstelligen dat deze mensen zonder veiligheidsrisico's medische zorg kunnen ontvangen en de Kamer hierover voor de zomer te informeren
Motie van het lid Synhaeve over stimuleren dat eind 2024 alle zorgaanbieders in de ggz overbruggingszorg aanbieden
Asks the cabinet to encourage all mental health care providers to offer bridging care by the end of 2024 to patients on waiting lists.
requests the cabinet to encourage that by end 2024 all mental health providers offer some form of bridging care
verzoekt het kabinet om te stimuleren dat eind 2024 door alle zorgaanbieders in de ggz een vorm van overbruggingszorg wordt aangeboden
qa: Antwoord op vragen van het lid Synhaeve over misstanden in de pleegzorg

An MP asked the state secretaries whether, given recent reports of abuse of children in foster and family-home care, supervisory bodies failed to intervene, and what steps will improve screening, monitoring, signalling and protection in youth care. The government answered that the inspectorates are investigating, describes existing screening criteria, child-protection duties and planned reforms, but offers no definitive assessment of the specific case.
What exactly happened in the family home is for the inspectorates to investigate.
Wat er precies is voorgevallen in het gezinshuis, is aan de inspecties om te onderzoeken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Synhaeve over het rapport van de Nationale ombudsman getiteld ‘Hoe eerder, hoe beter.Vroegsignalering van schulden door gemeenten’

An MP asked the Minister for Poverty Policy about the Ombudsman's report on municipal early detection of debt problems, including uniformity, minimum standards, reach and knowledge sharing. The minister acknowledged the report, pointed to a fuller government response in May, a Wgs evaluation due early 2025, a forthcoming action plan on basic service provision, and existing measures to raise reach.
In mid-May I will send a comprehensive government response to the Ombudsman's report and then address the specific recommendations in more detail.
Medio mei kom ik met een uitgebreide kabinetsreactie op het rapport van de ombudsman en dan ga ik nader in op de specifieke aanbevelingen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Synhaeve over het bericht over grote verschillen in verslavingszorg

An MP asked the minister about reports of large quality differences in addiction care, patients receiving no care through cherry-picking, and the gap between people with addiction and those receiving treatment. The state secretary acknowledged the signals, pointed to insurers' duty of care and IGJ supervision, and promised a response to the NRV annual report before summer.
As promised in the aforementioned letter, the cabinet will send your House a response to the NRV annual report before the summer recess.
Zoals toegezegd in bovengenoemde brief zal het kabinet uw Kamer voor het zomerreces een reactie op het jaarverslag van de NRV aanbieden.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Synhaeve, Mohandis, Van Kent, Ceder en Koekkoek over de uitspraak van het gerechtshof Den Haag dat de Nederlandse Staat en twee drinkwaterbedrijven onrechtmatig handelen door niet al het r

MPs asked the government to respond to a Hague Court of Appeal ruling that the State and two water companies acted unlawfully by not preventing children from losing access to drinking water, and about measures, a water fund and changes to disconnection rules. The minister answered that the companies will restore supply to occupied homes with children, that a study on child protection including a water fund will be sent to parliament before summer, and that the disconnection regulation will be reviewed.
The judgment calls for action in two areas.
Het arrest vraagt om actie op twee gebieden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Synhaeve over het afwijzen van sociale huurwoningen aan woningzoekenden met een verleden als cliënt in de jeugdzorg

An MP asked the state secretary and minister whether housing corporations refusing social rental homes to former youth-care clients is acceptable, and what will be done to prevent exclusion. The minister says the case was resolved, that a new urgency rule for youth-care leavers is planned via the Wetsvoorstel versterking regie volkshuisvesting, and that programme progress will be reported, while declining to find a violation of equal-treatment law.
With the Housing Governance Strengthening Act I want to ensure the government takes back control to steer how much, where and for whom housing is built now and in the future.
Met de Wet versterking regie op de volkshuisvesting wil ik regelen dat de overheid de regie herneemt om nu en in de toekomst te sturen hoeveel, waar en voor wie er gebouwd wordt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Synhaeve over het bericht dat verantwoordingsorganen (VO’s) meer initiatief kunnen nemen

MP Synhaeve (D66) asked the minister about reports that accountability bodies (verantwoordingsorganen) of pension funds could take more initiative, including the share of elected versus appointed members, diversity, continuity, and their role in investment policy. The minister answered that such composition data are not kept, pointed to existing governance codes, diversity task force plans and a planned follow-up governance study, and stated that accountability bodies can already give opinions on fund policy.
Such data are not kept. The requested overview therefore cannot be provided.
Dergelijke gegevens worden niet bijgehouden. Het gevraagde overzicht kan dan ook niet worden gegeven.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Synhaeve over het bericht ''Red flags' bij bijna 50 procent van de jeugdhulpinstellingen’ en Onderzoek niet-integere bedrijfsvoering jeugdhulp

An MP asked the state secretary for Health, Welfare and Sport how the current supervision structure allows youth care providers to act improperly, whether quality can be assessed beforehand through licensing, whether a joint supervisory structure will be stimulated, how the private equity findings will be used, and when the integrity bill (Wibz) will be submitted. The state secretary answered that improper conduct has no place in youth care, pointed to the Wvbjz and Wibz bills giving the NZa supervisory tasks, committed to exploring licensing with VNG and providers, and gave a timeline of Raad van State advice in the first quarter of 2024.
The bill 'Wet verbetering beschikbaarheid jeugdzorg (Wvbjz)' contains obligations regarding, among other things, the governance structure and financial management of youth care providers.

In het wetsvoorstel «Wet verbetering beschikbaarheid jeugdzorg (Wvbjz)» zijn verplichtingen opgenomen ten aanzien van o.a. de bestuursstructuur en de financiële bedrijfsvoering van jeugdhulpaanbieders.

qn: Antwoord op vragen van de leden Piri en Boswijk over de dreigende sluiting van het Walaardt Sacré Kamp in Huis ter Heide

MPs Piri and Boswijk asked whether the Walaardt Sacré Kamp asylum reception site in Huis ter Heide would close, where Afghan refugees and family members were housed, and about alternative housing, medical care and schooling. The minister answered that the site is being returned to Defence from September 2024, that residents were moved to other locations, and that Defence has repeatedly weighed extensions but needs the site for its own growing organisation.
Defence needs the barracks for its own growing organisation.
Defensie heeft de kazerne nodig voor de eigen groeiende organisatie.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Gabriëls over het bericht ‘Vliegbasis Gilze Rijen en 11 andere Defensieterreinen ernstig verontreinigd met giftig PFAS’

An MP asked the Defence and Infrastructure ministers about reports that Gilze-Rijen air base and eleven other defence sites are heavily contaminated with PFAS, including why the 2013 data was not shared with parliament and what remediation and health measures follow. The government answered that the authorities were informed in 2020-2021, that no health risks were identified for current site use, and that remediation plans and costs will follow once risks are mapped, with a handreiking expected in autumn 2024.

Defence will periodically keep your House informed of the progress of the remediation programme and the results of any follow-up investigations into PFAS contamination on defence sites via the 'Stand van Defensie'.

Defensie zal uw Kamer via de «Stand van Defensie» periodiek op de hoogte houden van de voortgang van het saneringsprogramma en de resultaten van eventuele vervolgonderzoeken naar PFAS-vervuiling op defensieterreinen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Erkens over het bericht 'Poland's capital Warsaw earmarks $30 million for bomb shelters and other security'

An MP asked the ministers whether the government is prepared for worst-case scenarios, how many bomb shelters exist in the Netherlands and whether they are distributed evenly, and whether new shelters are planned. The government answered that it prepares for various threats through crisis plans and coordinates resilience work, but that public shelters have had no role since 1990, the current state of existing shelters is unknown, and no plans for new shelters are known.
The Minister of Defence, on behalf also of the Minister of Justice and Security, has promised a letter to the House on societal resilience in relation to military threats.
De Minister van Defensie heeft, mede namens de Minister van Justitie en Veiligheid, een Kamerbrief toegezegd over de maatschappelijke weerbaarheid in relatie tot militaire dreiging.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Erkens over het rapport 'Optimising Dutch Air and Space Power Policy Recommendations' van het Royal United Services Institute (RUSI)

MP Erkens (VVD) asked the Minister and State Secretary of Defence how the government views the RUSI report's recommendations on Dutch air and space power, including F-35 readiness, noise norms for military airbases, SEAD/DEAD capability, training, and financial implications. The government broadly endorses the need for sustained readiness, stronger SEAD/DEAD capability and growth to at least 2% of GDP, lists measures already taken, and leaves funding decisions to a future cabinet.
The financial implementation of this is a matter for a next cabinet.
Financiële invulling hiervan is aan een volgend kabinet.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Tuinman over het artikel 'Defensie stuurt special forces voor hun gezondheid op cursus sjamanistisch ademhalen'

An MP (Tuinman, BBB) asked the State Secretary of Defence about the BaseQamp pilot, which offered breathing, cold exposure and meditation training to active military personnel, and why it was paused and then stopped after IMG and IVD reviews raised concerns about aftercare, integration with military healthcare and use of unaccredited experience experts. The State Secretary answered most questions, explaining the pilot's funding, its position outside military mental healthcare, and the decision to stop it, while stating BaseQamp is not treatment and that the IMG does not investigate post-service care.
The Inspectorate of Military Health Care received signals from various quarters during 2023 expressing concerns about BaseQamp.
De Inspectie Militaire Gezondheidszorg (IMG) heeft in de loop van 2023 uit verschillende hoeken signalen ontvangen met zorgen over BaseQamp.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Nordkamp over het aanbieden van alternatieve behandelingen aan getraumatiseerde veteranen

MP Nordkamp asked the State Secretary of Defence about the offering of alternative treatments such as BaseQamp to traumatised veterans and whether this is compatible with Defence's duty of care. The State Secretary answered that Defence itself offers no alternative treatments, that the BaseQamp pilot was not a treatment and has been definitively stopped, and that veterans are directed to the Landelijk Zorgsysteem Veteranen.
Defence itself does not offer alternative treatments.
Defensie zelf biedt geen alternatieve behandelingen aan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Erkens over de voorbereidingen voor opschaling van het dienjaar

An MP from the VVD asked the State Secretary for Defence eleven questions on preparing the scale-up of the Dutch military service year, covering facilities, instructors, IT, social partners, intake moments, deployment and the specialist pilot. The government answers that preparations are underway within the armed forces' absorptive capacity, with conditions for 1000 participants in 2025 and 4000 later, though it does not commit to specific timelines or new institutional rules.
For the planned scale-up in 2025 to 1000 service year military personnel, the preconditions are in place.
Voor de geplande opschaling in 2025 naar 1000 dienjaarmilitairen zijn de randvoorwaarden op orde.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Tuinman over het bericht ‘IT-bedrijf Atos dieper in schulden, overheidsklanten nemen maatregelen.’

An MP asked the State Secretary for Defence about reports that IT firm Atos is deep in debt, whether this was reflected in risk analyses for the GrIT programme, how it affects the project's goals, and what the way forward is. The government said it monitors Atos closely with Kyndryl (main contractor) preparing contingency measures, that goals need not change for now, and that details are withheld for commercial confidentiality.
Due to commercial confidentiality, I cannot currently go into further detail on the situation surrounding Atos or the measures being prepared.
Vanwege de commerciële vertrouwelijkheid kan ik op dit moment niet verder ingaan op de situatie rondom Atos of de maatregelen die worden voorbereid.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Podt, Tuinman, Boswijk, Dobbe, Van Oostenbruggen, Nordkamp en Dassen over vrouwen in de krijgsmacht

Seven MPs asked the state secretary about women's advancement, part-time service, childcare, uniforms, sexual misconduct, the frontline role of women and veterans' support in the armed forces. The answers describe incremental measures such as a new part-time leave variant, modular training, a new combat uniform system and a 2023 harassment report count, and state that operational experience is not a formal condition for promotion.
Participation in deployments is not a condition for promotion in rank.
Deelname aan uitzendingen is niet voorwaardelijk om door te groeien in rang.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden de leden Veldkamp, Kahraman en Van Hijum over de voorgenomen sluiting van het Walaardt Sacré Kamp dat sinds de zomer 2021 fungeert als opvanglocatie voor Afghaanse vluchtelingen

Three NSC MPs asked why the Walaardt Sacré Kamp, a Defence-owned Afghan refugee reception site, is being closed and whether closure will be reconsidered. The government answered that, following a motion, the site will wind down gradually to July 2024 in agreement with COA, the municipality and Defence, and that Defence will keep looking for temporary reception support while the site is needed for its own units.
In agreement with COA and in consultation with the municipality of Zeist, Defence has decided to make the site available for longer.
In overeenstemming met het COA en in samenspraak met de gemeente Zeist heeft Defensie besloten om de locatie langer beschikbaar te stellen.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Tuinman over de, op vrijdag 12 januari 2024 plaatsgevonden, door de Verenigde Staten geleide aanvallen op Houthi trainings-, lanceer- en opslaglocaties van drones, raketten, kruisvluchtwape

An MP asked the Defence and Foreign Affairs ministers about Dutch capacity to counter Houthi drone, missile and cruise-missile attacks at sea, the Defence Projects Overview, munitions stocks and deep-strike plans. The minister answered that the Netherlands contributes staff officers to Operation Prosperity Guardian and a US-led coalition, is studying a further maritime contribution, and that acquisition timelines and munitions shortfalls remain constrained by available funds.
Once the study gives reason to do so, your House will be informed.
Zodra het onderzoek hier aanleiding toe geeft, zal uw Kamer worden geïnformeerd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Boswijk, Tuinman en Diederik van Dijk over de mogelijke oprichting van een eigen tankbataljon

MPs Boswijk, Tuinman and Diederik van Dijk asked the government about reviving a national tank battalion, its cost, its links with Germany and the timing of a Leopard 2A8 procurement decision. The government says a tank battalion is not funded and that the decision on it is left to the next cabinet, while giving substantive answers on cost structure, the German cooperation and technology, and withholding only the commercially confidential cost breakdown, which it supplies in a confidential annex.
This cost specification contains commercially confidential elements.
Deze kostenspecificatie bevat commercieel vertrouwelijke elementen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Erkens over het artikel ‘Extra munitie voor Oekraïne vergt enorme investeringen’

An MP asked the Defence ministers how Europe can jointly procure and expand production of ammunition and defence materiel, including tax incentives, pension and bank financing, export treaties and drones. The government answered in general terms, citing joint procurement initiatives, planned consultations and future letters to parliament, without new binding commitments on the scrutiny of the executive.
We will inform your House as soon as possible, by means of a DMP letter, about how this will be implemented and the associated consequences.
Wij zullen uw Kamer door middel van een DMP-brief zo spoedig mogelijk informeren over de invulling hiervan en de daarbij behorende consequenties.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Tuinman over de zorgen van Commandant der Strijdkrachten Onno Eichelsheim over de capaciteit van de Defensieindustrie

An MP from BBB asked the Defence Minister about the Chief of Defence's concerns over defence industry capacity, munitions production timelines, unmanned systems units, MQ-9 drones and the Defensievisie 2035. The Minister answered that existing European framework contracts can meet munitions needs within four years, that unmanned systems will be integrated into existing units rather than separate ones, and that the 2035 vision remains valid in analysis but is being adapted.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Boswijk, Tuinman en Erkens over het artikel ‘NATO’s Vilnius summit: the consequences for the Allies’

MPs Boswijk, Tuinman and Erkens asked the Dutch government about NATO's New Force Model, its personnel implications for small allies and the Netherlands, and related lessons learned. The Minister answered that the personnel needs will only be clear once NATO details the force model, that Dutch constitutional tasks depend on improved personnel levels, and that the Netherlands contributes to lessons-learned work.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Erkens over de voortgang van het dienjaar

An MP asked the State Secretary for Defence about the rollout of the one-year military service (dienjaar), including target numbers, selection, funding and lessons from Scandinavia. The government answered that the scale-up is on schedule, that the aim is to raise military staffing levels, and that it is exploring an enquiry for 17-year-olds and reviewing selection and training capacity.
The one-year service must be seen as a meaningful and valuable way to spend, for example, a gap year.
Het dienjaar moet gezien worden als een zinvolle en waardevolle invulling van bijvoorbeeld een tussenjaar.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kahraman en Van Oostenbruggen over de Maatschappelijke Diensttijd

Two MPs asked the Defence State Secretary about the Dutch national service year (Dienjaar Defensie), including whether 2,000 to 3,000 volunteers per year are needed and whether the government will fund that capacity. The State Secretary answered that scaling up will be gradual to about 1,000 participants in 2025, that current measures are insufficient, and that a mandatory questionnaire for 17-year-olds is being explored.
Defence will need to take additional measures to improve personnel readiness.
Defensie zal aanvullende maatregelen moeten nemen om de personele gereedheid te verbeteren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Krul en Kuik over begeleiding van probleemjongeren door de krijgsmacht

CDA MPs Krul and Kuik asked whether the Landmacht's BBJ-KL programme for at-risk youth, with 240 participants and 28 becoming soldiers, is successful, and whether it should be improved, expanded, linked to Justice's Preventie met Gezag, or combined with work and education. The State Secretary for Defence answered that the programme is not a core Defence task but is partly successful (136 returned to school or work), that expansion is capped at 200 youths a year with no added staff, that municipalities can refer youths, and that cooperation with Justice is being considered while broader goals are rejected.
Municipalities can refer youths to this guidance programme.
Gemeenten kunnen jongeren voordragen voor dit begeleidingstraject.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Fritsma over chroom-6 zaken

An MP asked the State Secretary of Defence about chromium-6 exposure at NATO POMS sites, including safety data sheets, bowel cancer, PBM quality, compensation and widow claims. The government answered that the RIVM found no sufficient link for bowel cancer, defended the compensation scheme and its causal-link requirement, acknowledged past failures in the employer's duty of care, and offered some adjustments such as wider survivor entitlements.
For privacy reasons I cannot go into individual files.
Vanwege privacy redenen kan ik niet in gaan op individuele dossiers.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Eerdmans en Eppink over ‘de Nedcar-fabriek in Born helpen omschakelen naar een fabriek voor militaire voertuigen’

MPs Eerdmans and Eppink asked whether the government would help convert the VDL Nedcar plant in Born to military vehicle production after BMW's Mini production ends in 2024, and about Chinese state-owned involvement in Dutch military vehicles. The minister said the plant is unsuited to military series production, that the government will facilitate contacts and support any viable initiative, and referred to defence procurement screening and a forthcoming investment-screening law.

The cabinet considers employment at VDL Nedcar of great importance for the regional labour market and the liveability of the area, and has therefore pledged its cooperation in finding solutions to preserve it.

Het kabinet acht de werkgelegenheid bij VDL Nedcar van groot belang voor de regionale arbeidsmarkt en de leefbaarheid van het gebied en heeft dan ook haar medewerking toegezegd om oplossingen te vinden voor het behoud ervan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Piri over het bericht dat militairen zelf moeten boeten voor de misstanden die ze melden

An MP asks the State Secretary of Defence about reports that soldiers who report misconduct are themselves punished, including questions on career consequences, independence of the COID, procedures, confidentiality and protection of whistleblowers. The government answers that Defence protects reporters, rejects retaliation, describes its procedures and monitoring, and commits to a feedback evaluation and further improvements.
Defence therefore does not accept it when commanders or supervisors confront reporters with this.
Defensie accepteert het dan ook niet wanneer commandanten of leidinggevenden melders hiermee confronteren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Futselaar over een hardnekkige misstandencultuur bij Defensie

The SP MP Futselaar asked the State Secretary of Defence about a persistent culture of misconduct at Defence, including alleged intimidation (loosened car wheel bolts), whether whistleblowing is effective, the independence of the COID and the Giebels follow-up, and settlement agreements with reporters. The State Secretary acknowledged that reporting remains a work in progress, rejected claims of a repressive culture and of a lack of COID independence, and stated that the COID and MID remain in place, with an ongoing culture investigation to be reported later.
Defence does not disclose the content of financial agreements made between Defence and reporters of suspected misconduct and recorded in a settlement agreement.
Defensie doet geen mededelingen over de inhoud van financiële afspraken die door Defensie en melders van een vermoeden van een misstand zijn gemaakt en vastgelegd in een vaststellingsovereenkomst.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Boswijk over het bericht 'Meer ambitie bij het opleiden van militairen'

MP Boswijk (CDA) asked the State Secretary of Defence about training capacity shortages, outsourcing of military training to civilian providers, and expansion of the Dienjaar Defensie programme. The State Secretary answered that Defence is pursuing civilian cooperation, insourcing and outsourcing where feasible, and gradual scaling of the Dienjaar, while most questions were answered substantively without concrete new commitments beyond further study.
Finally, on-the-job training will become increasingly important, so that regular courses can be shortened.
Ten slotte zal het opleiden op de werkplek steeds belangrijker worden, waardoor reguliere opleidingen kunnen worden verkort.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk over de erkenning voor een zieke militair na het gebruik van PX-10

Jasper van Dijk (SP) asked the State Secretary of Defence whether a sick soldier's recognition after PX-10 use shows a causal link and whether all PX-10-exposed personnel should be medically examined or supported by a damage fund. The State Secretary maintains there is no causal link under the 2011 RIVM findings, admits the pension was wrongly assessed under the pre-2011 framework without reversing it, and declines a medical re-examination or special fund.
I must note that the EenVandaag report you refer to repeats incorrect claims about the study.
Ik moet constateren dat er in het bericht van EenVandaag waar u naar verwijst onjuiste stellingen worden herhaald over het onderzoek.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Valstar over het artikel Chinees staatsbedrijf bouwt onze pantservoertuigen

An MP asked the government about reports that Visser B.V., a defence contractor building armoured vehicle components, is owned by a Chinese state-owned company, and whether a required security check and notification after the takeover took place. The State Secretary answered that Visser had not notified a November 2022 change in ownership despite holding an ABDO authorisation, that Defence is in discussion with the firm about consequences, and that a sectoral investment screening law and the Wet vifo are planned.
Visser BV did not do this; Defence is in discussion with the company and is considering what consequences should be attached to it.
Visser BV heeft dit niet gedaan; Defensie is hierover met het bedrijf in gesprek en beziet welke consequenties daaraan verbonden worden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Segers over het bericht ‘Luitenant-Kolonel van Woensel: 'De landmachtbrigades schieten op meerdere punten tekort'

An ChristenUnie MP asked the Defence ministers about a news report quoting an army officer that the Dutch army brigades fall short on several points, including NATO-identified shortcomings, the Dutch-German tank battalion cooperation, and tank availability. The government answered that the brigades are assessed as high quality, that some NATO-identified gaps are not addressed under current choices, that cooperation with Germany is considered good and will be evaluated and deepened, and that it will inform parliament on the integration.
The Netherlands supports sharing burdens and risks among allies (risk- and burden-sharing) and also makes a military contribution to this.
Nederland is voorstander van het verdelen van lasten en risico's tussen de bondgenoten (risk- en burden-sharing) en levert daar ook een militaire bijdrage aan.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt en Jasper van Dijk over een klokkenluiderszaak bij de Centrale Organisatie Integriteit Defensie

MPs Omtzigt and Jasper van Dijk asked about the status, composition and method of the investigation into alleged misconduct at the defence integrity office COID, the earlier inventory study, and the treatment of two whistleblowers. The State Secretary answered that the probe restarted in February 2023 with a revised scope, names its members, declines to disclose the mandate or details about the whistleblowers for privacy reasons, and promises to report the results once completed.
Once the Commission has completed the investigation, I will inform your House of the results of this investigation.
Nadat de Commissie het onderzoek heeft voltooid, zal ik uw Kamer berichten over de resultaten van dit onderzoek.
Antwoord op vragen die door het lid Valstar over het Zwitserse exportcontrole-regime in relatie tot het artikel ‘German ammunition plant to sidestep Swiss re-export ban’ in de Zwitserse media

An MP asked the Defence ministry about Swiss-made ammunition in Dutch stocks, Swiss re-export restrictions affecting supplies to Ukraine, and EU defence funding access for Swiss-linked firms. The government confirmed Swiss-produced 35mm and 30mm ammunition, declined to disclose stock levels as NATO-confidential, and said Switzerland's re-export policy is a sovereign matter while it urges Swiss producers to act in the Ukraine situation.
Because the NATO stock requirements for these ammunition types are confidential, I cannot inform you publicly about the stock of these munitions.
Omdat de opgedragen NAVO-voorraadnormen voor deze munitiesoorten vertrouwelijk zijn, kan ik u niet in het openbaar informeren over de voorraad van deze munitieartikelen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Eppink over de komst van een grote militaire kazerne in Zeewolde

An MP asks the State Secretary for Defence about the decision-making stage, expected personnel figures, the reasons for choosing Zeewolde, financing, and the impact on farmers, and whether lobbying by the Flevoland Commissioner of the King played a role. The State Secretary answers that the site is a provisional preferred location pending talks with the provinces and municipalities, declines to comment on the Commissioner's statements, and says the final site and financing are not yet decided.
Sharing the possible locations in Flevoland does not currently benefit the process, because talks with the provinces and municipalities are ongoing.
Het delen van de mogelijke locaties in Flevoland komt het proces op dit moment niet ten goede omdat de gesprekken met de provincies en gemeenten gevoerd worden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Hammelburg over het bericht dat oudgedienden van de Britse luchtmacht training geven en kennis overdragen aan de Chinese krijgsmacht

An MP asked the Defence Minister about reports that former British RAF pilots were being recruited to train Chinese army pilots, and what the Netherlands does about Chinese recruitment of military veterans and whether current law prevents personnel from working for foreign powers. The minister called the reports worrying, pointed to MIVD investigations without giving details, explained the existing rules (desertion rules, confidentiality duties, security screening that can lead to withdrawal of clearance) and said the cabinet is considering further action with the UK and partners.
Due to the classified nature of this investigation, no public statements can be made about it.
Vanwege het gerubriceerde karakter van dit onderzoek kunnen hierover in het openbaar geen uitspraken worden gedaan.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Valstar en Van Strien over het bericht ‘Scheepsbouwer IHC in zwaar weer: zo’n 250 personeelsleden ontslagen en werf in Krimpen tijdelijk dicht’

MPs Valstar and Van Strien asked about IHC's shipyard layoffs and whether closer cooperation with industry could speed up naval maintenance backlogs. The government answered that about half of naval maintenance is already outsourced to industry, that a backlog is manageable, and that talks with the maritime sector are ongoing.
Defence is exploring, within procurement rules, ways to further simplify and improve cooperation with and between maritime industry companies.
Defensie verkent de mogelijkheden om – binnen de aanbestedingsregelgeving – te komen tot verdere vereenvoudiging en verbetering van de samenwerking met en tussen bedrijven uit de maritieme industrie
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Valstar en Boswijk over het artikel 'Munitie-tekort explodeert: problemen met locaties en vergunningen voor kogelfabrieken'

MPs Valstar and Boswijk asked the Defence and Economic Affairs ministers about Dutch dependence on imported ammunition, the lack of domestic munitions factories, and permitting barriers for new production sites. The government acknowledged the strategic dependence and the value of European cooperation, but said it will not pursue active policy to restart domestic munitions production, that no Defence sites are available, and that the timeline is unknown.
There are no more ammunition factories in the Netherlands. If they were to come, that would be good, but we will not pursue active policy on this.
Er zijn geen munitiefabrieken meer in Nederland. Als die er zouden komen is dat goed, maar we gaan hier geen actief beleid op voeren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Valstar over het nieuwsbericht ‘Poland will lease MQ-9A Reapers to fill the UAV capability gap’

An MP asked the State Secretary for Defence whether the acquisition of four extra MQ-9A Reapers was delayed, why the order was not placed by late August despite parliamentary approval, and why parliament was not informed via the Defence Projects Overview. The government denied any delay, said the purchase was postponed only to renegotiate financial conditions with the US, and said the contract can now be signed in 2023 without delivery delay.
Since there is no delay in the acquisition process, this was not reported in the Defence Projects Overview.
Aangezien er geen sprake is van vertraging in het verwervingstraject, is dit niet gemeld in het Defensie Projecten Overzicht.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Valstar over het bericht ‘Pentagon suspends F-35 deliveries over Chinese alloy in magnet’

MP Valstar asked the government about reports that the Pentagon suspended F-35 deliveries over a Chinese alloy in a magnet, and whether countries with offensive intelligence programmes against the Netherlands should be excluded from defence supply chains. The government answered that Dutch rules exclude companies via the ABDO security screening and cited refusal counts, declined to name specific cases, and described US and EU supply-chain restrictions while noting Dutch law does not exclude countries in advance.
Specific cases I cannot share with your House via this route because of the sensitive and confidential nature of this information.
Specifieke casussen kan ik vanwege het gevoelige en vertrouwelijke karakter van deze informatie niet langs deze weg met uw Kamer delen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sneller en Bromet over de openbare agenda van bewindspersonen

MPs Sneller and Bromet asked all ministers about the public agendas of cabinet members and how the motion on publishing them is being implemented. The Finance ministers answered that they will follow the agreed guidelines, have updated their agendas, and can answer individually for them.
Yes. In the run-up to the Rutte IV cabinet taking office, the public agenda of cabinet members was discussed several times in the Voorlichtingsraad.
Ja. In aanloop naar het aantreden van het kabinet-Rutte IV is de openbare agenda van de bewindslieden meermaals onderwerp van gesprek geweest in de Voorlichtingsraad.
Antwoord op de vragen van het lid Van Haga over diversiteit en inclusiviteit bij Defensie

Van Haga asks the State Secretary for Defence about personnel shortages, the justification for a 30% female target, the KMA study on gender norms, and whether preferential policy for women works against recruitment and selection on quality. The State Secretary answers that recruitment is needed, that the 30% target is an ambitious, analysed goal to be set by the defence leadership, that it is a target rather than a quota, and that quality remains leading in selection.
We are going to work with target figures and not with a quota.
We gaan werken met streefcijfers en niet met een quotum.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Eppink over de brief Diversiteit en Inclusiviteit bij Defensie van 29 maart 2022

An MP from JA21 asks the State Secretary of Defence why diversity and inclusion targets, including preferential treatment for women, are being pursued amid staffing shortages, and whether such policy conflicts with equality rules and disadvantages male personnel. The State Secretary answers that the measures address understaffing and quality-based selection remains decisive, while acknowledging downsides and declining to commission some requested analyses.
No, this depends on many factors such as broader labour market developments and economic trends.
Nee, dit is van vele factoren afhankelijk zoals ook de bredere arbeidsmarkt-ontwikkelingen en economische trends.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sneller en Bromet over de openbare agenda’s

MPs Sneller and Bromet asked all ministers about the handling of the motion on public agendas of ministers and whether the 2022 guidance and the Open State findings on non-compliance would be acted upon. The Minister of Defence answered that the guidance has been adopted, that agendas will be retroactively updated and kept compliant, and that each minister can answer individually.
We will update the public agendas with retroactive effect.
Wij zullen de openbare agenda’s met terugwerkende kracht bijwerken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sneller en Bromet over hun openbare agenda

MPs Sneller and Bromet asked all ministers about the publication and completeness of their public agendas under the motion on ministerial agendas. Minister Schreinemacher answered that she accepts the motion and the 2022 guidance notes, will update her agenda retroactively to her appointment, and that all ministers can answer individually.
I will update my public agenda retroactively to the moment of my appointment.
Ik zal mijn openbare agenda met terugwerkende kracht bijwerken tot aan het moment van mijn aantreden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sneller en Bromet over de openbare agenda van bewindspersonen

MPs Sneller and Bromet asked all ministers about compliance with the motion and guidance on publishing their public agendas, including whether the requirements were being met and whether agendas would be corrected retroactively. Minister Hoekstra answered that he accepts the guidance, acknowledges his agenda is not yet fully compliant, and will update it retroactively to his appointment.
I will update my public agenda retroactively to the moment of my appointment.
Ik zal mijn openbare agenda met terugwerkende kracht bijwerken tot aan het moment van mijn aantreden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sneller en Bromet over "hun openbare agenda

MPs Sneller and Bromet asked all ministers about compliance with the motion and guidance on publishing their public agendas, including whether agendas are complete and whether they will be retroactively corrected. Ministers Van Gennip and Schouten answered that the Voorlichtingsraad handbook now serves as the instruction, that agendas are published a week ahead with corrections for the past week, and that they will answer jointly rather than individually.
That is why it was chosen to publish one week ahead and to correct the past week so that the picture afterwards is correct.
Daarom is ervoor gekozen een week vooruit te publiceren en de afgelopen week te corrigeren zodat het beeld achteraf correct is.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sneller en Bromet over de openbare agenda

MPs Sneller and Bromet asked all ministers about compliance with the motion and guidance on public ministerial agendas, including the low share of agenda entries meeting the required standards. The minister answered that EZK largely follows the guidance, will improve some points, will backdate its public agenda to the start of office, and that the answers are given jointly for all EZK ministers.
I will update my public agenda retroactively to the moment of my appointment.
Ik zal mijn openbare agenda met terugwerkende kracht bijwerken tot aan het moment van mijn aantreden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sneller en Bromet over onze openbare agenda

MPs Sneller and Bromet asked the ministers and state secretary of OCW and PO about how their public agendas are kept and whether they comply with the motion and the Rijksvoorlichtingsdienst guidance on public agendas. The government answers that agendas are kept systematically and categorised, acknowledges incomplete entries such as missing contact persons and topic descriptions, and commits to correcting agendas retroactively and to consistent future compliance.
We will update the public agenda retroactively in line with the previously mentioned improvement points.
Wij werken de openbare agenda met terugwerkende kracht bij volgens de eerder genoemde verbeterpunten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sneller en Bromet over de openbare agenda van bewindspersonen

MPs Sneller and Bromet asked all ministers how the motion on public ministerial agendas was raised, whether it will be implemented, and how compliance will be improved after a study found most agenda entries lack required information. Minister Helder answered that she will update her agenda retroactively, add contact details and descriptions, follow the agreed guidelines, and confirm she can answer individually.
I will update my public agenda retroactively to the moment of my appointment as Minister in the Rutte IV cabinet.
Ik zal mijn openbare agenda met terugwerkende kracht bijwerken tot aan het moment van mijn aantreden als Minister van kabinet-Rutte IV.

MPs Sneller and Bromet asked all ministers how the motion on public agendas of office-holders was handled, whether it will be implemented, and whether agendas comply with the guidelines. Minister Staghouwer answered that the motion is being implemented through a VoRa note with improvements such as contact details and categorisation, that his own agenda is already updated and compliant, and that he will continue to comply.
I already keep my agenda as far as possible in line with the agreements in the note 'Public agenda office-holders' and will continue to do so for the rest of this cabinet period.
Ik houd mijn agenda op dit moment al zoveel mogelijk bij conform de afspraken uit de notitie «Openbare agenda bewindslieden» en zal dit ook voor de rest van deze kabinetsperiode blijven doen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Eppink over het persbericht van de provincie Drenthe dat het sluiten van de Johan Willem Frisokazerne een 'serieuze optie' is voor de Staatssecretaris

MP Eppink (JA21) asked the State Secretary of Defence why closing the Johan Willem Friso barracks in Assen is considered a serious option, and about regional job losses, the DVO's investments and consultation, and compensation for Assen. The State Secretary answered that Defence is in an exploratory phase of concentrating, greening and renewing its property, that job retention in the region is the aim, that no decisions have been taken, and that regional partners will be consulted.
Defence is still in the exploratory phase of concentrating, greening and renewing its property, and no decisions have yet been taken.
Defensie bevindt zich nog in de verkenningsfase van het concentreren, verduurzamen en vernieuwen van het vastgoed en er zijn nog geen besluiten genomen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Agnes Mulder en Boswijk over het persbericht van de provincie Drenthe dat het kabinet overweegt de Johan Willem Frisokazerne te sluiten

CDA MPs Agnes Mulder and Boswijk asked the State Secretary for Defence whether the Johan Willem Friso barracks in Assen will be closed, on what grounds, what has been invested, what the regional impact is, and how other ministries' decisions are coordinated. The State Secretary answered that no decision has been taken, the barracks is part of an internal real-estate review, regional impact will be discussed with local partners, and a letter with first contours will follow in April.
It is therefore too simplistic to say that I intend to close the Johan Willem Friso barracks, but this barracks is part of this review.
Het is dus te kort door de bocht om te stellen dat ik voornemens ben de Johan Willem Frisokazerne te sluiten, maar deze kazerne maakt wel onderdeel uit van deze verkenning.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Hammelburg en Boulakjar over het Strategisch Vastgoedplan

MPs Hammelburg and Boulakjar asked the State Secretary for Defence how many of Defence's buildings are urban or rural, which are suitable for housing or greening, which lie in large cities, and which 35-40% of the property portfolio will be divested. The State Secretary answered that Defence does not define urban or rural, that suitability for housing is for regional authorities to judge, that no decision on divestment has been taken, and that the contours of the internal review will be shared in April.
No decision has yet been taken on which buildings or sites Defence wants to leave.
Er is nog geen besluit genomen over welke gebouwen of terreinen Defensie wil verlaten.
